jobs.title: AI Engineer - Mid-Level

model performance, accuracy, and efficiency in production environments * Research and implement state\-of\-the\-art AI/ML techniques and frameworks * Contribute to code reviews, documentation, and model interactions. * Evaluate implementation options based on response quality, latency, security, and cost. **Webex Contact Center and Webex AI Agents** * Build, configure, test, and enhance AI agents for Cisco Webex Contact Center. * Develop conversational flows that support customer self\-service and defined business use cases. * Integrate Webex AI agents with enterprise APIs, business applications, and knowledge sources. * Implement escalation and handoff to human agents, preserving relevant interaction context. * Collaborate with contact center stakeholders to clarify routing, workflow, and customer experience requirements. * Test conversational behavior, integration reliability, fallback handling, and end\-to\-end customer journeys. * Monitor interactions and recommend improvements to response quality and task completion. **AI Agents and MCP Integration** * Build AI agents that use approved tools and APIs to complete defined tasks. * Implement tool calling, workflow orchestration, state management, and appropriate human approval steps. * Develop or integrate MCP servers that expose authorized tools, resources, and enterprise services to AI applications. * document ingestion, extraction, cleaning, chunking, and embedding workflows. * Integrate vector databases or search platforms to support semantic retrieval. * Improve retrieval relevance, source attribution, and response groundedness. * Connect AI applications to structured and unstructured data sources while respecting access permissions. **APIs, Cloud, and Deployment** * Build and consume REST APIs using frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask. * Integrate AI services with enterprise applications, databases, and third\-party platforms. * Deploy and support applications using approved Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud services. * Contribute to containerization, CI/CD pipelines, configuration management, and secure secrets handling. * Monitor application performance, availability, and resource consumption. **Quality, Security, and Collaboration** * Create meaningful tests and evaluation datasets for AI features. * Assess response accuracy, tool\-use correctness, reliability, latency, and operating costs. * Address risks such as prompt injection, sensitive data exposure, and unauthorized tool execution. * Participate in code reviews, troubleshooting, release validation, and Agile delivery. * Maintain technical documentation and communicate progress, dependencies, and issues clearly. **Requirements:** * 2–4 years of experience in AI/ML engineering or a related software engineering role * Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit\-learn * Experience with NLP, computer vision, or generative AI is a strong plus * Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and MLOps practices * Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and statistical modeling * Experience with SQL/NoSQL databases  Experience building or consuming REST APIs and working with JSON. * Familiarity with AI agent tool calling and workflow orchestration. * Understanding of MCP concepts and how MCP servers connect AI applications to tools and resources. * Working knowledge of SQL, data processing, and application integration. * Experience with at least one major cloud platform: Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. * Familiarity with Git, testing, and collaborative software development. * Clear communication skills and the ability to work with technical and business stakeholders. * Experience developing and deploying RAG applications. * Hands\-on experience building MCP servers or integrating MCP clients. * Familiarity with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or comparable tools. * Experience with vector databases or search technologies such as pgvector, Pinecone, OpenSearch, or Azure AI Search. * Experience with contact center workflows, routing, human\-agent handoff, and conversational analytics. * Familiarity with speech\-to\-text, text\-to\-speech, and voice\-based AI applications. * Experience with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, asynchronous Python, or event\-driven integrations. * Understanding of AI architecture patterns, scalability, observability, and cost optimization. * Experience supporting enterprise or healthcare\-related applications. **Technology Stack** * Programming: Python, SQL * Application Frameworks: FastAPI, Flask * Generative AI: LLM APIs, prompt engineering, structured outputs, embeddings * Contact Center: Cisco Webex Contact Center, Webex AI agents, conversational flows, human\-agent handoff * Agents and Connectivity: AI agents, tool calling, MCP servers and clients * Retrieval: RAG, semantic search, vector databases * Integrations: REST APIs, JSON, enterprise systems * Cloud: Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud * Delivery: Git, Docker, CI/CD, automated testing, logging, and monitoring Experience with every listed tool is jobs.title: Agentic AI/LLM Engineer, Coverage Intelligence
jobs.description: **YOUR ROLE** As an Agentic AI / LLM Engineer on the Coverage Intelligence team, you design and build the AI systems that turn complex insurance documents into reliable, explainable coverage intelligence inside the Digital Exchange, powered by DeX ai. You own problems end to end, from understanding unstructured documents to building agents that reason about coverage, and you hold that work to a measurable standard of accuracy. You work alongside our coverage and ontology specialists and help shape how the team builds with AI as the technology evolves. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Design, build and own production AI systems for document understanding and coverage analysis. * Build agentic workflows that combine models, tools and human review, and recognize when a decision needs an expert. * Ground outputs in source documents and domain knowledge so every result is traceable and explainable. * Drive accuracy through evaluation, experimentation and error analysis against expert\-labeled data. * Make sound trade\-offs across models and providers on accuracy, cost and latency. * Partner with domain experts and engineers to turn expert judgment into durable system behavior. * Help set the team’s technical direction as LLM and agent capabilities evolve. * Other duties and responsibilities as assigned. **YOUR LOCATION** This is a fully remote role, with the exception of onboarding and optional in\-office events. **SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS** * 5\+ years’ experience in software engineering or applied machine learning, including 2\+ years building LLM applications in production. * Strong Python skills, including typed schemas for structured output (e.g., Pydantic). * Hands\-on experience extracting structured data from complex documents using PDF parsing, OCR and vision\-language models. * Experience with agentic patterns such as tool use, multi\-step workflows, self\-verification and human\-in\-the\-loop review. * Experience with retrieval\-augmented generation, embeddings and source\-grounded output. * A rigorous approach to evaluation: defining metrics, building test sets and doing systematic error analysis. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including working directly with domain experts. * Works autonomously with minimal direction, sets a clear path through ambiguity, and holds a high bar for quality. * Thrives on the energy of a start up: comfortable with pace, changing priorities, and building the function while running it. * Experience with insurance, legal, financial or other contract\-heavy documents (strongly preferred). * Experience with LangGraph or similar agent frameworks (preferred). * Experience with LLM observability and evaluation tooling (preferred). **Physical Requirements** * Must be able to sit/stand/walk for prolonged periods of time (up to 8 hours per day), at a desk working on a computer. * Must be able to use standard office equipment for extended periods of time, including but not limited to, a mouse, keyboard, phone and video conferencing. * Must be able to travel to the Bold Penguin office in Dublin, Ohio for New Hire Onboarding \& Orientation (2 days, 2 nights); travel costs are covered by Bold Penguin. * Must be able to travel occasionally (up to 10%) for corporate events and team planning sessions. Bold Penguin is the premier digital broker for commercial insurance. Their technology expands top\-of\-funnel demand and increases yield for enterprise partners. Through digital distribution, wholesale capabilities, and AI\-driven insights, they transform the lifecycle of both simple and complex risks, from prospecting to placement. **Benefits** We offer competitive compensation and progressive benefits that include: * Medical, Dental, and Vision * Flexible PTO Policy * 401(k) with a company match * Employee Assistance Program * Parental Leave * Disability and Life Benefits **Stay connected to the Glacier.** We have great SLACK channels for work and play. jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Location: Philadelphia, PA Employment Type: Full\-Time \| Permanent About the Role Copperline Systems is seeking an experienced Automation Engineer to support the design, development and improvement of industrial automation and control systems. This is an opportunity for an engineer who enjoys solving technical problems, working with complex systems and seeing the results of their work in real operating environments. We're looking for someone who combines strong technical knowledge with a practical, hands\-on approach. Someone who can work through a challenging controls issue, identify the underlying cause and develop a reliable solution that supports long\-term operational performance. The successful candidate will be involved in automation projects from initial design and development through to testing, commissioning and ongoing optimization. You'll work alongside engineering and technical teams to improve system reliability, efficiency and overall performance. Key ResponsibilitiesAutomation \& Controls Engineering * Design, develop, program and maintain industrial automation and control systems. * Develop and modify PLC programs to support automated equipment and manufacturing processes. * Configure, integrate and troubleshoot Human\-Machine Interface (HMI) and Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) systems. * Support the integration of sensors, actuators, variable frequency drives, instrumentation and other control components. * Develop control logic, system specifications and technical documentation. * Evaluate existing automation systems and identify opportunities to improve reliability, efficiency and performance. * Ensure automation solutions align with applicable engineering, operational and safety standards. System Integration \& Project Delivery * Participate in automation projects from initial requirements gathering through to implementation and commissioning. * Work with engineering teams, equipment suppliers and other stakeholders to define system requirements. * Support Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) and system validation activities. * Assist with equipment installation, start\-up, commissioning and performance testing. * Troubleshoot integration issues involving hardware, software, industrial networks and control systems. * Maintain accurate engineering documentation, including electrical drawings, control narratives and system configuration records. * Support project schedules, technical deliverables and implementation milestones. Troubleshooting \& Continuous Improvement * Diagnose and resolve automation\-related equipment faults, control system failures and performance issues. * Investigate recurring technical problems and implement corrective actions to improve system reliability. * Collaborate with maintenance, operations and engineering personnel to minimize equipment downtime. * Analyze equipment performance and recommend automation improvements. * Support upgrades, modifications and modernization of existing control systems. * Identify opportunities to improve system efficiency, safety and maintainability. Qualifications \& Experience Required Qualifications * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Controls Engineering, Mechatronics or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * Professional experience designing, programming or maintaining industrial automation systems. * Strong working knowledge of PLC programming and industrial control systems. * Experience with HMI and SCADA development, configuration or troubleshooting. * Understanding of industrial communication protocols such as EtherNet/IP, Modbus, Profinet or OPC UA. * Familiarity with electrical control systems, instrumentation, sensors and motor controls. * Experience troubleshooting automation equipment and diagnosing complex technical issues. * Ability to interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams and technical documentation. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving and organizational skills. * Ability to communicate effectively with engineering teams, technical personnel and project stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with Rockwell Automation / Allen\-Bradley or Siemens PLC platforms. * Familiarity with Studio 5000, RSLogix, TIA Portal or comparable programming environments. * Experience with industrial robotics, motion control or servo systems. * Knowledge of industrial networking and control system integration. * Experience supporting manufacturing, process automation or industrial equipment. * Familiarity with applicable electrical and machine safety standards, including NFPA 70, NFPA 79 or relevant OSHA requirements. * Experience participating in equipment commissioning, FAT or SAT activities. * Exposure to automation project management or multidisciplinary engineering projects. What We're Looking For Technical experience is important, but so is the way you approach your work. We're looking for an engineer who is methodical when troubleshooting, thoughtful when developing solutions and comfortable taking ownership of technical challenges. You'll be someone who can work independently when needed but understands the importance of collaboration, particularly when projects involve multiple engineering disciplines. You should be able to explain technical issues clearly, document your work accurately and recognize the importance of delivering automation systems that are safe, reliable and maintainable. We're particularly interested in candidates who enjoy continuous improvement and are motivated by finding better ways to design, operate and support automated systems. Why Consider Copperline Systems? This position offers the opportunity to apply your automation expertise to engineering challenges and contribute to the development and improvement of control systems. The role is intended to provide: * Involvement in automation and control system projects from development through commissioning. * Opportunities to work with PLCs, HMI/SCADA platforms and industrial control technologies. * Collaboration with engineering, technical and operational teams. * Scope to contribute ideas and improvements to existing automation processes. * Opportunities to expand your technical knowledge and take ownership of engineering responsibilities. * Exposure to practical engineering challenges where your work can have a measurable operational impact. How to Apply If you're an Automation Engineer with a strong background in industrial controls and a genuine interest in solving complex technical problems, we'd welcome your application. Please submit your resume outlining your relevant engineering experience, automation platforms and technical project involvement. Candidates with experience in PLC programming, controls integration, commissioning and industrial troubleshooting are particularly encouraged to apply. Copperline Systems welcomes applications from qualified candidates with diverse professional backgrounds and experiences. Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $116,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Backend Engineer (Python / FastAPI)
jobs.description: Rim Universe is building an AI\-native platform for animated and serialized video content creation. Our platform helps creators transform ideas and scripts into structured production workflows, including story development, character creation, episode and shot planning, AI image/video generation, and editing. We are currently expanding our engineering team and looking for a **Backend Engineer** to help build the core backend infrastructure powering our platform. If you're passionate about AI video creation, we'd love to have you join our team and help turn more great stories into amazing videos! About the Role As a Backend Engineer at Rim Universe, you will be responsible for building and maintaining backend systems supporting **AI model integrations, generation workflows, media asset management, and user/project data**. You will work closely with our AI and product teams to build reliable, scalable backend services that support AI\-powered content generation in a production environment. Responsibilities * Design, develop, and maintain backend services using **Python and FastAPI** * Build and maintain **REST APIs** for our platform * Integrate third\-party APIs, including **LLM, image generation, and video generation models** * Design and optimize **PostgreSQL** databases and queries * Build asynchronous AI generation workflows, including task queues, status tracking, retries, failure handling, and webhooks * Develop backend systems for users, projects, generated content, and media assets * Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot services in **Docker/Linux** environments * Improve system reliability, scalability, maintainability, and performance * Collaborate with AI, frontend, and product team members to deliver production\-ready features Requirements * **2\+ years** of backend development experience, with at least one project taken through development, launch and ongoing maintenance. * Strong **Python** skills and hands\-on production experience with **FastAPI** or **Django**. Able to quickly read and maintain an existing codebase. * Experience with **PostgreSQL**, database design, and SQL optimization. * Understands how background job systems work: job state machines, **leases and heartbeats**, timeouts, **retries**, **idempotency** and **failure recovery**. Familiar with reliable messaging patterns such as the **transactional outbox**. Has used **Redis** (Streams, locks or queues). * Experience integrating **third\-party HTTP APIs**, including authentication, **async callbacks**, **status polling**, **rate limiting** and **error classification**. Understands why a **pay\-per\-call API** must not be blindly retried when the outcome of a call is unknown. * Experience with **LLM API** integration, **prompt template** management or **agent** development. * Familiar with object storage such as **S3** or **MinIO**: **presigned URLs**, uploads and downloads, and **access control**. Able to guarantee **multi\-tenant data isolation**. * Comfortable with **Linux**, **Docker / Docker Compose** and **Git**. Able to investigate logs, manage secrets, run backup and restore, and write tests for critical flows. Nice to Have * Hands\-on work on **AI video, image or speech generation**, or audio/video processing; familiarity with **FFmpeg**. * Experience with the **ComfyUI API** or building **multi\-step generation workflows** (e.g. speech synthesis → video generation → lip sync). * Experience building **Stripe** payments, subscriptions, credit ledgers or usage\-based billing. * Experience optimizing generation job performance, analyzing model costs or planning service capacity. * Working knowledge of **Node.js / TypeScript** (our frontend BFF uses Next.js). * Experience with global SaaS products. What We’re Looking For We’re looking for someone who can take ownership of backend systems from maintaining through deployment. You should think beyond simply implementing APIs and consider system reliability, maintainability, scalability, and production performance when designing solutions. Rim Universe is moving quickly, so we value engineers who can work independently, solve problems proactively, and communicate clearly with the team. Pay: $30\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour Benefits: * 401(k) * Employee discount * Flexible schedule Language: * Mandarin (Preferred) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Clinical Trials Platform (Python, Django, Angular)
jobs.description: **Job Overview** Meadow Health is a 50 state telehealth practice providing precision care for neurodevelopmental conditions. We run our own multitenant care platform and are extending it to support decentralized clinical trials, from remote recruitment and prescreening through eConsent, remote visits, ePRO, data capture and sponsor reporting. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to build these capabilities hands on, end to end, in Python, Django, Angular, PostgreSQL and AWS CDK. This role sits at the intersection of engineering and clinical research: you will build, validate and document software that will be inspected under FDA 21 CFR Part 11, ICH E6(R3\) Good Clinical Practice, IRB and HIPAA expectations. The screening tools you build flag, explain and document, while investigators and clinicians make the decisions. You will report to the CEO and have early ownership of the clinical research architecture of a platform used in real patient care. **Duties** * Design and ship features across the stack in Python, Django and Django REST Framework, Angular and TypeScript, and PostgreSQL, running on AWS with infrastructure defined in AWS CDK. * Build online prescreen questionnaires, consent to contact registries and a versioned, protocol driven inclusion and exclusion rules engine whose results ("likely met," "likely not met," "needs review") are explainable and linked to evidence. * Build eConsent and assent workflows with version control of IRB approved materials, identity verification, comprehension checks and Part 11 compliant electronic signatures. * Support remote and telehealth study visits, scheduling and reminders, and ePRO and eCOA questionnaires for participants and caregivers. * Build electronic case report forms with edit checks, query management, data review and locking, and complete audit trails. * Implement Part 11 controls, including time stamped audit trails, electronic signatures, role based access, record retention and human readable exports. * Produce risk based validation evidence (CSV and CSA, IQ/OQ/PQ, traceability, test scripts and release records) in line with GAMP 5, backed by automated tests across the stack (Django unit and API tests, Angular unit tests, Playwright end to end tests). * Build secure, reliable integrations with sponsor, CRO and site systems (EDC, CTMS, lab and rater data) and sponsor reporting such as enrollment funnels, screen fail reasons and data completeness. * Keep each study and the clinical care program strictly separate in the data model, authorization and queries. * Protect PHI under HIPAA with encryption in transit and at rest, managed secrets, least privilege access and access logging, and contribute to controls aligned with NIST CSF and SOC 2\. * Write and maintain data models, API and data flow documentation, and system descriptions for IRB submissions, sponsor audits and regulatory inspections. * Work closely with clinicians, research and operations staff to translate protocol requirements into clear specifications and working software. **Skills** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering with production ownership of a web application. * Strong Python, Django and Django REST Framework, including the Django ORM and versioned migrations. * PostgreSQL schema design, migrations, constraints and query performance. * Angular with TypeScript (components, services, routing, HTTP interceptors) and RxJS. * AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS, IAM, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch), Docker, and infrastructure as code with AWS CDK in TypeScript. * REST API design, OAuth 2\.0 and JWT authentication, role based access control and multitenant SaaS patterns. * Automated testing across the stack, CI/CD, and Git with pull request based code review. * Experience building and running software that stores PHI under HIPAA. * Working knowledge of 21 CFR Part 11 and GCP, or equivalent experience building GxP or other FDA regulated software. * Experience building rules or decision logic whose outputs are explainable, versioned and auditable. * Clear technical writing for regulated documentation. **Preferred** * Software for clinical trials or DCTs (EDC, eConsent, eCOA/ePRO, CTMS, IRT or recruitment platforms). * Hands on validation work (IQ/OQ/PQ, CSV and CSA) and audit or inspection support. * CDISC standards (CDASH and SDTM; ODM and ADaM awareness). * HL7 FHIR R4 and US Core data mapping. * Telehealth or video visit experiences and WCAG 2\.1 AA accessibility. * LLM assisted extraction of criteria from protocols and records, with human review. * Familiarity with autism assessment instruments such as ADOS 2, ADI R and Vineland 3\. * SOC 2 Type II audit support, AWS Associate level certification, or GAMP/CSV training. Required within 30 days of start: ICH E6(R3\) GCP training (for example CITI GCP), Human Subjects Research training and Meadow HIPAA training. We offer a competitive salary and equity, and meaningful work that improves care and research access for autistic children and their families. Meadow Health is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.description: About Peregrine Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA. Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership. We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become. People first. Ownership always. We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else. At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk. At Peregrine Advisors, you will build cloud services in Python that automate a federal agency's high\-volume filing intake. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are. This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination. Your first project Your first project will likely have you automating how a federal agency handles a high\-volume stream of filer applications. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Turn a manual, document\-heavy intake process into a pipeline that reads, understands, and routes each submission. * Build document\-intelligence services that use optical character recognition (OCR) and AI in the cloud to pull structure and meaning out of filings at scale. * Add confidence scoring and the decision logic that determines what happens to each document next. * Build the validation around it: exact and fuzzy matching and the business rules that apply to each filing. * Design the human\-review workflows that catch what the machine should not decide alone. You help deliver a working document pipeline that moves filings from submission to decision, built for an environment where accuracy and auditability are not optional. This is where you start, not the shape of your career here. **Requirements** * 4\+ years of software development experience in Python * Bachelor's degree * Hands\-on experience building document\-processing systems in the cloud, from OCR through extraction, using Amazon Textract or an equivalent service * Experience with data validation, including exact and fuzzy matching * Experience building the application programming interfaces (APIs) and SQL that move documents through to a decision * Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel Preferred* Experience applying large language models (LLMs), machine learning, or natural language processing (NLP) to documents * Experience with Amazon Bedrock * Experience processing PDF documents Who you are You have a hacker's mindset: you would rather ship a working prototype tonight than a perfect plan next week. You have built real document\-processing systems in Python, and you move at the speed of the tools, not the clock. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. What you bring* Deep, hands\-on Python, with real experience building cloud document\-processing systems on Amazon Textract or its equivalents, from OCR through extraction. * The engineering that surrounds it: data validation, matching, and the APIs and SQL that carry a document through to a decision. * The judgment to build in a regulated environment where accuracy and auditability are not optional. You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver. When we talk Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. The technical assessment is a live Python coding exercise. **Benefits** This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $92,000 to $133,000 per year. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education. What we offer You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship. What we commit to As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager, Integrations
jobs.description: **Role** **Context** Altic is the rules\-based operational network that enables private markets to operate within managed accounts at scale. It is the infrastructure layer that did not exist before. Not a platform, not a portal, not a workflow tool. The right historical reference is what NSCC and Omgeo did for equities: common standards, rules and infrastructure that allowed an entire asset class to operate at volume. A network is only worth as much as it is connected. An alternatives trade touches a wealth platform, a trading or order management platform, a custodian, and a transfer agent or fund administrator. Today each of those connections is built bilaterally, differently, every time. That is why the industry runs at an 8 to 10 per cent not\-in\-good\-order rate. Altic is targeting less than 0\.01 per cent, and connectivity is where that is won or lost. The connectivity itself is unglamorous and genuinely hard. Some counterparties expose modern REST APIs. Many still exchange fixed\-width or delimited files over SFTP on a nightly cycle. Some sit behind decades\-old platforms with a batch window and no appetite to change it. The job is not to wish that away. It is to design flows that work across all of it and still deliver a trade end to end, in good order, at volume. **Purpose of the Role** You will own how data moves into, through and out of the Altic network. That means consuming the interfaces our network participants already have, exposing the interfaces Altic offers back to them, and designing the flows in between so that the full lifecycle of an alternatives trade completes without manual intervention. The counterparties in scope are wealth platforms, trading and order management platforms, custodians, and transfer agents and fund administrators. Each has a different technical reality and a different set of constraints. Your job is to build reusable connectivity rather than a series of one\-off builds, so that the tenth integration of a given type is materially faster than the first. You work against the network's rules and technical specification rather than inventing requirements from scratch. Where a rule cannot be implemented as written, you are the person who says so and works it back through. **Key Stakeholders** * Wealth platforms, trading and order management platforms * Custodians, transfer agents and fund administrators * GPs and asset managers participating in the network * Altic Engineering and Architecture * Altic Network Rules and Governance * Altic Operations, Business Development and Partnerships **Why This Role Is Different** This role offers: * The chance to connect network participant types that have never been connected for this asset class. There is no existing integration pattern for alternatives inside a managed account, because the flow did not exist. * Ownership of an integration product, not an integration project. Success is a reusable interface that shortens every subsequent onboarding, rather than a delivered connection. * Real technical heterogeneity to solve for. Modern APIs on one side, nightly flat files on the other, and a trade that has to complete across all of it. * A specification that already exists. The rules and technical specification are being written alongside you, so you are building against something rather than guessing. * A measurable target. Less than 0\.01 per cent not\-in\-good\-order is not a slogan, and connectivity design is most of how it gets hit. The network is real to a network participant at exactly the point their systems connect to it. That point is yours. **How you will provide meaningful contributions:** **What You'll Actually Be Doing** This role is technical, external and detail\-heavy. On any given week, you might be: * Sitting with a custodian's technology team working out which of their existing feeds can carry an alternatives position, and what has to be built if none of them can. * Mapping a transfer agent's file layout to the network data model and finding the three fields nobody actually populates. * Deciding whether a new counterparty gets an API integration or a file\-based one, and being honest with them about the trade\-off. * Working out why a subscription order completed at the platform and then failed downstream at the fund administrator. * Designing the standard interface for wealth platforms so the next one onboards in weeks rather than quarters. * Prototyping a transformation or a validation yourself rather than raising a ticket and waiting to find out whether the idea works. **Key Responsibilities** **Integration Architecture and Data Flow** * Own how data flows between network participants and Altic across the full lifecycle of an alternatives trade, including orders, confirmations, positions, activity and cash. * Design the target\-state connectivity pattern for each network participant type rather than accumulating bilateral integrations. * Decide where each integration sits on the spectrum from real\-time API t can run a design session with another firm's engineers, hold your own on their architecture, and leave with a specification both sides agree on. **Hands\-on with AI:** actively excited about using the latest AI techniques to automate and prototype. Comfortable across AI, no\-code and low\-code tools, and inclined to build a working thing rather than write a requirements document about it. **Domain experience (beneficial, not required):** any of the following gives you a head start, and none of them on its own is the role: DTCC Fund/SERV, NSCC Networking or AIP; direct experience inside a custodian, transfer agent, fund administrator or wealth platform; alternatives operations or product experience from a firm such as iCapital or CAIS; order management or trading platform integration; knowledge of the wealth management channel and managed accounts, including model\-driven and portfolio\-driven trading. **Personal Attributes** * Reads the file before asking what is in it. * Comfortable with counterparties who cannot change, and designs around them without complaint. * Shows rather than tells. Defaults to a working prototype over a slide deck. * Treats a production failure as a design signal rather than an operational nuisance. * Precise about detail without losing sight of why the integration exists. **About InvestCloud** InvestCloud, a global leader in wealth technology, aspires to enable a smarter financial future. Driving the digital transformation of the wealth management industry, the company serves a broad array of clients globally, including Wealth and Asset Managers, Wirehouses, Banks, RIAs, and Insurers. In terms of scale, the company’s clients represent more than 40 percent of the $132 trillion of total assets globally. As a leader in delivering personalization and scale across advisory programs, including unified managed accounts (UMA) and separately managed accounts (SMA), the company is committed to the success of its clients. By equipping and enabling advisors and their clients with connected technology, enhanced intelligence, and inspired experiences, InvestCloud delivers leading digital wealth management and financial planning solutions, complemented by a dynamic data warehouse, which scale across the complete wealth continuum. In 2024, InvestCloud was named CNBC World’s Top Fintech Company, a proof point of the company’s commitment to innovation and client success. Headquartered in the United States, InvestCloud serves clients around the world. For more information, visit InvestCloud.com (https://nam10\.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url\=https%3A%2F%2Finvestcloud.com%2F\&data\=05%7C02%7Chjacobsen%40investcloud.com%7Ced84e5c3e8524e4d5c1e08dce318b0e3%7C134fa738eba84721a959151561c6c68e%7C0%7C0%7C638634942404266514%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C\&sdata\=MWVDvATUCh92zSkL%2F9PonMNS3hr8Zqp2xaVJmF4Vbx8%3D\&reserved\=0\). **Our Values** * Client Connected * Human Centered * Technology Forward * Respect \+ Integrity * Excellence The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on the applicant’s geographic location. Salary range: $200,000 \- $225,000\. Benefits include medical/Rx, dental, vision, disability, and life/AD\&D insurance plans, Flexible Savings Account (FSA), Health Savings Account (HSA), Employee Assistance Plan (EAP), health advocacy, voluntary ancillary plans (accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity, legal, identity theft, auto/home, and pet insurance), 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match, and paid time off. \#LI\-BH1 Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: **About Abode Money** --------------------- Abode Money is the first financial manager for homeowners. We save homeowners money on property taxes, insurance, mortgage and more, every year. Our vision is to be the first to create an ongoing relationship with 80M\+ homeowners. Homeowners spend $2T\+ a year on their homes with almost no help. We're the first and only company that can lower property taxes in all 50 states, and there's no better way into the homeowner relationship than the bill everyone hates. Most consumer fintechs are building slightly better versions of products that already exist. We're using AI to turn work that has always been a service into software, and there has never been a better moment to do it. We've raised $25M from Permanent, Drive, Sequoia, Core VC and 81 Collection. **The Role** ------------ This is the most AI\-pilled role at Abode. You're just as much product and design as you are engineer, and you use AI in every part of the job to move faster than anyone thinks is possible. You'll build the first version of new products, features, and flows in days, push code every day, and work directly with the CEO and growth team to see the impact in the numbers. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * **Launch New Products Fast:** Build MVPs of new products, features, and flows in days, from insurance and mortgage to whatever we bet on next. * **Ship Every Day:** Push code daily and turn funnel ideas into production tests fast. * **Own Product and Design:** Decide what to build, design the flow, and make the UX calls yourself. * **Build with AI:** Use AI across the whole stack to move faster, and show the rest of the team how. * **Measure Everything:** Instrument what you build and use the data to decide what's next. **Who You Are** --------------- * In Austin or willing to relocate. We work in person 5 days a week. * 5\+ years shipping consumer\-facing product * Strong with React, TypeScript, and a modern backend * Use AI for nearly everything you build and are always testing new tools * Have product and design taste, and care how the product feels to the customer * Are a former founder or early\-stage engineer who owns outcomes **Our Values** -------------- We hire people who want to own their work outright. * **Take ownership.** You get more autonomy here than almost anywhere else. Own the outcome, make the calls, and see it through. * **Move fast.** Speed is our only advantage, so we ship first and refine after. Sometimes that means fixing things in the open, and we're fine with that. * **Dive deep.** Go to the source. Pull the data, read the county code, call the assessor. The details are where we win. * **Be intellectually curious.** Learn new domains fast and keep asking why. Now is the time to work smarter, and AI is how we do it. * **Go all in.** We work hard and put in long hours because the window in front of us won't stay open forever. We're looking for people who want to do the same. **Compensation** ---------------- $170,000 – $220,000 base, plus equity Compensation Range: $170K \- $220K

jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer, Growth
jobs.description: **About Airwallex** ------------------- Airwallex is the AI\-native financial operating system for a real\-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85\+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia\-Pacific. We're co\-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder\-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. **How you'll make impact** -------------------------- Growth Engineering at Airwallex is building an AI\-native platform that powers customer acquisition, activation, conversion, retention, and expansion. We're developing scalable infrastructure, intelligent decision systems, and automation capabilities that connect product, sales, and marketing to drive measurable business outcomes. As a Senior Frontend Engineer, you'll design, build, and own high\-performance web experiences and frontend platforms that power Growth at scale. You'll work on everything from customer\-facing acquisition and conversion journeys to AI\-powered internal tools, combining frontend engineering excellence with rapid experimentation and measurable business impact. * **Build scalable frontend experiences**, including high\-performance websites, landing pages, growth funnels, campaign management platforms, and personalized customer journeys using React and TypeScript. * **Develop AI\-native user experiences**, building intuitive interfaces and workflows that help teams leverage AI\-powered insights, automation, and intelligent decision\-making. * **Own end\-to\-end technical delivery**, independently designing, implementing, testing, deploying, and optimizing complex frontend applications and components. * **Drive performance and experimentation**, improving web performance, SEO, accessibility, and conversion through experimentation, feature flagging, and data\-driven iteration. * **Solve ambiguous business problems**, partnering with Product, Design, Marketing, Data Science, and Backend Engineering to translate requirements into intuitive, scalable solutions. * **Elevate frontend engineering quality** through thoughtful architecture, reusable component systems, code reviews, knowledge sharing, and mentoring other engineers. US: You'll work from our Seattle office three days a week. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- ### **Essentials** * **5\+ years of professional frontend engineering experience**, including building and operating production web applications, and a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. * **Strong proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and modern frontend development practices**, with solid computer science fundamentals and experience building clean, modular, maintainable applications. * **Strong understanding of frontend architecture and web performance**, including component design, state management, API integration, responsive design, accessibility, and performance optimization. * **Proven ability to independently design and deliver complex frontend solutions**, making sound technical tradeoffs and owning features from implementation through production. * **Strong ownership, problem\-solving, and collaboration skills**, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, work effectively with cross\-functional teams, and deliver high\-quality solutions with minimal oversight. ### **Preferred** * Experience building growth platforms, campaign management systems, content management systems, experimentation frameworks, or customer\-facing conversion funnels. * Experience developing AI\-powered applications or agentic user experiences, including interactive AI workflows, streaming responses, and human\-in\-the\-loop interfaces. * Experience with web performance optimization, A/B testing, feature flagging, analytics instrumentation, and conversion optimization. * Experience with modern frontend ecosystems, including Next.js, server\-side rendering, static generation, design systems, and frontend build tooling. * Experience with rapid prototyping and using data to validate product hypotheses and guide iteration. * Experience in high\-growth technology companies, fintech, payments, or regulated environments. * Experience mentoring engineers and improving frontend engineering practices. **You'll thrive here if** ------------------------- * **You have high agency.** You proactively identify opportunities for improvement and take ownership of delivering solutions. * **You're a strong builder.** You enjoy turning ideas into polished, production\-ready experiences and take pride in usability, performance, and code quality. * **You're pragmatic and outcome\-oriented.** You balance engineering excellence with speed of execution and focus on measurable customer and business impact. * **You're comfortable with ambiguity.** You break down complex problems, make thoughtful decisions with incomplete information, and adapt quickly. * **You have strong product intuition.** You care about the customer experience, challenge assumptions, and use data and experimentation to guide decisions. * **You communicate proactively.** You surface risks early, collaborate effectively, and bring solutions rather than just problems. * **You thrive in a global environment.** You're comfortable working with distributed teams across APAC, EMEA, and the US. **Learn more about your team** ------------------------------ Growth at Airwallex is building a unified, AI\-native growth system across product, sales, and marketing. Rather than applying AI to isolated tasks, we use customer context, machine learning, automation, and continuous learning to transform how Airwallex acquires, activates, converts, retains, and expands customers. You’ll build agentic AI platforms, experimentation frameworks, and intelligent decision systems that turn signals—such as company profile, product usage, lifecycle stage, behavior, and intent—into personalized journeys, next\-best actions, and measurable incremental value. The work spans both human \+ AI and autonomous operating models: AI\-native tools that increase the leverage of growth teams, alongside agentic workflows that can research opportunities, launch and optimize campaigns, orchestrate customer journeys, and measure outcomes within clear strategies and guardrails. The challenge is to combine consumer\-technology speed with the precision, trust, and regulatory complexity of global B2B finance. If you enjoy owning ambiguous problems end to end, prototyping quickly, measuring real business impact, and using every outcome to improve the next decision, you’ll help define how an AI\-native global financial platform grows. **Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third\-Party Recruiters** -------------------------------------------------------------- *To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @**airwallex.com* *email address. Please apply only through* *careers.airwallex.com* *or our official LinkedIn page.* *Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.* **Equal opportunity** --------------------- Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know. Compensation Range: $158K \- $225K

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer in Test
jobs.description: ### **Description** We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer in Test who brings a builder's mindset to quality engineering. You'll be a hands\-on senior engineer and mentor who helps shape our test automation strategy alongside our Principal Software Engineer in Test, raises the bar for engineering quality across the products you support, and partners closely with engineering and product to embed quality from the start. You'll write code, build and extend test infrastructure, and influence how a team of 3–5 engineers thinks about reliability and correctness at scale. If you're energized by hard technical problems, care deeply about craft, and want to help shape how quality scales at a growing fintech, this is the role for you.### **As a Senior Software Engineer in Test, you will:** * **Shift Left on Quality**: Partner with engineers and product managers early in the development cycle to define testability requirements, acceptance criteria, and risk\-based test strategies before a line of code is written. * **Build and Maintain Test Automation**: Build, extend, and help maintain the frameworks, tooling, and CI integration the team's testing runs on — taking ownership of key areas and evolving them within the technical direction set with our Principal SET. * **Test Across the Spectrum**: Design and execute functional, integration, regression, and load/performance test automation, using k6 or Gatling for performance and Cypress/Postman for functional and API coverage, so we catch issues at the right layer. * **Innovate on Process**: Identify and eliminate bottlenecks in the testing lifecycle. Champion adaptive QA practices that scale with rapid iteration without slowing down delivery. * **Elevate the Team**: Be a senior technical voice and mentor for QA engineers. Share your expertise generously, raise the quality of the work around you, and contribute to a culture of ownership and continuous improvement. * **Drive Metrics That Matter**: Partner with the engineering lead to define and track meaningful quality signals — automation coverage, test reliability, bug escape rates, and feedback loop speed — and use data to continuously improve. * **Align with Business Goals**: Build testing practices that support compliance, security, and reliability standards while staying tightly aligned with Akoya's product and engineering objectives. * **Automation reliability and coverage** — high pass rates, meaningful coverage, less reliance on manual regression * **Faster feedback loops** — test results that unblock engineers, not delay them * **Quality influence** — bugs caught earlier, fewer escapes, and engineering teams that proactively think about testability * **Team elevation** — QA engineers who are more capable and confident because of your mentorship and example ### **Experience and Skills** * **7\+ years** in software testing or quality engineering, with at least **2\+ years in a technical lead or senior IC capacity** * Deep proficiency with **Cypress**, **Node.js**, **Docker**, **Bitbucket Pipelines**, **Postman**, **WireMock**, **K8s**, and **AWS** * Experience with **load/performance testing** — k6, Gatling, or similar * Strong understanding of CI/CD, cloud environments, and shift\-left testing principles * Experience designing and scaling test infrastructure in agile, high\-growth SaaS environments * Ability to communicate clearly across engineering, product, and senior leadership — translating quality risk into business impact * Ownership\-driven, collaborative, and biased toward action ### **Additional Information** **Our Commitment** Akoya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status. We’re committed to building an inclusive, welcoming workplace where people feel supported, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We know that experience can come from many different paths. We value diverse perspectives and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if they don’t meet all of the qualifications. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. You may be the right candidate for this role or another opportunity at Akoya. **Where We Work** Akoya is remote\-first, with this role open to candidates currently located within commuting distance of **Boston, MA, New York, NY, and Raleigh, NC**. While our teams work primarily remote, we are building talent hubs in these locations to create opportunities for in\-person collaboration, team connection, and professional development. **Compensation \& Benefits** The expected base salary for this role is **$xxx,xxx to $xxx,xxx.** The actual base salary offered takes into account the candidate's work location, relevant education, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience, among other factors. Base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes employer\-subsidized medical, dental, and vision coverage, company\-sponsored life insurance, 401(k) matching, flexible PTO, and paid parental leave. Some roles may be eligible for a performance\-based bonus. Candidates who receive offers must complete successful criminal background, drug, and credit screenings.### **About Akoya** Akoya is a financial data access network, backed by major financial institutions, that connects banks with the apps and services consumers use to manage their money. Our platform uses standardized APIs and consumer permissioning, so people can share their financial data safely without handing over their usernames and passwords. We're a collaborative, fast\-paced team with deep expertise across banking, securities, fintech, and data aggregation, and we're working to make financial data sharing safer and more transparent for everyone.

jobs.description: **POSITION OVERVIEW** The Tooling Team is part of the DevOps organization and supports scalable, secure CI/CD and platform tooling across Alarm.com engineering teams. We are seeking a DevOps Engineer (3\-5 years of experience) to build and maintain the CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, and cloud deployment frameworks that support Alarm.com's engineering organization. This role focuses on build and release work including managing pipelines, deployments, and the infrastructure behind them. You will collaborate closely with Engineering, Quality Engineering, Operations, and Release Management to modernize build and release workflows, reduce operational toil, and improve reliability, performance, and developer productivity. This position is based on\-site at our corporate headquarters in Tysons Corner, Virginia. **RESPONSIBILITIES** * Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines and automation frameworks * Build and manage infrastructure using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices * Own provisioning, configuration, and deployment automation for the services you support * Manage build and release environments (VMs, containers, and cloud resources) * Work with Kubernetes (RKE2 and AKS) and ArgoCD to deploy and maintain services using GitOps practices * Monitor system performance, scalability, availability, and security using Grafana dashboards and alerts * Troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure issues, and deployment failures, including escalations from the engineering teams we support * Document processes and contribute to continuous improvement efforts * Participate in the team's on\-call rotation after an initial ramp\-up period **QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience required * 3\-5 years of experience in DevOps, Build \& Release Engineering, Platform Engineering, or Software Engineering * Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language (C\#, Java, Python, PowerShell, or similar) * Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with tools such as Jenkins, Bamboo, or GitHub Actions * Solid scripting experience with PowerShell and/or Bash * Working experience with Azure and/or AWS * Working experience with Kubernetes or another container orchestration platform * Comfortable administering Windows Server and/or Linux systems * Able to troubleshoot production issues and drive them to resolution with limited direction * Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including with engineers outside the DevOps organization Please note that sponsorship of new applicants for employment authorization, or any other immigration\-related support, is not available for this position at this time. **WHY WORK FOR** **ALARM.COM****?** * **Collaborate with outstanding people:** We hire only the best. Our standards are high and our employees enjoy working alongside other high achievers. * **Make an immediate impact:** New employees can expect to be given real responsibility for bringing new technologies to the marketplace. You are empowered to perform as soon as you join the Alarm.com team! * **Gain well rounded experience:** Alarm.com offers a diverse and dynamic environment where you will get the chance to work directly with executives and develop expertise across multiple areas of the business. * **Community and Camaraderie:** One of our core values is to 'Keep It Fun,' which to us means fostering a strong sense of community. Our culture is built on collaboration and connection, where we celebrate our successes and believe that a positive, engaging environment is key to doing our best work. * **Alarm.com** **values working together and collaborating in person. Our employees work from the office** **4 days a week****.** **COMPANY INFO** Alarm.com is the leading platform for intelligently connected properties. Millions of homeowners and businesses rely on Alarm.com's technology to secure, monitor, and manage their environments from anywhere. Our comprehensive suite of solutions—including security, video surveillance, access control, active shooter detection, intelligent automation, energy management, and wellness—is delivered exclusively through a trusted network of thousands of professional service providers and commercial integrators across North America and worldwide. Alarm.com's common stock is traded on Nasdaq under the ticker symbol ALRM. Alarm.com delivers serious security for serious people. For more information, please visit www.alarm.com. **COMPANY BENEFITS** Our total rewards package is designed to support you holistically—in your health, your finances, and your life outside of work. The package includes medical plans with company subsidies, a Health Savings Account (HSA) with a company contribution, and a 401(k) with an employer match. We encourage a healthy work\-life balance with paid vacation that increases with tenure, paid holidays, wellness time, and paid maternity and bonding leave. To complete the package, we also provide company\-paid disability and life insurance, all within a collaborative and casual work environment. **Alarm.com** **is an Equal Opportunity Employer** In connection with your application, we collect information that identifies, reasonably relates to or describes you ("Personal Information"). The categories of Personal Information that we may collect include your name, government\-issued identification number(s), email address, mailing address, other contact information, emergency contact information, employment history, educational history, criminal record, and demographic information. We collect and use those categories of Personal Information about you for human resources and other business management purposes, including identifying and evaluating you as a candidate for potential or future employment or future positions, recordkeeping in relation to recruiting and hiring, conducting criminal background checks as permitted by law, conducting analytics, and ensuring compliance with applicable legal requirements and Company policies. jobs.description: **Meet the Moment with Alteryx** We're living through a once\-in\-a\-generation shift in how work gets done. Data, automation, and AI are quickly becoming the center of every business decision \- and Alteryx is leading the transformation. You'll be working on the challenges that sit at the heart of modern business. No matter your role, the work you do will help organizations move faster, see more clearly, and tackle questions that used to feel impossible. If you're ready to meet the moment with innovation, curiosity, and excellence, there's a place for you here. Meet the Moment with Alteryx At Alteryx, we're building technology that helps organizations connect to, manage, and work with their data securely and efficiently. As data, automation, and AI continue to evolve, our cloud platform plays an important role in helping customers solve complex problems and make better decisions. We're looking for engineers who enjoy meaningful technical challenges, value collaboration, and want to build technology that makes a real difference. Alteryx is seeking a **Senior Software Engineer** . This position is remote\-friendly. **Position Overvie** w We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Data Plane Transport team within Cloud Platform Engineering. Our team builds and operates foundational services that enable secure, reliable communication between Alteryx Cloud, data planes, and customer environments. Our work includes Data Bridge, which enables customers to securely access private data sources, along with shared platform services for connectivity, networking, registration, and orchestration across distributed cloud environments. This is a hands\-on, backend\-focused engineering role, primarily developing services and APIs in Go, with some opportunities to contribute to frontend applications using TypeScript and React. You'll take ownership of complex technical initiatives, drive solutions from design through production, influence technical decisions, and help mentor and support other engineers. **Key Responsibilities** Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reliable backend services, APIs, and distributed systems, primarily using Go. Lead the design and implementation of secure connectivity solutions involving service registration, orchestration, routing, and proxy/relay\-based communication. Own complex technical initiatives end\-to\-end, including solution design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production support. Design and improve cloud\-native services across AWS and GCP, with an emphasis on scalability, reliability, security, and operational efficiency. Contribute to frontend applications and platform management experiences using TypeScript and React when needed. Investigate and resolve complex issues spanning application code, cloud infrastructure, networking, and multiple distributed services. Drive improvements in automated testing, system observability, monitoring, and operational readiness. Lead and contribute to technical design discussions, code reviews, and architectural decisions while mentoring other engineers. Collaborate closely with Product, Architecture, Infrastructure, Security, and other engineering teams to deliver cross\-functional solutions. Participate in an on\-call rotation, troubleshooting production issues, identifying root causes, and driving improvements that prevent recurring problems. **Required Qualification** s 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent relevant experience. Strong backend development experience using Go or a comparable backend language, with the ability to become productive in Go. Experience designing, building, and operating production services using REST APIs, microservices, and distributed system architectures. Hands\-on experience developing and operating cloud\-native applications in environments such as AWS or GCP. Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including HTTP/TLS, TCP/IP, DNS, and service\-to\-service communication. Experience designing systems for scalability, reliability, fault tolerance, and failure recovery. Ability to independently investigate and troubleshoot complex issues spanning application code, infrastructure, and multiple services. Experience with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, Git, and modern software development practices. Strong problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to independently drive technical decisions and complex engineering work. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred Qualifications** Experience with TypeScript, React, or similar frontend technologies. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, or other cloud\-native tooling. Experience with cloud networking technologies such as AWS PrivateLink, GCP Private Service Connect, VPC networking, proxies, or secure tunneling. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Can a large language model read a regulatory change and draft the requirements and control tests that follow from it, accurately enough for a Compliance Officer to sign off? How do you train a breach\-risk model when confirmed breaches are rare, arrive months after the event, and mean different things to Compliance, Assurance, and the regulator? SPARC's bold outcome is to accelerate the end\-to\-end regulatory change cycle by 10x, supercharging Compliance Officers as part of Amazon’s first AI\-Native Second Line of Defense (2LoD). Our team builds the data, analytics, and modeling layer that RCS runs on, from regulatory reports and filings to the intelligence that tells Compliance Officers and our first line of defense (1LoD) partners where risk concentrates and which controls hold. You build the machine learning (ML) and generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) systems in that layer, take them into production, and own the evaluation science that lets Compliance rely on them. The work spans 3 areas: risk models that score which open risks and control weaknesses convert to breaches; GenAI systems that remove manual effort from requirement translation, control testing, and regulatory reporting, with human approval gates at every stage; and the evaluation science behind every model and agent the team ships. Financial crime compliance is the first domain, and its constraints shape the science: threats change faster than control sets adapt, and every output faces internal audit and external examination. Once an approach proves out, you carry it into the next compliance domain across the RCS portfolio. As a Senior Applied Scientist on SPARC, you own the science strategy for this layer, not just its individual models. You design and architect the agentic systems at the heart of it — objective\-driven agents with human approval gates — and customize the technology to real compliance use cases. You define a multi\-year science vision and roadmap for ML and GenAI in RCS, translate it into concrete plans for scientists and engineering partners, and anticipate where generative AI is heading so what you build capitalizes on compounding advances. You are the technical leader in AI/ML for the team and across partner teams, setting the standard for scientific rigor, raising the bar in design and model reviews, and mentoring scientists and engineers. You own problems from formulation to production: framing the science question with Compliance and 1LoD partners, designing experiments and backtests, building and validating models, and shipping them into the pipelines, reports, and tools that RCS teams use. The stack includes Amazon SageMaker, Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Redshift, and AWS Lambda, and your partners include data scientists, data engineers, business intelligence engineers, and software development engineers across RCS. The successful candidate treats an auditor's question as a design requirement, writes production\-quality code alongside their models, and stays comfortable when the evaluation set does not exist until they build it. jobs.title: Staff Engineer - System Test
jobs.description: **Company Overview** **Ambiq** is on a mission to enable intelligence everywhere — powering the AI edge revolution with the world's lowest\-power semiconductor solutions. Built on our proprietary sub\- and near\-threshold technology, our chips deliver multi\-fold improvements in energy efficiency without costly process scaling. Since 2010, we've shipped over 300 million units to customers building smarter wearables, medical devices, IoT products, and AI\-powered edge applications. Our cross\-functional teams span design, research, development, production, marketing, sales, and operations across Austin, Hsinchu, Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Singapore. We move fast, tackle hard problems, and create space for people to grow through complex, meaningful work that shapes the future of technology. We're looking for self\-motivated, creative problem\-solvers who are eager to push technological limits and make a real impact in energy efficiency. At Ambiq, we live by five values: **Innovate. Collaborate. Focus. Learn. Achieve.** If that's you, join us — the intelligence everywhere revolution starts here. **This role will be on\-site 5 days a week in NW Austin.** **Scope** This is an on\-site role based in Austin, Texas. As a Staff Engineer, System Test at Ambiq, you will provide technical leadership for system\-level test strategy and automation across Ambiq MCU platforms. You will own improvements to the regression framework and help ensure system tests are reliable, repeatable, and effective at finding issues early. You will work closely with global MCU software, validation, architecture, hardware, and automation teams. The role spans embedded firmware, test infrastructure, lab equipment, and data analysis, supporting both pre\-silicon platforms such as FPGA or emulation and post\-silicon evaluation boards. The successful candidate is an experienced engineer who can lead complex test and debug efforts, turn recurring manual work into maintainable automation, and communicate findings clearly. They bring sound engineering judgment, collaborate across hardware and software boundaries, and help other engineers improve test quality and efficiency. This role will guide the design and maintenance of regression and automation infrastructure, develop system tests and instrument\-control workflows, analyze test results, and drive root\-cause investigations. They will also mentor engineers and contribute to the team's long\-term system test methodology. **Responsibilities** * Define test coverage and execute system\-level testing across Ambiq MCU platforms and SDK releases. Architect, develop, and maintain the regression framework and test automation using Python or other scripting languages, including test orchestration, board and target control, result collection, reporting, failure triage, and integration with the team's CI or automation workflows. * Design, implement, and debug embedded test cases for MCU subsystems and peripherals, using C and assembly where appropriate. * Automate laboratory instruments and measurement workflows to support repeatable system characterization and regression testing; define reliable setup, control, data capture, and recovery behavior. * Improve test result storage, traceability, querying, and reporting so engineers can compare runs, identify trends, and investigate failures efficiently. * Lead complex system\-level debug across firmware, drivers, SoC blocks, evaluation boards, and lab setups; document root cause, evidence, and recommended corrective actions. * Work with software, validation, architecture, and hardware teams to define test requirements, acceptance criteria, and coverage priorities for new features and platforms. * Support pre\-silicon testing on FPGA or emulation platforms and post\-silicon bring\-up, validation, and regression on evaluation boards. * Mentor engineers on test design, automation, debugging, and laboratory practices; promote reusable tools and continuous improvement. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. * At least 6 years of relevant experience with a Master's degree or 8 years with a Bachelor's degree in embedded systems, system testing, validation, or related engineering work. * Strong Python programming experience for test automation and C or C\+\+ for embedded software and test development. * Demonstrated experience developing or maintaining automated regression systems, including test execution, result handling, failure analysis, and ongoing framework improvement. * Hands\-on experience automating laboratory instruments or measurement equipment. Familiarity with instrument\-control interfaces and protocols such as SCPI, VISA, or PyVISA is desirable. * Strong understanding of MCU architecture and embedded systems, including interrupts, DMA, memory, power or clock control, and peripheral interfaces such as SPI, I2C, UART, or USB. * Experience debugging embedded systems in a laboratory using equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, power analyzers, or debug probes. * Experience with an RTOS such as FreeRTOS or Zephyr, source control such as Git, and issue tracking and collaboration tools. * Ability to lead technical investigations, manage multiple priorities, mentor engineers, and communicate clearly with global cross\-functional teams. * Experience with relational databases or SQL, test\-data schemas, or data\-analysis and reporting pipelines is a plus. * Experience with pre\-silicon validation, FPGA or emulation platforms, silicon bring\-up, or MCU SDK testing is a plus. * Experience with using AI tools such as Cursor or OpenAI's Codex to develop test code or debug issues is a plus. Must be currently authorized to work in the United States for any employer. We do not sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas (now or in the future) for this role.
