jobs.title: Senior GRC Engineer
jobs.description: At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market. What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers' success and to our Winning Culture. Our customers rank among the who's who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform. Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebratingour wins – big and small. Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you'll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let's build what's next \- together! Security Trust \& Risk owns governance, risk, compliance, vendor \& customer assurance, and business continuity across Anaplan's ecosystem. This role is a genuine ground\-floor opportunity. You'll help build the technical backbone that lets GRC operate as an engineering discipline, moving away from point\-in\-time audits and risk scores to a continuously measured heartbeat that drives prioritization and high\-visibility, high\-impact decisions. **This role is based in our New York office and requires a hybrid schedule with in\-person attendance twice a week.** As an **Engineer III, Security and Compliance**, you're the technical bridge between GRC and the rest of the business. You're comfortable sitting in a room with engineering and talking architecture some days, and on other days, feeling confident on a customer call and translating security into practice to build trust. Your north star is compliance by design: instead of audits being a point\-in\-time scramble to assemble evidence, they should be a natural byproduct of controls, monitoring, and processes that run continuously, year\-round. A core part of that is thinking in terms of build once, apply to many: using our cross\-framework control crosswalk to identify where requirements across our certified standards — including ISO 27001, 27017, 27018, 27701, and 42001, SOC 1/2 Type 2, Cyber Essentials, ENS, and TX\-RAMP — genuinely overlap, so our partners build to a single common control instead of a different bespoke solution for every certification. As important as the automation itself is, it's also about making the reasoning behind it visible: helping partners across the business understand the why behind a given control, whether it traces back to a compliance obligation, a customer request, or an emerging threat, not just the what. Over time, you'll develop genuine fluency in how the Anaplan product and platform work, how we manage our infrastructure and internal systems, and where our security controls live operationally. **Your Impact** --------------- * Act as a technical GRC partner to technical and non\-technical teams, translating compliance, governance, and risk requirements into implementation details, and engaging credibly in architecture/design discussions * Use the cross\-framework control crosswalk to identify synergies across regulatory requirements, so engineers build one common solution instead of duplicating effort per certification * Support customer\-facing security/compliance conversations requiring deeper technical context (platform architecture, control implementation, how obligations are met) * Build the processes, scripts, workflows, and tooling that embed controls into daily operations, and design automation that keeps compliance/risk data current continuously rather than refreshed only ahead of audits * Create knowledge\-sharing resources and clear documentation/diagrams that help partners understand the reasoning behind a control — whether it's a compliance obligation, a customer request, or an emerging threat — not just the mechanics of it * Partner with Risk Management to engineer risk identification, scoring, and monitoring into day\-to\-day operations; support continuous monitoring (ConMon) across Compliance, Risk, and Governance; and build working knowledge of the Anaplan product/platform over time **Your Qualifications** ----------------------- * 6\+ years in security engineering, GRC, DevSecOps, or a closely related technical role, with hands\-on exposure to compliance/regulatory frameworks * Comfortable writing scripts or light code (Python, Bash, or similar) to automate evidence collection, reporting, or monitoring tasks * Working knowledge of at least two of: ISO 27001 and its extensions (27017, 27018, 27701, 42001\), SOC 1/2, Cyber Essentials, or similar, including experience using a cross\-framework control mapping/crosswalk to reduce duplicate implementation effort * Comfortable building and reading system/data\-flow diagrams, and proficient with a GRC/risk platform (e.g., Drata, Vanta, Hyperproof, Archer, OneTrust, ServiceNow GRC, or similar) * Experience translating compliance/risk requirements into implementation guidance engineering teams can act on * Comfort engaging directly with both engineering teams and customers on technical topics, and building process/tooling in a growing function ### **Nice\-to\-Have** * Hands\-on experience applying AI/LLM tooling to a real operational workflow — for example, automating a repetitive review step or summarizing evidence for a control * Familiarity with OSCAL or similar machine\-readable control languages * Experience with quantitative or semi\-quantitative risk scoring methodologies (e.g., FAIR or similar) * Experience with FedRAMP and/or HIPAA/HITRUST is a plus — especially if you have experience across more than one of these * Experience supporting external audits or assessments as a technical point of contact * Certifications such as CISA, CISSP, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer \#LI\-SP1 **Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren't just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it's how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. **Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals. Anaplan does not: * Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person. * Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication. All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence. **Privacy \& AI** **Notice** Candidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist our team in evaluating qualifications.

As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. ### **ABOUT THE TEAM** The Reliability Engineering team partners across Anduril's engineering, manufacturing, and operations organizations to ensure our autonomous systems survive real\-world conditions and deliver consistent performance for our customers. Our mandate spans the complete product lifecycle \- from early concept design through production scale\-up and fielded operations. We use data, statistical methods, and engineering analysis to forecast how our systems will perform over time and influence design decisions, including part selection, redundancy strategies, and maintenance approaches. We establish tailored reliability frameworks by program and partner with Quality to drive design robustness, failure prevention, and rapid response to issues in the field. ### **ABOUT THE JOB** Anduril Intelligence Systems (AIS) group is focused on positioning Anduril as a lead provider of specialized engineering and products for Intelligence Community (IC) customers. We work within the IC to understand their requirements, shape their concepts of operation, and deliver exquisite capability across their problem set. We aim to develop and deploy critically needed capabilities that address our customers' most pressing national security requirements. This role will be highly collaborative, hands\-on spanning the entire product lifecycle \- from early concept trade studies and detailed design through manufacturing scale\-up, production, and sustained field performance. You'll be the reliability champion throughout the design and development process, working closely with mechanical, electrical, and software engineering teams to ensure designs are robust. You'll also partner with manufacturing, quality, test operations, and field service teams to transition these products from engineering prototypes to production\-ready systems. Your scope will span performing predictive reliability analysis and FMEAs, developing and executing qualification and production test plans, leading root\-cause failure investigations from both the factory floor and the field, and closing the loop to drive continuous design and process improvements. We are looking for candidates who bring deep technical knowledge of hardware reliability and failure mechanisms, practical experience in both design and production environments, and the ability to drive cross\-functional alignment without direct authority. These roles demand independent, data\-driven engineers who can build reliability infrastructure from the ground up and take ownership of product performance from concept to deployment. ### **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Support and review system block diagrams, interface control documents, and schematics for compliance, redundancy, and accuracy against requirements and concept of operations. * Lead Failure Modes \& Effects Analysis (FMEA) and Fault Tree Analysis (FTA) efforts, collaborating with cross\-functional engineering teams to implement design improvements. * Perform predictive reliability analysis to calculate probability of loss of control, loss of asset, and MTTF/MTBF utilizing Anduril requirements, specifications, and relevant industry standards (i.e. MIL\-HDBK\-217Plus). * Develop and execute comprehensive Qualification and Validation Test plans (including environmental, life/limit, and accelerated testing) to ensure appropriate requirements coverage and de\-risking for production readiness; partner with Test Engineering to fixture and instrument test campaigns. * Work with Quality and Manufacturing Engineering to develop, refine, and validate assembly, integration, and testing processes (including inspection/acceptance test gates) to optimize build reliability and reduce time\-to\-deploy. * Develop Maintainability prediction models using MIL\-HDBK\-472, and support the development of Preventative Maintenance \& Sparing plans. * Perform Weibull analysis utilizing data from qualification campaigns, production testing, and fielded assets to predict failures and identify trends. * Lead failure investigations on anomalies originating from design validation, production testing, and field returns; jobs.title: Principal Engineer Capacity/Compute
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the Role** ------------------ Anthropic manages one of the largest and fastest\-growing infrastructure fleets in the industry — spanning multiple accelerator families, cpu families and clouds. The Capacity Engineering team is responsible for making sure all our infrastructure resources are accounted for, well\-utilized, and efficiently allocated. We own the data, tooling, and operational systems that let Anthropic plan, measure, and maximize utilization across first\-party and third\-party compute. As an engineer on Capacity Engineering, you will build the production systems that power this work: data pipelines that ingest and normalize telemetry from heterogeneous cloud environments, observability tooling that gives the org real\-time visibility into fleet health, and performance instrumentation that measures how efficiently every major workload uses the hardware it’s running on. You will be expected to write production\-quality code every day, operate alongside Kubernetes\-native infrastructure at meaningful scale, and directly influence decisions around one of Anthropic’s largest areas of spend. You’ll collaborate closely with research engineering, infrastructure, inference, and finance teams. The work requires someone who can move between data engineering, systems engineering, and observability with comfort — and who thrives in a high\-autonomy, high\-ambiguity environment. **This is a pipeline role feeding four areas.** **Depending on your background and business priority, you’ll focus primarily in one, but the boundaries are fluid and the problems overlap:** * **Data platform** Pipelines that ingest occupancy and utilization telemetry from Kubernetes clusters, normalize billing and usage across cloud providers, and serve the BigQuery tables the rest of the org queries against. Correctness, completeness, and latency are the job, not a footnote. Consumers range from research engineers to finance to leadership, so it's product work as much as engineering: defining schema contracts, making data discoverable, and figuring out what people actually need. * **Planning** Knowing what the fleet has, where it's going, and what's in the way. Making the state of the fleet legible and actionable in real time: cluster health tooling, capacity planning platforms, alerting on occupancy drops and allocation problems, and systemic fixes to scheduling and fragmentation. Kubernetes operations on one side, cross\-team coordination on the other. * **Efficiency** Measuring and improving how effectively every major workload uses the hardware it runs on. Instrumenting utilization across training, inference, and eval systems, building benchmarking infrastructure, establishing per\-config baselines, and working directly with system\-owning teams to close the gaps. The metric has to be good enough that the team on the hook for it agrees with the number. * **Attribution and forecasting** Connecting what the fleet costs to what the business is doing with it. Reconciling CSP billing exports against vendor telemetry and internal systems with mismatched schemas, attributing spend to the workloads and teams that generate it, and turning inference demand signals and research roadmaps into a defensible compute plan. Efficiency metrics have to survive contact with finance: stripped of pure demand and unit\-price effects, reproducible month over month, and legible to a CFO. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ * Build the planning and allocation stack — the tools leadership uses to allocate capacity, teams use to plan against their allocations, and the scheduler enforces. Cross\-region and cross\-provider placement, guardrails, queueing, occupancy KPIs. * Drive the efficiency programs: stranding and rightsizing, unused capacity recovery, and job\-level utilization across training, inference, and eval. Establish per\-config baselines and work with system\-owning teams to close the gaps. Utilization improvements are worth enormous sums at our scale. * Own attribution and forecasting — reconcile billing across ten\-plus providers against telemetry and internal systems, attribute spend to the workloads that generate it, and turn demand signals and research roadmaps into a defensible compute plan and supply pipeline. * Build the data platform underneath all of it: pipelines ingesting occupancy, utilization, and cost from a rapidly diversifying fleet into BigQuery, with real ownership of completeness, latency SLOs, and gap detection. Every new provider is a net\-new integration. * Operate Kubernetes\-native systems at scale — collection agents, workload labeling, and th ow the data gets consumed. * Storage efficiency, retention, and lifecycle program experience at exabyte scale. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $320,000 \- $485,000 USD **Logistics** ------------- **Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Engineering Leader, AI Safety Engineering & Evaluation, Apple Services Engineering
jobs.description: Apple Services Engineering (ASE) powers AI and machine learning experiences across the App Store, Apple Music, Apple TV, and more. We build intelligent, deeply personal experiences designed to serve users around the world. Ensuring these experiences are safe, trustworthy, and representative of the diverse communities we serve is fundamental to how we develop and deploy AI. We are seeking an experienced engineering leader to lead AI Safety Engineering \& Evaluation within the Human\-Centered AI organization. This role combines software engineering, machine learning, evaluation science, and Responsible AI to develop scalable capabilities for identifying, measuring, and mitigating risks associated with AI\-powered experiences. You will lead an emerging, multidisciplinary organization of engineering managers, engineers, and applied scientists, building the technical expertise, engineering practices, and organizational capabilities needed to scale AI safety evaluation. This is an opportunity to shape a growing function, developing its technical foundations while transforming manual safety assessments into automated, scientifically rigorous processes. The ideal candidate brings strong engineering leadership, practical expertise in machine learning and modern AI systems, and demonstrated success building technical organizations and translating complex challenges into measurable engineering outcomes. **Description** As the Engineering Leader for AI Safety Engineering \& Evaluation, you will lead the development and operationalization of technical capabilities to systematically assess AI model behavior, identify potential harms, and measure the effectiveness of safety mitigations. Your organization will advance safety evaluation methodologies, model\-based assessment, adversarial testing, automated risk identification, and failure analysis. In partnership with Evaluation Systems \& Research (ESR), which provides shared evaluation infrastructure and services, you will integrate safety\-specific models, assessment workflows, and measurement capabilities into scalable evaluation systems. jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description: AtmosZero is building the next generation of industrial steam infrastructure. Our flagship product, Boiler 2\.0, is a modular industrial steam heat pump designed to help manufacturers reduce operational risk, improve flexibility, and modernize steam generation over time. Rather than forcing facilities to choose between reliability and sustainability, AtmosZero enables a practical path toward future\-ready steam systems that integrate with existing operations and scale with customer needs. AtmosZero · Loveland, Colorado (onsite) · Full\-time · Senior Engineer I **Reports to:** VP, Engineering **Why this role exists** Industrial steam runs manufacturing across food, pharmaceuticals, specialty chemicals, and other essential industries, yet most steam is still produced by combustion\-based boilers. AtmosZero is replacing that legacy equipment with an electrified platform designed for practical deployment in existing boiler rooms. Boiler 2\.0 is a modular industrial heat\-pump system that produces steam using electricity. We are moving the platform from development hardware into repeatable customer delivery, with a 1 MW customer system now driving controls implementation, integration, testing, and commissioning readiness. The controls challenge spans process sequences, compressor and drive interfaces, distributed instrumentation, protection logic, HMI and SCADA, industrial networking, data infrastructure, and live\-system troubleshooting. This role adds the hands\-on capacity to complete the 1 MW system and turn first\-unit learning into a reusable controls platform for future systems. **Level and scope** *We are hiring an experienced engineer who can own major portions of an industrial controls system from requirements through commissioning. The role is intentionally hardware\-close: you will move between design documentation, PLC code, HMI and SCADA configuration, panels, field devices, test equipment, and operating data.* * **Controls Engineer (5\+ years).** You own controls implementation and issue resolution for assigned systems and subsystems, while helping establish the architecture, software standards, diagnostics, and commissioning methods needed for repeatable product delivery. *If your experience does not follow a conventional path but you have commissioned complex industrial equipment and can demonstrate strong controls judgment, apply anyway.* **What you will do** * **Deliver the 1 MW controls system** * + Complete PLC programming, sequence implementation, controls integration, and system\-level testing for the 1 MW Boiler 2\.0 platform. * + Develop and verify startup, normal operation, shutdown, maintenance, fault, trip, and recovery behavior, including interlocks, permissives, alarms, timeouts, and protective responses. * + Own controls issue resolution during panel checkout, I/O checkout, build, factory acceptance testing, commissioning, and early operation. * **Build the controls architecture and software platform** * + Develop modular, state\-based control software using consistent equipment modules, control modules, interfaces, naming, and version\-control practices. * + Configure Siemens PLC and distributed I/O hardware, industrial networks, drives, IO\-Link devices, instrumentation, and third\-party equipment interfaces. * + Create reusable code libraries, simulation and test typing where appropriate, and consistent error handling * Define and enforce testing practices for applied AI (unit tests, integration tests, golden/regression tests) * Implement instrumentation appropriate for debugging and iteration (basic logging/tracing/metrics for AI features) * Ensure reliability and security basics: rate limiting where needed, safe input handling, prompt\-injection awareness, and sensible defaults Experience in shipping data projects to real users * * **Collaboration \& Enablement** * Experience collaborating with software engineers * Work with AI Developers to productionize their experiments regarding improving user workflows * Define workflows: notebook/test repository PR staging production * Document AI infrastructure and best practices * Review code and (beyond prototypes) * Strong software engineering fundamentals: design patterns, code structure, testing practices, and code review habits * Cloud infrastructure experience: GCP (Vertex AI preferred) or AWS (SageMaker) * API/service development experience (e.g., FastAPI/REST/async programming)CI/CD and DevOps: Docker, Terraform, GitHub Actions * Monitoring and observability * Problem\-solving mindset * Operating experience with AI deployment in enterprise environment * Proactiveness and versatility: The role requires being comfortable with defining and scoping tasks independently as well taking the initiative and finding ways to improve **Nice\-to\-Have** * Experience fine\-tuning or training models * Familiarity with LangChain, Pydantic AI or similar frameworks * Knowledge of prompt engineering and evaluation techniques * Experience with real\-time inference and streaming responses * Background in data engineering or ML engineering * Understanding of RAG architectures * Contributions to open\-source AI/ML projects **What we offer:** * **Competitive compensation** * **Stock Options Plan:** Empowering you to share in our success and growth. * **Cutting\-Edge Tools:** Access to state\-of\-the\-art tools and collaborative opportunities with leading experts in artificial intelligence, physics, hardware and electronic design automation. * **Work\-Life Balance:** Flexible work arrangements in one of our offices with potential options for remote work. * **Professional Growth:** Opportunities to attend industry conferences, present research findings, and engage with the global AI research community. * **Impact\-Driven Culture:** Join a passionate team focused on solving some of the most challenging problems at the intersection of AI and hardware. **Work model \& location expectations:** *Hybrid from Boston office, 3x/week* **Why join us?** At Axiomatic\_AI, you will be working on technology that drives innovation in AI for scientific and engineering jobs.title: Director of Machine Learning
jobs.description: ### **Description** BigHat Biosciences is seeking an exceptional player\-coach to serve as Director of Machine Learning. Reporting to the CIO, you will own the technical direction, and a meaningful share of the hands\-on execution, of BigHat's machine learning capabilities and the growing domain of machine learning operations, including agent development and how agents automate and extend our internally built computational platform and force multiply the impact of our teams. We are looking for someone with genuine theoretical depth and the vision to say where ML\-driven antibody design should go next. Your team will develop state\-of\-the\-art antibody property models with the goal of iteratively improving our antibody designs and you’ll own the proof points that demonstrate the impact of these models. You’ll build agent services to bolster the agility and impact of our teams and work with frontier AI labs to adapt LLMs to new agentic antibody design challenges. As our platform value grows, so does our opportunity to create new and valuable platform partnerships. You will be accountable for the ML that differentiates our therapeutic programs, and for the modeling capabilities we put in front of data and model partners. At BigHat, we only declare success upon synthesis of real antibodies with drug\-like properties that improve patient outcomes. This is a rare opportunity to run frontier ML within a one\-of\-a\-kind production platform, with an automated high\-throughput wet lab generating the data to fuel it.### **Key Responsibilities** **ML strategy and vision:** Own and continuously sharpen BigHat's machine learning roadmap. Articulate where the field is going and where we intend to lead. **Deliver best in class therapeutic models:** Utilize BigHat’s data repository and data generation capabilities to create multi\-objective predictive models to demonstrate a durable, benchmarked, best\-in\-industry proof that better models accelerate real therapeutics. Develop and train models that support the safe and effective creation of increasingly sophisticated, multi\-specific antibodies that patients need today. **Frontier models joined with best\-in\-class data**: Apply frontier models, utilizing BigHat’s unique datasets and data capabilities, against nature’s hardest protein design challenges. Optimize our design loop by integrating our lab, computational platform and data with LLM automation. **Agentic direction**: Join forces across the CIO organization to steer our unified LLM and ML approach. Relentlessly drive our adoption of safe, impactful LLMs and similar models, agent frameworks and RL evaluation benchmarking frameworks to empower every BigHatter. **Program impact:** Ensure that models, provenance, and benchmarks flow through our infrastructure without heroics, and that build\-test\-train design rounds fully leverage model insight for all 2k\+ antibodies designed each week. Be accountable for computational deliverables to internal and partnered programs, delivering timely analyses, predictions, and optimized variant sets that drive progress toward clinic\-ready molecules. **Platform as product:** Work with business development, partnerships, and executive leadership to translate our data generation and modeling capabilities into offerings that frontier AI companies and biopharma partners can buy. Scope pilots, define what technical success looks like, and deliver it. **Team leadership:** Mentor and grow a small, senior team of ML scientists and engineers. Set the bar for rigor, collaboration, and intellectual honesty, and create the conditions for people to do the best work of their careers. **External leadership:** Publish, present, and engage the ML and protein engineering communities. Strengthen BigHat's reputation as the place where frontier machine learning meets industrial\-scale, purpose\-built biological data.### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise** **Theory and vision:** You reason from first principles about why a method should work, design the experiment that would falsify it, and explain the whole thing clearly to a room of interdisciplinary scientists. You hold opinions about where protein ML is heading and have a track record that supports them. **Technical mastery:** Deep, current command of modern ML: generative models of protein sequence and structure, Bayesian optimization and active learning, uncertainty quantification, data\-efficient predictive modeling/in\-context learning, etc. Strong Python and PyTorch, with real comfort in modern software engineering practice, cloud computing, and MLOps. **Player\-coach instinct:** You lead by doing as well as by directing. You are energized by writing code and running benchmarks alongside your team. **Operational excellence:** You have shipped ML into production systems and care about reproducibility, provenance, benchmarking, and cycle time as much as about model architecture. **Biological fluency:** Working knowledge of antibody biology, developability, and drug development, or the demonstrated ability and appetite to acquire it quickly. Familiarity with display, NGS, and high\-throughput biophysical data is a strong plus. **Education \& Experience:** Ph.D. in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Computational Biology or a related field, with 8\+ years of experience developing and applying advanced ML methods (industry experience strongly preferred), including demonstrated leadership of technical teams or major technical programs. **Collaboration \& Communication:** Excellent written and verbal communication. You thrive in interdisciplinary settings alongside protein scientists, automation engineers, software engineers, and drug developers, and you are credible in front of partners and external audiences. **Passion for Impact:** Motivated by BigHat's mission to bring safer, more effective antibody therapies to patients, and motivated by the chance to make a one\-of\-a\-kind platform the best in the world at what it does.### **Total Rewards** The salary estimated for this position is $250,000 \- $365,000 \+ bonus \+ options \+ benefits. Compensation will vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Actual compensation will be confirmed in writing at the time of the offer.### **About BigHat Biosciences** **BigHat Biosciences designs safer, more effective biologic therapies for patients using machine learning and synthetic biology.** BigHat integrates a wet lab for high\-speed characterization with machine learning technologies to guide the search for better antibodies. We apply these design capabilities to develop new generations of safer and more effective treatments for patients suffering from today’s most challenging diseases. BigHat is a Series B biotech outside San Francisco with a team\-oriented, inclusive, and family\-friendly culture. Our broad pipeline of wholly\-owned and partnered therapeutic programs span many disparate indications with high unmet need, such as cancer, inflammation, and infectious disease. BigHat has raised \>$100M from top investors, including Section 32, a16z, and 8VC.

jobs.title: Senior Research Programmer/Analyst Pharmacoepidemiology
jobs.description: Site: The Brigham and Women's Hospital, Inc. Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not\-for\-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high\-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham. **Job Summary** GENERAL SUMMARY/ OVERVIEW STATEMENT: The Division of Pharmacoepidemiology and Pharmacoeconomics at Brigham and Women’s Hospital and Harvard Medical School was created to facilitate a wide range of activities related to the use and outcomes of medications. Its mission is to bring together medicine, epidemiology, biostatistics, health services research, data science, and related disciplines to evaluate the benefits, risks, utilization, and costs of existing and new prescription medications and to develop methods to optimize medication use. The Senior Research Programmer/Analyst will support this mission as part of a highly collaborative multidisciplinary research environment comprising approximately 30 Harvard Medical School faculty members and 80 research and administrative staff, including a team of experienced research programmers/analysts. The Division’s research makes extensive use of large and complex real\-world healthcare data, including longitudinal health insurance claims and electronic health records, as well as data from surveys and randomized trials. The Senior Research Programmer/Analyst will have the opportunity to work closely with epidemiologists, biostatisticians, clinicians, and other quantitative researchers to translate scientific questions into reproducible analytic datasets and analyses. The Division uses a range of programming languages and computational tools to work with large\-scale, complex healthcare data, with SAS serving as a core programming language and R and Python used in complementary applications across our research portfolio. Because a substantial body of our established analytic infrastructure is built in SAS, advanced SAS expertise is essential for this position, while proficiency in R and/or Python is strongly valued. We encourage the use of modern, efficient, and reproducible approaches to data analysis and welcome candidates who bring strong computational skills and can contribute to the continued evolution of programming practices across languages and platforms. PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: * Support faculty and other research staff in the development of analytic datasets and the conduct of statistical analyses for pharmacoepidemiologic, health services, and related research. * Develop, validate, manage, analyze, and document large and complex healthcare datasets, including longitudinal health insurance claims and electronic health record data. * Translate research questions and study protocols into efficient and reproducible programming workflows, including data cleaning, transformation, linkage, cohort construction, variable creation, and statistical analysis. * Apply programming best practices, including systematic quality control, code review, version control, modular and reusable programming, and clear documentation to support reproducibility and collaboration. * Contribute to the Division’s programming and research\-computing environment across SAS, R, Python, SQL, and related tools, including identifying opportunities to improve workflows, computational efficiency, and reusable infrastructure. * Collaborate closely with faculty and research staff across multiple ongoing and new research projects. * Participate in programmer/analyst team meetings, mentor junior programmers/analysts, and serve as a technical resource to other members of the research team. **Qualifications** QUALIFICATIONS: * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, statistics, biostatistics, epidemiology, biomedical informatics, mathematics, engineering, or another relevant quantitative field required. * Master’s degree preferred. * At least 3 years of relevant programming and data\-analysis experience required; 5 or more years of experience in a healthcare, research, or similarly data\-intensive environment preferred * Advanced proficiency in SAS required, including substantial experience with data management and analysis of large datasets. * Proficiency in R and/or Python strongly preferred. * Experience with SQL and relational databases strongly preferred. * Experience working with large, complex, longitudinal datasets required; experience with healthcare claims and/or electronic health record data strongly preferred. SKILLS/ ABILITIES/ COMPETENCIES REQUIRED: * Strong programming and problem\-solving skills, with careful attention to accuracy, reproducibility, and quality control. * Ability to manage and prioritize multiple concurrent research projects * Experience working in Linux/Unix\-based command\-line environments and remote computing systems. * Experience with version\-control systems such as Git/GitHub or similar platforms. * Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary research teams and communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical collaborators. ADDITIONAL DESIRED SKILLS: The following are considered a plus but are not required: * Experience developing reusable, efficient, and reproducible data\-processing or analytic workflows for large datasets. * Familiarity with high\-performance, cloud\-based, or distributed computing environments and modern software development practices. * Knowledge of epidemiologic and biostatistical methods and/or experience with emerging computational approaches, including machine learning and AI\-enabled research tools. **Additional Job Details (if applicable)** **Remote Type** Hybrid **Work Location** 399 Revolution Drive **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40 **Employee Type** Regular **Work Shift** Day (United States of America) **Pay Range** $79,560\.00 \- $115,720\.80/Annual **Grade** 7 At Mass General Brigham, we believe in recognizing and rewarding the unique value each team member brings to our organization. Our approach to determining base pay is comprehensive, and any offer extended will take into account your skills, relevant experience if applicable, education, certifications and other essential factors. The base pay information provided offers an estimate based on the minimum job qualifications; however, it does not encompass all elements contributing to your total compensation package. In addition to competitive base pay, we offer comprehensive benefits, career advancement opportunities, differentials, premiums and bonuses as applicable and recognition programs designed to celebrate your contributions and support your professional growth. We invite you to apply, and our Talent Acquisition team will provide an overview of your potential compensation and benefits package. **EEO Statement:** 2200 The Brigham and Women's Hospital, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religious creed, national origin, sex, age, gender identity, disability, sexual orientation, military service, genetic information, and/or other status protected under law. We will ensure that all individuals with a disability are provided a reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. To ensure reasonable accommodation for individuals protected by Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, the Vietnam Veteran’s Readjustment Act of 1974, and Title I of the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, applicants who require accommodation in the job application process may contact Human Resources at (857\)\-282\-7642\.**Mass General Brigham Competency Framework** --------------------------------------------- At Mass General Brigham, our competency framework defines what effective leadership “looks like” by specifying which behaviors are most critical for successful performance at each job level. The framework is comprised of ten competencies (half People\-Focused, half Performance\-Focused) and are defined by observable and measurable skills and behaviors that contribute to workplace effectiveness and career success. These competencies are used to evaluate performance, make hiring decisions, identify development needs, mobilize employees across our system, and establish a strong talent pipeline.

jobs.title: Senior Mobile Developer (Contract)
jobs.description: **Ready to accelerate your career?** Cardata is where driven people make an outsized impact. We're a small but mighty team transforming how businesses manage vehicle reimbursement — replacing outdated programs with smart, automated solutions. Our vision is bold: to provide the most comprehensive, intelligent, and automated software and services for creating ideal vehicle programs. And we're building toward that vision every single day. Join us and you'll find challenge, growth, and the chance to deliver real impact — helping hundreds of companies and thousands of drivers across North America focus on the work that matters most to them. We're hiring a Senior Developer with deep mobile expertise for a small, self\-contained innovation group (Initial three\-month contract, with opportunity for extension or move to full\-time). Working alongside a Product Manager and a web\-focused developer, you will take an ambiguous business problem, turn it into a testable product bet, and build the smallest end\-to\-end experience that can generate meaningful evidence, often in roughly one to two weeks. You will bring early versions back to customers and the market validation group, gather feedback, and rapidly iterate through V1, V2, V3, and beyond. Once the concept is validated, the group will shift from proving the idea to determining what must change for it to become secure, reliable, scalable, and ready for handoff. The group operates like an entrepreneurial startup within the larger organization and owns the path from problem discovery through rapid prototyping, customer and market validation, iterative development, and a validated proof of concept. From there, it determines what is required to harden and scale the product before handing it to the core product and engineering team. The operating principle is simple: build to learn first, then build to scale. During validation, speed comes from controlling scope and making deliberate, reversible technical choices—not from designing the final production architecture before the opportunity is proven. Security, privacy, and responsible data handling remain non\-negotiable throughout. Once an idea demonstrates value, you will work with our Core team at key technical integration points to harden, refactor, or redesign what is needed for scale. That judgment lets us discard weak ideas cheaply and invest deeply in the ones that earn it. This is a fit for someone with strong product and commercial instincts, sound technical judgment, and a high degree of ownership. You identify gaps, propose a path forward, and keep momentum without waiting for perfect requirements. You own outcomes, make clear trade\-offs to meet timelines, and raise consequential risks early. ### **What you'll do:** * Work with the Project Lead, Product Manager and Web Developer to turn ambiguous problems into unified driver\-and\-admin experiences * Build the smallest end\-to\-end prototype that can test the idea, often within one to two weeks * Bring prototypes to customers and the market validation group, then rapidly translate feedback into V2, V3, and beyond * Challenge assumptions, cut scope, and keep the group moving without waiting for perfect requirements * Make deliberate, reversible technical choices during validation while protecting security, privacy, and data integrity * Build within the shared codebase, behind feature flags and in isolated modules that can be removed cleanly * Integrate with our platform backend and third\-party APIs using existing contracts and patterns * Once a concept is validated, identify and complete the work required to harden, scale, test, and release it * Prepare validated features and technical context for a clean handoff to the core product and engineering team ### **What you'll bring:** **Core Experience** * 6–8 years as a software engineer at a senior level, with a track record of product work at startups and in fast\-paced environments * You've built from nothing, cut scope under time pressure, and shipped * Comfortable with ambiguity: you can take an unfamiliar domain and an under\-specified problem and make progress without waiting to be handed a spec * Strong product thinker who can connect driver and administrator needs, commercial value, and technical choices across mobile and web * Strong communicator who identifies gaps, proposes a path forward, and keeps the work moving * High ownership, sound judgment under time pressure, and a track record of delivering against commitments without hiding material trade\-offs * Comfortable working in a small, autonomous group where priorities can change quickly as new evidence emerges **Technical** * Very comfortable with React Native, plus native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) development * Familiar with the full mobile release process for both iOS and Android, including store submission and review * Solid integrating against REST / backend APIs and handling auth, tokens, and SSO on device * Comfortable collaborating across mobile, web, and backend boundaries to create one coherent product experience * You adopt the existing patterns and conventions of the mobile codebase rather than introducing your own * You know how to code and understand good software design. You are not strictly a "vibe coder": you can reason about architecture and trade\-offs, not just prompt your way to output **AI\-Native Mindset** * You've adopted modern AI development workflows and use tools like Cursor, Claude Code, or Copilot as part of how you ship * You understand AI skills, agents, and code\-spec workflows, and how to use them without losing engineering rigour * You lean on AI to move faster on prototypes and to hold quality up during hardening **Bonus (nice to have)** * Ability to flex onto the Portal stack (TypeScript / Next.js / NestJS / PostgreSQL) when a bet calls for it **Why you'll love working at Cardata:** We'll be honest — Cardata isn't for everyone. If you thrive in a fast\-paced environment, take extreme ownership, and constantly push yourself (and your work) to be the best, you'll fit right in. You'll be surrounded by driven teammates who genuinely care — about the work, about our customers, and about helping each other succeed. Together, we take on ambitious goals and celebrate the wins along the way. What we offer in return for you bringing your best: * Remote work and flexible working hours * Mentorship and development opportunities (to help you achieve your career goals!) * Extended medical \& dental benefits * Healthcare spending account * $3,000 annual Health and Wellness Spending Account to support your overall wellbeing * Employee assistance program (EAP) * Flexible (Unlimited) Time Off: No annual cap on vacation, supported by a trust\-based, flexible approach to time away. *Cardata is an equal opportunity employer. All candidates will be equally considered without regard to race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, language, citizenship, creed, religion, gender/gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, physical and/or mental handicap or financial ability. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to bring their authentic selves to work.* *If you require accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know.*

jobs.title: Agentic Product Manager
jobs.description: CCC Intelligent Solutions Inc. (CCC) is a leading cloud platform for the multi\-trillion\-dollar insurance economy**,** creating intelligent experiences for insurers, repairers, automakers, part suppliers, and more. At CCC, we’re making life just work by empowering more than 35,000 businesses with industry\-leading technology to get drivers back on the road and to health quickly and seamlessly. We’re pushing boundaries with innovative AI solutions that simplify and enhance the claims and repair journey. Through purposeful innovation and the strength of its connections, CCC technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most. Learn more about CCC at www.cccis.com. **The Role** ============ We are hiring a Product Manager to own the development of CCC’s Agentic product platform. This is a new product line focused on delivering AI agents across our portfolio, with an initial focus on improving the claims experience. This role is ideal for a hands\-on product manager who is energized by zero\-to\-one product building, complex enterprise workflows, and regulated environments. You will build the product from discovery through launch, partnering closely with engineering, design, go\-to\-market teams, and customers to define how agentic AI can safely and effectively operate in high\-stakes claims processes.**Key Responsibilities:** ========================= * Own the product strategy, roadmap, and business case for agentic capabilities, taking the work from initial concept through customer validation, launch, and iteration * Define what the agents do, including the claims workflows they manage, where people remain in the loop, and how autonomy expands as performance and trust are demonstrated * Set product requirements for quality and safety, including evaluations, guardrails, escalation paths, and auditability, in partnership with engineering, legal, compliance, and claims experts * Work directly with claims leaders and end users to identify high\-value problems, validate product concepts, and translate customer insight into product decisions * Own the product story, value proposition, and proof points, partnering with sales, customer success, and product marketing to bring the product to market * Partner closely with engineering and design to prototype, build, test, and ship working agentic experiences, using AI tools to accelerate learning and delivery * Define success measures, adoption hypotheses, and decision criteria for each product investment, and make clear recommendations about when to iterate, scale, or stop **Requirements:** ================= * 3\+ years of product management experience in enterprise software or a high\-growth SaaS environment * Experience owning a product or significant product area from discovery through launch and iteration * Experience working in or learning a complex, regulated industry * Demonstrated experience building and shipping AI\-driven products; experience with LLM\-based or agentic systems strongly preferred * Track record of working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders to validate product direction and communicate value * Ability to translate customer needs into product requirements, priorities, measurable outcomes, and clear decisions * Comfort operating in ambiguity, with a bias toward action, learning, and accountable ownership **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- * **You are a product manager who has owned meaningful work from concept through launch**, ideally in an environment where speed, curiosity, and resourcefulness were important. You connect customer problems to business value and can carry that framing through discovery, delivery, and iteration. * **You can learn complex, regulated workflows quickly.** Experience in fintech, healthtech, legaltech, HCM, insurtech, or a similar industry is valuable, but what matters most is your ability to distinguish essential requirements from legacy process and turn domain knowledge into strong product decisions. * **You have commercial instinct and are comfortable creating demand for something new.** You can participate in customer pitches, build a practical value story, listen for real buying signals, and translate market feedback into product priorities. * **You are technically fluent and enjoy building.** You can work closely with engineers, use AI coding or prototyping tools, understand technical tradeoffs, and assess whether a product experience is effective—not merely functional. * **You have shipped a product where AI was central to the value proposition.** You can explain when an agentic approach is appropriate, when a deterministic workflow is better, and how reliability, autonomy, and human oversight should be designed. * **You create momentum across teams.** You communicate clearly, build trust, and bring engineering, design, data, sales, marketing, and customer\-facing partners together around the work you own. **Interview Policy \& Privacy Notice:** ======================================= A video interview is required for this position. Video interviews are transcribed. Transcriptions are retained and may be reviewed by CCC and our recruiters. Candidates are not permitted to use generative AI or automated assistance during the interviews unless explicitly allowed by the interview team for a specific exercise. Our Job Applicant Privacy Notice is available HERE. **About CCC's Commitment to Employees:** ======================================== CCC Intelligent Solutions understands that our employees play an integral role in our vision to shape a world where life just works. Our team is defined by our values of Integrity, Customer\-Focus, Innovation, Inclusion \& Diversity, Tenacity, and Connection. Through diverse perspectives, purposeful innovation, and the strength of connections, our technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most. At CCC, together everyone can thrive as we innovate and collaborate, creating employee experiences that just work. We are committed to providing opportunities for our people to make real\-life impacts, advance in their careers, and contribute to CCC’s success. CCC offers competitive compensation and benefits to support you and your families, including: * 401K Match * Paid time off * Annual Incentive Plan Performance Bonus * Comprehensive health insurance * Adoption Assistance * Tuition Reimbursement * Wellness Programs * Stock Purchase Plan options * Employee Resource Groups For more information about our benefits, please check out our careers site. Here, you belong. You are seen, valued, and respected. We celebrate you for who you are and all you bring. Every voice is heard and is important to our success. You can hear what employees have to say about our culture here If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, please contact (800\) 621\-8070\.

jobs.title: Director, Engineering
jobs.description: Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. **About the Role:** We’re looking for a seasoned engineering leader to own and scale the GPU and data center infrastructure that powers our neocloud platform. This hands\-on leadership role sits at the intersection of software and hardware. You’ll lead the teams building validation platforms, lifecycle automation, and orchestration services that keep our fleet healthy, while also owning firmware qualification, hardware security, deployments, and data center operations across a fleet growing roughly 10x year over year. Our fleet runs under a 99\.5% monthly availability SLA, so your reliability and automation work is directly tied to revenue. You’ll set the technical charter for fleet reliability and operational excellence, defining north\-star availability metrics and building automation that replaces today’s manual processes. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Product, Finance, and the executive team. The ideal candidate scales through systems rather than headcount, reasons from first principles, and leads from the front by digging into root causes. This is a full\-time, senior leadership position. **What You'll Be Working On:** * **Infrastructure Deployment \& Fleet Management:** Lead day\-to\-day fleet operations and greenfield deployments across co\-location and owned facilities, from rack landing to customer availability. Own core fleet\-health metrics and drive toward a 30\-day time\-to\-sellable target. * **Firmware Lifecycle Management:** Build the pipeline to qualify and track every firmware release across 10\+ SKUs and multiple OEMs/ODMs. Eliminate the qualification backlog (e.g., the \~66\-day NVIDIA firmware lag), hold partners accountable, and evaluate in\-house BMC development (OpenBMC). * **Validation Framework \& Platform:** Consolidate siloed hardware automation pipelines and validation scripts into a single platform built on a proper workflow engine. Own bare\-metal and multi\-node burn\-in/stress testing, define pass/fail criteria, deliver performance baselines (such as MFU) at cluster handover, and make stack\-validation results a required approval criterion for production changes. * **Data Center Infrastructure Engineering (DCIE):** Own power, cooling, networking fabrics, and physical security. Prioritize RMAs ahead of warranty expiry, reduce manual node recoveries through lifecycle automation, and make that automation the source of truth for site deployments. Lead asset\-visibility initiatives such as fleet\-wide RFID and advanced DCIM tooling. * **Hardware Security \& Attestation:** Own the strategy for trusted, tamper\-evident hardware. Lead the design and rollout of firmware and OS integrity attestation (TPM\-based identity, secure boot gating, remote attestation) that can quarantine compromised hardware, with no impact on customer training or inference workloads. * **Reliability \& Incident Operations:** Define operational KPIs (uptime, PUE, MTTR, MTTD, MTBF), and establish runbooks, a tiered on\-call model, and single\-owner incident closure. * **Procurement, CapEx \& Budget Ownership:** Partner with Procurement, Hardware, and Supply Chain on GPU and hardware sourcing, including pricing, supply commitments, and SLAs. Work with the Hardware leader on fleet capital and operating budgets, and report on fleet health, spend, and forecast to executive leadership. * **Team Leadership \& Outcome Alignment:** Build, develop, and retain a high\-performing team of fleet engineers, DC infrastructure professionals, and platform/automation software engineers. Translate engineering targets into clear business outcomes and define SLOs with Product across compute, storage, networking, and inference. **What You'll Bring to the Team:** * 18\+ years of experience in infrastructure, data center operations, or fleet management, including 6\+ years in a senior leadership role * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience * Deep hands\-on expertise with GPU infrastructure, including NVIDIA or AMD accelerator platforms * A genuine blend of software and hardware leadership, with equal credibility driving platform/automation software (workflow engines, orchestration, validation pipelines) and physical\-layer DC operations * Experience operating or scaling data center infrastructure in a high\-growth environment such as a neocloud, hyperscaler, or large enterprise * Strong command of DC fundamentals: power distribution, cooling systems, networking fabrics, and physical security * Proven ability to manage vendor relationships and negotiate large\-scale infrastructure contracts ($50M\+), and to own large CapEx budgets in partnership with Finance and Procurement * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex infrastructure topics for executive and non\-technical audiences **Bonus Points** * Prior experience at a neocloud or AI infrastructure company, and familiarity with GPU failure modes and auto\-remediation techniques * Hands\-on experience with firmware qualification, BMC/OpenBMC development, or hardware attestation (TPM, secure boot, remote attestation) * Familiarity with InfiniBand, RoCE, or other high\-performance networking fabrics at scale * Experience building validation/burn\-in platforms and multi\-node performance benchmarking (e.g., MFU, collective communication tests) * Exposure to DCIM, asset management/RFID, or lifecycle automation and fleet orchestration tools (e.g., NetBox, Temporal), or a background in sustainability initiatives such as renewable energy procurement **Benefits:** * Competitive compensation and equity packages * Restricted Stock Units * Paid time off, paid holidays \& leave of absence programs * Comprehensive health, dental \& vision insurance * Employer contributions to HSA account * Paid parental leave * Paid life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability * Professional development \& tuition reimbursement * Mental health \& wellness support * Commuter benefits (parking \& transit) * Cell phone jobs.title: Production Engineer II
jobs.description: Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. ### **Start Your Infrastructure Career at the Center of the AI Buildout** This is an entry point into Production Engineering, not a stepping\-stone support role. You'll be one of the engineers keeping a multi\-billion dollar, rapidly scaling AI cloud business online, from every GPU cluster to every customer workload and every SLA, while you build the foundational skills that turn into a Senior and Staff\-level infrastructure career. We're hiring several Production Engineer II roles as we build out the next generation of our reliability organization. We'll determine which team is the best fit for you after the interview process, based on your background, interests, and where your strengths line up with our needs. The work ranges from broad, cross\-domain operations to deeper specialization in compute, storage, or networking, depending on the team. **What You'll Work On** * Triage and resolve production incidents: parse logs, correlate signals across services, and drive issues to root cause using logs, telemetry, and profiling * Write real automation and tooling in Python or Go to reduce manual toil, including remediation scripts and health checks that catch problems before customers do * Build and improve monitoring, alerting, observability, and telemetry so the team can see problems before they become incidents * Participate in on\-call rotations, respond to alerts, and contribute to blameless post\-mortems * Work directly with senior and staff engineers on real production engineering problems, and grow into more autonomy quickly **Depending on Your Team** * Own the health and reliability of production infrastructure supporting Crusoe's AI cloud, whether working cross\-domain or going deep in one area * Build breadth across Crusoe's infrastructure stack and grow toward a specialization (compute, storage, networking, or continued breadth) over time * On some teams, go deep on one specialization (compute and GPU fleet reliability, storage and distributed storage systems, networking fabric and SDN, Managed AI, Inference, or Managed Cloud) * On hardware\-focused teams, help keep our GPU fleet, including NVIDIA and AMD hardware, running reliably under real production AI workloads * Run validation testing on configuration changes, firmware updates, and infrastructure modifications before they touch production * Learn directly from senior and staff engineers who own the hardware and reliability standards for their domain, and grow toward owning more of that surface area yourself **What You'll Bring** * A CS or EE degree, bootcamp, or equivalent hands\-on experience, plus genuine interest in infrastructure and systems reliability over application development * 3 to 5 years of working proficiency in Python or Go. You're comfortable writing and debugging real code, not just shell one\-liners * Familiarity with Linux fundamentals: processes, networking, filesystems, and how hardware and software interact * Comfort in a fast\-paced, high\-ownership environment with a real on\-call rotation * Strong communication skills. You'll write incident summaries and work with engineers across compute, storage, and networking, not just your own team **Mindset** * Curiosity about how distributed systems fail and a habit of asking "why" past the first answer * Openness to either broad cross\-domain work or early specialization in one domain, depending on where the team needs you **Nice to Have** * Exposure to Kubernetes or container orchestration (not required, we'll teach you what matters here) * Exposure to GPUs, HPC environments, kernel internals, or systems and validation engineering coursework or projects * Prior on\-call, NOC, IT ops, or lab/systems administration experience, plus personal projects, open source contributions, or coursework touching distributed systems, low\-level systems, or hardware **What This Role Is Not** * **This is a role that focuses on reliability, not pure Software Engineering**. You won't be building product features. You'll be keeping GPU, storage, or networking infrastructure healthy and reliable under real production load. * **Not a role where scripting is optional**. You need working proficiency in Python or Go on day one. Real automation work starts immediately, not after a year of ramping. * **Not a help desk or NOC ticket\-passing role**. You'll do real engineering: writing automation, debugging distributed systems, and contributing to design discussions. * **Not a low\-ownership job**. You'll carry on\-call and be expected to grow into more autonomy quickly. * **Not primarily a Kubernetes or orchestration\-tooling job**. Managing a Kubernetes cluster isn't the bar. We're looking for people curious about what's happening below that layer, in the hardware and systems themselves. **Benefits** * Industry competitive pay * Restricted Stock Units in a fast growing, well\-funded technology company * Health insurance package options that include HDHP and PPO, vision, and dental for you and your dependents * Employer contributions to HSA accounts * Paid Parental Leave * Paid life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability * Teladoc * 401(k) with a 100% match up to 4% of salary * Generous paid time off and holiday schedule * Cell phone reimbursement * Tuition reimbursement * Subscription to the Calm app * MetLife Legal * Company paid commuter benefit; $300 per month **Compensation** Compensation will be paid in the range of $140,000 to $165,000\. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.
