jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer - Trust and Safety
jobs.description: #### **What's in it for you?** Ready to make a serious impact? Millions of people already rely on Calendly, and we're still in the midst of exciting product growth — it's a fantastic time to join us. Everything you'll work on here will accelerate your career to the next level. If you want to learn, grow, and do the best work of your life alongside the best people you've ever worked with, then we hope you'll consider allowing Calendly to be a part of your professional journey. **About the team \& opportunity** Millions of people use Calendly to book meetings, and most of that happens on public booking pages where anyone with a link can schedule time. That openness is what makes Calendly easy to use, and it's also what makes it a target. The **Trust \& Safety** team keeps Calendly safe without slowing anyone down. We protect everyone who interacts with Calendly: the hosts who share their links, the invitees who book with them, and the email and SMS providers and partners who rely on us to send responsibly. Our work covers three areas: preventing and responding to abuse, protecting the deliverability and compliance of the messages Calendly sends, and keeping messaging costs predictable as the platform grows. Most of our problems are adversarial. We often can't rely on knowing who someone is, so we judge behavior, patterns, and content instead. Attackers change tactics all the time, so we build signals that last from one attack to the next. And we take false positives seriously, because blocking a real customer costs more than letting a spammer through. Engineers work closely with our Trust \& Safety Operations team, who see abuse first and shape what we build. In this role, you will report to the Engineering Manager for the Trust \& Safety team. **A day in the life of a Full Stack Engineer at Calendly** On a typical day, you will be working on: * Building and improving the systems that detect and stop abuse across sign\-up, booking, and messaging, such as spam, phishing, bots, and fraudulent SMS traffic. * Improving the reliability, deliverability, and compliance of the email and SMS notifications Calendly sends. * Shipping new detection carefully: measuring how it performs on real traffic before it acts on accounts, and weighing false positives against false negatives. * Responding to active abuse, including during on\-call, by stopping the damage fast, then replacing quick fixes with durable ones. * Building tools that help our Trust \& Safety Operations team review accounts faster and understand why the system took each action. * Partnering with Product, Operations, and Data to define requirements and measure the impact of what we ship. * Working with other product teams to add protections to the flows they own. * Reviewing implementation plans and pull requests, and sharing what you learn with the team. **What do we need from you?** * 3\+ years of professional software development experience at a SaaS or technology company, including building and running production systems. * Strong backend skills: building services, APIs, and data\-heavy workflows in a service\-oriented architecture. * Experience with Rails, Node/TypeScript, Go, or a comparable language or framework, and a willingness to work across more than one. * Comfort with relational databases and SQL, and with using data to check whether a change actually worked. * An analytical, curious mindset: you think about how a system could be misused, not only how it's supposed to be used. * Good judgment about trade\-offs, such as stopping bad actors without adding friction for real customers. * A commitment to clean, reliable, maintainable code, thoughtful testing, and shipping in small increments. * Clear communication with engineers and non\-engineers alike, including Operations and Support partners. * Comfort and skill with AI tools in your engineering work, including reviewing their output critically. * Availability to take part in an on\-call rotation for critical services. * Authorized to work lawfully in the United States of America as Calendly does not engage in immigration sponsorship at this time. **Nice to have** * Experience in trust and safety, fraud, spam, or abuse prevention. * Experience with email or SMS delivery, such as deliverability, sender reputation, or messaging compliance. * Experience with bot protection, rate limiting, or third\-party risk and verification services. * Experience building rules engines, risk scoring, or ML\-backed decisions in production. * Experience using LLMs to classify or moderate user\-generated content. * Experience with GCP, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, or Redis. The ranges listed above are the expected annual base salary for this role, subject to change. Calendly takes a number of factors into consideration when determining an employee's starting salary, including relevant experience, relevant skills sets, interview performance, location/metropolitan area, and internal pay equity. Base salary is just one component of Calendly's total rewards package. All full\-time (30 hours/week) employees are also eligible for equity awards, and competitive benefits. Eligible Sales employees also qualify for a Sales Incentive program. Calendly uses the zip code of an employee's remote work location, or the onsite building location if hybrid, to determine which metropolitan pay range we use. Current geographic zones are as follows: * Tier 1: San Francisco, CA, San Jose, CA, New York City, NY * Tier 2: Chicago, IL, Austin, TX, Denver, CO, Boston, MA, Washington D.C., Philadelphia, PA, Portland, OR, Seattle, WA, Miami, FL, and all other cities in CA. * Tier 3: All other locations not in Tier 1 or Tier 2 **If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the application or recruiting process, please let your Recruiter know when first connecting with them. Calendly is registered as an employer in many, but not all, states. If you are located in Alaska, Delaware, Hawaii, Idaho, Iowa, Montana, Nebraska, North Dakota, Rhode Island, South Dakota, and West Virginia, you will not be eligible for employment. Note that all individual roles will specify location eligibility.** **All candidates can find our Candidate Privacy Statement** **here** **Candidates residing in California may visit our Notice at Collection for California Candidates here:** **Notice at Collection** This role may require occasional travel for company events, team collaboration, or offsites.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Overview** We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our dynamic development team. In this role, you will lead the design, development, and implementation of scalable, high\-performance software solutions that drive our core systems forward. You will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams to develop innovative features, optimize existing applications, and ensure our infrastructure supports rapid growth and evolving business needs. Your expertise in software engineering principles, system architecture, and modern development practices will be instrumental in shaping the future of our technology landscape. **Responsibilities** * Lead the architecture and design of complex software systems, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security across cloud infrastructure and on\-premises environments. * Develop robust web applications using JavaScript frameworks such as React or Angular, integrating seamlessly with backend services via RESTful APIs. * Build and maintain microservices architectures utilizing programming languages like Java, C\#, Python, or Ruby on Rails to support scalable system development. * Implement and optimize database solutions using SQL\-based systems such as MySQL or PostgreSQL, ensuring data integrity and performance. * Drive software development best practices through Agile methodologies, including sprint planning, code reviews, continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD), and version control with Git or SVN. * Design and implement APIs adhering to REST principles for seamless communication between distributed components. * Collaborate with product managers and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical specifications while applying design patterns for maintainable code. * Ensure system security through RBAC (Role\-Based Access Control), secure coding practices, and compliance with industry standards. * Contribute to the evaluation and integration of cloud infrastructure services such as AWS or Azure to enhance system scalability and resilience. **Experience** * Proven experience as a Senior Software Engineer or similar role with a strong portfolio of developing scalable web applications and backend systems. * Extensive knowledge of IT infrastructure components supporting software deployment in cloud environments like AWS or Azure. * Hands\-on expertise in programming languages including JavaScript (React, Express), Java, C\#, Python, Ruby on Rails, C\+\+, C, or.NET frameworks. * Deep understanding of software design principles, patterns, microservices architecture, RESTful API development, and system design for large\-scale applications. * Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban to foster collaborative project execution. * Experience working with version control tools like GitHub or SVN alongside CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment processes. * Strong background in database management using SQL databases like MySQL or PostgreSQL; experience with NoSQL is a plus. * Knowledge of security best practices including RBAC implementation and secure API development to protect sensitive data. * Ability to work effectively in Linux environments and utilize modern front\-end technologies such as JavaScript frameworks (React) for full\-stack development. Join us to innovate at the forefront of technology by designing systems that are not only powerful but also reliable and scalable! Your expertise will help shape solutions that empower users worldwide while advancing your career in a vibrant tech environment committed to excellence and continuous learning. Pay: $117,000\.00 \- $142,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Faculty Position in Electrical Engineering
jobs.description: **Job Description** The Division of Engineering and Applied Science at the California Institute of Technology invites applications for tenure\-track/tenured faculty positions. We seek highly qualified candidates committed to a career in teaching, mentoring and research excellence in the department of Electrical Engineering. Preference will be given to candidates at the Assistant Professor level; however, well\-qualified applicants at the associate or full professor level may also be considered. Our department is a unique environment where innovative, interdisciplinary, and foundational research is conducted in a collegial atmosphere. We are seeking candidates in the broad area of information systems, including decision systems, systems for science, distributed systems, sensory systems (such as speech and vision), signal processing, data science, data communications and storage, energy systems, control, robotics, artificial intelligence, networking, and human\-in\-the\-loop systems. For tenure\-track candidates, the initial appointment is contingent upon completion of the Ph.D. degree. It is also anticipated that a successful candidate would collaborate broadly with investigators both within and beyond the Engineering and Applied Science Division, as well as in centers at Caltech including, for example, the Jet Propulsion Laboratory, the Center for Sensing to Intelligence, the Center for Autonomous Systems and Technologies, the Institute for Quantum Information and Matter, the Chen Institute for Neuroscience, the Merkin Institute, and the Resnick Sustainability Institute. Applications should be submitted online. Reviewing of applications will begin on November 8, but full consideration will be given to all candidates who apply by **December 6, 2026\.** The appointment is contingent upon completion of the Ph.D. degree in an appropriate engineering or science related discipline. Applications should include: * A brief cover letter. * Curriculum vitae. * Relevant publications. * A research statement describing research highlights and future goals and plans. * Applicants should submit an education statement that addresses the applicant’s thoughts on classroom and laboratory instruction, mentorship of students and postdoctoral scholars, and ways to foster an inclusive environment for the development of scholars who come to Caltech with many different perspectives and experiences. Questions about the application process may be directed to: ee\-search@caltech.edu. Pay: $125,000\.00 \- $400,000\.00 per year Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Software Development Manager
jobs.description: **Job Description:** Cambria is seeking an experienced, results\-driven Software Development Manager to lead a high\-performing team of software engineers responsible for building, optimizing, and maintaining enterprise applications, including Cambria .NET, Salesforce and Oracle platforms. Reporting to the VP, Program Management and Engineering, this role oversees software execution across Oracle EBS, microservices, and custom applications. You will mentor developers, streamline CI/CD delivery pipelines, and drive a culture of continuous improvement, urgency, and decisive communication. **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities:** * **Leadership \& Talent Development:** Lead, mentor, and grow a team of software engineers; conduct performance management, hiring, and career development. * **Execution \& Delivery:** Oversee application development, code reviews, and release lifecycles using Agile/Scrum/Kanban methodologies. * **Technical Oversight \& CI/CD:** Provide technical guidance across APIs, cloud services, and Oracle EBS integrations; establish automated testing, CI/CD, and coding standards. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with IT leaders, Product Owners, and Architects to translate product roadmaps into executable technical solutions. * **Operational Support \& Maintenance:** Maintain production applications, SQL/Oracle databases, software inventory, and technical documentation/SOPs. **Qualifications \& Skills:** * **Leadership:** Proven experience managing and scaling software engineering teams in fast\-paced environments. * **Technical Expertise:** Strong familiarity with modern stack technologies (microservices, APIs, SQL) and enterprise ERP systems (Oracle EBS). * **Agile \& Tooling:** Expertise in Agile delivery frameworks (Scrum/Kanban) and tools like Jira, Confluence, and CI/CD pipelines. * **Communication \& Strategy:** Strong interpersonal and problem\-solving skills with an ability to bridge business objectives with technical execution. **Minimum Requirements:** **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience. **Experience:** Minimum of 6–8 years of experience in software engineering, with at least 2–4 years in a direct supervisory, lead, or team management role. **Systems:** Hands\-on background with Oracle EBS, microservices, relational databases/SQL, and modern web application development. **Additional Requirements:** **Managerial Requirements:** Yes **Physical Requirements:** Able to lift up to 20 pounds occasionally / sparingly (office supplies, packages, samples). May need to bend, reach, walk, or stoop occasionally. Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer. **Travel Requirements:** May be required to travel between local Cambria locations Cambria’s starting salary range for this position is $121,000\- $160,000\. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the target for new hires for the position. Individual pay is determined by several factors, including work location, job\-related experience, and relevant education and/or training. Cambria offers a competitive benefits package that encompasses Health and Dental Insurance, Paid Time Off, 7 paid Holidays , 401(k) plus matching, Discretionary Profit Sharing, Flexible Spending Account; Life, Supplemental Life, and Disability Insurance; Referral Program, Tuition Reimbursement, Employee Assistance Program, Employee Discount and Professional Development Assistance. Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice. At Cambria, dedication to philanthropy and our people is at the heart of who we are. We strive to make a meaningful difference in the world every day by prioritizing employee well\-being and fostering inclusivity and empowerment. Under the banner of CambriaCares, our philanthropic endeavors show our commitment to our people and our community to uplift kids, support education, and contribute to a sustainable future. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend
jobs.description: CMT is seeking a senior\-level backend Software Engineer to produce scalable software solutions to reliably collect, process, and manage data from sensors on smartphones and connected devices in vehicles. In this role, you will design architecture, build back\-end applications, and build features and applications that meet the needs of our customers. If you're interested in using your skills to make the world's roads and drivers safer, we'd like to meet you. CMT is looking for a **Senior Software Engineer, Backend** to help us change the world. CMT has helped protect over 65 million drivers and prevent over 126,000 crashes worldwide. We build AI to solve some of the most difficult challenges in mobility — understanding and reducing risk, detecting crashes, and getting people life\-saving help. The problems are hard. The impact is real. No matter your role, your work will matter at CMT. **Responsibilities:** * Solve complex problems and transform them into business solutions in collaboration with team members * Analyze and translate business and functional specifications and change requests into technical specifications suitable for implementation * Able to independently transform complex technical requirements into smaller implementable pieces; able to implement performant software solutions that are maintainable, scalable, reliable and testable * Participate in code and design reviews * Train and guide junior developers on proper software development procedures and methods * Follow company defined development and operational standards and processes * Provide on\-call support during business critical emergency scenarios. Support and troubleshoot production issues as needed * Complete any additional tasks as they arise **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of experience and/or certification in Computer Science or related field * 4\+ years of relevant working experience in software engineering, with a focus on backend applications, services, and APIs * Strong programming skills in languages such as Python, Golang, and/or Rust * Experience with SQL databases in a production setting * Experience working with services in AWS * Ability to commute to our Cambridge, MA office 3 days per week * Excellent communication and collaboration skills **Compensation and Benefits:** * Fair and competitive salary based on skills and experience, and annual performance bonus * Equity may be awarded in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) * Medical, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance, matching 401k, short\-term \& long\-term disability and parental leave * Unlimited Paid Time Off including vacation, sick days \& public holidays * Flexible scheduling and work from home policy depending on role and responsibilities **Base Salary Range** * The base salary range for this position is: $139,300 to $174,100\. This range is specifically for Cambridge, MA **A****dditional Perks:** * Work on a mission with real impact: crashes prevented, injuries avoided, lives protected around the world * Join an industry leader — 65 million drivers protected, powering 140\+ programs across 25 countries * Recognized innovator in mobility AI, earning top honors including the TIME Industry Leader in AI, a Gold Edison Award, and the Artificial Intelligence Excellence Award for AI for Social Good. CMT is also Great Place to Work Certified * Be part of the team inventing the future of mobility and road safety * Move fast, own outcomes, do work that matters * High ownership, small teams, and direct access to leadership — no layers between your work and its impact * Unlimited PTO, flexible scheduling, competitive salary, annual performance bonus, RSUs, and full benefits including medical, dental, vision, and 401k match * Summer Fridays provide team members with half days to recharge * Join one of our employee resource groups: Black, AAPI, LGBTQIA\+, Women, Book Club, and Health \& Wellness * Comprehensive wellness, education, and employee assistance programs **Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:** At CMT, we believe the best ideas come from a mix of backgrounds and perspectives. We are an equal\-opportunity employer committed to creating a workplace and culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to bring their unique talents and perspectives. Diversity is essential to our success, and we actively seek candidates from all backgrounds to join our growing team. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability state. CMT is headquartered in Cambridge, MA. To learn more, visit www.cmtelematics.com and follow us on Instagram @cmt.ai **A****bout Cambridge Mobile Telematics:** Cambridge Mobile Telematics (CMT) is the world's largest telematics and AI company for safer mobility. Its mission is to make the world's roads and drivers safer. The company's AI\-driven platform, DriveWell Fusion®, proactively identifies and reduces driving risk, leading to fewer crashes and injuries. To date, CMT's technology has helped prevent over 126,000 crashes worldwide. CMT enables partners to measure risk, detect crashes, provide life\-saving assistance, and streamline claims. jobs.title: City Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary** Make a lasting impact on the future of a growing community. The City of Defiance is seeking an experienced and collaborative engineering professional to serve as City Engineer and lead the City's Engineering Division. Reporting to the City Administrator, the City Engineer is responsible for the planning, design, bidding, construction administration, and inspection of municipal infrastructure projects. This position oversees the City's engineering functions related to streets, sidewalks, stormwater systems, water distribution, sanitary sewer systems, drainage improvements, subdivision and development review, and capital improvement planning. The City Engineer supervises Engineering Division staff, manages consultant and contractor relationships, administers the division budget, assists with long\-range infrastructure planning, and works closely with City divisions, elected officials, government agencies, developers, and residents to ensure the successful delivery of public improvement projects. Qualified candidates must possess a bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, engineering, or engineering technology; registration as a Professional Civil Engineer in the State of Ohio; and at least five years of progressively responsible civil engineering experience involving municipal infrastructure or public works projects, including at least two years in a supervisory role. jobs.title: Data Engineer - Client Implementation
jobs.description: **DATA ENGINEER – CLIENT IMPLEMENTATION** Collective Data is seeking a client\-facing Data Engineer to help customers bring accurate, usable data into our fleet, asset, and quartermaster management platform. The primary focus of this role is working directly with clients and internal teams to efficiently load live and historical data from legacy systems, databases, spreadsheets, APIs, and other sources. This person will understand client requirements, evaluate source data, develop mapping and transformation logic, and build reliable processes for initial migrations and ongoing data feeds. The ideal candidate combines strong SQL skills, practical problem\-solving, and clear communication. They should also know how to use AI tools to accelerate data analysis, develop solutions, and improve efficiency while independently validating results. The role includes light database administration, with PostgreSQL experience strongly preferred. **Key Responsibilities:** **Client Collaboration and Data Planning** * Work directly with clients to understand their source systems, data structures, business processes, and migration or integration needs. * Partner with Client Delivery, Project Management, Support, Product, and Development teams to define requirements, dependencies, timelines, and acceptance criteria. * Translate business requirements into clear source\-to\-target mappings, transformation rules, and loading plans. * Explain data issues, technical options, and project progress in language clients and internal stakeholders can understand. **Data Migration and Integration** * Design, build, and maintain processes for loading historical records and ongoing operational data into the Collective Data platform. * Extract and transform data from relational databases, CSV and Excel files, APIs, ODBC connections, and other sources. * Write efficient SQL for profiling, cleansing, mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation. * Identify and resolve duplicates, missing values, inconsistent formats, invalid references, and other data quality issues. * Develop repeatable loading processes with logging, error handling, safe reruns, and controls to prevent duplicate or incomplete imports. * Validate record counts, relationships, key values, and business totals with clients and internal teams before accepting a load. * Troubleshoot failed imports and integration issues, identify root causes, and implement durable fixes. * Create reusable scripts, mapping templates, and documentation that reduce manual work across client projects. **Light Database Administration** * Assist with database health checks, query tuning, indexing, and troubleshooting, particularly in PostgreSQL. * Support approved database access, permissions, and routine maintenance activities. * Coordinate with Development and Infrastructure teams on database changes, backup and recovery needs, and performance issues. * Follow established change controls when working with production databases and client data. **AI\-Assisted Analysis and Solutions** * Use approved AI tools to accelerate source\-data analysis, SQL and script development, troubleshooting, and documentation. * Identify practical opportunities to improve data workflows through AI and automation. * Review, test, and validate AI\-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and suitability. * Handle client data according to company security requirements when using AI tools. **Required Qualifications:** * Demonstrated experience in data engineering, data migration, database development, or a closely related role. * Strong SQL skills, including complex joins, transformations, troubleshooting, and query optimization. * Experience moving data between systems and validating the accuracy and completeness of results. * Working knowledge of relational database design, keys, constraints, and referential integrity. * Experience with a scripting language such as Python for data processing and automation. * Ability to work directly with clients, ask effective questions, and turn incomplete requirements into workable solutions. * Practical experience using AI tools to support analysis or technical solution development. * Strong attention to detail, documentation habits, and ability to manage multiple client projects. **Preferred Qualifications:** * PostgreSQL experience. * Experience with ETL/ELT processes, REST APIs, ODBC, and scheduled or incremental data loads. * Experience with SaaS implementations, legacy system migrations, or customer data onboarding. * Familiarity with XML, JSON, and configurable business applications. * Experience with fleet, asset, inventory, maintenance, or government operational data. * Familiarity with version control and basic database administration. **What Success Looks Like:** * Clients live and historical data is loaded accurately, efficiently, and within agreed timelines. * Data issues are identified early and resolved with clear ownership and communication. * Imports and integrations are repeatable, documented, and easy to troubleshoot. * Reusable tools and automation reduce manual effort and client onboarding time. * Client and internal teams trust the quality of the data and understand how it was validated. **Who is Collective Data?** Collective Data is a leading provider of Fleet Management and Asset Management software for both the public and private sectors. Our mission is to empower organizations with intelligent software solutions that help streamline operations, reduce costs, and improve efficiency. **Why Join Us?** At Collective Data, we value innovation, collaboration, and the personal growth of our employees. We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, flexible work arrangements, and an environment where your input is valued and encouraged. Interested in making a difference with Collective Data? Please submit your resume and cover letter detailing your relevant experience to careers@collectivedata.com *Collective Data is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.* Pay: $85,000\.00 \- $105,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * Are you willing and able to work in the office 5 days a week? * This role works on client projects. jobs.title: Senior RPA Specialist
jobs.description: **Overview** You will leverage RPA development tools to replace redundant business processes, analyze the performance of RPA architecture, and refactor workflows for scalability and performance, specifically focusing on automated utility bill transactions. In this role, you will build, monitor, and troubleshoot robots to ensure consistent and accurate data processing. You will also look for opportunities to expand automation into EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) and other core system processes. Serving as a key liaison, you will coordinate with external vendors for system setup and collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure all automated processes run seamlessly. **Responsibilities** As an RPA Specialist in the Electronic Space, you will: * **Design, Build, \& Deploy:** Plan, design, and develop automated robots tailored to handle utility bill transactions and complex data processing. * **Monitor \& Optimize:** Continuously monitor production robots, diagnose system exceptions, and fix or refactor code to ensure continuous, reliable business functions. * **Expand \& Innovate:** Proactively analyze current manual operations to identify additional areas of growth, scaling the footprint of automation across the department. * **System \& EDI Integration:** Assist in building and maintaining SFTP/MFT platforms and other specialized transaction systems. * **Vendor \& Internal Collaboration:** Act as the primary technical point of contact to work with external vendors on system configuration, while aligning internally with developers and testers to bring robots online. * **Testing \& Quality Assurance:** Develop and execute rigorous testing protocols to validate robot reliability and data integrity before production deployment. Requirements: **Qualifications and Preferred Skills** * **Education \& Experience:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; OR equivalent hands\-on experience (typically 2–4 years) designing, building, and troubleshooting complex RPA robots to handle architecture and system integrations. * **Technical Background:** Strong computer knowledge and a solid background in RPA development suites, with exposure to or an understanding of EDI and electronic transaction file formats. * **Problem\-Solving \& Troubleshooting:** Analytical mindset with the ability to quickly identify, debug, and resolve issues within live robot architectures. * **Attention to Detail:** Strong attention to detail, ensuring high accuracy when manipulating financial and utility bill data. * **Relationship Management:** Able to develop and maintain strong relationships with internal team members, cross\-functional stakeholders, and third\-party vendors. * **Time Management:** Excellent organization skills with the ability to balance ongoing bot maintenance and monitoring with new development pipelines. * **Adaptability:** Flexible and able to adapt quickly to different processes, evolving vendor specifications, and changing system requirements.

jobs.description: he Sibley School of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering at Cornell University in Ithaca, New York, USA, invites applications for a tenure\-track or tenured faculty position at the rank of Assistant Professor, Associate Professor, or Professor in the broad areas of Energy Systems, Thermal and Fluid Sciences, and Nanoscale Science. We seek candidates who will advance these fields through innovative experimental, theoretical, or computational research. Areas of interest include, but are not limited to, energy conversion and storage; sustainable energy and building technologies; heat and mass transfer; fluid dynamics and multiphase flows; nanoscale transport; and thermal engineering for applications spanning advanced electronics, AI computing and data centers, quantum technologies, biomedicine, and aerospace. We welcome research that bridges disciplines and connects fundamental discoveries with solutions to pressing societal and technological challenges. Candidates must hold a doctorate in a relevant field. Successful candidates will be expected to develop and sustain an outstanding, externally funded research program, contribute to undergraduate and graduate education in Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, and engage in collaborative research across Cornell. Salary and rank will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. Cornell’s interdisciplinary graduate field system and research centers foster a strong culture of collaboration. New faculty will have exceptional opportunities to collaborate with faculty, research scientists, and graduate students across fields such as Materials Science and Engineering, Applied Physics, Systems Engineering, and Chemical Engineering, and through centers and facilities such as the Cornell Atkinson Center for Sustainability, Cornell Energy Systems Institute, Cornell NanoScale Science and Technology Facility, and AFRL Regional Network–Mid\-Atlantic Hub. Applications will be accepted until the position is filled. jobs.title: Systems Engineer I

Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. If you have a disability and you believe that you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or to submit an online application, please contact Human Resources at 281\-897\-7788 or HRCompliance@cornerstone\-bb.com. This email is used exclusively to assist disabled job seekers whose disability prevents them from being able to apply online. Only emails received for this purpose will be returned. Messages left for other purposes, such as following up on an application or technical issues not related to a disability, will not receive a response. California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) of 2018 *Must be at least 18 years of age to apply.* **Note to External Recruiters** Cornerstone Building Brands does not accept unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees for any candidate submissions that were not expressly authorized. **Notice of Recruitment Fraud** We have been made aware of multiple scams whereby unauthorized individuals are using Cornerstone Building Brand's name and logo to solicit potential job\-seekers for employment. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Backend
jobs.description: Crazy Maple Studio is a rapidly growing entertainment and technology company with offices in the San Francisco Bay Area and Los Angeles. We specialize in mobile gaming, digital reading, and streaming, bringing together a global team to create innovative, engaging entertainment experiences for audiences worldwide. Our flagship platform, **ReelShort**, is a leading vertical streaming app in the U.S., with more than 8 million daily active users (DAU). Through its short\-form episodic content, ReelShort delivers compelling stories designed for today’s mobile\-first audiences. Our portfolio also includes **Chapters**, an interactive storytelling platform featuring immersive drama, fantasy, and romance experiences, and **My Fiction**, a platform dedicated to discovering and creating serialized romance stories. In 2025, Crazy Maple Studio was recognized as one of the **Global Most Loved Workplaces**, reflecting our commitment to fostering a culture that values creativity, innovation, collaboration, and employee well\-being. At Crazy Maple Studio, we’re passionate about pushing creative boundaries, exploring new possibilities in digital entertainment, and building experiences that connect with audiences around the world. **Position Overview:** We’re looking for builders. We don’t want ticket\-closers, and you won’t need a 40\-page spec. We’re putting together a small vanguard team, led directly by our executive team, with one mission: find out what AI can really do for entertainment, then ship it. ReelShort already entertains millions of people around the world. This team works outside the normal roadmap. You might take an idea on Monday, have a working demo by Friday, and put it in front of real users soon after. Some experiments will fail fast. The ones that work could become the company’s next big product. If you’ve been waiting for a place where your work gets seen, your judgment is trusted, and your growth isn’t capped by a ladder, this is it. **Why This Team:** * You work directly with the leadership. There are no layers. Your ideas get heard, and your work is seen by the person who makes the call. * Zero\-to\-one, every time. You build new things instead of maintaining old ones. * Help shape the stack. This is a brand\-new team with no legacy code. The tools we choose now are the ones we’ll scale on, and you’ll help choose them. * AI is the job, not a side project. You’ll use the newest models and tools every day, and you’ll be paid to explore what comes next. * Real ownership. You own what you build, from the first line of code to the user metrics after launch. * We invest in your future here. We offer sponsorship for strong performers. **Responsibilities:** * Design and build the backend systems behind new AI\-powered apps, from first prototype to serving real users at scale * Help choose and set up our stack, from languages and databases to deployment and CI/CD * Connect large language models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or open\-source) to our products through a unified gateway, so we can switch models, control costs, and track spend by feature * Build the APIs our mobile apps depend on, along with the data foundations that show us what’s working * Own reliability for the services you build: monitoring, debugging, and fixing what breaks * Try new AI infrastructure and research, and turn what you learn into proposals **Requirements** * Around 2–5 years of experience building backend systems that real users depend on * Strong in at least one backend language, such as Python, TypeScript (Node.js), Go, or Java * Solid experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar), plus caching and queues (Redis, SQS, Pub/Sub, or similar) * Deployed services on AWS or GCP using containers or serverless (ECS, Cloud Run, Lambda, or similar), and set up CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar) * Kubernetes experience is not required. We keep infrastructure lean at this stage * Daily user of AI coding tools, with the drive to go much deeper * Fast learner who moves quickly and is comfortable with ambiguity * Self\-directed, low ego, and willing to do the unglamorous work a zero\-to\-one product needs * Hands\-on experience with LLM APIs, RAG, vector databases, or agent frameworks a plus * Experience with LLM gateways (such as LiteLLM) or tracking inference costs a plus * Infrastructure\-as\-code experience (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar) a plus * Experience with media pipelines or AI image, video, or audio generation a plus * Experience with machine learning or model fine\-tuning a plus * Additional language capability (Mandarin) a plus, though not required **Immigration Support** * H\-1B transfers welcome * On OPT or STEM OPT? We’ll register you for the H\-1B lottery * Green card sponsorship for strong performers * Legal and filing fees are covered by the company **How We Hire** Four steps, with no marathon onsite: * Intro call * Take\-home technical exercise * Technical interview * Conversation with our CEO Logistics * Five days a week, onsite in Sunnyvale, CA * Occasional evening availability to sync with teams in other time zones **Benefits** Crazy Maple Studio, Inc. provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Our target salary range for this role is between **$120,000 and $150,000**. Actual starting salary within the range will depend on various considerations, including: work experience, skills, specializations, and training. This role also offers medical insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan, and a range of additional employee benefits and perks.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Crescent is a differentiated U.S. energy company committed to delivering value through a disciplined, returns\-driven growth through acquisition strategy and consistent return of capital. Our long\-life, balanced portfolio combines significant cash flow from stable production with a deep, high\-quality development inventory. Crescent is a top three producer in the Eagle Ford basin and a scaled operator in each of the Permian and Uinta basins. Crescent’s leadership is an experienced team of investment, financial and industry professionals that combines proven investment and operating expertise. For more than a decade, Crescent and our predecessors have executed on a consistent strategy focused on cash flow, risk management and returns. Through disciplined and accretive investments, we have successfully tripled the size of our company since going public in December 2021 while maintaining a strong balance sheet. Crescent Energy is seeking an AI Engineer to build practical AI solutions and help employees use them effectively. This role combines hands\-on software and AI engineering with employee education and community building. You will work with teams across engineering, operations, finance, and IT to turn business needs into secure, dependable applications, and to help colleagues learn where AI can add value in their work. The successful candidate enjoys both building and teaching: improving AI applications through code, testing, and evaluation while creating useful learning experiences that help employees adopt AI with confidence. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **AI Engineering** ------------------ * Design, build, test, and support AI applications, assistants, and workflow automation for operational, technical, financial, and business needs. * Contribute to the shared AI platform and its specialized applications through software development, data and API integrations, user interfaces, and workflow capabilities. * Improve AI application behavior through clear instructions, prompt and context design, retrieval, tool use, and workflow logic. * Develop representative evaluation cases and regression checks; investigate failures and improve accuracy, source grounding, task completion, and reliability using test results and user feedback. * Compare model and application changes using consistent evaluation methods, considering quality, security, response time, and operating cost. * Integrate AI applications with approved databases, business systems, APIs, and document repositories while respecting access controls and data handling requirements. * Use validated data sources and deterministic calculations for numerical results, with AI supporting retrieval, explanation, and communication. * Apply sound engineering practices, including code review, automated testing, deployment pipelines, logging, monitoring, documentation, and support. **Employee Education and Community** ------------------------------------ * Build an active internal community of AI users and champions across business functions. * Plan and facilitate practical workshops, demonstrations, office hours, and learning sessions for employees with different levels of experience. * Create clear, reusable learning materials and examples based on real Crescent workflows, including how to review AI outputs and handle company information appropriately. * Gather employee questions, feedback, use cases, and adoption barriers; translate recurring needs into improvements to AI applications, evaluations, and learning resources. * Partner with subject matter experts and technical colleagues to keep training accurate, useful, and aligned with available capabilities. * Measure whether education and AI tools are helping employees, using participation, continued engagement, user feedback, and workflow outcomes. **Required Qualifications** =========================== * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Professional software development experience building and supporting applications. * Hands\-on experience developing applications powered by large language models or other AI techniques. * Proficiency in a modern programming language and SQL, with experience working with structured and unstructured data. * Experience working with APIs, enterprise systems, and software testing. * Ability to explain technical ideas clearly, listen to business needs, and collaborate with technical and nontechnical colleagues. * Strong problem\-solving skills and sound judgment about AI limitations, data confidentiality, and when human review is needed. **Preferred Skills and Experience** =================================== * **Upstream oil and gas experience** , especially in production, drilling and completions, reservoir engineering, reserves and economics, or asset evaluation. * **Experience facilitating employee learning or an internal technical community** , including workshops, office hours, demonstrations, or champion networks. * **Experience improving AI application quality** through evaluation datasets, regression testing, error analysis, and structured comparison of changes. * Experience with retrieval\-augmented generation, AI agents, model tool use, or multi\-step workflows. * Familiarity with cloud hyper\-scalers, Snowflake or industry applications such as ARIES, WellView, or ProCount. * Experience delivering software or learning programs that achieve measurable improvements in productivity, analysis, decision\-making, or employee confidence. **What Success Looks Like** =========================== * Employees are able to find practical guidance, get help, and use approved AI capabilities with confidence. * Employee feedback and recurring business needs lead to clear improvements in AI applications and learning resources. * AI application changes are supported by evaluation evidence and reliable software practices. * AI solutions deliver useful, measurable improvements to Crescent workflows. *Crescent Energy is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender/pregnancy, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status or any other legally protected status. Crescent Energy is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status. If you require accommodation to complete the application process, please let us know by contacting* *recruitment@crescentenergyco.com* *.*

jobs.title: AI Technical Lead
jobs.description: **Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:** At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry. **Job Description:** **About Crowe AI** Everything we do is about making the future of human work more purposeful. We do this by leveraging state\-of\-the\-art machine learning, generative AI, modern architectures, and industry experts to create AI\-powered solutions that transform the way we do business. Our world\-class AI and ML professionals give Crowe the ability to capture and harness the power of data. A combination of AI and Machine Learning Engineers and AI Platform and Infrastructure Engineers create and deploy AI functionality to solve complex problems. We focus on building scalable AI solutions, based on rigorous data exploration, validation via proof\-of\-concept buildout, and close partnership with subject matter experts across business areas. The future is powered by AI, come build it with us. **Role Overview** Crowe’s Studio team is seeking an AI Tech Lead to serve as a hands\-on technical leader for the design, development, and lifecycle management of AI agents that accelerate the delivery of Crowe’s Audit services. This role is built around Crowe’s forward deployed engineer (FDE) model: rather than sitting above a project as a traditional program manager, this person sits with Audit practitioners, learns the workflow, designs the agent as it is built, and owns the outcome end to end. The goal is to establish the technical patterns, Skills\-based architecture, and engineering practices needed to support a growing portfolio of agents. As that portfolio grows, the role is expected to grow into leading a small team as an engineering manager with full\-stack engineers who each own a slice of the roadmap. **Key Responsibilities** **Delivery of Audit AI Agents** * Own the design, development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of AI agents and agent\-assisted workflows that accelerate the execution of common tasks across Crowe’s Audit practice. * Operate as a forward deployed engineer paired directly with an Audit SME — sitting with practitioners, learning the workflow firsthand, and designing the agent as it is built rather than from a static spec. * Remain hands\-on in development: write, review, test, and maintain substantial Python codebases and the Skills, instructions, prompts, and supporting resources that define agent behavior. * Manage project scope, timelines, and stakeholder communication for the agents you own — balancing hands\-on delivery with the planning, prioritization, and coordination expected of a senior technical lead. * Design and develop agents using a Skills\-based architecture — modular, reusable capabilities that can be efficiently discovered, invoked, tested, maintained, and enhanced over time. * Serve as the technical authority for the agent layer, making key design and implementation decisions while partnering with architects and engineering teams to ensure alignment with the broader Audit technology ecosystem. * Implement and maintain monitoring, observability, and alerting for agents running in production, including trace\-level visibility into agent reasoning and tool calls, to proactively detect, diagnose, and resolve issues. **Build and Scale the Engineering Capability** * Establish reusable engineering patterns and development practices that let a growing portfolio of agents be developed, evaluated, deployed, supported, and enhanced sustainably. * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps to automate testing, evaluation, and deployment of agents across environments. * As the portfolio grows, lead a small team of forward deployed engineers that advance the roadmap per the audit stakeholders they serve. * Participate in the development and evolution of agent evaluation strategies, including representative test cases, automated evaluators, regression testing, quantifiable accuracy metrics, and processes for identifying and addressing changes in agent behavior. * Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership, including code and design reviews, as the agent portfolio and supporting team grow. * Promote collaboration across the Audit BU and the broader Studio to surface opportunities, share reusable patterns, and avoid duplicated build effort. **Product Judgment** * Think in terms of ROI, business cas we is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Crowe, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $102,400\.00 \- $204,100\.00 per year. **Our Benefits:** Your exceptional people experience starts here. At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We care about our people and offer employees a comprehensive total rewards package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you! **How You Can Grow:** We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper! **More about Crowe:** Crowe provides professional services through two separate entities: Crowe LLP delivers audit and attest services, and Crowe Advisory LLC provides tax, advisory, consulting, and other nonattest services. The Crowe Global network consists of more than 300 independent accounting and advisory services firms in more than 150 countries around the globe, making it one of the largest accounting networks in the world\*. As independent members of Crowe Global, Crowe LLP and Crowe Advisory LLC serve clients worldwide. (\*As of July 2026\) Crowe LLP and Crowe Advisory LLC (and their respective subsidiary entities) provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetics, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Crowe LLP and Crowe Advisory LLC (and their respective subsidiary entities) does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third\-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre\-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge. Crowe will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the California Fair Chance Act. Please visit our webpage to see notices of the various state and local Ban\-the\-Box laws and Fair Chance Ordinances, where applicable. We are committed to a merit\-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job\-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination. If you are interested in applying for employment with Crowe and are in need of an accommodation or require special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please visit our Applicant Assistance and Accommodations page for more information: https://careers.crowe.com/crowe\-applicant\-assistance\-and\-accommodation

jobs.title: Wix and Wordpress Web Builder
jobs.description: **Location:** Wasilla, Alaska (In\-Office) \- This is NOT a remote position. **Position Type:** Full\-Time or Part\-Time (20–40 hours/week) **About CJC Dynamic Solutions** CJC Dynamic Solutions is a veteran\-owned, women\-owned agency based in Wasilla, Alaska. We deliver web design, backend systems, content, and digital marketing strategies for small businesses. We operate in a fast\-paced environment built on integrity, client independence, accountability, and real team collaboration. **Role Summary** We are hiring a Web Builder with expertise in Wix and solid familiarity with WordPress to design, update, and maintain high\-quality client websites. This is not a freelancing gig or a solo venture stepping stone. We are looking for a dedicated team member who prefers working within an established agency alongside a small, fast\-moving team. You will report to the CEO (Crystal Chapman) and collaborate directly with our Creative Director (Chaney Fray) to translate design concepts into functional site builds under tight deadlines. **Key Responsibilities** * **Website Development \& Maintenance:** Build, update, and optimize websites primarily using Wix, as well as WordPress. * **Collaboration \& Execution:** Work closely with the Creative Director to turn mockups into pixel\-perfect, mobile\-optimized sites while adhering to agency standards and design guidelines. * **Proactive Problem\-Solving:** Identify technical blockers or design constraints early, troubleshoot independently, and seek guidance promptly when needed. * **Process \& Ownership:** Follow client briefs, document routine tasks, double\-check work before submission, and integrate feedback immediately into future assignments. * **Adaptability:** Maintain high quality and composure when project priorities or deadlines shift quickly. **Required Core Attributes** * **Ownership \& Initiative:** You take full responsibility for your builds, track your own deadlines, and don't hide behind excuses when issues arise. * **Early Communication:** You speak up immediately when stuck, confused, or running behind schedule rather than waiting until a deadline passes. * **Team\-First Mindset:** You enjoy collaborating with a close\-knit group, thrive on feedback, and value long\-term stability in an established agency setting over solo freelancing. * **Stress Tolerance \& Speed:** You work efficiently under fast\-paced agency conditions while maintaining attention to detail and standard website functionality. **Technical QualificationsEssential** * Proven experience building, editing, and launching complete websites on **Wix**. * Working knowledge of **WordPress** page builders, plugin setup, and site troubleshooting. * Strong understanding of responsive layout principles, mobile optimization, basic SEO hygiene, and site performance. **Preferred** * Familiarity with Shopify or e\-commerce integrations. * Basic understanding of custom code snippets (HTML/CSS) when platform tools reach their limit. **Working Environment \& Expectations** * **Location:** In\-office position in Wasilla, Alaska. * **Trial \& Growth:** Candidates complete a 90\-day training/evaluation period. Demonstration of technical independence and alignment with team expectations can lead to earlier advancement to established rates. * **Hiring Preference:** We prioritize applicants who are seeking career stability inside an agency rather than those currently operating or building their own independent business. **Application Process** Applicants will complete an initial interview followed by a brief, **paid work sample build** that includes a realistic feedback and revision cycle to evaluate speed, execution accuracy, and collaboration style. **Advisor Recommendations for Selection** * **Screen for Entrepreneurial Intent:** Filter candidates early during the intake interview by asking about their current side projects, agency contracts, or business ownership ambitions. * **Paid Work Sample Structure:** Provide a 2\-hour paid test assignment creating a specific Wix section from a brief. Include one deliberate ambiguity and one required revision to evaluate whether they communicate early, handle fast\-paced edits, and apply feedback accurately without defensiveness. * **Collaboration Check:** Ensure Chaney reviews the layout work sample for precision before final onboarding, as her C/S working style requires clear definitions of finished quality. Pay: $22\.00 \- $32\.00 per hour Expected hours: No more than 40\.0 per week Benefits: * 401(k) * Paid time off * Professional development assistance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Bilingual Mandarin AI Chat R&D Trainee - Full-Stack Engineer (Go Backend)
jobs.description: About CWILL CWILL (pronounced 'quill') is a post\-purchase and retention suite built for Shopify brands. Reduce support tickets, recover lost revenue from returns, and turn one\-time buyers into loyal fans — with tools purpose\-built for every touchpoint that follows the sale. About the Role CWILL AI Chat is growing from a live chat and AI chatbot into an AI customer service and sales conversion tool for Shopify merchants, with more AI capabilities, deeper Shopify data integration, an agent workspace, merchant settings, reporting and system reliability on the way. As an R\&D Trainee, you'll learn by building real features with a mentor, and grow into an engineer who owns a module independently. **Product Intro:** https://www.cwill.com/products/ai\-chat/ **Base location required:** Cary, NC (We are unable to hire in other states; relocation will be required.) jobs.title: Sr. Staff Engineer, Lustre
jobs.description: **We are seeking a Staff Engineer with 10\+ years of experience in distributed storage and Linux\-based systems engineering. This is a hands\-on senior technical role focused on design, debugging, performance, and operational excellence across LustreFS and adjacent stack components. The ideal candidate brings strong expertise in one or more Lustre subsystems, can independently drive complex investigations, and collaborates effectively across engineering, QE, support and release teams. Engineers who are comfortable using AI to accelerate triage, debugging, code comprehension and new feature design will be especially valuable.** ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Design, develop and debug LustreFS features, fixes and enhancements across relevant subsystems such as llite, MDS/MDT, OSS/OST, LDLM and LNet. * Investigate customer and scale\-related defects, drive root\-cause analysis and implement high\-quality fixes with strong attention to correctness and maintainability. * Contribute to performance tuning, failure analysis and reliability improvements for large\-scale Lustre deployments. * Participate actively in code reviews, design reviews and subsystem discussions, bringing rigor to testing and operational readiness. * Work closely with QE and support to reproduce issues, improve diagnostic data quality and increase coverage for high\-risk failure scenarios. * Help document subsystem behavior, debugging approaches, known failure patterns and operational best practices. * Use AI\-assisted tools where appropriate to speed up issue triage, summarize logs, improve code understanding and capture reusable lessons learned. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * 10\+ years of experience in systems software, distributed systems, storage, Linux kernel or filesystem engineering. * Strong experience in LustreFS development, support or performance engineering with depth in at least one major subsystem. * Strong C programming and Linux systems debugging skills. * Working knowledge of Linux kernel internals, filesystem semantics, networking and performance analysis. * Experience with LNet and/or high\-performance transports such as RDMA, InfiniBand, RoCE or TCP\-based storage networking. * Ability to debug and resolve issues spanning multiple layers including client, server, network and backend storage. * Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work across functions in a fast\-moving engineering environment. **Preferred Skills** -------------------- * Experience in HPC, AI infrastructure or large\-scale parallel storage environments. * Exposure to metadata\-heavy and throughput\-heavy workload characterization and tuning. * Familiarity with ZFS, ldiskfs, NVMe\-backed storage and related observability / performance tooling. * Experience creating test plans, reproducer frameworks, runbooks or diagnostic automation. * Comfort using AI tools to accelerate debugging, code reviews, triage, documentation and early\-stage design ideation. * Experience mentoring junior engineers or leading focused technical efforts within a subsystem. **What You Will Work On** ------------------------- * Hands\-on development and debugging of LustreFS defects, performance issues and subsystem enhancements. * Customer\-facing and scale\-related issue investigation across llite, metadata, object storage, LNet and transport layers. * Collaborative design and implementation of reliability, observability and serviceability improvements. * Reviewing and validating fixes through targeted tests, failure injection, log analysis and performance characterization. * Using AI\-assisted workflows to accelerate triage, debug loops, code understanding and documentation quality. * Contributing to team redundancy by strengthening documentation, code review quality and subsystem knowledge sharing. **Why This Role Matters** ------------------------- This role is central to building durable engineering redundancy in LustreFS: expanding deep subsystem ownership, reducing concentration risk, and accelerating next\-generation delivery through strong engineering fundamentals and AI\-enabled execution.

jobs.title: Lead Platform Engineer
jobs.description: For decades, DTN has been the silent force behind some of the world’s most critical industries—helping businesses navigate complexity, uncertainty, and risk with smarter, faster decisions. From agriculture to energy to weather intelligence, our proprietary Operational Decisioning Platform transforms raw data into decision\-grade insights—enabling companies to optimize supply chains, ensure market stability, and safeguard infrastructure against disruption. We don’t follow trends—we set the standard for precision, trust, and operational impact. DTN is at an exciting inflection point. Building off a foundation of financial strength, profitability, and industry trust, we’re accelerating growth and expanding our global footprint. Our purpose\-built solutions—powered by AI and honed by decades of vertical expertise—are helping some of the world’s most significant enterprises thrive amid operational constraints and uncover new opportunities in a fast\-changing world. **J** **ob Description:** DTN is seeking an experienced, technically accomplished **Lead Platform Engineer** to help design, build, and evolve the foundational capabilities of our Operational Decisioning Platform (ODP). The DTN Operational Decisioning Platform is an internal platform that packages cloud infrastructure into purpose\-built, higher\-level capabilities, enabling our engineers, solutions teams, and customers to build data products, applications, and AI\-powered tools without managing the underlying cloud infrastructure themselves. As a Lead Platform Engineer, you will be directly responsible for implementing, operating, and maintaining complex core components across the platform, including developer\-facing APIs, software development kits (SDKs), command\-line interfaces (CLIs), the framework other teams use to build modules, and managed capabilities running on cloud infrastructure. This is a deeply technical leadership role for an engineer who thrives on challenging distributed\-systems problems, including secure cross\-account communication, multi\-tenant isolation, and creating abstractions that dramatically improve developer productivity. You will own complex systems end\-to\-end, establish technical direction and engineering standards, and mentor other engineers while partnering with Enterprise Architecture and cross\-functional teams. With a significant portion of the platform still in greenfield development, this position offers the opportunity to design foundational systems from first principles while evolving existing capabilities. Lead engineers on this team play a meaningful role in shaping the platform's architecture and standards, with a clear path toward Staff\- or Principal\-level technical leadership as the platform grows. **What You Will Be Responsible For:** ------------------------------------- **Platform Architecture, Technical Design, and Delivery** * Lead the technical design, implementation, delivery, operation, and ongoing evolution of complex platform capabilities. * Define engineering problems, evaluate architectural alternatives and technical tradeoffs, and propose scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions. * Partner with the Enterprise Architecture team to design and implement foundational platform capabilities. * Own complex components end\-to\-end, from developer\-facing interfaces through the underlying cross\-account cloud infrastructure that supports them. * Design, develop, and maintain developer\-facing APIs, SDKs, CLIs, module frameworks, and managed platform services. * Build reusable abstractions and platform capabilities that enable other engineering teams to develop data products, applications, and AI\-powered solutions without directly managing cloud infrastructure. * Lead the development of greenfield platform capabilities while maintaining and evolving existing systems. Establish architectural patterns and technical approaches that support long\-term scalability, reliability, security, and developer productivity. * **Distributed Systems and Cloud Infrastructure** * Design and build secure distributed systems that operate reliably across isolated AWS accounts and multi\-tenant environments. * Develop secure cross\-account communication mechanisms and infrastructure supporting multi\-tenant isolation. * Design and implement provisioning and lifecycle automation for cloud\-based platform capabilities. * Build asynchronous and event\-driven processing capabilities, including reliable message handling, retries, backoff strategies, and idempotent operations. * Develop service discovery, reconciliation, and health\-monitoring capabilities that support reliable platform operations. * Apply distributed\-systems principles, including at\-least\-once delivery, eventual consistency, failure\-mode analysis, and resilient service interactions. * Evaluate potential failure scenarios, including communication failures, service interruptions, and isolation\-boundary violations, and design appropriate safeguards. cular attention to developer ergonomics, consistency, and usability. * Familiarity with observability technologies such as OpenTelemetry. * Experience with schema\-driven interface validation. * Awareness of multi\-cloud architectures and technologies. * Experience developing platform components using TypeScript/Node.js, Python, containers, Terraform, and modern AWS cloud\-native services. * Experience building secure cross\-account infrastructure and developer\-facing abstractions in greenfield platform environments. * Familiarity with module frameworks that manage authenticated dispatch, signing, validation, metrics, and reconciliation. * Experience applying trunk\-based development, ADR\-driven design, immutable or pinned releases, least\-privilege access, and schema\-validated interfaces. Background in operational or data\-intensive industries such as energy, logistics, weather, or agriculture. * **What You Can Expect from DTN:** --------------------------------- * Competitive Salary * Unlimited PTO * Flexible working hours * Remote work model (position dependent) * Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance Plans * 6% 401K matching * Unlimited access to 13k\+ courses via learning platform to support employee career advancement Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * **Compensation** ---------------- *The targeted hiring base pay range for this position is between* ***$132,000 and $175,000*** *. DTN is a pay for performance organization, which means there is the opportunity to advance your compensation with performance over time. The actual base pay offered for this position will be dependent upon many factors, including but not limited to: prior work experience, training/education, transferable skills, business needs, internal equity and applicable laws. The targeted hiring base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for market competitive variable pay and benefits.* \#LI\-HYBRID \#LI\-TH1 **About DTN:** DTN is a global data and technology company helping operational leaders in energy, agriculture, and weather\-driven industries make faster, smarter decisions. Our Operational Decisioning Platform turns complex data into decision\-grade insights—empowering customers to expand their margins, accelerate growth, and outpace risk. With more than 1,200 employees globally, DTN serves the companies that feed, fuel, and protect the world. At DTN, we value **clarity,** **trust** , and **action** . We’re a team of problem\-solvers, outcome\-drivers, and industry nerds who believe that precision matters – and that mission is at the core of what we do. * **Trust Built:** We earn it. We keep it. We protect it. Our neutrality, precision, and integrity are non\-negotiable. * **Confidence\-Driven:** We help customers move with clarity and conviction. We bring the data and operational knowledge leaders need to act. * **Built for Industry:** We speak operations because we come from operations. Our expertise is forged in fuel terminals, fields, flight paths, and forecasts. * **Future\-Forward:** We see what’s coming\- and we’re ready. We help customers lead through change with smarter decisioning. **Recruitment Fraud Notice:** DTN is aware of incidents where external parties have impersonated our organization, issuing fraudulent communications and/or job offers. Please be advised that all legitimate communication from DTN will come from an official @dtn.com email address. Any offers are extended directly by our Talent Acquisition team following a formal interview process. If you receive a suspicious message or offer claiming to be from DTN, please do not engage. Contact our Talent Acquisition team at Careers@dtn.com to verify the legitimacy of any communication. Report any fraudulent messaging as phishing or spam. **DTN is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** We welcome and encourage applicants of all backgrounds, including minorities, women, veterans, and individuals with disabilities.
