Please note that the compensation details listed on US role postings reflect the base salary only and does not include bonus, equity or benefits. **Company Overview** ==================== Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion\-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real\-time APIs for speech\-to\-text (STT), text\-to\-speech (TTS), and building production\-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300\+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice\-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self\-hosted and on\-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. **Company Operating Rhythm** ============================ At Deepgram, we expect an AI\-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day\-to\-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9\-to\-5\. **The Opportunity** ------------------- We're building the engine that solves customer challenges at scale. When customers hit a limit in our voice AI, you'll measure it, fix it, and ship the fix to every customer in weeks. Example projects: * Expanding our models to new languages and regions * Improving how text\-to\-speech pronounces names, terms, and numbers * Isolating a speaker's voice from background noise and crosstalk * Giving customers early access to new voice capabilities, like steerable and cloned voices, and using their feedback to guide the research methodology * Releasing new benchmarks for Voice AI use\-cases **The Role** ------------ You will thrive in this role if you enjoy: * Turning vague customer problems into clear metrics * Using whatever works to fix them, including fine\-tuning, new data, and external models * Shipping work that customers use within weeks **The Challenge** ----------------- We are seeking researchers who: * Own a customer problem until it measurably improves in production * Find the fastest path to a fix, even if it's an approach no one has tried * Can tell when a result is ready for customers If these expectations energize you, you might be the person we need. This role takes focus on the customer's problem, creativity in approach, and a strong drive to ship. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Find where our models fall short and set targets for improvement * Design evaluations that show whether a model is better and why * Curate and generate data and fine\-tune models * Build working systems quickly and ship them to production We don't require a specific degree. Show us hard problems you've solved in past projects, shipped systems, or open source work. **You May Be a Good Fit If You Have** ------------------------------------- * Deep experience training, fine\-tuning, and evaluating deep learning models * Strong Python and PyTorch skills * A track record of shipping ML to production * A habit of owning problems end to end and learning what you need along the way * Good judgment about which problems matter and when a result is ready to ship **Strong Candidates May Also Have** ----------------------------------- * Experience with speech\-to\-text, text\-to\-speech, or voice agents * Experience with distributed training * Published papers, open source contributions, or public benchmarks ***Notice****: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @**deepgram.com* *email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.* Compensation Range: $150K \- $250K

jobs.title: Lead Data Architect
jobs.description: **Company Description** Domino’s is a purpose\-inspired, performance\-driven company powered by exceptional people who are committed to feeding the power of possible—one pizza at a time. Founded in 1960 as a single store in Ypsilanti, Michigan, Domino’s has grown into the largest pizza company in the world, with more than 22,300 stores across 90\+ markets. Our success is built on the strength of our people, technology, and franchise system. As a leader in innovation, we continue to transform the pizza and QSR industry while creating opportunities for team members to learn, grow and thrive. If you're ready to make an impact, build a meaningful career and help shape what's next, there's a place for you at Domino's. **Job Description** As Lead AI Architect, you own the technical architecture for Domino's enterprise AI platform – spanning classical AI, generative AI, and agentic AI. This is the senior individual\-contributor technical authority on AI: you set the direction for how AI capabilities are built, served, orchestrated, and governed, and you drive outcomes through design authority and influence rather than direct reports. You own the reference architecture and the paved road teams build on, and the build\-depth judgment for every incoming ask – production now, minimum viable, scaffolded as a contract for later, or deliberately deferred rather than quietly dropped. This is a deeply hands\-on role for an architect who has delivered AI platforms and solutions at enterprise scale – someone who knows why a technique works and when it survives contact with enterprise data, latency budgets, unit economics, and governance, and who still builds prototypes and reference implementations. Our environment is Azure\-primary with Databricks. **Responsibilities** Architecture Ownership and Direction * Own the enterprise AI reference architecture end to end, establishing scalable standards, principles, and design patterns across business groups. * Own the roadmap for agentic systems platforms, translating business objectives into sequenced technical strategy, milestones, and a build\-depth decision for every use case with explicit, traceable reasoning. * Design and maintain the paved road for AI development – golden patterns for building, serving, evaluating, and integrating models and agents, with an API\-first integration default, MCP by exception against explicit criteria, and guardrails inherited rather than bolted on per team – so teams ship without re\-solving solved problems. * Guide optimization of AI compute and token usage as adoption scales, and lead build\-versus\-buy, model, and framework decisions with evidence – benchmarks, cost per answer, real\-load latency. Semantic Search, Retrieval and RAG Architecture * Chunking, embedding and indexing: design chunking strategy per content type and tune size, overlap, and boundaries against measured retrieval quality; select and evaluate embedding models; own re\-embedding and versioning. * Query construction and hybrid retrieval: implement query rewriting, decomposition, and expansion; combine dense and sparse retrieval with fusion and re\-ranking; manage the recall\-versus\-precision and latency trade\-off explicitly. * Retrieval and response evaluation: instrument recall, precision and faithfulness against curated golden datasets; ground answers in the certified semantic layer and knowledge graphs where they outperform vector retrieval; design for graceful abstention over confident wrong answers. Generative AI Portfolio * Define prompt and instruction management standards – versioning, templating, context budgeting, and regression testing on prompt or model changes. * Own the AI gateway and multi\-model routing, matching each request to the right model on complexity, cost, latency, and quality, and own the benchmarking discipline for how models are compared, selected, and re\-tested as the landscape shifts. * Establish the evaluation harness as a launch gate – offline/online evaluation, LLM\-as\-judge with human calibration, A/B and shadow testing, and an explicit quality threshold we won't launch below. * Hold a clear, evidence\-based position on when prompt engineering suffices versus when fine\-tuning or customization is warranted, and define caching strategy as a deliberate cost and latency lever. Agentic AI Portfolio * Architect the orchestration layer that chains agents, tools, retrieval, and human review – orchestration as the enforced contract, domain agents scoped by journey and business context, and a reusable skills and tool layer where reusability actually lives. * Design memory and context management with an explicit position on what persists, for how long, and under what access rules; define enterprise standards for tool/function calling and MCP server contracts. * Establish agent guardrails – authorization scope, permission models, approval and escalation paths, sandboxing, fallback behavior, and safe failure – plus step\-level tracing, regression data ingestion, transformation pipelines, chunking and indexing strategies, vector and hybrid retrieval, knowledge graphs, metadata models, lineage, provenance, data quality, and access controls, including grounding conversational experiences in structured data (text\-to\-SQL, multi\-turn dialogue). * Model evaluation and production lifecycle engineering. Experience establishing evaluation frameworks and benchmarks (recall@k, NDCG, groundedness, LLM\-as\-judge), automated testing, release controls, model and prompt versioning, observability, quality monitoring, incident response, rollback, and ongoing improvement using MLOps and LLMOps principles. * Security, privacy, responsible AI, and governance. Ability to build identity, authorization, privacy, model security, human oversight, regulatory controls, and auditability into the architecture from the start. Must understand AI\-specific threats such as prompt injection, sensitive\-data leakage, unsafe agent actions, and model or software supply\-chain risk. * Scalability, reliability, performance, and AI economics. Ability to make quantitative architecture decisions on latency, throughput, concurrency, availability, capacity, inference architecture, compute utilization, quality\-versus\-performance trade\-offs, consumption forecasting, and cost optimization, including AI FinOps at scale. * Business and value\-oriented solution architecture. Ability to translate business strategy into qualified AI use cases, measurable outcomes, target\-state architectures, investment priorities, and delivery roadmaps. Must separate value\-producing opportunities from technology demos and tie solutions to operational or financial KPIs. * End\-to\-end delivery with hands\-on technical credibility. Demonstrated ability to move from discovery and architecture through experimentation, production deployment, and operational improvement. Able to build or review prototypes (Python, SQL, Spark), validate assumptions, review implementation designs, diagnose cross\-layer failures, and defend technical trade\-offs, with production depth in DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes, and model serving. * Technical leadership and stakeholder influence. jobs.title: Global Head of AI Deployment & Partner Delivery (US)
jobs.description: **About Dust** ============== **Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.** With enterprise\-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest\-moving companies to rewire how work gets done. With 70%\+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. **We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.** We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026\. Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50\. **Summary** ----------- Dust is hiring a **Head of AI Deployment \& Partner Delivery** to make high\-impact Dust deployments repeatable at scale. When customers deploy Dust well, AI agents become part of how their teams work every day. Your job is to make that happen consistently, whether a deployment is led by Dust or by a trusted partner. You will lead our most complex customer deployments, turn what works, technically and organizationally, into clear playbooks, and build the partner delivery capacity that lets more customers succeed with Dust in 2027 and beyond. This is a player\-coach leadership role. You will lead and grow Dust’s global AI Deployment team, stay directly involved in our most important deployments, and build the methods, standards, and partner network that allow delivery to scale without depending on you for every engagement. You will work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering to connect what customers want to achieve with how deployments are planned, delivered, and measured. This is a chance to define how an AI\-native company delivers transformation: what an exceptional deployment looks like, how value is measured, and how partners become delivery teams our customers trust. **What you’ll do** ================== **Lead and grow the global AI Deployment team** ----------------------------------------------- * Lead Dust’s existing global AI Deployment team and set its direction, priorities, and standards. * Hire and develop deployment leaders and practitioners as customer demand grows. * Shape roles, career paths, and coverage across regions, customer segments, and deployment types. * Coach the team through complex customer situations and hold a consistently high bar for the work. * Set up the operating rhythms, capacity planning, and reporting the function needs to scale. **Define how Dust deployments are delivered** --------------------------------------------- * Build one deployment method, from discovery through handoff, that Dust and partner teams can both follow to the same standard. * Define which deployments Dust should lead, which a partner can deliver well, and how work moves between the two. * Set clear entry and exit criteria and go\-live readiness checks, and track delivery health: time to first value, go\-live quality, and customer satisfaction. * Run regular delivery reviews, spot at\-risk engagements early, and bring the right Dust and partner people together quickly when a deployment is blocked. * Turn lessons from each engagement into reusable playbooks, templates, and reference architectures, and recurring friction into clear input for Product and Engineering. **Lead AI transformation with strategic customers** --------------------------------------------------- * Personally lead complex, high\-priority, and first\-of\-their\-kind deployments, from scoping to lasting adoption, bringing in Solutions Engineering, Product, and Engineering when complexity or risk calls for it. * Help customer leaders define what AI transformation means for their organization: map how teams work today and identify the workflows where agents can create the most value. * Align executives, IT, security, and business teams on goals, use cases, and success measures, with a baseline before launch and measured impact after. * Design change programs for each deployment: executive sponsorship, communication plans, role\-based enablement, and clear adoption milestones. * Develop AI operators and champions inside customer teams, and help customers update ways of working, governance, and ownership so agents become part of how teams operate. * Track adoption after launch, act quickly when teams aren’t changing how they work, and hand off to Customer Success with a clear picture of what comes next. **Build a high\-quality partner delivery network** -------------------------------------------------- * Work with Partnerships to assess partners’ delivery capability, technical depth, and customer readiness. * Start  delivery function, adding the structure needed to scale without unnecessary process. * You have led organizational change alongside technology rollouts, and built champion networks or adoption plans that changed how teams work after the project ended. You don’t need to be a machine\-learning engineer. Beyond that, we care more about evidence that you have built high\-performing delivery systems than about a perfect sequence of titles. * You understand how systems integrators, consultancies, and implementation partners staff, deliver, and grow a practice, and you have built enablement or certification programs that created lasting capability in teams you didn’t manage. * You have turned around engagements at risk from scope, staffing, technical complexity, or stakeholder misalignment, and you know when to standardize, when to adapt, and when to reset. * You are credible with customer executives, partner leaders, and technical practitioners, and you communicate clearly with all of them. * You are a hands\-on, low\-ego leader with a builder’s instinct: you would rather solve the problem than hand off a recommendation. * You are comfortable traveling to customers and partners when it matters most. **AI and technical credibility** -------------------------------- * Advise customers on where AI agents can create meaningful value and where they can’t yet, and explain why to technical teams, business leaders, and executives. * Understand how agents work in practice: prompting, context, tool use, retrieval, evaluations, reliability, and cost. * Challenge a deployment plan’s assumptions about integrations, data connectors, authentication, permissions, security, and production readiness, and discuss the trade\-offs with engineers. * Design evaluation approaches that connect AI performance to customer and business outcomes. **Location** ============ We're prioritizing building our team with an in\-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together. We have an office\-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect. That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call. **Why Dust** ============ The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves. We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast. If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk. *Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.* **Learn how we think and work.** * Our product constitution, *a story about our mission* * Your Next Co\-Worker Isn’t Human, **Stanislas Polu**, VivaTech 2026\. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them. * Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, **Gabriel Hubert**, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026\. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe. Compensation Range: $300K \- $350K

jobs.title: Builder Developer II/III/IV (Senior Agentic Software Engineer)
jobs.description: ECI is hiring senior\-level **Builder Developers** (Senior Agentic Software Engineers) focused on rewriting how enterprise software is built, tested, and operated using AI. **The Mission:** Use AI to build autonomous agents and workflows that transform legacy ERP systems into modern, AI\-driven platforms. You are not maintaining old code, you are building the future. If you enjoy 4\-hour "alignment meetings" and writing Jira tickets for things an agent could do in 3 seconds, you’re going to hate it here. **Builder** is not just a title; it is a measure of **autonomy, architectural complexity, and "Agentic Leverage."** While a traditional "Senior Software Engineer" might be focused on completing tickets, a **Builder is focused on automating workflows** and owning the execution of AI\-driven modules. ### **Here are the Builder levels we are hiring:** * **BUILDER 2 (Senior):** Focuses on **Agentic Implementation**. This is the "Engine Room" of the team. They don't just use AI; they build the agents. They can take a legacy module and build a LangGraph or CrewAI flow to modernize it with minimal supervision. * **BUILDER 3 (Lead):** Focuses on **Systemic Orchestration**. They design the "Guardrail Layers" and the "Eval Frameworks." They ensure that the agents built by the team are deterministic, cost\-effective, and scalable. * **BUILDER 4 (Principal/Architect):** Focuses on **The Meta\-Platform**. They build the internal "Builder Tools" that the other three levels use. They are looking at the 12\-month horizon of model capabilities and ensuring the ERP architecture is ready for "Autonomous Operation." **Core DNA (Shared Foundation)** * **AI\-Native Workflow:** Use AI tools to accelerate development, testing, and documentation 10x faster than traditional methods. * **Agentic Implementation:** Build, debug, and deploy autonomous agents (LangGraph, AutoGen, Playwright\-LLM hybrids) that navigate complex ERP schemas and business logic. * **Legacy\-to\-Modern Bridge:** Treat 20\-year\-old legacy systems as puzzles for AI\-driven modernization. * **Deterministic Mindset:** Build for 100% reliability with automated validation, evals, and guardrails. **What You’ll Actually Do** * **Build Execution Agents:** Move beyond RAG into **Action**. Build agents that can navigate an ERP schema, identify a data discrepancy, and suggest a fix. * **Automate the "Untestable":** Use AI to wrap legacy business logic in modern unit tests and documentation. * **Prompt Engineering \& Evals:** Use frameworks like **DSPy** to move from "vibes\-based" prompting to programmatic, optimized instructions. * **Rapid Prototyping:** Turn a "what if" into a working AI\-driven feature in days, not months. **The Stack** Python, SQL (Postgres/SQL Server), TypeScript, OpenAI/Anthropic, pgvector/Qdrant, LangChain/LangGraph, dbt, Apache Hop/Airflow, Docker, Weights \& Biases, OpenTelemetry. And, any other tool that helps us achieve greatness. **Who You Are** * **The "Early Adopter" Archetype:** You were using GPT\-3 before it was cool and had a local Llama running the week it leaked. You spend more time on **r/LocalLLaMA**, **GitHub Trending**, and **X (AI Twitter)** than on LinkedIn. * **Agent\-First Thinker:** You don't think in "functions"; you think in "capabilities." You’ve built at least one autonomous agent or complex LLM chain that actually *does* something useful. * **The "Manual Task" Hater:** You have a physical reaction to repetitive work. If you have to do a task twice, you’ve already started drafting the Python script or agentic workflow to automate it. * **Technically Fearless:** You aren't intimidated by spaghetti legacy code. You see a 20\-year\-old undocumented ERP module as a goldmine for AI\-driven refactoring and modernization. * **Rigor over Hype:** While you love the latest models, you care about **Evals**. You know the difference between a "cool demo" and a "production\-grade agent" that handles financial data with 100% accuracy. * **The Tribe Member:** You want to work in an environment where your "AI hacks" and custom automation scripts are celebrated as your greatest contribution, not hidden as "side projects." **Why Join Us?** * **The "Final Boss" of Complexity:** ERPs are the ultimate challenge for AI. If you can automate a General Ledger or a global supply chain, you’ve mastered the hardest problem in software. * **Agentic Autonomy:** We don't do "tickets." We do missions. You’ll have the freedom to choose the models, frameworks, and agent architectures you believe will win. * **The BUILDER Tribe:** You won't be the "only AI person" in the room. You’ll be part of a 4\-person squad of like\-minded enthusiasts who are all obsessed with moving 10x faster. * **No Red Tape:** If the agent works and the evals pass, we ship. We don't have a "Change Management Committee." We have a "Does It Work?" policy. * **The Final Boss:** ERP data is the hardest problem in software. If you want an easy life, go build another photo\-sharing app. If you want to win the game, let’s go!

jobs.description: **A Little About Us** EDB provides a data and AI platform that enables organizations to harness the full power of Postgres for transactional, analytical, and AI workloads across any cloud, anywhere. EDB empowers enterprises to control risk, manage costs and scale efficiently for a data and AI led world. Serving more than 1,500 customers globally and as the leading contributor to the vibrant and fast\-growing PostgreSQL community, EDB supports major government organizations, financial services, media and information technology companies. EDB's data\-driven solutions enable customers to modernize legacy systems and break data silos while leveraging enterprise\-grade open source technologies. EDB delivers the confidence of up to 99\.999% high availability with mission critical capabilities built in such as security, compliance controls, and observability. For more information, visit www.enterprisedb.com **\*\*Candidate Note: This role is 100% remote for candidates based in EST or CST \*\*** We are seeking a **Solution Developer** to join our engineering team. This is a versatile role requiring a mix of full\-stack web development, data pipeline engineering, and cloud infrastructure management. You will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining applications that involve both user\-facing interfaces and complex back\-end automation. The ideal candidate is a technical generalist who is comfortable working across multiple languages (JavaScript and Python) and is eager to adopt new technologies as our stack evolves. ### **Your impact will be:** * Develop and maintain responsive web applications using Next.js and Node.js. * Write clean, maintainable code in Python for backend services and data processing scripts. * Build and monitor automated workflows and data pipelines using Airflow and dbt. * Design and implement secure, scalable RESTful APIs. * Manage and deploy applications within an AWS environment, ensuring cloud best practices are followed. * Optimize database performance and manage data migrations in Postgres. * Quickly learn and implement new frameworks or tools based on project\-specific requirements ### **What you will bring:** * **Frontend/Backend:** 5\+ years of experience with JavaScript/Typescript \& Node.js; with deep understanding of the Next.js framework; and strong experience with API development \& integrations * **Python:** Proven experience using Python for application development or data engineering. * **Cloud:** Working knowledge of AWS core services (e.g., EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS). * **Data Tools:** Experience in Pipeline Development, specifically transforming data with dbt and/or workflow tools like n8n along with scheduling tasks with Airflow. * **Automation:** Experience with workflow automation platforms (e.g., n8n, Zapier, or custom\-built solutions). * **Database:** Strong SQL skills and experience managing PostgreSQL databases (schema designs; complex queries and optimization). * **Version Control:** Proficient in Git version control (branching, PRs, code reviews) and implementing CI/CD workflows to ensure stable, high\-quality code delivery. * **Adaptability:** Ability to switch between different programming languages and technical domains (e.g., moving from a UI task to a data pipeline task). * **Problem\-Solving:** A track record of identifying technical bottlenecks and implementing efficient solutions. * **Continuous Learning:** A proactive approach to learning new technologies and staying current with industry trends. **Compensation Range**: $110\-125k \+ annual bonus EDB is committed to supporting our employees' overall well being by offering a range of benefits and resources to promote a healthy work\-life balance and wellness. We provide access to CuraLinc to aid employees in health and wellness tips and practices, as well as Wellness Fridays extending to December 2026! Check out our career site for more information on perks and benefits and reach out to our Talent Acquisition team for region specific benefits. We know it takes a unique mix of people and skills to help us in our mission to supercharge Postgres, and we understand that not everyone will check every box. We'd love to hear from you and we want you to apply! EDB is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. EDB was built on a commitment to trust and respect each other and to embrace an array of people and ideas. These values remain at the center of our culture and are key to our company's integrity. EDB does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. EDB and its affiliates are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other similar payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written signed agreement between EDB and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee. \#LI\-Remote

Good Problem Solver. Lead and manage a team of 5\-8 or more Data engineers, architects, and technical specialists. * **CategoryResponsibilities** Delivery leadership Planning, Risks, Dependencies, Status, Escalations Business partnership Requirements, Scope, Prioritization, Stakeholder Communication Technical leadership Azure, Databricks, SQL/RDBMS, Git, Integration patterns, Customer 360/MDM, Data Modeling, Copilot, Claude, Github Copilot Data governance Quality, Controls, Lineage, Documentation, Data Privacy \& Security Team leadership Mentoring, Agile ceremonies, Design reviews Domain Marketing (B2B), Analytics Responsibilities: Oversee organizational data engineering solutions. jobs.description: Hiring Range: $100,890 \- $150,000 *The posted salary range reflects Eastern’s expected hiring range. In this hands\-on role, you’ll develop AI agents and automated workflows, build retrieval and prompt systems, and support the integration of AI tools within embedded business division roles. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Easterseals Southern California transforms lives every day. For over a century, Easterseals has championed inclusion and independence—delivering essential services like early childhood programs, autism services, employment and independent living support to more than 29,000 people each year. Through advocacy and education, we break barriers and create opportunities for the one\-in\-four Americans with disabilities. Responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining database architectures that support business applications and processes. Responsible for data ingestion, ETL processes, database security, and performance optimization within the Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW). Ensures compliance with data governance policies, backup and recovery protocols, and industry regulations. Collaborates with stakeholders to provide insights, manage projects, and support data\-driven decision\-making. With expertise in database management and security, plays a key role in maintaining system integrity, anticipating capacity needs, and ensuring seamless database operations. Starting Salary Range: $87k \- $110k / yr.**OVERVIEW OF POSITION:** Responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining database architectures that support business applications and processes. Responsible for data ingestion, ETL processes, database security, and performance optimization within the Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW). Ensures compliance with data governance policies, backup and recovery protocols, and industry regulations. Collaborates with stakeholders to provide insights, manage projects, and support data\-driven decision\-making. With expertise in database management and security, plays a key role in maintaining system integrity, anticipating capacity needs, and ensuring seamless database operations. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:** * Designs, implements, and maintains database schemas that support our applications and business processes. * Manages data ingestion and ETL/ELT processes for all data related to the Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW). Ensures backup and recovery procedures are documented, reviewed against IT security, infrastructure and compliance standards and tested. * Serves as the primary Major Incident Management (MIM) resource for the EDW. Monitors EDW users and conducts audits as requested. * Collaborates with IT Security and Compliance to ensure proper data governance guidelines are followed. * Monitors and optimizes database performance to ensure optimal query execution and system efficiency. * Implements and maintains security measures to protect sensitive data from unauthorized access or breaches. * Develops and implements backup and recovery plans to ensure the integrity and availability of our data. * Plans and execute database upgrades and patching to ensure that our database systems are up to date and secure. * Diagnoses and resolves database\-related issues in a timely manner to minimize downtime and ensure the reliability of our systems. * Leads technical sessions and projects, representing the EDW team in managing the Microsoft Fabric environment. * Maintains accurate documentation of database configurations, processes, and procedures. Preferred experience in DevOps or similar. * Analyzes data usage trends to forecast capacity needs and support scalability planning. * Serves as a key EDW resource, collaborating with development and IT teams to provide insights and recommendations. Ensures that our databases comply with relevant regulations and standards, such as GDPR, HIPAA, or PCI DSS. * Collaborates with data scientists and analysts to support advanced analytics and data\-driven decision\-making. * Develops and maintains data models and metadata to ensure data consistency and quality. * Provides training and support to other team members on database management and best practices and new implementations. * Performs other duties as assigned. **EDUCATION****:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or related field or commensurate experience or equivalent work experience. * Certification in database administration desired (e.g., Oracle Certified Professional, Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate). **EXPERIENCE:** * Proven experience with Microsoft ecosystem. 3 \- 5 years of experience as a Database Administrator and cloud architecture (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, Google, etc.) or in a similar role. * Experience with Spark, PySpark, and KQL, Notebooks and Lakehouses preferred. * Proficiency in managing relational database management systems (RDBMS) such as T\-SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Oracle. * Strong SQL skills and the ability to write and optimize complex SQL queries. * Experience with database performance tuning and optimization techniques. * Knowledge of database security best practices and experience implementing security measures such as encryption, access controls, and auditing. Experience with Microsoft Purview preferred. * Preferred experience includes DevOps or similar environments. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES:** * Demonstrated proficiency with MS Office applications (Word, Excel, Outlook). * Ability to maintain customer service orientation and professionalism in all interactions. * Ability to translate technical concepts into business\-friendly language for non\-technical stakeholders. * Effective communicator with cross\-functional teams including IT, compliance, and analytics. Ability to mentor and train team members on database management best practices and new implementations. * Ability to mentor and train team members on database management best practices and new implementations. * Ability to exercise independent judgment, exercise discretion and maintain a high level of confidentiality with sensitive documentation and/or situations. * Ability to obtain and maintain a criminal record/fingerprint clearance from the Department of Justice and Federal Bureau of Investigation per Easterseals Southern California and/or program requirements. **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS IN ACCORDANCE WITH ADA:** * Carrying/Lifting: Occasional / Up to 30 lbs. * Standing: Occasional / Up to 3 hours per day. * Sitting: Constant / Up to 8 hours per day. * Walking: Occasional / Up to 3 hours per day. * Travel: 0\-20%. * Repetitive Motion/Activity: Keyboard activity, telephone use, writing. The position requires occasional standing, bending, reaching, stooping, squatting, kneeling, grasping, lifting and twisting. * Visual Acuity: Ability to view computer monitor and read newsprint. * Environmental Exposure: None.

jobs.title: Process Engineer
jobs.description: As a Commissioning, Qualification, and Validation (CQV) Process Engineer, you will provide CQV services to clients in the Life Sciences Industry. The position provides an excellent opportunity to work for a Global Engineering Firm and support clients that manufacture life changing products. This position shall be responsible for the development and execution of CQV documentation on a variety of equipment, facilities, utilities, components, products, and systems for a diverse client base of biotechnology, pharmaceutical, medical device, gene therapy and cell therapy manufacturers. Join us and you will have the chance to work on projects including state of the art pharmaceutical facilities.You’ll be accountable for providing CQV process support to clients that manufacture GMP products on a consistent basis in conjunction with industry best practices. You will be responsible for developing CQV planning documents to manage CQV projects, generating and executing CQV protocols using Good Documentation Practices (GDPs), investigating and resolving protocols exceptions or discrepancies, developing technical reports and CQV summary reports, and starting up equipment in a safe and effective manner; as well as performing risk assessments and impact assessments. You’ll also be accountable for reading and verifying facility and equipment drawing (e.g., P\&IDs, AF\&IDs, etc.), developing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), process workflows, Validation Master Plans, User Requirement Specifications, Turnover Packages, and other regulatory support documentation. You will perform risk assessments and impact assessments, participate on integrated delivery (EPCMV) project teams to delivery facility and process, and you will be responsible for applying engineering knowledge of, and experience with, manufacturing equipment, process equipment, HVAC utilities, instrumentation, controls, and automation to support clients and troubleshoot processes. Additional responsibilities include leading tech transfer projects for clients. Bring your curiosity, talent for multi\-tasking and collaboration, and extreme organizational skills and we’ll help you grow, pursue and fulfill what drives you – so we can make big impacts on the world, together. Here’s what you’ll need: * Bachelor’s degree in Chemical, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or equivalent years of experience in lieu of degree * At least 3\-5 years of CQV process engineering experience in the Life Sciences industry * Understanding of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs) * Strong technical writing skills * Proficient with Microsoft Office – Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project * Flexibility and willingness to travel and work at various clients’ locations * Ability to work well with diverse, multi\-disciplined groups * Ability to effectively communicate with management and fellow project team members * Ability to negotiate/compromise with other project team members to achieve project goals * Ability to listen and respect fellow project team member’s ideas and opinions and work through conflicts or disagreements Ideally, you’ll also have: * Knowledge of US FDA (21 CFR 210, 211, 810\) and EU EMEA regulations * Knowledge of industry guidance: * ISPE Baseline Guide 5 Commissioning and Qualification * ISPE GAMP V, A Risk Based Approach to Compliant GMP Computerized Systems * ASTM E2500 Standard Guide for Specification, Design, and Verification of Pharmaceutical and Biopharmaceutical Manufacturing Systems and Equipment * ISPE Guideline: Science and Risk\-based Approach for the Delivery of Facilities, Systems, and Equipment, 2011 * ISPE Good Practice Guide: Applied Risk Management for Commissioning and Qualification, 2011 * Six Sigma Certification Pay: $30\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour Work Location: In person

The Firmware Engineer should have a strong background in firmware development and coding to join our team. The ideal candidate will have experience working with embedded systems and a passion for developing high\-quality code in a fast paced startup environment. **What you’ll be responsible for:** * Design, develop, and maintain firmware for embedded systems. * Write and debug software in C, C\+\+, Rust and Python. * Work across both Windows and Linux codebases to ensure system compatibility. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality software solutions. **Qualifications and Experience for success:** * BS or higher in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or equivalent. * 2\-3 years of experience in firmware development or equivalent. * Proficiency in C, C\+\+, and Python. * Experience working with both Windows and Linux environments. * Experience with IP/Ethernet and I2C/SPI/UART communication protocols. * Experience with wireless communication protocols (e.g., Bluetooth, Wi\-Fi). * Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git). * Experience with developing test scripts for validating firmware functionality. **If you have these, it would be even better:** * Experience with Rust. * Familiarity with video pipeline flow. * Experience working with NVIDIA platforms and SDKs. * Circuit design knowledge and experience. * Design and development experience on complex robotic systems. * Small company, high\-tech start\-up, mentality with a high appetite for innovation and success. **In exchange, we’ll offer you:** * Opportunities for professional growth and development. * A collaborative and inclusive work environment. * Competitive compensation packages * Flex work schedule * 401K * High\-quality, industry competitive, individual and family medical, dental and vision plan. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer (Applications), Full Stack
jobs.description: Many structural heart patients suffer from heart failure with limited options. Our Implantable Heart Failure Management (IHFM) business's AI, Product and Platforms organization is at the forefront of addressing these unmet patient needs through pioneering technology that enables early, targeted therapeutic intervention. Our innovative solutions are not just transforming patient care but also creating a unique and exciting environment for our team members. It is our driving force to help patients live longer and healthier lives. Join us and be part of our inspiring journey. At Edwards Lifesciences, the Implantable Heart Failure Management (IHFM) AI, Product and Platforms organization designs and builds the software and data products that clinicians and patients depend on. As a Staff Software Engineer (Applications), Full Stack, you set the web application architecture across the front end, the BFF, and supporting services, drive modernization at scale, and personally build the patterns and tooling multiple teams adopt. Based in Irvine, CA, you'll join a high\-impact medtech innovation hub in the heart of Orange County, collaborating in person with cross\-functional teams to shape patient\-focused technology. **How you'll make an impact:** * Web architecture, built. Set the web application architecture across the front end and its consumption of Platform APIs, including design system implementation, API contract patterns, navigation, feature flags, and modularization, and personally build the reference implementations. * Modernization at scale. Drive the Angular to React and BFF to Platform APIs migrations across teams, progressively retiring the BFF layer, and make monorepo and rendering strategy (server\-side, static, and client\-side) decisions backed by working prototypes. * API and platform partnership. Partner with Platform engineers on API and gateway design that serves the application layer well, contribute server\-side code to Platform\-owned services where it unblocks client work, design integrations with third\-party and EMR / EHR systems, and bring client constraints into product roadmap discussions. * Cloud\-native patterns. Set the cloud deployment patterns for web applications (containers, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code) in partnership with Platform and DevOps and build the reference pipelines teams adopt. * Mobile partnership. Partner with the Mobile track on shared API contracts, design system parity, and cross\-surface architecture, so that web and mobile evolve coherently. * Standards. Set engineering standards across the web application ecosystem for code quality, accessibility implementation, performance budgets, API design, and test strategy. * Design control at scale. Shape how application design outputs, verification evidence, and traceability are produced across teams, in partnership with Software Systems and Process Development. * Multiplier. Mentor P3 engineers, set the hiring bar at this level, and multiply team output through the architecture and tooling you build. **What you'll need (Required):** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field plus 8 years, or Master's degree plus 6 years. * Recognized depth in web application architecture, with hands\-on fluency in React, Angular, Platform API and gateway consumption (REST and GraphQL), and at least one server\-side language, plus working knowledge of mobile client architecture. * A track record of setting technical standards adopted across multiple teams. * Experience leading a large\-scale frontend or API modernization, such as Angular to React or BFF to Platform APIs. * Experience designing and operating cloud\-deployed applications at scale, including containers, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code. * The ability to embed quality and traceability into a secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC), including CI/CD and automated testing. **What else we look for (Preferred):** * Experience in medical device software (SaMD), or other regulated classes of device software, under IEC 62304, ISO 13485, IEC 62366\-1, and FDA design controls. * Experience with experimentation, feature flag, and modular build infrastructure. * Experience across the UI framework and design system ecosystem, such as Material UI, Chakra UI, Radix UI, Tailwind UI, shadcn/ui, IBM Carbon, or Ant Design. * Experience with EMR / EHR integration (HL7, FHIR, IHE) and clinical workflows. * Experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes) and infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK). Aligning our overall business objectives with performance, we offer competitive salaries, performance\-based incentives, and a wide variety of benefits programs to address the diverse individual needs of our employees and their families. For California, the base pay range for this position is $121,000 \- $171,000 (highly experienced). The pay for the successful candidate will depend on various factors (e.g., qualifications, education, prior experience). Applications will be accepted while this position is posted on our Careers website. Edwards is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer including protected Veterans and individuals with disabilities.

jobs.title: ML Platform Engineer, Distributed Training
jobs.description: **About Egen:** Egen is a fast\-growing and entrepreneurial company with a data\-first mindset. We bring together the best engineering talent working with the most advanced technology platforms, including Google Cloud and Salesforce, to help clients drive action and impact through data and insights. We are committed to being a place where the best people choose to work so they can apply their engineering and technology expertise to envision what is next for how data and platforms can change the world for the better. We are dedicated to learning, thrive on solving tough problems, and continually innovate to achieve fast, effective results. If this describes you, we want you on our team. *Want to learn more about life at Egen? Check out these resources in addition to the job description.* Meet Egen Life at Egen Culture and Values at Egen Career Development at Egen Benefits at Egen **About the opportunity** ------------------------- We're looking for an engineer who is equally at home running a GPU training platform and the large\-scale model training that runs on it. You'll be embedded with a healthcare and life\-sciences AI client that trains foundation models on a large GKE\-based H200 and GB200 cluster. The client is reorganizing so that its foundation\-model platform and its agent platform teams work more closely together. The role centres on the training stack and the scientists who use it. Solid infrastructure knowledge and experience are required, but the client already has strong SRE and infrastructure capacity, so running the cluster isn't the focus: you'll partner with that team and understand the training workloads well enough to tune, benchmark, and debug them end to end. You'll work alongside other Egen engineers and client scientists, and you'll own your area outright. ### **What You Will Do:** ### **Training platform** * Work with the client's infrastructure team on the GKE training platform (GPU node pools, job queueing and scheduling, quota and capacity) from the training workload's side. * Diagnose and fix platform failures at the root (for example a controller that keeps running out of memory) rather than restarting them. * Tune multi\-node GPU networking (RDMA/GPUDirect, NCCL) for training throughput. ### **Distributed training** * Run, scale and debug multi\-node distributed training with PyTorch (FSDP, DeepSpeed, Megatron or NeMo\-style) and Ray Train. * Profile jobs and remove bottlenecks across compute, memory, input pipelines and interconnect. ### **Benchmarking and evals** * Design and run performance benchmarks for the cluster and training stack: throughput, scaling efficiency, cost per run. * Build and maintain model evaluation harnesses so changes to the platform or training recipes are measured, not assumed. * Instrument training and the platform with telemetry and monitoring, and keep end\-to\-end pipeline tests running against what users actually run. **Ownership on the client team** * Treat the platform as your own: proactively find issues, plug gaps and propose solutions before anyone asks, keep the team informed of status and risks, and look after the scientists who use it. * Explain and defend your design decisions to client engineers and scientists in detail. * Stay effective while the client's priorities and team structure change. ### **Your Technical Toolkit:** * **Core Languages**: Mastery of Python and shell scripting * **AI/LLM Ecosystem**: Extensive experience with Google Gemini, GPT\-4, or LLaMA; deep knowledge of Prompt Engineering and Fine\-tuning * **Data \& Search**: Expertise in Vector Databases (Vertex AI Vector Search, pgvector, etc.) and implementing Semantic Search * **Infrastructure**: Hands\-on experience with Google Cloud (Vertex AI) and building scalable software architectures * **Frameworks**: Proficiency in LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar orchestration layers * **Mindset:** A strong software engineering foundation—you write clean, maintainable code and understand the full SDLC ### **Basic Qualifications:** * 5\+ years of engineering experience, with recent hands\-on work on GPU training infrastructure and large\-scale training. * **Strong Python software engineering:** production\-quality code, tests and code review. Actual compensation will depend on a candidate’s education, experience, skills, and geographic location. jobs.title: Security Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: When a customer hits a thorny technical question, someone at Expel needs to have the answer. Fast, accurate, and complete. That's where you come in. As a Security Solutions Engineer (SSE), you're the technical backstop for our Customer Success organization. When our Customer Success Managers (CSMs), Technical Account Managers (TAMs), and Technical Support Engineers (TSEs) run into complex technical challenges, you're the person they turn to. You'll dig in, troubleshoot, and deliver answers that help our customers get the most out of Expel. You'll work closely with a team of technical experts and collaborate across Security, Detection \& Response Engineering, and other Engineering teams to build a deep understanding of our platform, integrations, detection strategies, and security operations. Just as importantly, you'll turn that knowledge into documentation, enablement, and repeatable solutions that help the broader organization become more effective over time. Success in this role comes from having a "the buck stops here" mindset. You're someone who takes ownership, enjoys solving complex problems, and knows how to balance being a trusted technical resource with helping others become more self\-sufficient. **What Expel can do for you** ----------------------------- * Give you the opportunity to work with a wide variety of security technologies, platforms, and customer environments. * Deepen your expertise in managed detection and response (MDR), security operations, and the broader cybersecurity landscape. * Connect you with experienced security practitioners, engineers, and leaders across Expel and our customer base. * Provide hands\-on exposure to complex technical challenges that require creative problem\-solving and thoughtful troubleshooting. * Help you sharpen your consultative skills as you translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable guidance. * Give you the opportunity to influence how our Customer Success organization operates through documentation, enablement, and process improvements. * Surround you with a collaborative team that values technical curiosity, knowledge\-sharing, and continuous improvement. **What you can do for Expel** ----------------------------- * Serve as a trusted technical resource and escalation point for our Customer Success organization, providing timely, accurate, and thorough responses to technical questions. * Troubleshoot complex technical issues, perform root cause analysis, and help identify practical solutions that improve customer outcomes. * Partner with CSMs, TAMs, and TSEs to address technical challenges, occasionally joining customer conversations when deeper technical expertise is needed. * Collaborate with Security, Detection \& Response Engineering, and other Engineering teams to develop a strong understanding of Expel's platform architecture, integrations, data flows, and detection and response capabilities. * Identify gaps in existing documentation and proactively create, maintain, and improve internal and external knowledge resources. * Help enable Customer Success teams to answer common technical questions independently, reducing repetitive inquiries and improving response times. * Maintain accurate records of technical inquiries, including request types and trends, to help the team identify recurring challenges and prioritize improvements. * Contribute to the team's operational processes, helping improve how technical requests are tracked, escalated, resolved, and documented. * Share your expertise with teammates and help build a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and technical excellence. **What you should bring with you** ---------------------------------- * 5\+ years of experience in the cybersecurity industry, ideally with exposure to technical troubleshooting, security operations, or consultative customer\-facing roles. * Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills, with the ability to independently investigate and resolve complex technical challenges. * Technical depth in one or more security technology areas, including EDR, NDR, SIEM, cloud security, or related security platforms. * A solid understanding of detection strategies, security operations workflows, and the technical tradeoffs associated with different security solutions. * Familiarity with common attack vectors, threat tactics and techniques, frameworks such as MITRE ATT\&CK, and the broader attack lifecycle. * Working knowledge of the cybersecurity landscape, including security products, service providers, and their relative strengths and limitations. * An understanding of security controls across common operating systems, cloud environments, and enterprise technologies, including Windows, Unix/Linux, AWS, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, and network infrastructure. * Experience working with ticketing, case management, or operational workflow platforms such as Zendesk, ServiceNow, or similar tools. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical practitioners and business stakeholders. * A consultative approach to problem\-solving, including active listening, thoughtful questioning, and the ability to understand the underlying issue before recommending a solution. * Sound judgment when prioritizing competing requests, managing challenging conversations, and knowing when to escalate. * A collaborative, curious mindset and a genuine interest in learning, sharing knowledge, and continuously improving how work gets done. * Awareness of how security challenges and priorities can differ across customer industries and environments. * A bachelor's degree or relevant security certifications are a plus, but they're not required. **Additional notes** -------------------- The full base salary range for this role is $102,000 to $147,900 USD, plus bonus eligibility and equity. While this represents the full range for the position, we're targeting a base salary between $115,000 and $137,500 USD for this hire, depending on experience, skills, and other relevant factors. We believe in paying transparently and equitably. Your compensation will ultimately be determined based on your experience, skills, internal team equity, and market data. You'll also be eligible for unlimited PTO (which we model and encourage), work location flexibility, up to 24 weeks of parental leave, and excellent health benefits. This role is open to candidates residing within the continental United States. Employees may work remotely from their home office if they are not located near Expel's headquarters in Herndon, VA. Some travel to customer sites may be required, generally not exceeding 20%. We're only hiring individuals authorized to work in the United States. We do not currently sponsor immigration visas. We're an Equal Opportunity Employer. You'll receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability. We'll ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please let us know if you need accommodation of any kind. \#LI\-Remote

jobs.title: Senior Tax Professional - AI Tax Engineer
jobs.description: **Join Filed as an AI Tax Engineer: bring your expertise to the platform tax professionals rely on, work alongside a team of CPAs, and help shape where the profession goes next. Full\-time, on\-site in New York.** **Filed is building the first AI tax preparer trusted by America's accounting firms.** The accountant is irreplaceable. The work surrounding them isn't. Filed takes on that surrounding work, from the moment client documents arrive to the plan a firm hands back, so tax professionals can spend their time on judgment, advice and the client relationship. Filed works inside the software firms already use (CCH Axcess, UltraTax, Lacerte, Drake and ProConnect) across individual, business, trust and exempt organization returns. We're backed by Northzone, Neo, Raine and Day One Ventures. Read more in TechCrunch. ### **What we should tell you about the role** Filed is built for tax professionals, by a team that includes them. Our CPAs sit at the center of the company. They decide what quality means in everything Filed does, and they shape what we build next. As an AI Tax Engineer, you'd join that team. This is a strategic role. You'll bring years of practice experience to the product, work with our product and engineering leads on where Filed goes next, and work directly with the firms that run on it. Your judgment ends up in a platform used by firms across the country, instead of staying inside one practice. We think the profession deserves better than the busywork that has grown up around it, and that the people doing this work should spend their time on the parts that need their expertise. This role is how we make sure Filed delivers on both. We hire for this role on a rolling basis rather than to a fixed headcount. If you're the right person, we'd rather meet you now than wait for a req to open. ### **Here's why this is a terrible job** * You won't sign returns anymore. jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting \& Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. **The Role** Are you a builder who has already shipped AI that changed how a business runs? Fanatics wants you. We're hiring full\-time Applied AI Engineers to join a small, senior team that sits at the center of how Fanatics transforms itself with AI. Our goal is simple and ambitious: make Fanatics a leaner, faster, more automated company. Each Applied AI Engineer works like a tiger team: embed with a business function, find its biggest bottlenecks, replace slow, manual work with AI agents and workflows that actually run in production, then move on to the next challenge. This is a doer's role, not an advisory one. You'll own problems end to end: define them, design the solution, build it, prove it works, and drive adoption. You'll have real autonomy, executive visibility, and a direct line to leadership, with joint reporting to the CFO and Corporate AI Transformation Lead. We're looking for someone with prior experience doing applied AI work at a startup or fast\-growing company, who is used to moving quickly with limited resources and is ready to bring that pace to a global brand. **What You'll Do** * Embed within corporate functions across the business, find the workflows where AI can remove the most manual effort or unlock the most growth, fix them, then rotate to the next function. * Design, build, and deploy production\-grade agents and agentic workflows using frontier models (Claude, GPT, Gemini) and the modern agent stack: MCP servers, agent SDKs, orchestration tools, browser and computer use, and evals. * Move fast: take a high\-impact use case from concept to working solution in weeks, not quarters, and prove it with measurable results. * Think in systems and bias toward solving the problem, not toward building for its own sake. Sometimes the right answer is a custom agent; sometimes it's configuring an existing tool. * Partner with business leaders to be accountable for outcomes, and help them rethink how their teams operate in an AI\-first way. * Call balls and strikes: pressure\-test whether a problem is worth automating, what "good" looks like, and how to measure ROI. * Help set the bar for AI across the company, including tool evaluation, security and InfoSec coordination, governance, and best practices. * Spread the practice: document and showcase wins, coach colleagues, and help build a company culture that automates by default. **What We're Looking For** * 3\+ years of experience in applied AI or software engineering, including time at a startup or fast\-growing company where you shipped AI\-powered products or automations to real users. * A track record of building and deploying custom agents or agentic workflows with frontier LLMs that solved real business problems, not just prototypes. * Fluency with the modern AI stack: LLM APIs, MCP, agent frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, or similar), prompt engineering, RAG, and evaluation methods. * Strong coding skills (Python preferred) and the judgment to pick the right tool for the job, including buying or configuring instead of building. * Comfort operating independently in ambiguity, with a high bar for speed, ownership, and follow\-through. * A strategic mindset paired with a "get it done" attitude; you can tell the difference between a cool demo and a business outcome. * Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to earn trust and drive change with senior business leaders. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, Software Engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent practical experience welcome. * Bonus points if you're a fan of sports, collectibles, or fandom culture (because we're a little obsessed). **Why You'll Love It Here** * Real ownership of high\-visibility problems, with exposure to every part of Fanatics and direct access to senior leadership. * A chance to be part of a small, hand\-picked team shaping how a global sports and collectibles company becomes AI\-first. * Backing for your work: dedicated headcount, budget, and executive sponsorship to get things done. * Competitive salary and comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. * 401(k) plan with company match. * Generous paid time off, paid holidays, and parental leave. * Wellness benefits and a learning \& development stipend. * NYC office with daily in\-person collaboration. * Employee discount on Fanatics products and (yes) some sweet Fanatics swag. **Final Word** If you've built AI that moved a business and you're ready to do it at global scale, let's talk. This is where the doers build. By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy. *Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it* *here**.*
