jobs.title: Data and Analytics Integration Specialist II
jobs.description: JMARK is a leading provider of managed IT services, cybersecurity solutions, cloud technologies, and strategic IT consulting. Founded on the principle of People First. Technology Second., JMARK partners with businesses to transform technology into a true driver of growth, resilience, and competitive advantage. With a focus on proactive strategies, exceptional customer experience, and business value, JMARK helps organizations reduce risks, increase efficiency, and plan for the future. Our team combines technical expertise with a people\-centric approach, ensuring that every solution aligns with client goals, culture, and long\-term success. At the heart of JMARK’s philosophy are our core values:* **Honesty** – honoring commitments and building trust * **Passion** – loving what we do and where we do it * **Teamwork** – working together to prevent problems and create solutions * **Excellence** – exceeding expectations through initiative and follow\-through * **Accountability** – doing what we say we will do * **Fun** – celebrating success and enjoying the journey For more than three decades, JMARK has served as a trusted IT partner across industries, helping businesses thrive with secure, reliable, and future\-ready technology solutions.### **About The Role:** ### **Turn Complex Data into Meaningful Business Insights** Are you passionate about data, analytics, and finding creative ways to solve business problems? Do you enjoy building solutions that take information from multiple systems and transform it into something businesses can actually use to make better decisions? At JMARK, we're looking for a Data and Analytics Integration Specialist II to join our growing AI Operations team. This is an opportunity to work with modern data technologies, including Databricks, Python, PySpark, Terraform, and API integrations, while helping businesses unlock the value of their data. You'll play an important role in designing data models, building integrations, developing dashboards, and delivering analytics solutions that help our clients make smarter, more informed decisions. We're looking for someone who enjoys digging into the details, solving complex problems, collaborating with others, and taking ownership of their work. Just as importantly, we're looking for someone who wants to continue learning and growing as technology evolves. ### **What You'll Be Doing** **Data Engineering \& Integration** * Design, build, and maintain Common Data Models (CDMs) that support clients across industries such as financial services, healthcare, legal, government, and hospitality. * Develop and manage data integrations connecting multiple applications, systems, and APIs. * Build reusable Databricks notebooks, jobs, and Python modules to streamline data processing and improve efficiency. * Use Python and PySpark to transform raw data into structured, accurate, and reliable information. * Develop and maintain infrastructure\-as\-code solutions using Terraform. * Troubleshoot complex data integration issues and optimize performance, reliability, and cost. * Implement data quality, validation, and reconciliation processes to ensure accuracy and consistency. **Analytics \& Business Intelligence** * Work directly with clients to understand their business goals, reporting requirements, and key performance indicators (KPIs). * Design and develop dashboards, reports, and automated alerts that provide meaningful business insights. * Transform complex data into easy\-to\-understand visualizations that help clients make informed decisions. * Develop reusable reporting templates, data dictionaries, and analytics standards. * Help clients understand and effectively use their dashboards and reporting tools. * Ensure reporting solutions are accurate, secure, and aligned with client business objectives. **Security, Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement** * Apply security best practices to protect client data and ensure appropriate access controls. * Follow secure development practices, change management procedures, and established data governance standards. * Collaborate with JMARK's AI Operations team, engineers, and client\-facing teams to deliver effective solutions. * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to less experienced team members. * Identify opportunities to improve processes, automation, and overall solution quality. * Maintain clear documentation and communicate project progress, challenges, and solutions. ### **What We're Looking For** We understand that great candidates don't always have experience with every technology. We're looking for someone with a strong technical foundation, demonstrated problem\-solving ability, and the desire to continue developing their skills. **Technical Experience \& Skills** * Experience working with Databricks or similar cloud\-based data engineering platforms. * Proficiency with Python and PySpark for data processing, transformation, and integration. * Experience building integrations using APIs, including authentication and data retrieval. * Familiarity with Terraform or similar infrastructure\-as\-code technologies. * Experience developing dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using business intelligence tools. * Understanding of data modeling, data pipelines, and data quality best practices. * Experience working with cloud environments, preferably AWS. * Knowledge of data security, access controls, and governance practices. * Ability to troubleshoot technical challenges and develop scalable, reliable solutions. **Experience \& Education** * Typically 3–4 years of hands\-on experience in data engineering, data integration, analytics, or a related field, or demonstrated equivalent technical competence. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field; relevant technical certifications; or equivalent professional experience. * Experience taking ownership of data integration projects, data models, or analytics solutions. * Experience working directly with clients or business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver solutions. * Previous experience in a managed services environment is a plus. ### **What Will Help You Succeed** Technical ability is important, but how you approach your work matters just as much. The ideal candidate will: * **Be naturally curious.** You enjoy understanding how things work, asking questions, and finding better ways to accomplish tasks. * **Take ownership.** You're comfortable managing projects and seeing solutions through from beginning to end. * **Think analytically.** You can break down complex challenges, identify root causes, and develop practical solutions. * **Communicate effectively.** You can explain technical concepts to both technical and nontechnical audiences. * **Have a client\-first mindset.** You understand that technology is only valuable when it helps people and businesses succeed. * **Enjoy collaboration.** You work well with others, share knowledge, and contribute to the success of the team. * **Embrace continuous learning.** You're excited about emerging technologies, AI, analytics, and opportunities to expand your expertise.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: Government technology has failed citizens, veterans, public servants, and service members for decades. Kaizen powers America’s application layer. We replace the legacy systems federal agencies run on with modern software, built with craft. The ticketing platform a resident uses to visit a presidential library. The marketplace DoW uses to procure counter\-drone systems to protect lives and critical infrastructure. The system a Veteran uses to access benefits. We build systems of record, of national consequence. Our AI\-native modules and harness allow us to do so in weeks, not years. This year, our revenue has grown 35x. Next year, our software will serve over 100 million Americans across dozens of federal agencies. Founded in 2022 and based in New York City and DC, Kaizen has raised $35 million from NEA, a16z, Accel, 776, and Carpenter Capital. **The Role** ------------ We built an internal tool called Bidbuddy. Before it existed, someone on our team spent eight hours a week scraping procurement sites, pulling RFPs by hand, and reading them to figure out which ones were worth chasing. Now one system does the scraping and the first pass of analysis. Those eight hours went back to the people doing the actual work of winning. That's one tool. We need many more, and most of them don't exist yet. Kaizen is about 40 people supporting software that reaches 40 million residents across 50\+ agencies in 17 states, and the only way that math holds is if the company runs on tools instead of hours. This role owns that. You'll go department by department, find where the time goes, and build the thing that takes it back. Sometimes that's an internal app. Sometimes it's an automation nobody notices. Sometimes it's teaching a team to use AI properly, which is often the highest leverage thing available. Then you roll it out and stay on it until people actually use it. We already have the list, and it's long. **Location** ------------ This is a hybrid role based out of our New York. Candidates must reside in New York or be able to commute to New York City to work out of our office at least four times a week (Monday \- Thursday). **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Own internal tools end to end, from the hallway conversation that surfaces the problem through architecture, build, rollout, and the week two fixes. * Build AI powered internal systems in the mold of Bidbuddy: document parsing and analysis, agentic workflows, automated research and routing, and tooling that turns hours of manual work into minutes. * Work directly with leads across Proposals, Customer Ops, Sales, Design, and Engineering to find where the time is going, and translate half\-formed asks into something worth building. * Drive AI enablement across the company. Every person at Kaizen should know how to get the most out of these tools. * Support the external analytics layer inside Kaizen's platform, so customers have clear, actionable data at their fingertips * Back up the deployment team during an implementation **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * 2 to 5 years of engineering, data, or applied AI experience, or work that makes the years irrelevant. Slope matters more than seniority * Something you built end to end that a team still uses today: an internal application, an automation, a tool that changed how people work. Not a prototype, not a demo * Genuine fluency with AI tools. You've shipped with them, not just explored them, and you can name where they failed you and how you caught it * Strong SQL and enough data modeling to work in an existing warehouse and ship a model when the job calls for it * The ability to take a vague problem from a non\-technical stakeholder and come back with the right scope, not the requested one * Low ego, high output. You do the unglamorous rollout work because that's what makes the build matter **Strong Candidates May Also...** --------------------------------- * Have built internal tooling at a company where the hard part was getting hundreds of people to change how they work * Come out of forward deployed or solutions engineering at an AI or developer tools company, where the job was making software work inside someone else's mess * Know N8N, Zapier, or similar deeply enough to have a view on when not to reach for them * Have built in government, healthcare, or another environment where getting it wrong has consequences **What Kaizen Offers** ---------------------- **Health \& Insurance** * 100% coverage across the board: medical through Oxford/United (Gold and Platinum PPO plans), dental through Guardian PPO, and vision through Beam — all fully covered for employees, with 100% coverage for dependents. * $100,000 in fully paid life insurance. FSA and Dependent Care FSA. * One Medical membership, on us — same\-day primary care, 24/7 virtual visits, and offices all over the city. * Fertility and family\-building support through Carrot. * 401(k) through Guideline, with a 2% company match. **Family \& Time Off** * 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for birthing parents. 10 weeks fully paid for non\-birthing parents. * Unlimited PTO, with a two\-week minimum (we mean it when we say take time off!) * Closed for all federal holidays. * Company\-wide winter break the week of Christmas. * Company offsites throughout the year. **Office \& Remote Setup** * Up to $750 one\-time home office or desk setup stipend for NYC\-based employees. $500 for remote employees. * $50/month commuter benefit (company contribution). * Expensed lunch while in the office. * Dinner and Uber rides home will be expensed if you choose to work in the office past 7pm. * Company\-provided laptop of your choice. **Wellness** * NYC employees: Fully covered gym membership at Grindhouse — right across the street from our office at 47 W 17th St (and in Williamsburg). A $225/month value, on us. * Non\-NYC employees: $100 per month, dedicated to gym / physical fitness reimbursement. **Stipends** * $100/month utility stipend. * $250/quarter home cleaning stipend * $500/year professional development. * $250/year recreation. * $300/quarter pet care stipend. Compensation Range: $150K \- $200K

jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer, SDK
jobs.description: **About LaunchDarkly Engineering** ---------------------------------- LaunchDarkly helps engineering organizations ship software and AI with speed, safety, and control. Our platform gives teams the confidence to release gradually, target experiences to the right audiences, learn through experimentation, understand what is happening in production, and respond quickly when risk appears. Our engineers build the systems, services, SDKs, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, and product experiences that make this possible. The work spans high\-scale distributed systems, reliable data and event pipelines, intuitive enterprise workflows, and AI\-powered capabilities that help teams manage the next generation of software delivery. LaunchDarkly's SDKs are used in systems that perform trillions of feature flag evaluations each day, giving our engineering work a direct connection to the reliability and customer experience of software around the world. As the company grows, we are expanding beyond traditional feature management into experimentation, observability, and AgentControl—helping customers control more of the software and AI lifecycle. That creates an unusually broad set of technical challenges, visible customer impact, and room for engineers to shape what comes next. We believe in the power of teams. We work with humility, openness, curiosity, and care; we value clear communication, thoughtful technical judgment, inclusive collaboration, and a strong sense of ownership. We encourage people to apply even when they do not meet every qualification listed below. We are interested in the experience, perspective, and potential you would bring to the role. **About the Job** As a Software Engineer on LaunchDarkly's SDK team, you will build the primary touchpoint that our customers interact with on a daily basis. You'll work with multiple technologies across our 35\+ SDKs while enabling customers of all kinds to feature flag their code. When working on our SDKs, you'd be contributing to much more than thin client wrappers. Our SDKs are feature\-rich agents with strong emphases on performance, concurrency, and resiliency \- all while following idiomatic practices for their tech stack. LaunchDarkly serves trillions of feature flags daily to customers all around the globe, and every flag is handled by our SDKs. This team has a major impact not only on our company, but on our customers (and their customers). We are growing fast and we need your help writing the next chapter in our story. #### **Responsibilities:** * Contribute to development for SDKs in supported platforms: + Implement new features and improvements to meet customer performance and resiliency requirements + Keep up to date with the latest development practices * Collaborate with our engineering and product teams to drive the implementation and release of major features * Actively maintain our open\-source repositories * Identify areas of improvement and advocate for best practices * Have an active voice in shaping both technology and product decisions #### **Basic Qualifications:** * Demonstrable experience building libraries and packages used by other developers * Polyglot background with an ability to context switch between languages quickly * 5\+ years experience with at least two of the following: .NET/Go/Ruby/Python/NodeJS/Java * Experience with the following is a plus: + C\+\+/Erlang/Haskell/Lua + AI SDKs + Observability SDKs + Mobile development * Strong computer science fundamentals * Committed to working in a communicative, collaborative environment * Self‐starter and problem solver, willing to solve difficult problems and work independently when necessary * Strong testing background: experience building unit, integration, load tests, and benchmarks * Experience writing production\-ready code with emphasis on quality and maintainability * Experience contributing to open\-source software #### **Logistics:** * This is a remote role, with opportunities to visit the office in the Bay Area, California, for team offsites * The SDK team is spread between Eastern and Pacific time zones #### **Highlights:** * You will work collaboratively with a team of highly experienced engineers who are amazing at the craft of engineering and building SDKs * Your contributions will be publicly visible as the SDK team develops LaunchDarkly's open\-source SDKs in public * LaunchDarkly uses our own SDKs. You will have opportunities working with the other teams within LaunchDarkly * In this role, you can learn about many programming languages and frameworks * You will have opportunities to strongly influence roadmap and prioritization **Pay:** *Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones\* for Level 3:* * Zone 1: *San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle* \- $171,200 \- $235,400\*\* * Zone 2: *Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago \-* $154,100 \- $211,860 \*\* * Zone 3: *All other US locations \-* $145,500 \- $200,090 \*\* *LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.* * *Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.* *\*\*Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.* #### **About LaunchDarkly:** Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big\-bang" technology migrations. The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by: * Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages * Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts * Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize * Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types * Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability At LaunchDarkly, we believe in the power of teams. We're building a team that is humble, open, collaborative, respectful and kind. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. LD invites any applicant to review our written Affirmative Action Plan. To do so, contact People Ops at hr@launchdarkly.com. **Do you need a disability accommodation?** Fill out this accommodations request form and someone from our People Operations team will contact you for assistance. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, LaunchDarkly recruiters will only contact you from @launchdarkly.com email addresses or via LinkedIn from "Verified Recruiter" accounts. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate LaunchDarkly recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before making a job offer. LaunchDarkly will never make a job offer without conducting a formal interview process. Our interview process does not involve asking detailed questions by email. and connecting both corporate IT and OT, industrial, or lab\-instrumentation networks. * Practical experience implementing network segmentation, zero\-trust concepts, and secure remote access. * jobs.title: Senior Databricks Engineer/Architect
jobs.description: Senior Data Architect – Databricks Position Overview We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Architect with deep expertise in Databricks architecture and implementations to lead the design, development, and modernization of enterprise data platforms. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in data architecture, cloud\-based data engineering, and hands\-on experience implementing Databricks solutions from initial design through production deployment. This individual will play a critical role in defining data architecture strategies, implementing scalable data solutions, and helping organizations maximize the value of their data through modern cloud technologies. We are looking for someone who can operate at both the strategic and technical levels—designing enterprise solutions while remaining hands\-on throughout implementation. Key Responsibilities Data Architecture \& Strategy * Design and implement scalable, secure, and high\-performing enterprise data architectures leveraging Databricks. * Lead end\-to\-end Databricks implementations, including architecture design, environment setup, data integration, migration, and production deployment. * Define architectural standards, best practices, and technical roadmaps for modern data platforms. * Design and implement Lakehouse architectures supporting analytics, business intelligence, and advanced data processing. * Evaluate existing data environments and recommend modernization strategies. * Partner with business stakeholders, engineering teams, and technology leadership to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Databricks Implementation \& Engineering * Lead the design, configuration, deployment, and optimization of Databricks environments. * Architect and implement data pipelines using Databricks, Apache Spark, PySpark, Python, and SQL. * Design and implement Delta Lake solutions for reliable, scalable data storage and processing. * Establish data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and integration patterns. * Implement medallion architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) and other appropriate data modeling frameworks. * Configure and optimize Databricks workflows, compute resources, and data processing performance. * Support migration of legacy data warehouses, ETL processes, and data platforms into Databricks. * Implement CI/CD processes, infrastructure automation, and deployment best practices. Data Governance, Security \& Optimization * Design and implement data governance frameworks utilizing Databricks Unity Catalog. * Establish data quality, lineage, access control, and security standards. * Ensure solutions meet enterprise security, compliance, and data management requirements. * Optimize platform performance, scalability, reliability, and cloud infrastructure costs. * Develop architectural documentation, technical standards, and implementation guidelines. Technical Leadership \& Collaboration * Serve as the subject matter expert for Databricks architecture and implementation. * Provide technical leadership and guidance to data engineers, developers, and cross\-functional teams. * Lead architecture discussions, design reviews, and technical decision\-making. * Collaborate with cloud infrastructure, DevOps, analytics, and business intelligence teams. * Identify opportunities to improve data accessibility, platform efficiency, and overall data capabilities. Required Qualifications * 8\+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, data warehousing, or related technical disciplines. * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience with Databricks, including designing and implementing enterprise solutions. * Demonstrated experience leading at least one end\-to\-end Databricks implementation, from architecture and initial setup through production deployment. * Strong understanding of Databricks Lakehouse architecture, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Apache Spark. * Advanced proficiency in Python, PySpark, and SQL. * Experience designing and implementing scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and data integration solutions. * Strong experience with at least one major cloud platform: Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform. * Experience with cloud\-based data storage, data warehouses, and distributed processing technologies. * Strong understanding of data modeling, data governance, data security, and performance optimization. * Experience migrating or modernizing legacy data platforms into cloud\-based architectures. * Ability to develop architecture diagrams, technical documentation, and implementation roadmaps. * Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate with technical teams and business stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications * Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional or Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate. * Databricks Certified Data Architect (if applicable to current certification offerings) or other advanced Databricks credentials. * Experience implementing Databricks in multiple enterprise environments. * Experience with Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, AWS Glue, Amazon S3, or similar cloud services. * Experience with Terraform, infrastructure as code, and automated deployment pipelines. * Familiarity with dbt, Airflow, or other orchestration and transformation technologies. * Experience integrating Databricks with Power BI, Tableau, or other analytics platforms. * Understanding of streaming data architectures and real\-time processing. * Experience supporting machine learning, AI, or advanced analytics workloads. * Experience with enterprise data platform modernization initiatives. What Success Looks Like * Successfully architect and implement a production\-ready Databricks environment. * Establish scalable, repeatable, and well\-governed data architecture standards. * Deliver reliable data pipelines and integration frameworks that support enterprise reporting and analytics. * Improve data processing performance, accessibility, and operational efficiency. * Provide technical leadership that enables engineering teams to effectively develop and maintain solutions within Databricks. Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is a hands\-on architect who has personally designed, built, and implemented Databricks environments, rather than someone whose experience is limited to maintaining or developing within an established platform. They should be comfortable owning technical architecture decisions, guiding implementation teams, solving complex data challenges, and translating business needs into scalable enterprise data solutions. Pay: $65\.00 \- $75\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Location: * Kansas City, MO 64126 (Required) Ability to Commute: * Kansas City, MO 64126 (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Kansas City, MO 64126

jobs.title: Staff Network Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **About Mytra:** We’re creating an entirely new way to solve the most ubiquitous problem in industry \- moving and storing material. We’re applying robotics and distributed software to create a new class of product for this $1T market. We’re focused on the supply chain industry first. The industry is in a massive bind with the continued growth of e\-commerce, sharp rise in costs, and supply chain disruptions. What has been a “sleepy” industry for decades is now at the epicenter of sustaining the global economy. **About the role** ------------------ As a **Staff Network Systems Engineer** at Mytra, you will be the technical owner and DRI for the network subsystem that ships as part of our robotic warehouse automation product. The network connects our robots, on\-premises compute infrastructure, operator interfaces, and supporting systems, and its performance is fundamental to the operation of the overall Mytra system. This is a product engineering role rather than a traditional corporate IT networking role. You will define what good looks like for networking at Mytra and own the subsystem from requirements and architecture through hardware selection, physical design, configuration, deployment, validation, and ongoing evolution. You will work across software, robotics, electrical, mechanical, systems, deployment, and operations teams to translate system requirements into a network architecture that performs predictably in complex industrial environments. This is a hands\-on design and implementation role. You should be equally comfortable designing a network topology, evaluating switches and wireless access points, determining AP placement, partnering on the design of a network cabinet, configuring equipment, establishing performance requirements and validation methodologies, and debugging difficult problems on a live robotic system. **What you’ll do:** ------------------- * Serve as the technical DRI for Mytra's product network, defining and evolving the architecture supporting our robots, on\-premises compute, operator interfaces, and other system components. * Own wired and wireless network design, including topology, switching, routing, addressing, segmentation, redundancy, QoS, wireless coverage, channel planning, roaming behavior, interference management, and capacity. * Translate robotics and application requirements such as latency, jitter, packet loss, throughput, availability, roaming performance, and fault tolerance into concrete network requirements, architectures, and acceptance criteria. * Own the selection, evaluation, qualification, and lifecycle of networking hardware, including switches, routers, firewalls, wireless access points, antennas, cabling, optics, and related components. * Own wireless architecture and AP placement for environments containing continuously moving robots, designing for predictable connectivity as robots move throughout large industrial structures and transition between access points. * Partner with Electrical and Mechanical Engineering on the physical design of the networking subsystem, including network cabinets, power, thermal management, cabling, serviceability, installation, and maintainability. * Define standard network configurations, deployment practices, and automation so a validated network architecture can be reliably reproduced across customer installations. * Develop network qualification, performance, and acceptance testing covering wireless coverage, roaming, latency, packet loss, throughput, redundancy, capacity, and performance under representative robot fleet loads. * Establish network observability, telemetry, diagnostics, and troubleshooting capabilities that allow Engineering and Operations teams to understand network health and quickly identify failures or degradation. * Lead investigation of complex system\-level issues spanning robots, wireless connectivity, network infrastructure, on\-premises compute, and application behavior. * Own the technical roadmap for the network subsystem as Mytra systems grow in physical scale, robot count, traffic volume, and deployment complexity. * Establish the standards, documentation, commissioning procedures, troubleshooting tools, and engineering practices that allow other teams to deploy, operate, and support the network effectively. **Ideal Candidates:** --------------------- * Have deep professional experience designing and deploying production network systems and the technical depth to independently own a networking subsystem from architecture through deployment and validation. * Have strong practical knowledge of Ethernet and IP networking, including switching, routing, VLANs, DHCP, DNS, QoS, redundancy, network segmentation, and network security. * Have strong practical knowledge of Wi\-Fi and RF fundamentals, including 802\.11 behavior, channel planning, interference, roaming, antenna characteristics, coverage, capacity, and spectrum analysis. * Have experience designing wireless networks for **mobile  e difficult network and wireless problems. * Are comfortable working directly with physical systems, including switches, access points, antennas, cabling, network cabinets, test equipment, robots, and deployed hardware. * Demonstrate strong systems thinking and can reason across networking, software, robotics, electrical, mechanical, and physical infrastructure boundaries. * Can take an ambiguous system\-level problem, establish the requirements, make appropriate engineering tradeoffs, and independently drive the solution through architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing ownership. * Operate effectively as a Staff\-level technical leader, establishing standards and technical direction for an area where the broader organization may not already have deep domain expertise. **Nice to have:** ----------------- * Experience designing Wi\-Fi networks for mobile robots, AGVs, AMRs, autonomous vehicles, or other continuously moving machines. * Experience with large industrial wireless deployments where metal structures, machinery, inventory, physical obstructions, reflections, and changing environmental conditions create challenging RF environments. * Experience with industrial Ethernet, industrial networking equipment, or networking systems designed for manufacturing and automation environments. * Experience building automated network configuration, Infrastructure as Code, configuration management, or zero\-touch provisioning systems. * Experience developing automated performance, qualification, regression, or acceptance testing for network systems. * Experience designing high\-availability networks where degraded network performance has direct operational consequences. * Experience with network security and segmentation for systems deployed into customer environments. * Experience partnering with electrical and mechanical engineers on integrated hardware systems, cabinets, enclosures, power, thermal, cabling, and serviceability. * Experience working directly with networking equipment vendors on product evaluation, technical issues, roadmap planning, component lifecycle, and obsolescence. **A Final Note:** ----------------- If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply — even if you don’t check every box. At Mytra, we build bots, but we hire humans. We value thoughtful challengers who communicate with clarity and respect, and we’re lifelong learners committed to getting better every day. We move fast, learn faster, and show up for each other under pressure. The best outcomes come from diverse perspectives working together to build something meaningful and built to last **Benefits Include:** --------------------- * Competitive compensation and equity grants at a high\-growth company backed by top\-tier VCs * Fully subsidized health coverage, including medical (baseline plans), dental, and vision for employees and dependents * 401(k) plans and employer\-subsidized life insurance * Fully subsidized lunch and snacks at HQ—we eat and share stories together at the “long” table * Generous PTO and company\-paid holidays, including one week over the winter break so everyone can recharge together * Voluntary pet insurance, Voluntary Life Insurance, Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity * Fully subsidized tax advisory services and education to help you understand your equity * Commuter benefits, including a up to $150 monthly commuter benefit * Lively, modern combined office and lab space where we rapidly iterate through design, build, and test phases * Fully equipped onsite gym and showers at headquarters **Pay Notice** -------------- Compensation for this position will be set based on the candidate's experience level and location. The posted salary band is applicable only to the San Francisco Bay Area and is subject to change. ***Pay Range for this position is:*** $210,000 – $230,000 ***This role requires on\-site presence at our Brisbane, CA headquarters, for close collaboration with the other teams.***

You’ll own application modules end to end, from technical definition through development, testing and release, working alongside back\-end, front\-end, mobile, QA, business analysis, architecture and IT teammates to turn client needs into secure, maintainable and scalable applications. You’ll deepen your .NET expertise, strengthen your understanding of modern delivery practices, and contribute to solutions running in highly visible, regulated client environments where reliability and security really matter. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Implement application modules based on provided specifications, and contribute to maintaining product quality through code reviews and self\-assessment. * Analyze and estimate small technical tasks, and perform updates and maintenance on existing code. * Support nontechnical staff in understanding straightforward client requirements, and help them see what is and is not feasible. * Develop, integrate and consume APIs, and build against relational databases with an eye on performance. * Build technical expertise through work experience and training, collaborating with senior team members to deliver reliable and efficient solutions. * Work within a multidisciplinary team made up of technical and nontechnical members. * Participate in solution brainstorming and help identify the best approach to delivering against client needs and requirements. * Support DevOps and deployment work, including GitLab repositories, merge requests, CI/CD pipelines and controlled production releases. * Write and maintain technical documentation, including solution specifications, API documentation, deployment procedures and code documentation that supports long\-term maintainability. * Assist with project estimation, planning and milestone tracking, providing accurate effort estimates so projects are delivered on time and within scope. * Research emerging technologies, AI\-assisted development techniques and industry trends, sharing what you learn and recommending improvements to our development practices. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- ### **30\-Day Expectations** * Learn the lottery business domain, product ecosystem and team processes. * Become comfortable with the development environment and team workflows * Deliver initial bug fixes or small enhancements while meeting coding and quality standards. ### **Six\-Month Expectations** * Independently deliver features and enhancements of moderate complexity. * Demonstrate a solid u lopment life cycle, from discovery and technical definition through design, development, testing, release and support * Familiarity with Agile delivery practices, including sprint planning, estimation, backlog refinement, demos, retrospectives and cross\-disciplinary collaboration * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools responsibly to accelerate research, prototyping, debugging, documentation or code quality improvements ### **Industry and Environment** * Experience in a marketing or digital agency, or in finance, lottery, gaming or consulting * Experience working in regulated, high\-visibility or transaction\-oriented digital environments where reliability, security and maintainability are important **ECOSYSTEMS TEAM VALUES** -------------------------- We believe technical excellence works best paired with strong human skills. In this role, you’ll succeed if you bring: * Adaptability and resilience across dynamic and fast\-paced projects * A growth mindset and self\-awareness that fuel continuous learning * Clear and empathetic communication with both technical and nontechnical teams * Organization and time management that help you lead yourself and support others * Creativity and innovation when tackling technical challenges * Strong analytical thinking and decision\-making capabilities * A collaborative spirit and willingness to educate and uplift others **Team Values** --------------- At Marcus Thomas, our values shape how we work with each other and with our clients. **Community** – We contribute to the growth of our agency, our industry and our communities. **Accountability** – We show up, keep our word, and take ownership of our work and results. **Collaboration** – We lead with empathy, listen actively and value every voice. **Curiosity** – We stay curious, ask questions and bring new ideas to the table. **Diversity** – We respect and celebrate different perspectives because they make the work stronger. **Make Work Play** – We bring energy, creativity and joy into everything we do.**Benefits Highlights** ----------------------- * **Time Off:** A flexible time\-off policy, with most employees taking approximately four to six weeks annually. * **Family Support:** Twelve weeks of fully paid parental leave. * **Health and Wellness:** Medical, dental and vision coverage, plus telemedicine, behavioral health resources. * **Lifestyle Support:** Wellness and creative stipends, phone plan support and partner discounts. * **Financial Benefits:** A 401(k) with company contributions, student loan repayment support and college savings options. * **Career paths:** Defined career paths for every department, so you can see how to progress and what it takes to get there **Our Hiring Process** ---------------------- Our process usually includes a recruiter conversation, a hiring manager interview, a team or leadership conversation, a timed technical assessment built around the skills this role uses, and a final decision. We may use AI\-assisted tools to help organize applications and, with your consent, transcribe interviews. You can opt out of either without affecting your candidacy, and AI never makes the hiring decision – our team does. If you need an accommodation at any point in the process, contact us at recruiting@mtllc.com . jobs.title: Information Technology Security Manager
jobs.description: **Information Technology Security Manager** **We are** PEAC Solutions—large enough to finance the globe, yet small enough to stand shoulder\-to\-shoulder with our customers. We believe in the power of partnership and the promise of possibility. Our purpose is to fuel growth by providing smart, flexible lending solutions that help businesses overcome obstacles and seize new opportunities. Backed by HPS Investment Partners, a leading global investment firm, we offer equipment financing, working capital, and inventory lending solutions that keep businesses moving forward. As the world’s largest independent equipment finance company, we are expanding our global footprint—and we are doing it with purpose, grit, and a commitment to those we serve. **You are** someone who thrives in an environment where ambition meets action. You bring curiosity, resilience, and a strong sense of accountability. You see challenges as opportunities and believe in making an impact for customers, for your team, and for the business. If you are looking to be a part of a company that values partnership over hierarchy and purpose over routine, your next chapter could start here. The **Information Technology Security Manager** leads PEAC Solutions’ cybersecurity program, combining strategic oversight with hands\-on technical expertise to configure and maintain security controls. This role develops security strategy, governance, policies, standards, and procedures; oversees security operations, risk management, incident response, compliance, and awareness initiatives; and partners with business leaders, auditors, and third\-party providers to align security priorities with business objectives. **Core Responsibilities** * **Strategy and Governance:** Develop and maintain the cybersecurity strategy, roadmap, policies, standards, and operating procedures. * **Security Operations and Threat Management:** Oversee protection across network, endpoint, cloud, identity, email, application, and data environments; monitor emerging threats and implement preventive and detective controls. * **Incident Response:** Lead triage, containment, remediation, recovery, root\-cause analysis, and corrective actions following cybersecurity incidents. * **Risk and Vulnerability Management:** Direct risk assessments, vulnerability reviews, penetration testing, control evaluations, and remediation tracking across internal systems, cloud services, and third parties. * **Compliance and Audit:** Coordinate security audits, compliance initiatives, and evidence collection to meet regulatory, contractual, and internal requirements. * **Security Architecture and Access:** Guide security design for systems, projects, integrations, and technology changes; govern authentication, privileged access, role\-based permissions, and access reviews. * **Security Awareness:** Deliver training and awareness programs that strengthen accountability and the organization’s security culture. * **Third\-Party Oversight:** Manage security vendors, auditors, and service providers to ensure effective performance and appropriate risk management. * **Metrics and Executive Reporting:** Develop cybersecurity and departmental KPIs covering risk exposure, control effectiveness, operational performance, incident trends, remediation, and program maturity. Present results to executive leadership with recommendations on priorities, improvements, and resource needs. **Required Skills** * Advanced knowledge of NIST, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, and zero\-trust principles. * Hands\-on experience securing Microsoft 365, Azure, hybrid infrastructure, and enterprise networks. * Working knowledge of Microsoft Defender ATP, Fortinet security technologies, and Cisco networking and security platforms. * Technical proficiency with firewalls, EDR/XDR, SIEM, multifactor authentication, email security, vulnerability management, encryption, and data loss prevention tools. * Expertise in identity and access management, privileged access controls, Active Directory, and Microsoft Entra ID. * Experience in incident response, forensic coordination, threat remediation, business recovery, and post\-incident improvement. * Ability to assess security risks, support audits, evaluate compliance, and develop policies and standards. * Strong leadership and communication skills, including the ability to translate technical risks into business impacts and practical recommendations. * Effective planning and prioritization skills to manage multiple initiatives, vendors, and competing demands. **Preferred Skills** * Experience with Cloudflare security, performance, and application protection services. * Familiarity with Cisco Umbrella or Cisco Secure Access, including secure web gateway, DNS\-layer security, and secure access service edge capabilities. * Knowledge of Microsoft Exchange and Exchange Online security, including threat protection, filtering, authentication, and mail\-flow controls. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional experience considered. * At least eight years of progressively responsible experience in cybersecurity, information security, or infrastructure security. * Hands\-on experience in cloud security, security operations, vulnerability management, incident response, and regulatory compliance or audit support. * Relevant certifications, such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate, or equivalent, strongly preferred. * Demonstrated ability to develop and strengthen cybersecurity programs that reduce risk and support long\-term business resilience. **Additional Information:** * This is a hybrid position, based in our Mt. Laurel, NJ office, three days a week, with two days remote. PEAC Solutions is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, disability, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, sexual orientation, age, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. The successful candidate will receive competitive compensation along with our benefit package which includes medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short and long\-term disability, 401(k) with match, flexible spending, and paid time off. PEAC provides one paid day off per year to support community involvement. Celebrate you by also having off your birthday on us!

jobs.title: Lead AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ A career with us means you’ll work alongside exceptional people and be empowered to reach your professional and personal goals. Our employees are at the foundation of what enables MassMutual to deliver on our purpose to help people secure their futures and protect the ones they love. We embrace the idea that we all are stronger and better through our support for one another. We strive to create a culture where employees feel valued and are celebrated for who they are. **Job Description** ------------------- **The Opportunity** MassMutual’s AI Platform Engineering team is seeking an impact\-driven AI Platform Engineer, to apply the AI platform where it matters most: improving how MassMutual builds and runs technology. Embedded directly with IT teams across the portfolio, you will diagnose where engineering and operational effort goes, design and hands\-on deliver AI\-enabled solutions across the full software development lifecycle, including cybersecurity, and prove the results with data. You will pair enterprise\-level strategy with deep implementation skill, turning what you learn in the field into reusable patterns and platform capabilities. **The Team** This is a unique opportunity to work on the team that builds and operates the platform powering MassMutual’s AI initiatives. The team operates at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, AI/ML systems, and developer experience—delivering foundational capabilities that shape how the entire organization builds and deploys AI. We partner closely with AI engineering, product, and cloud engineering teams across the enterprise, and we invest in growth through a culture of peer learning, candid feedback, and shared technical standards. This team is defined by a shared commitment to engineering excellence, clear documentation, and the kind of technical leadership that makes hard problems tractable. **The Impact** * Embed with IT portfolio teams and deliver outcomes hands\-on—work shoulder to shoulder with engineering and operations teams, moving quickly from discovery to working solution to production, in their real environments, toolchains, and constraints. * Apply the AI platform across the full SDLC—requirements and design, code generation and review, test automation, CI/CD, release, legacy modernization, and production support—to measurably improve build and run efficiency. * Build and ship the hard parts yourself—agentic workflows, integrations with existing engineering and operations toolchains, evaluation harnesses, and automation—then package successes into reusable accelerators, playbooks, and reference implementations other teams can adopt. * Embed security and responsible AI into every engagement—threat modeling for AI use cases, secure pipelines, access and secrets management, software supply chain integrity, audit logging, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. Translate governance and compliance requirements (e.g., NIST AI RMF, OWASP LLM Top 10\) into practical controls teams can adopt without slowing delivery. * Define the AI\-enabled engineering strategy for the IT portfolio—assess workflows across teams, prioritize opportunities by measurable value, and translate them into a sequenced roadmap with clear business cases. * Establish baselines and measure results—define build and run efficiency metrics (e.g., cycle time, deployment frequency, quality, toil, incident volume, time to resolve, and cost), track adoption and return, and report outcomes to senior IT leadership. * Serve as the senior technical escalation point for the most complex adoption and integration challenges across teams. Run design reviews, provide deep technical feedback, and pair with engineers on the gnarliest problems. * Close the loop with platform engineering—translate field learnings into prioritized capability requests, ADRs, and design input that improve the platform, without owning core platform build. * Drive adoption through influence—lead change with directors and engineering leaders across the portfolio, communicate technical trade\-offs clearly to technical and executive audiences, and represent the platform to senior stakeholders. * Raise the technical bar across the organizationby mentoring leads and senior engineers, running enablement and communities of practice, and setting the standard for AI\-assisted engineering—without managing anyone directly. **The Minimum Qualifications** * 12\+ years total experience in software engineering, DevOps/platform engineering, SRE, security engineering, or solutions engineering, including 5\+ years at lead, staff, or principal level with multi\-team or enterprise\-wide technical scope. * Proven record of delivering measurable build and run efficiency gains in large, complex IT environments—from strategy through hands\-on implementation. * Forward\-deployed or customer\-facing engineering experience: embedding with teams, running discovery, shaping ambiguous problems into working solutions, and driving ad ifics of the assistance you need. California residents: For detailed information about your rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), please visit our California Consumer Privacy Act Disclosures page. MassMutual will accept applications on an ongoing basis until such time as a candidate has been offered employment. The job description includes the main duties of this position, which may evolve over time. You may be required to perform other duties not listed. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. Salary Range: $172,000\-$225,700 **Award\-Winning Culture** -------------------------- MassMutual is guided by a single purpose: We help people secure their future and protect the ones they love. As a company operated for the benefit of our members and participating policyowners, we are defined by mutuality and our vision to provide financial well\-being for all Americans. It’s more than our company structure — it’s our way of life. We are a company of people protecting people. Our company exists because people are willing to share risk and resources and rely on each other when it counts. We strive to build a thriving community where everyone is valued, included, and feels that they belong. At MassMutual, we Live Mutual. **How We Work** --------------- MassMutual’s flexible workplace approach combines the importance of connecting in person and the flexibility of working remotely. Our hybrid model puts collaboration first with employees coming in at least three days per week to our spectacular campus settings and also enjoying the flexibility of remote Fridays, company\-wide remote weeks, and a bank of flexible remote weeks to use throughout the year. **Benefits for the whole you (and your loved ones)** ---------------------------------------------------- There’s more to your life than your job and there’s more to your aspirations than a paycheck. We take a holistic view of compensation and benefits that provides the flexibility to create a healthy balance in your life for work, family, and community. We offer the benefits you’d expect, like medical, dental, 401(k), and generous vacation time, but we also offer ones you might not expect, like three paid days for volunteering, a $1,250 annual Well\-Being Wallet, and up to 320 hours of caregiver leave. Explore some of our offerings below. ### **Paid Time Off** * In addition to generous vacation time, paid holidays, and flexible holidays, MassMutual offers 'take care' time to care for yourself or someone you love—whether for physical illness or mental health. ### **Health \& Well\-Being** In addition to top\-line medical and dental coverage, personalized mental health solutions, on\-site and virtual health coaching, and much more, MassMutual reimburses employees up to $1,250 per year for eligible expenses supporting mental, physical, and financial well\-being. ### **Financial Well\-Being** In addition to competitive salaries and bonuses, educational assistance programs, and much more, MassMutual offers up to a 10% total 401(k) benefit, consisting of a 5% company match and a 5% annual contribution. ### **Taking Care** MassMutual offers generous maternity and parental leaves, as well as bereavement leave to mourn the loss of a loved one (and the employee defines 'loved one'). In addition, we offer up to 320 hours of caregiver leave to help employees support loved ones in times of need. ### **Giving Back** MassMutual offers three paid days for employees to volunteer with eligible nonprofits of their choice, and the MassMutual Foundation matches employee donation dollars to eligible nonprofit organizations up to $5,000 annually. ### **Commuter Benefits** MassMutual offers a Qualified Commuter Program through which eligible employees can pay qualified workplace commuting expenses with before\-tax dollars, as well as a commuter wallet option for employees based at Boston and NYC campuses.

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description: ### **Help Us Build What's Next at Mathnasium** ***Applicants must be located in the Los Angeles metropolitan area.*** At Mathnasium, we believe every child has the ability to succeed in math—and we're passionate about helping them get there. Through our personalized approach to math learning, we help children build confidence, develop critical thinking skills, and discover what they're capable of. Behind that mission is a dedicated corporate team working to support our franchise network, strengthen our technology, and help Mathnasium continue to grow. We're looking for a Software Developer who wants to be part of that work. If you enjoy solving problems, building useful solutions, exploring new technologies, and seeing your work make a real impact, this could be a great next step in your career. ### **The Opportunity** As a Software Developer at Mathnasium, you'll join a collaborative, hands\-on engineering team where your contributions matter. You'll work on applications and services that support our business, deliver meaningful improvements to our users, and help shape how our technology evolves. Our team works across a mature C\# and ASP.NET Framework application and newer TypeScript services. We're looking for someone with a solid foundation in software development who is ready to take the next step: owning meaningful work, growing their technical capabilities, and becoming more independent over time. You'll have support from an experienced team, opportunities to contribute ideas, and room to expand your responsibilities as your skills develop. You don't need to know everything on day one. If you're strong in .NET and excited to learn more about AWS serverless development, automation, and AI\-powered tools, we're ready to help you grow. ### **What You'll Work On** * Build Features That Matter: Develop and enhance applications that support Mathnasium's business operations and customer needs using C\#, ASP.NET MVC, Web API, and serverless TypeScript services. * Help Modernize Our Technology: Improve existing applications, reduce technical debt, and move functionality into modern services where it makes sense. * Make Releases Faster and Smarter: Help evolve our software delivery process from monthly releases to two\-week releases and, ultimately, continuous deployment using GitHub Actions and related tools. * Explore Cloud Development: Build and support services using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and other cloud technologies as you develop your serverless skills. * Automate and Improve Quality: Write automated tests, expand test coverage, and identify opportunities to eliminate repetitive work through better tooling and automation. * Work With Data: Build and maintain functionality that interacts with Microsoft SQL Server, Aurora SQL, and DynamoDB. * Explore What's Next in AI: Help evaluate emerging AI tools and experiment with AI\-powered features and agentic workflows that could improve how we build software and support our business. * Keep Our Applications Running Well: Help troubleshoot production issues, improve monitoring and alerting, and address root causes to keep our systems reliable. * Learn and Collaborate: Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and documentation while sharing ideas and learning from teammates. ### **What We're Looking For** We're looking for a developer who brings technical fundamentals, curiosity, and a willingness to take ownership. You should be comfortable contributing independently while knowing when to ask questions, collaborate, and learn from others. Required Qualifications * 3\+ years of professional software development experience. * Strong experience with C\#, ASP.NET MVC or Web API, and object\-oriented programming principles. * Experience with TypeScript or modern JavaScript, including Node.js, along with HTML and CSS. * Solid SQL skills and experience working with Microsoft SQL Server. * Hands\-on experience with AWS or another cloud platform. * Experience working in an Agile development environment with Git/GitHub, code reviews, and automated testing. * Strong problem\-solving skills, clear communication, and the ability to manage assigned work independently. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Skills We'd Love to See You don't need to check every box. We're interested in your foundation, your curiosity, and your ability to learn. * Experience with AWS serverless technologies, including Lambda, API Gateway, and DynamoDB. * Familiarity with infrastructure as code using Terraform and/or the Serverless Framework. * Experience with Aurora SQL. * Exposure to Amazon S3, Redis, or Valkey. * Experience designing REST APIs with Express, NestJS, or similar frameworks. * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, particularly GitHub Actions, as well as Docker and monitoring tools such as Amazon CloudWatch. * Experience with LLM APIs, agent frameworks, or AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or . Our approach to AI\-assisted development and agentic workflows is still evolving, and you'll have an opportunity to help evaluate tools, share ideas, and influence how we incorporate these capabilities into our engineering practices. We're looking for someone who is eager to keep learning, comfortable with change, and excited to grow into greater technical ownership over time. ### **Our Technology Environment** Our engineering team works across established applications and evolving cloud\-based services, including: * Application Development: C\#, ASP.NET Framework, MVC, Web API, Node.js, and TypeScript * Cloud \& Serverless: AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Aurora SQL, and Amazon S3 * Data: Microsoft SQL Server and cloud\-based databases * Development \& Delivery: GitHub, GitHub Actions, automated testing, Terraform, and the Serverless Framework * Emerging Technology: AI coding assistants, LLM integrations, and agentic workflows You won't be expected to master every technology before joining us. We value a strong technical foundation, adaptability, and the ability to learn new tools as our environment evolves. ### **Where You'll Work** This is a hybrid position based at Mathnasium's corporate headquarters in the Los Angeles metropolitan area. * Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday: Work onsite with the team at our headquarters. * Tuesday and Friday: Work from home. We're looking for someone located in the Los Angeles metro area who can regularly collaborate with the team in person and participate in our hybrid work schedule. Why Mathnasium? Mathnasium is more than a network of learning centers. We're a team committed to helping children build confidence in math and develop skills that can serve them throughout their lives. At our corporate headquarters, every department plays a part in supporting that mission. As a Software Developer, your work will help strengthen the systems, tools, and technology that support our business and franchise network. You'll join a collaborative environment where your ideas matter, your contributions reach real users, and you can continue developing your skills while helping build what's next. If you're ready to take ownership, solve meaningful problems, and grow alongside a supportive team, we'd love to hear from you. The Mathnasium Mission Teach children math so they understand it, master it, and love it. Math can change their lives, and they can change the world. Mathnasium makes math make sense, building children's confidence and a deep understanding and lifelong love of mathematics. With more than 1,000 locations on four continents, our franchised and company\-owned learning centers provide tutoring from pre\-K through high school. The Mathnasium Method increases a child's math competency and improves their lives by opening the doors to higher education, greater career opportunities, and a better future. It is in that sense that we aim to change the world ... one child at a time. Our teaching method, the Mathnasium Method, is the life’s work of Larry Martinek, Mathnasium’s Chief Instructional Officer and a teacher and math teaching consultant in the Los Angeles area for more than 35 years. The Mathnasium Method uses a time\-tested, customized program which stems from a unique assessment to identify what students need to improve their math skills. We offer personalized instruction, proprietary worksheets, and games to build Number Sense and provide a fun and supportive environment in which children can learn and practice math. Pay: $100000\.00 \- $110000\.00 / year Pay: * Bonus pay Benefits: * Flexible schedule * Paid time off * Health insurance * Vision insurance * Life insurance * Disability insurance * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Referral program * Employee discount Job Type: fulltime Schedule: * Monday to Friday * On call Education: Bachelor's degree Work location: Flexible work from home options available Mathnasium HQ \- Los Angeles, CA. 5120 Goldleaf Cir, Suite 400, Los Angeles, CA, 90056

jobs.title: Staff Software Integration Engineer
jobs.description: **Merlin (NASDAQ: MRLN)** is a publicly traded aerospace and defense company building a non\-human pilot to deliver full\-stack autonomy for any aircraft from takeoff to touchdown. The Merlin Pilot autonomy system powers a growing range of aircraft and mission profiles and has been proven through hundreds of autonomous flights from Merlin's global flight test facilities, including Kerikeri, New Zealand; Smithfield, Rhode Island; and soon, Bedford, Massachusetts. Headquartered in Boston, Merlin is expanding its organization to accelerate the development and deployment of its autonomy platform, helping customers solve some of aviation's most pressing challenges, from pilot shortages to improving flight safety. Backed by some of the world's leading investors prior to its public listing, Merlin continues to advance the certification and commercialization of autonomous flight across commercial and defense aviation. ### **About You:** You are a hands\-on systems software engineer who takes ownership of complex software and hardware integration efforts, from architecture through deployment and operation. You write disciplined, maintainable code and troubleshoot methodically across real\-time applications, Linux hosts, networks, and physical equipment. You work independently, collaborate across engineering disciplines, and help other engineers build on what you deliver. As part of Merlin’s Virtual Test Environments (VTE) team, you will own software connecting aircraft avionics, hardware\-in\-the\-loop test environments, simulation models, and flight\-test data systems. Your work will enable engineers to exercise aircraft systems before flight, observe their behavior, and capture and replay data to investigate issues. ### **Responsibilities:** * Own the architecture, development, and sustainment of real\-time I/O software and telemetry infrastructure supporting aircraft integration benches and simulation environments. * Develop modern C\+\+ software on embedded Linux targets to interface with avionics hardware, manage periodic execution and watchdogs, and integrate generated aircraft simulation models. * Develop and maintain hardware abstraction layers using UEI PowerDNA equipment, vendor SDKs, low\-level I/O APIs, and device drivers. * Integrate ARINC 429, CAN, serial, and discrete I/O using aircraft interface control documents; validate message encoding, signal mapping, update rates, and error handling. * Develop and maintain asynchronous Rust services that ingest multiple telemetry sources, synchronize and order samples, and stream data to flight\-test displays and recording systems. * Implement robust binary protocols and network interfaces using UDP, TCP, and messaging technologies such as ZeroMQ, accounting for packet loss, ordering, buffering, and client liveness. * Build capabilities for timestamp alignment, session recording, data retrieval, and simulation replay that make integration issues reproducible. * Maintain cross\-compilation, packaging, and deployment workflows for ARM Linux targets and Linux hosts, including Yocto SDKs, CMake, Debian packages, systemd, Docker, and Docker Compose. * Establish automated verification through unit tests, hardware integration tests, parser fuzzing, and Python\-based smoke tests and tooling. * Partner with avionics, aircraft software, flight dynamics, and flight test engineers to reproduce aircraft integration conditions in the lab and resolve issues across software and hardware boundaries. ### **Qualifications:** * Strong proficiency in modern C\+\+, including resource management, concurrency, error handling, and maintainable systems software design. * Experience developing timing\-sensitive software on Linux, including fixed\-period execution, watchdogs, thread synchronization, and reliable startup and shutdown. * Deep familiarity with Linux host and embedded systems, including services, permissions, networking, software builds, deployment, and system\-level diagnostics. * Experience integrating avionics or comparable hardware interfaces, including ARINC 429, and the ability to interpret and implement interface control documents. * Experience developing binary serializers and parsers, with attention to byte order, framing, validation, malformed inputs, and protocol compatibility. * Strong understanding of UDP/TCP networking and asynchronous data pipelines, including buffering, packet loss, ordering, backpressure, and connection management. * Experience with embedded Linux cross\-compilation and deployment using vendor SDKs and build systems such as CMake. * Proficiency in Python for engineering tools, test automation, and data\-processing workflows. * Experience developing Rust services, or substantial experience with asynchronous systems programming and the ability to become productive in Rust. * Experience with automated testing, continuous integration, Git\-based version control and code review, and Jira or comparable issue tracking. * Demonstrated ability to own  ur Boston lab to integrate and troubleshoot equipment. ### **Nice to Have:** * Direct experience with UEI PowerDNA/PDNA SDKs or comparable data acquisition and avionics interface platforms from vendors such as NI or Ballard. * Experience with async Rust using Tokio, channels, serde, and axum. * Familiarity with ARINC 429 labels, SDI/SSM fields, CAN messaging, MIL\-STD\-1553, and RS\-232/RS\-422 serial communications. * Experience with IRIG time, NTP, clock alignment, and timestamp\-ordered merging of asynchronous data sources. * Experience with Curtiss\-Wright IADS or similar flight\-test telemetry, ground\-station, or engineering data\-display systems. * Experience with Yocto SDKs, ARM targets, Debian packaging, systemd services, and Linux device\-driver development or troubleshooting. * Familiarity with flight dynamics and integrating generated six\-degree\-of\-freedom aircraft models into real\-time execution environments. * Experience with GoogleTest, pytest, parser fuzzing, and CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions, including self\-hosted runners. * Experience with Docker\-based deployment on lab or edge systems, S3 data storage, and automated simulation replay workflows. * Experience with REST APIs, JSON schema validation, Cap’n Proto, SQL, or diagnostic interfaces using GL Studio, React, or HTML5\. * Aviation experience through professional work, flight simulation, or a pilot’s license. The compensation range provided is reflective of **base salary only**, and is a good\-faith estimate based on a wide range of factors. The actual offer will be determined by a variety of factors including the candidate's qualifications, skills, experience, education, and training. Highly competitive equity grants are considered part of Merlin's total compensation package. Additionally, Merlin offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees. This position is based on\-site at Merlin HQ in Boston, MA. Once you’re here, you’ll enjoy a variety of on\-site perks designed to make your workday enjoyable and convenient. These include catered lunches featuring a rotating menu of delicious options, an assortment of snacks to keep you fueled throughout the day, and a selection of beverages, including coffee, tea, and other drinks, to keep you refreshed. Our goal is to create an environment where you can thrive both professionally and personally. Merlin Labs offers an innovative, entrepreneurial, and team\-focused startup environment. We also offer a top\-notch benefits package (health, dental, life, flexible paid time off, and 401k with match) and work/life integration. Being part of the Merlin team allows you to become part of a small team that supports professional development while working together to achieve our mission. Merlin Labs is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, genetic information, sex (including pregnancy), gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military service or obligation or disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. All job offers are contingent upon the candidate passing background and reference checks. At this time, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or consider candidates who require visa transfers. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing an application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to: people@merlinlabs.com Merlin Labs does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from candidates.
