jobs.title: Principal DFIR & Threat Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description: **Join the Team Modernizing Medicine** At **ModMed**, we’re not just building software—we’re reimagining the healthcare experience. Founded in 2010 by a practicing physician and a successful tech entrepreneur, we took a radically different approach: **we hired doctors and taught them how to code.** This "for doctors, by doctors" philosophy has allowed us to create an AI\-enabled, specialty\-specific cloud platform that places patients at the center of care. **A Culture of Excellence** When you join ModMed, you’re joining an award\-winning team recognized for innovation and employee satisfaction. From our global headquarters in Boca Raton Florida, and extensive employee base in Hyderabad India, we are a team of 4,500\+ passionate problem\-solvers on a mission to increase medical practice success and improve patient outcomes: * **Consistently ranked as a Top Place to Work** * **2025 Globee Business Awards:** Gold Globee for “Technology Team of the Year” * **2025 Black Book Awards:** Ranked \#1 EHR in 11 Specialties * **Florida Venture Forum:** Venture\-Backed Company of the Year We are growing fast, thinking big, and we are just getting started. **Ready to modernize medicine with us?** **Job Description Summary:** The **Principal, DFIR \& Threat Intelligence Analyst** serves as the final technical authority and technical lead for an end\-to\-end cyber defense function that unifies Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI), AI\-augmented SOC monitoring, Incident Response (IR), Digital Forensics, and Malware Analysis into a single operational pipeline. Operating with an AI\-first mindset, this position provides dedicated, hands\-on\-keyboard coverage from Thursday through Sunday, closing the weekend dwell\-time gap and independently owning High and Critical security incidents end to end. As the sole hands\-on DFIR responder during weekend shifts, you will command incidents, execute machine\-speed containment, conduct deep\-dive memory and cloud forensics, drive root\-cause remediation, and author regulatory breach\-determination recommendations. While carrying no direct reports, this terminal individual contributor role holds technical authority across the enterprise, setting detection and hunting methodologies, mentoring the broader security operations team, and briefing executive leadership. **Schedule: Thursday to Sunday; 9am to 5pm EST in Boca Raton, FL** **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **1\. Incident Command, Digital Forensics \& Malware Analysis (25%)** * Direct end\-to\-end incident containment, host isolation, and post\-incident root\-cause analysis during High and Critical security events as Incident Commander. * Serve as the sole weekend hands\-on responder, independently owning incidents from initial detection through forensic reconstruction and post\-mortem delivery. * Execute real\-time host isolation via CrowdStrike Real Time Response (RTR) and extract forensic artifacts across volatile memory, storage volumes (EBS, EFS, FSx, S3\), container workloads (AWS EKS, ECS, Fargate), and application logs (Apache Tomcat, CI/CD, Databricks). * Utilize forensic suites—including CrowdStrike Falcon Forensics, KAPE, Volatility, FTK Imager, and Velociraptor—to perform memory analysis and disk triage. * Perform malware triage, dynamic/static reverse engineering, sandbox detonation, deobfuscation, and C2 extraction, translating findings into defensive YARA signatures. * Enforce strict evidentiary chain\-of\-custody protocols and author legally defensible forensic investigation reports adhering to regulatory standards. **2\. AI\-First Automation, Detection Engineering \& Log Architecture (20%)** * Author, tune, and operationalize multi\-source correlation rules and custom Falcon Indicators of Attack (IOAs) using detection\-as\-code methodologies with version control and CI/CD testing. * Write complex query logic across CrowdStrike Query Language (CQL), Falcon Query Language (FQL), Kusto Query Language (KQL), and SQL/Athena against AWS Security Lake (OCSF/Parquet format). * Ingest, transform, and optimize high\-volume security telemetry using Cribl Stream and Axonius (CAASM) pipelines. * Build and maintain automated orchestration workflows using Tines SOAR, CrowdStrike Fusion SOAR, serverless Python tools, and multi\-agent AI investigation platforms (custom agents, prompts, and skills) to accelerate analyst triage. * Map detection coverage systematically against MITRE ATT\&CK and MITRE D3FEND frameworks to run gap analyses and harden defenses. **3\. Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI), Hunting \& Threat Surface Defense (20%)** * Execute the complete intelligence lifecycle against Priority Intelligence Requirements (PIRs)—collection, processing, analysis, dissemination, and feedback—using structured analytic techniques (Diamond Model, Cyber Kill Chain, Analysis of Competing Hypotheses). * Design and conduct hypothesis\-driven, TTP\-based threat hunts evaluated against the Hunting Maturity Model to uncover advance S, EFS, FSx, S3\), and container investigations under HIPAA, PCI DSS, SOC 2, or HITRUST standards. * **Cloud \& Identity Mastery:** Deep experience analyzing telemetry across large AWS organizations (100\+ accounts), containerized environments (EKS), CI/CD pipelines, and enterprise identity architectures (Okta, Active Directory, Duo). * **Automation \& Engineering:** Proficient in engineering detection logic and queries in CQL, FQL, KQL, and SQL (Athena/OCSF), with scripting/automation capability in Python, PowerShell, or Bash. * **Threat Surface Defense:** Proven experience designing hypothesis\-driven threat hunts, directing Digital Risk Protection (secret leak tracking, domain takedowns), deploying deception networks (Thinkst Canary), and operationalizing CTI (Health\-ISAC, CISA KEV). * **Schedule Requirement:** Ability and willingness to work a dedicated weekend schedule (Thursday through Sunday) as the primary DFIR responder. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or related technical field. * Industry certifications: + **Core DFIR:** GIAC Certified Forensic Analyst (GCFA), GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH). + **Cloud \& Governance:** AWS Certified Security \- Specialty, GIAC Cloud Security Automation (GCSA), CCSP, CISSP. + **AI \& Automation:** GIAC AI Security Automation Engineer (GASAE), GIAC Machine Learning Engineer (GMLE). + **CrowdStrike:** CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Hunter (CCFH), Falcon Responder (CCFR), or Falcon Administrator (CCFA). * Experience administering Tines SOAR, CrowdStrike Fusion SOAR, Cribl Stream, or building agentic LLM investigation workflows. * Direct experience handling regulatory breach risk evaluations (HIPAA 4\-factor assessments, PFI investigations) in a healthcare technology or SaaS environment. ***ModMed Benefits Highlight:*** At ModMed, we jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Atlas Clusters Security
jobs.description: MongoDB is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join the Atlas Clusters Organization. The organization is responsible for building MongoDB Atlas, our database as a service offering and fastest growing product. Atlas allows users to deploy fault\-tolerant, secure, globally distributed MongoDB clusters in just minutes. This includes developing software to interface with the three major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, and GCP) in order to bring security, durability, availability, and performance to all deployments of MongoDB. Atlas Clusters Security builds the security experience that Atlas customers depend on for mission\-critical applications. Across the organization we own cluster networking, data encryption, database authentication, and related controls. This role sits on the Encryption \& Compliance team. We own Encryption at Rest with customer\-managed keys (Bring Your Own Key) across AWS, Azure, and GCP, including private networking to customer key management systems. We also own the security and compliance work that lets Atlas serve highly regulated markets, including government offerings and internal credential management. You will design and operate these systems in production, lead fleet\-wide rollouts, and partner with customers when encryption or key\-management issues hit their clusters. This role can be based remotely within the U.S. in the Pacific, Mountain, or Central time zones only. ### **What you'll do** * Build and design new features for MongoDB Atlas * Contribute to and lead complex technical projects * Work closely with product and design teams, considering the user's perspective while building technical solutions * Work with customers and support engineers to fix issues * Collaborate with team members to develop our codebase, best practices, and design principles * Learn from and mentor other team members * Join an on\-call rotation to support Atlas' production services ### **We're looking for someone who** * Has at least 5 years of professional software development experience * Is skilled at writing large\-scale, distributed backend systems in a compiled language (Java, Go, etc.) * Has experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP) * Has led the launch of a new feature and maintained it in production * Is eager to solve tough problems * Has excellent communication skills * Is curious, collaborative, and motivated * Nice to have: experience with cloud key management (KMS / Key Vault / Cloud KMS), IAM, private networking, or encryption in a production SaaS environment ### **Success Measures** * In 3 months, you'll have shipped code into production and collaborated with the team to solve tough problems * In 6 months, you'll have contributed to a large project and joined our on\-call rotation * In 12 months, you'll have designed new features, led development work, and become a go\-to expert on Encryption at Rest, customer\-managed keys, or a related part of the system ### **About MongoDB** MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud\-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi\-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI\-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software. Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB. To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world! jobs.title: AI Computational Engineer
jobs.description: **City/State:** Yonkers, New York **Grant Funded:** No **Department:** IT \- Data \& Analytics Health Research Informatics **Work Shift:** Day **Work Days:** MON\-FRI **Scheduled Hours:** 8:30 AM\-5 PM **Scheduled Daily Hours:** 7\.5 HOURS **Pay Range:** $124,000\.00\-$155,000\.00 **The AI Computational Engineer will work on the operational development of Health Research Informatics at Montefiore Einstein, building dependable data and AI capabilities that help investigators move from a research question to governed data access, cohort discovery, study feasibility, analysis, and reproducible results. The role combines hands on computer science research with implementation of reusable services. This individual may focus on different data types or methods while sharing responsibility for rigorous evaluation, documentation, and investigator support.**  **Key Responsibilities:** ========================= * Develop and maintain research data pipelines that integrate clinical records, text, imaging, and other approved data sources. Document data definitions, quality checks, metadata, lineage, and transformations to support FAIR aligned reuse. * Help implement standardized, governed data access workflows and reusable tools for cohort discovery, phenotyping, trial feasibility, recruitment planning, and research analytics. Translate investigator needs into scoped requirements and track delivery. * Develop, benchmark, and validate AI methods, including information extraction, multimodal models, large or vision language models, and interpretable or knowledge informed approaches when suitable for the use case. * Turn validated methods into maintainable research services and interfaces, with version control, automated tests, monitoring, user documentation, and clear handoff to authorized operational partners. * Set evaluation plans with investigators and clinical experts, including baselines, validation splits, human review, error analysis, reproducibility checks, and assessment of subgroup performance and potential bias. * Work with ICTR, the Data Science Institute, and Montefiore data, IT, security, privacy, and oversight partners to implement approved access and governance requirements. Prepare technical evidence for review and escalate higher risk use cases through established channels. * Support investigators through consultations, demonstrations, training materials, and reusable examples; contribute technical content to publications, grants, and multi\-site research collaborations. Track service measures such as request turnaround, cohort or feasibility output quality, reuse of methods, model performance, and investigator feedback; report progress and operational issues to the CRIO. * ### **Qualifications:** **Required:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, data science, or a closely related quantitative field, plus substantive experience building machine learning or data intensive software; a master’s degree may provide that experience. * Strong Python programming skills and practical experience with a modern machine learning framework such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. * Demonstrated ability to prepare complex datasets, run controlled experiments, assess model performance, and communicate limitations clearly. * Experience using Git and working collaboratively on documented, maintainable software or research pipelines. * Ability to translate needs across technical and nontechnical colleagues, prioritize practical work, and learn biomedical and research operations concepts **Preferred:** * Master’s degree or equivalent research or industry experience in AI, computer science, biomedical informatics, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * Experience in one or more of the following: medical imaging; clinical NLP or information extraction; large language or vision language models; multimodal learning; clinical or other sensitive research data. * Experience with GPU or high\-performance computing, reproducible model training and inference, containers, SQL, APIs, or research data platforms. * Familiarity with clinical research workflows, FAIR data practices, common data models, biomedical ontologies, data provenance, human review, or responsible AI assessment. Evidence of research communication and user focused delivery through publications, presentations, open\-source work, training, or documented deployed projects. * Montefiore Health System, Inc. is an equal employment opportunity employer. Montefiore Health System, Inc. will recruit, hire, train, transfer, promote, layoff and discharge associates in all job classifications without regard to their race, color, religion, creed, national origin, alienage or citizenship status, age, gender, actual or presumed disability, history of disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic predisposition or carrier status, pregnancy, military status, marital status, or partnership status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Team Lead - Perception Platforms
jobs.description: **Mission Summary:** On our Perception team, you have the opportunity to work with world\-class ML engineers and research scientists to make self\-driving vehicles a reality. The Perception Platform team is central to this mission, operating at the intersection of ML Infrastructure and Perception. We build the foundational frameworks, evaluation pipelines, and tooling that enable our Perception team to scale their work on the tech stack responsible for perceiving the dynamic world around our robo\-taxi. These foundational systems include our large\-scale data pipelines, which are critical for efficient end\-to\-end ML development (e.g. data transformation, model training, and model evaluation) of our on\-car and off\-car Perception solutions. It also includes our evaluation and visualization tools, which provide intuitive insights into dataset distributions, model behavior, system performance, and edge\-case scenarios. Finally, our active learning loop which continuously selects and incorporates high\-value data to improve model accuracy and robustness over time. **What you'll be doing:** * Build, lead and manage a high\-performing team in the creation, maintenance, and optimization of our internal data, training, and evaluation pipelines specific to perception modelling team. * Provide technical guidance, mentorship, and career development opportunities to team members * Define team goals, priorities, and roadmap in alignment with company objectives * Work closely with ML engineers to proactively identify and resolve technical challenges , while also contributing directly to the implementation of those improvements. This includes troubleshooting and optimizing machine learning workflows for maximum efficiency and performance, architecting and executing cutting\-edge technologies/methodologies for accelerating ML development end\-to\-end from concept to deployment \& maintenance. * Lead design and code reviews, setting a high bar for quality and ensuring the adoption of best practices. * Foster cross\-functional collaboration ensuring alignment with broader organizational goals. **What We're Looking for:** * 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 3\+ years in a formal or informal leadership or mentorship role. * 2\+ years of experience developing, operating, or supporting distributed machine learning training across clusters of GPU nodes. * BS or MS in Computer Science or a related technical field. * A passion for remaining hands\-on and a proven ability to contribute high\-quality, production\-level code to a shared codebase. * Fluency in Python and familiarity with data processing libraries (e.g., NumPy, Pandas) * Proven experience in backend development and leading the architecture of complex systems. * A deep understanding of ML or Perception topics to strategically guide pipelines/tooling. * Demonstrated experience in designing and delivering data visualization tools or internal engineering dashboards that drive insights and action. * Expert knowledge of software engineering principles, with a track record of leading teams in software design, source control management, build processes, code reviews, and testing methods. * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate a technical vision and motivate a team **Bonus Points:** * Expertise in concurrency, parallel processing, and database systems to inform architectural decisions. * Experience with distributed computing frameworks like K8s and Ray. * A proven track record of developing and deploying Perception systems for autonomous vehicles or robotics. * A Ph.D. in a relevant field, or equivalent industry experience that demonstrates a commitment to continuous learning. * Proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+14/17 or later) * Experience with building products with current LLMs and MCP protocols. * Experience with GPU\-accelerated data processing. * Familiarity with Pytorch, TensorFlow or other modern ML development platform * Experience in project management and a history of successfully delivering complex technical projects. \#LI\-BP1 **Motional is a driverless technology company making autonomous vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. We're driven by something more.** **Our journey is always people first.** We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places to live, work, and connect. Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move. **Higher purpose, greater impact.** We're creating first\-of\-its\-kind technology that will transform transportation. To do so successfully, we must design for everyone in our cities and on our roads. We believe in building a great place to work through a progressive, global culture that is diverse, inclusive, and ensures people feel valued at every level of the organization. Diversity helps us to see the world differently; it's not only good for our business, it's the right thing to do. **Scale up, not starting up.** Our team is behind some of the industry's largest leaps forward, including the first fully\-autonomous cross\-country drive in the U.S, the launch of the world's first robotaxi pilot, and operation of the world's longest\-standing public robotaxi fleet. We're driven to scale; we're moving towards commercialization of our technology, and we need team members who are ready to embrace change and challenges. Formed as a joint venture between Hyundai Motor Group and Aptiv, Motional is fundamentally changing how people move through their lives. Headquartered in Boston, Motional has operations in the U.S and Asia. For more information, visit www.Motional.com and follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube. *Motional AD Inc. is an EOE. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. To comply with Federal Law, we participate in E\-Verify. All newly\-hired employees are queried through this electronic system established by the DHS and the SSA to verify their identity and employment eligibility.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Cloud Engineering
jobs.description: **Why Mozilla?** Mozilla Corporation is the non\-profit\-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy\-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non\-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute **open\-source** software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. **About this role:** Mozilla’s Cloud Engineering team seeks a Senior Software Engineer to mature, maintain, and build features for our Internal Developer Infrastructure Platform. You will work on creating standardized, scalable systems for CI/CD, Observability, Kubernetes optimization, environment bootstrapping, cost optimization, and more. Supporting the Infrastructure needs of the organization and identifying new opportunities to mature the path to production in a safe, cost effective way will also be an integral part of this role. **What you’ll do:** * Support infrastructure that development teams use to own and operate their services at Mozilla. * Guide technical decision\-making and adoption of user\-centric solutions. * Create Claude skills and design agentic workflows that improve developer productivity * Guide team members and promote engineering standard methodologies, with a focus on usability and maintainability. * Facilitate cross\-functional collaboration for efficient and cohesive platform delivery. * Write proposals and decision briefs for new policies, processes, and platform functionality. * Create new features for the platform with a meaningful value proposition * Be trusted to resolve unclear but urgent tasks. **What you’ll bring:** * 5\+ years experience in software engineering with expertise in at least one of (Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, SRE, DevOps) * Proven technical leadership experience. * Expertise in several of the following (ArgoCD, Grafana, K8s, GitHub, Terraform, Helm, Backstage, Cloud Cost Optimization) * Proficient in Python, JavaScript, or Go. * Strong expertise in cloud\-native technologies (GCP preferred; AWS also acceptable). * Excellent communication skills aligning technology with user needs and organizational goals. * Self\-starter who thrives in ambiguity. * Curiosity and interest in learning new things * Commitment to our values: * + Welcoming differences + Being relationship\-minded + Practicing responsible participation + Having grit **Bonus points for…** * Experience with distributed systems architecture and design * Knowledge of cloud security and governance principles * Experience designing agentic workflows * Database expertise * Experience building Internal Developer Platforms **What you’ll get:** * Generous performance\-based bonus plans to all regular employees \- we share in our success as one team * Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage * Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute) * Quarterly all\-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together * Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday * One\-time home office stipend * Annual professional development budget * Quarterly well\-being stipend * Considerable paid parental leave * Employee referral bonus program * Other benefits (life/AD\&D, disability, EAP, etc. \- varies by country) **About Mozilla** Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online. **Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging** Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer II
jobs.description: **Job Details** =============== New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL. You’ll work closely with ML engineers, backend engineers, and Forward Deployed Engineers to define what “good” looks like for an agent operating in high\-stakes industrial settings, then build and run the systems and processes that measure it continuously. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **Automation and Infrastructure** * Design, build, and maintain test frameworks, evaluation harnesses, and regression suites for LLM\-based agents, covering reasoning quality, tool\-call correctness, task completion, and multi\-turn coherence. * Build automated pipelines that run evals and systems and tool APIs so agents can be tested safely, repeatably, and at scale. * Implement API, contract, integration, and end\-to\-end tests for the services, tools, and orchestration layers that quality bars, release criteria, and sign\-off processes for new agent capabilities, blending automated gates with manual verification. * Decide what to automate and what to keep manual, and continually shift repeatable manual work into automation. * Mentor engineers on testing strategies and test\-driven practices for probabilistic, LLM\-driven systems. * Advocate for testability, observability, and tracing in agent architecture from day one. **Qualifications** ================== * 5\+ years as an SDET, QA engineer, or software engineer with a strong testing focus, with demonstrated ownership of test strategy and automation for complex distributed systems. * Proven experience in both manual and automated testing, including exploratory testing, test planning, and writing high\-quality bug reports. * Strong programming skills (Python preferred) with a software engineering mindset: clean, maintainable, well\-reviewed code for frameworks, data pipelines, and tooling. * Experience building test frameworks and infrastructure from the ground up, not just writing test cases within an existing framework. * Hands\-on experience with CI/CD systems (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) and containerized test environments (Docker, Kubernetes). * Experience testing APIs and microservices, including contract, integration, and end\-to\-end testing. * Hands\-on experience testing LLM\-based products, chatbots, or AI agents, and an understanding of why traditional deterministic assertions break down for generative systems. * Practical experience with eval frameworks or tooling (e.g., promptfoo, DeepEval, RAGAS, LangSmith) or a track record of building your own. * Understanding of how LLM agents work: prompting, tool/function calling, context management, RAG, memory, and orchestration frameworks. * Experience designing test data and labeled datasets, including sourcing, sampling, and managing dataset drift over time. * Familiarity with LLM\-specific failure modes: hallucination, prompt injection, context poisoning, tool misuse, goal drift, and non\-determinism. * Comfort operating in ambiguity, defining what “correct” means for a **Preferred** ============= * Experience with human\-in\-the\-loop evaluation workflows (labeling pipelines, inter\-rater reliability, rubric design). * Experience with performance and load testing tools (e.g., k6, Locust) and chaos or fault\-injection testing. * Background in ML/data science sufficient to read model evals and statistical significance. * Experience red\-teaming or doing adversarial/security testing on ML systems. * Familiarity with observability and tracing tools for LLM applications (e.g., LangSmith, Arize, Langfuse, Weights \& Biases) and general observability jobs.title: Director, Forward Deployed Engineering - Open Models
jobs.description: Do you want to help the world build custom AI at scale? We’re hiring a founding Director to build and lead NVIDIA’s Forward Deployed Engineering organization for open models, including NVIDIA Nemotron and NVIDIA Cosmos, across North America. The mission is to turn open models into production\-ready AI tuned to a specific domain, delivered through our partner ecosystem. We want any organization to build, own, and run its own AI on open source models, and this organization helps the ecosystem get there! Unlike most forward deployed organizations, ours works primarily through NVIDIA’s partner ecosystem. Our FDEs work side by side with top partner engineering and research teams, co\-lead joint customer engagements, and build the recipes and playbooks that help partners succeed and scale. This leader sets the strategy for North America, builds the organization, and carries the vision to partners, customers, and NVIDIA leadership. Are you an exceptional technical leader with deep roots in open model post\-training and agent harness engineering, ready to build a world\-class FDE organization? We’d love to meet you. **What you’ll be doing:** * This role sets the strategy and leads the team that delivers custom AI to end customers through NVIDIA’s partner ecosystem. The team deepens partner relationships and leads three\-way engagements among NVIDIA, the partner, and the end customer. Our goal is hundreds of end customers running domain\-specific Nemotron or Cosmos in production, supported by a strong ecosystem that delivers it. * Hire and develop FDE leads, managers, and senior engineers across North America, and set a high bar for technical depth and customer impact. Create clear paths for growth and a team structure that scales with the ecosystem. * The work stays technical. Set the technical direction for post\-training, evaluation, harness engineering, and inference optimization, and be the person the team turns to on the hardest engagements. Keep up with the open model, post\-training, and agents landscape, and bring new use cases and partner opportunities forward before partners ask. * Partners are how we reach customers at scale. Build trusted relationships with leaders at partner and end\-customer companies, shape joint plans and agreements, and see three\-way engagements through to production. Set clear goals and track the results: partners adopting Nemotron, customers running in production, and customers willing to speak publicly. We help partners succeed on their own with reusable recipes, reference pipelines, and playbooks, so more developers can build domain\-specific AI. * We connect NVIDIA’s model research to partner and customer use cases. NVIDIA is seeking a Senior Systems Software Engineer for the Apache Spark Acceleration group. GPU accelerated data processing has moved from proof of concept to production deployments. Enterprises now recognize the need for accelerated computing to handle large data processing needs. Multi\-node GPU deployments reduce cloud computing costs and lower the latency of batch ETL workloads. At NVIDIA, we accelerate Apache Spark with an open source plugin that speeds up Spark applications on GPUs without code changes, and our cuDF Spark library is integrated with AWS EMR, Databricks, Google Dataproc, Oracle Cloud Data Flow, Bytedance Volcengine, Tencent Cloud and Cloudera. The service accomplishes production data pipelines for NVIDIA’s internal data platform at thousands of jobs an hour on Kubernetes and AWS, under a customer SLA. It packages the cuDF Spark plugin and a CPU/GPU workload router into an API\-based service built on Spark Connect, Kyuubi, Helm and Flux. You will work across all three layers: the service, the GPU Spark runtime, and the router. **What you’ll be doing:** * Design, build and operate hosted Spark service control plane on Kubernetes: the Java REST API, the Spark Connect runner, Kyuubi, and deployment using Helm charts and Flux * Own code review for one or more services end to end and keep them releasable on the release train * Extend the cuDF Spark runtime and the CPU/GPU workload router in Scala and Java, including interoperability with Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg and Unity Catalog * Investigate production failures on clusters running more than a thousand concurrent jobs together with the customer team and upstream library teams, and drive fixes to closure * Instrument metrics, dashboards and alerts; jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager — AI & Child Safety
jobs.description: The National Center on Sexual Exploitation (NCOSE) is a national nonprofit organization working to prevent sexual abuse and exploitation mass scale by eliminating institutional behaviors \& cultural norms that enable it. Through advocacy, education, research, communications, and strategic partnerships, NCOSE works to advance policies, practices, and cultural change that protect human dignity and promote healthier communities. The **NCOSE Parent Center** is a key part of this work, equipping parents and caregivers with practical resources, education, and support to help children navigate an increasingly sexualized and digital world. The Parent Center helps families understand emerging risks, have meaningful conversations with children, and take informed action to create safer environments for young people. **Position Overview** The National Center on Sexual Exploitation (NCOSE) is seeking a **Senior Technical Product Manager** to lead the development, beta testing, launch, and continued evolution of an innovative AI\-powered Parent Center focused on helping parents, caregivers, and communities protect children in an increasingly complex digital environment. This is not a traditional project management position. We are looking for a hands\-on product leader who understands how modern software is built, has successfully helped bring technology products to market, and can operate effectively between organizational leadership, users, subject\-matter experts, and an external software development team. Experience launching AI or LLM\-powered products is strongly preferred. The successful candidate will become NCOSE's day\-to\-day product owner for the Parent Center and will initially lead an important beta deployment involving schools and real\-world users. This person must be technically fluent enough to challenge developers, evaluate technical recommendations, understand AI system limitations, identify product risks, and hold an external development firm accountable for quality, schedule, and results. **Key Responsibilities** **Product Leadership** Own the Parent Center product from beta through broader deployment. Translate NCOSE's vision, child\-safety expertise, stakeholder requirements, and user feedback into actionable product requirements. Develop and maintain the product roadmap, backlog, user stories, priorities, acceptance criteria, and release schedule. Serve as the primary day\-to\-day product contact between NCOSE leadership and the external development team. Ensure that technology decisions remain aligned with the mission and intended purpose of the Parent Center. **Beta Program** Design and manage the Parent Center's initial school beta program. Develop structured beta\-testing protocols, success metrics, feedback mechanisms, and launch criteria. Coordinate onboarding and communication with participating schools and users. Analyze qualitative and quantitative feedback and translate findings into product improvements. Maintain clear reporting on beta performance, adoption, user experience, defects, risks, and development progress. **AI Quality \& Evaluation** Develop a repeatable evaluation framework for the Parent Center's AI system. Create and maintain test suites covering normal user interactions as well as difficult, ambiguous, adversarial, and high\-risk situations. Evaluate areas including: * Response accuracy and usefulness * Hallucinations and unsupported claims * Source quality * Consistency * Appropriate escalation * Child\-safety scenarios * Crisis and emergency situations * Sextortion * Grooming * Pornography exposure * Sexting and explicit\-image situations * Social media and gaming platforms * School\-device concerns * Prompt injection and adversarial behavior * AI\-generated sexual exploitation concerns * Privacy and data handling * Guardrails and system boundaries Partner with NCOSE subject\-matter experts to ensure the system accurately reflects organizational guidance and child\-safety best practices. Establish measurable release thresholds rather than relying solely on subjective assessments that the AI "looks good." **Development \& Vendor Management** Manage NCOSE's relationship with the external development firm at the product level. Hold the development team accountable for: * Deliverables * Engineering estimates * Timelines * Product quality * Defect resolution * Documentation * Release readiness Review proposed technical solutions and ask informed technical questions. Identify unclear estimates, unnecessary complexity, product risks, technical debt, and potential gaps between requirements and delivered functionality. Ensure fixes are validated through regression testing before release. **Launch \& Product Operations** Develop formal criteria for moving from: **Internal Testing** **School Beta** **Expanded Pilot** **Production Launch** Establish dashboards and reporting covering product health, AI quality, user feedback, open defects, critical issues, development velocity, an icated technology into products that real people can confidently use. **Why This Role Matters** Children and parents are navigating rapidly evolving technologies, platforms, social networks, AI tools, and online risks. The Parent Center is intended to provide parents and caregivers with practical, accessible guidance when they need it—including during situations that can be confusing, frightening, or urgent. That creates an unusually high standard for the technology behind it. NCOSE is looking for someone who wants to help us meet that standard. This position initially centers on successfully bringing the Parent Center through beta and launch, but it also represents an opportunity to help shape NCOSE's broader AI and digital product strategy. **Working Environment/Physical Requirements** * This is a hybrid position in the DC Office or optional remote. Individuals will be required to sit for long periods, stand, or walk as needed. Also, light lifting \- up to 15 pounds. * For remote positions, the individual must work in a quiet space \- no background noise \- and have the camera turned on during all calls and meetings. * Local travel to meetings, including walking or taking an uber or cab. Occasional out of town travel may be required. **Compensation \& Benefits** Salary is commensurate with experience with a range of **$140,000–$165,000**. Exceptional candidates may be considered above the posted range. Benefits include generous medical, dental, vision insurance, FSA, 401K, paid time off, and EAP. **To Apply:** Click "Apply for this Job" at the top of this screen to submit your application. Please include your resume, cover letter, and references. \- **About NCOSE** NCOSE is passionate about building a diverse team (and movement) committed to a world free from sexual abuse and exploitation. We love people and fight for the human dignity of all. We have a global and multicultural impact. Our work is premised on the following principles. * We view the commodification of people for sex as inherently harmful, * We support laws which seek to decrease and ultimately end demand by strongly penalizing those who pay to use the bodies of other people for sex, * We work to create robust services for those seeking freedom from organized systems of sexual exploitation, * We prevent sexual exploitation by opposing policies and reforming systems which facilitate harm, and * We support legal reforms that decriminalize victimization. **Our Mission** Prevent sexual abuse and exploitation mass scale by eliminating institutional behaviors \& cultural norms that enable it. **Our Vision** The National Center on Sexual Exploitation (NCOSE) believes in a world free from sexual abuse and exploitation. We believe every human being deserves the opportunity to live life to its fullest potential: to pursue dreams; express creativity and hone talents; seek beauty, truth, and faith; experience hope, joy, and love with family and friends—to thrive. Such a vision requires not only individuals and institutions that work towards its realization, but also a culture that embraces its responsibility to preserve and protect human flourishing. We aspire to create that culture. **How Do We Behave?** * Unifying – We love people and partnerships. * Aspiring – Being in this work is a deep\-seated calling to justice. * Unrelenting – With hope, we persevere with enduring determination. * Dignifying – We recognize and uplift the inherent human dignity of all. * Innovating – We seek thoughtful, inventive, cutting\-edge tactics and methods. * Inspiring – We elevate others with our vision and coalesced passion. **Our Approach** NCOSE inspires society to end sexual abuse and exploitation through corporate advocacy, public policy, research, training, litigation, and by catalyzing a global movement to defend human dignity. If you share our principles and hope for a world where everyone has the opportunity to thrive, come put your mind, background, and experience to work for us!

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect (Remote - Americas)
jobs.description: ### **Nexla, briefly** Nexla is the data connectivity layer for enterprise AI. Over 1,000 bidirectional connectors give agents real\-time access to data and actions over MCP. Nexla's Agentic Data Integration handles high\-volume streaming ETL, CDC, and Document ETL. At the core of the platform is Helix, a context engine that continuously learns from metadata, schemas, telemetry, and documentation to give agents accurate context and keep pipelines reliable. Nexla processes over a trillion records a month for enterprises including DoorDash, LiveRamp, LinkedIn, and J\&J. Honorable Mention in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Data Integration Tools, and top\-rated by customers on Gartner Peer Insights four years running. **About the role** ------------------ You'll own the technical relationship with our accounts: onboarding, implementation, adoption, escalations, and everything that happens when a pipeline that used to work stops working. You are the person the customer's data team calls, and the person who tells them the truth when the answer is inconvenient. Most of the job is conversation: understanding what they are actually trying to do, explaining what the platform will and will not do for them, keeping their expectations aligned with reality, and raising problems while they are still small. The technical part matters, but not in the way people usually assume. We want a generalist who has built things before and therefore understands how the pieces fit together: what a Kubernetes cluster is for, why a VPN tunnel might be the bottleneck, what a stack trace is telling you, what a slow query looks like. You will not be asked to be the deepest engineer in the room. You will be asked to be the person who can talk to the deepest engineer in the room, understand them, and translate what they said to a VP who has thirty seconds. **What you will do** -------------------- * Own the technical relationship for a portfolio of accounts. You are the continuity: the person who knows their environment, their history, and their constraints. * Lead onboarding and implementation. Understand what the customer is trying to build, design the integration with them, and guide it to production. * Run the hard conversations. A missed date, a degraded pipeline, a limitation they did not expect, a customer who is upset and technically wrong. You stay calm, keep credibility, and land on a next step everyone agrees to. * Flag risk early and in writing. Adoption stalling, a champion who left, a project quietly losing sponsorship, an architecture heading somewhere that will not scale. Flagging a risk three weeks early is worth more here than fixing it heroically after it lands. * Translate between audiences. The same situation explained to a data engineer, to a security reviewer, and to a VP, without losing any of them. * Troubleshoot alongside the customer: failed runs, schema drift, connector and authentication failures, connectivity problems, performance issues. You do the first\-line diagnosis and bring engineering a clear reproduction when it needs to escalate. * Partner with CSM and Support on renewal risk, and hand expansion signals to Sales. * Mentor other SAs on how to handle customers, not just how to solve problems. **What you need** ----------------- ### **Communication and customer ownership (the core of the role)** * You can explain a technical concept to a non\-technical stakeholder without either dumbing it down or losing them. * You handle conflict without escalating it. You can tell a customer no, or "that was our mistake" and keep the relationship intact. * You build trust over months, not meetings. Customers should ask for you by name. * You write clearly and unprompted: summaries, next steps, and owners after every meaningful call. * You raise problems early, including your own. We would much rather hear "this is slipping and here is why" than a confident status update that turns out to be wrong. * You push back on bad requirements instead of silently building them. ### **Technical breadth** You should be a generalist who has built software or data systems at some point. Not necessarily an expert in any one of these, but genuinely conversant in most of them, in the way someone is conversant after having actually worked with them: * **Python.** You can read someone else's script, follow what it does, make a modification, and understand stack traces. * **SQL.** Comfortable writing joins, aggregations, and filters. You can look at a slow query and have a sensible first guess about why. * **Data pipelines and integration.** APIs and their common failure modes (rate limits, pagination, retries, auth expiry), webhooks, CDC, file\-based ingestion, batch versus streaming trade\-offs. * **Cloud data platforms.** Working familiarity with at least one of Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, or a major cloud data warehouse. * **Authentication.** You understand what OAuth, SSO, service accounts, and API keys are and roughly  ou do not need to configure them, but you need to understand the concepts well enough to hold a productive call with a customer's network team and know when the network is the problem rather than the platform. * **Containers and Kubernetes.** Conceptual understanding only: what a container is, what Kubernetes does, why workloads run in pods, what it means when something runs out of memory. You will **not** be administering clusters. * **Linux.** Comfortable enough in a terminal to read a log file, check a process, or run a curl command. ### **Experience** * 5\+ years in technical customer\-facing work: solutions architecture, implementation, technical account management, professional services, consulting, support engineering, or a data engineering role that involved heavy stakeholder contact. * At least some of that spent hands\-on building, not only advising. * Experience owning accounts or projects through delivery, not just handing off. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Prior experience at a data integration, ETL, or data platform vendor. * Background in data engineering or software engineering earlier in your career. * Experience in a regulated industry (healthcare, financial services, insurance). * Entrepreneurial experience or similar (having worked at a fast\-paced startup environment). **What this role is not** ------------------------- * Not a support queue. You own outcomes on named accounts. * Not a deep engineering role. * Not a pure relationship role either. You need to be technical enough to earn the customer's respect in the first meeting. **Interview process** --------------------- * Recruiter screen (30 min) * Hiring manager conversation (45 min) * Technical breadth session (60 min): troubleshooting reasoning, plus basic Python and SQL * Customer scenario (60 min): you handle a difficult account situation with a panel playing customer roles ### **Why Nexla? Why now?** A few large companies \- DoorDash, SentinelOne, Johnson \& Johnson, LinkedIn, Amex, Integrity Marketing, among them use Nexla for data integration. Connectors, runtime, transformations, scheduling, the parts of the stack where data has to move between systems reliably. The reason this is an interesting moment to join is what the agent shift is doing to the category. Data integration used to mean "land this data in that warehouse so a human can look at it." That product is mature. What it's becoming is closer to "an agent asks a business question, and the platform figures out which data and what code and which APIs add up to a real answer." That's a much bigger problem, and most of the architecture for it hasn't been built yet by anyone. A concrete example. A revenue team wants to ask "which enterprise customers are showing renewal risk" and get a real answer through whatever agent or app they work in. Today there is no clean way to answer that question, it requires CRM, usage, support, and billing data joined in org\-specific ways, and the calling agent can't just invoke a tool that returns the right answer unless someone first establishes whether the underlying data is even capable of producing one. That is the system we are building. A probe agent investigates the data plane whether the right fields are populated, whether freshness is adequate, whether the joins exist, whether credentials cover the required scope and returns a grounded feasibility answer. Where there are gaps, Express.dev composes the pipelines to close them. The capability is then exposed as an MCP server: "renewal risk" as a curated product, with the business logic correct and the query semantics described well enough that the calling agent uses it as intended. The MCP Gateway governs which agents can call which capabilities, with the policies, audit, and observability an enterprise control plane requires. The bet is that ten years of connector work, an enterprise customer base, and a runtime that already moves real volume are the right foundation to define this layer from.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer - Evals
jobs.description: **About this role** You'll own evaluation of Honcho end to end, the instrument that tells a research\-driven team whether their identity representations are actually getting better. Plastic Labs builds the memory and identity layer for the agentic world, and the product works. It's a complex multi\-agent harness with real black\-box behavior, so the job is defining what "better" means for representations that change over time, without ground truth, and building the machinery that measures it. If you love constructing measurements from nothing, reading traces to find what's actually broken, and shipping the fix yourself, you'll feel at home here. **What You'll Do** Design the evals. Define the scores and decide what "better" means for an entity representation that changes over time, and keep that definition current as the product and methods move. Build the pipelines and harnesses. Data in, labels, versions, reruns, judges: the machinery that lets the team ask a new question this week and get an answer this week. Run them and harvest insights. Read the traces and results, find what's actually broken, not what's easy to measure, and propose fixes that produce higher\-fidelity representations. Build simulation agents at scale. The ceiling on iteration speed is how many entities can be modeled and measured at once. You raise it. Own the loop end to end. The question, the pipeline, the rerun, the writeup. Nothing gets scoped and handed off, and nothing waits on someone else's sprint. **Work experience** * **Must have**: Designed,​ built,​ and ran evals end to end (LLMS) **Education** * Degree in computer science,​ mathematics,​ statistics,​ or a related quantitative field **Skills** * **Must have:** Production\-​quality Python (tests,​ maintenance,​ release cadence) * 3\+ years of experience 3\+ years designing and owning LLM evaluation * PyTorch,​ Hugging Face,​ Weights \&​ Biases.​ Data pipeline tooling (Hydra,​ Kafka,​ SQL) a plus **Nice\-to\-have** * Work on memory,​ identity,​ personalization,​ agent evaluation,​ or agentic optimization.​ * Shipped research:​ first or co\-​author at NeurIPS,​ ICML,​ ICLR,​ or equivalent,​ OR self\-​published open\-​source work of comparable quality Join us to be at the forefront of AI innovation! Bring your passion for machine learning/AI\-based analysis to develop impactful models that drive strategic decisions across industries while working with the latest technologies in a collaborative environment that values your expertise! Pay: $220,000\.00 \- $300,000\.00 per year Application Question(s): * Are you able to work in\-person at our NYC office full\-time? * Describe your experience designing and building a production ML evaluation system from scratch — particularly when you had no ground truth or existing benchmark to rely on. * What's your trackable research experience? Share a first\-author paper or significant open\-source project and explain your specific contribution. * Can the candidate be on\-site? If not, is the candidate willing to relocate? * What is their salary expectation? Education: * Bachelor's (Required) Experience: * designing and owning LLM evaluation: 3 years (Required) Location: * New York, NY (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.description: ##### **About Peraton** Peraton is a next\-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure. ##### **Program Overview** The program is an IDIQ contract for an AWS\-based cloud hosting system. Currently, Peraton is supporting the Cloud Security, IoT, and AIML use cases for the environment in a hybrid work environment with Federal employees. Peraton also support the following applications as part of the environment: Dremio, Tableau, Globus, Posit/RStudio, Atlassian, ThingLogix, Alteryx and CloudCheckr. ##### **About The Role** Peraton is seeking an experienced and detail\-oriented **Senior Cloud Administrator** to support the DOI USGS Permitting Modernization and Cloud Infrastructure program on the WARP platform. In this fully remote hands\-on role you will serve as the day\-to\-day operational owner of the AWS cloud infrastructure supporting a diverse development workforce of 50\+ engineers, 20 business analysts, and Government personnel across fully separated development, testing, staging, and production environments. You will manage AWS Marketplace subscriptions, enforce Government\-directed security controls, monitor environment health, and serve as the primary point of contact for AWS support escalations. Operating in a strict FedRAMP Moderate federal environment, you will ensure platform availability, access integrity, and security compliance playing a foundational role in the success of one of DOI's most significant technology modernization programs. Peraton supports the U.S. Department of the Interior (DOI) and U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) in modernizing the federal permitting process through the Permitting Modernization and Cloud Infrastructure program. At the heart of this initiative is the WARP platform (Workflows, Authorizations, Registrations, and Permits), a cloud\-native AWS environment purpose\-built to streamline and accelerate how the federal government processes permits, authorizations, and registrations. The program leverages cutting\-edge cloud infrastructure, AI\-assisted decision support, and advanced data engineering to serve a large, distributed team of developers, business analysts, and Government stakeholders. Peraton's role spans the full lifecycle of cloud operations from provisioning and managing secure multi\-environment AWS infrastructure and AI/ML services to delivering workforce training and certification, all within a rigorous federal compliance framework including FedRAMP, FISMA, and NIST security standards. **Work Location:** Remote **What You Will Do:** * Administer and maintain all AWS cloud environments (dev, test, staging, production) for the WARP permitting platform, ensuring availability, performance, and security at all times. * Manage AWS Marketplace subscriptions, including procurement, provisioning, renewal, and decommissioning of approved runtime subscriptions for permitting and development workloads. * Monitor environment health and performance using AWS
