jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff (Software Engineer, Enterprise Agent Evals & Efficiency)
jobs.description: **About the Role** ------------------ The Enterprise Agent Evals \& Efficiency team makes Perplexity's agents better at completing real work across enterprise connectors, tools, and data. Our goal is to help agents choose the right tools, use the right context, and complete complex workflows reliably, with less time and compute. This team owns the improvement loop: define what successful work looks like, build evaluations that measure it, understand where agents fail, and ship changes that improve outcomes. This is a hands\-on engineering role with end\-to\-end ownership, from building realistic enterprise evaluation environments to shipping improvements across the agent harness, tools, and skills. You'll create complex scenarios spanning connected systems, data, and permissions, use them to identify where agents struggle, and improve the tools agents call, the skills they follow, the context they receive, and the models they use. Working with AI Research, Connectors, and Platform teams, you'll turn experimental results into measurable gains in task success, latency, and cost per successful task. The goal is not just to measure agents, but to make more enterprise work reliable and practical to automate. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Build realistic enterprise evaluation environments spanning connected applications, representative datasets, user roles, and permissions, with complex, multi\-step workflows and reproducible system state. * Own evaluation infrastructure, task suites, and automated graders that measure how well agents complete enterprise work, calibrated against human judgment and grounded in end\-to\-end outcomes. * Analyze agent trajectories and production failures, identify root causes, and ship improvements across the agent harness, tools, and skills that measurably improve task success and reliability. * Develop reusable skills and improve tool descriptions, schemas, and result handling so agents can select the right tools, execute workflows correctly, and recover from errors with fewer unnecessary calls. * Build and evaluate model\-selection and routing strategies that match each task to the right model and effort level, balancing quality, latency, reliability, and cost. * Improve agent efficiency through context management, skill loading, caching, and execution strategies that reduce wasted tokens and cost per successful task without compromising quality or safety. * Build regression gates and launch\-readiness signals for model, connector, tool, skill, and harness changes, and validate that evaluation gains translate into better production outcomes. **Qualifications** ------------------ * 5\+ years of software engineering or machine learning engineering experience, with a track record of owning complex production systems from design through deployment and operation. * Strong system design skills, including building reliable, scalable infrastructure for experimentation, evaluation, or data\-intensive applications. * Strong proficiency in a backend language such as Python, Go, or Rust, and the ability to work effectively across a multi\-language production stack. * Hands\-on experience building, evaluating, or improving LLM\-based applications or agents, including tool use and multi\-step workflows. * Deep expertise in at least one of the following: + Evaluation infrastructure, benchmark design, and automated grading. + Agent harnesses, tool interfaces, and reusable skills for complex workflows. + Realistic test environments or simulations spanning multiple systems, datasets, permissions, and stateful workflows. + Model selection, routing, and inference efficiency, including context management and caching. * Strong experimental and statistical judgment, including choosing representative tasks, defining meaningful success criteria, diagnosing failures, and distinguishing real improvements from noise. * Sound technical judgment in balancing task quality, latency, reliability, and cost, with a track record of translating evaluation findings into shipped improvements. * A track record of leading ambiguous, cross\-team initiatives from architecture through production adoption, setting technical direction, and raising engineering quality through mentorship. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every qualification. We value demonstrated impact, deep ownership, and the initiative to turn ambiguity into results.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Summary** The Data Engineer is an individual\-contributor role responsible for building, maintaining and improving reliable data engineering solutions that enable trusted data, analytics and AI across Pharming. The role translates defined business and data requirements and architectural direction into practical data pipelines, integrations, data models and reusable components that support data\-driven decision\-making and scalable delivery across global functions. Reporting to the Head of AI, Data \& Analytics, the Data Engineer works independently on assigned data engineering activities of moderate to high complexity within the AI \& Transformation domain. The role applies established engineering standards, contributes to technical design decisions, resolves day\-to\-day engineering issues and collaborates with data owners, data stewards, architecture, cybersecurity, privacy, quality, compliance, applications and business stakeholders to ensure data solutions are secure, governed, maintainable and fit for purpose. More complex architectural, cross\-domain or high\-risk decisions are escalated through the appropriate technical and governance channels. This is a hybrid role based in our Warren, NJ office with an expectation of 2\-3 in office days in office each week and the flexibility to adjust schedules depending on business needs. **What you'd do** * Data engineering and platform delivery + Build, maintain and enhance scalable batch and real\-time data pipelines, ingestion workflows and transformation processes that integrate data from enterprise, scientific, operational and external sources. + Develop and maintain data models, curated datasets and reusable data components that provide trusted, well\-structured data for analytics, reporting, AI and machine\-learning use cases. + Translate approved enterprise architecture and data\-platform direction into practical engineering implementations using established patterns for storage, processing, orchestration, integration and access. + Support reliability, performance and maintainability by implementing automated testing, monitoring, observability, error handling, documentation and operational support practices. + Apply modern software\-engineering practices to data solutions, including version control, code review, CI/CD and automation; use infrastructure\-as\-code where appropriate and established by the platform standards. + Contribute to continuous improvement of data\-engineering methods, reusable components and platform capabilities to reduce duplication and improve delivery efficiency. * Data quality, governance and integration + Implement data\-quality controls, validation rules, lineage and monitoring that improve confidence in data used for business decisions, analytics and AI. + Work with data owners, data stewards and business subject\-matter experts to translate data definitions, quality expectations and governance requirements into practical technical controls. + Build and maintain secure data integrations across applications, platforms and external data sources using approved APIs, interfaces, event\-driven or file\-based patterns. + Apply privacy, cybersecurity, access\-control, retention and compliance requirements in data pipelines and platform solutions in collaboration with the relevant control functions. + Support metadata, master/reference data, interoperability and lifecycle\-management practices that improve discoverability, consistency and reuse of data across functions. + Support regulated and GxP\-relevant data needs where applicable by ensuring engineering solutions are traceable, controlled and aligned with Pharming's quality and validation requirements. * Technical delivery and collaboration + Contribute technical expertise to data initiatives, follow established engineering standards and guardrails, and raise design risks or exceptions for review where appropriate. + Partner with AI, analytics and business teams to ensure data foundations support analytics, AI and automation use cases and can be transitioned from development into reliable production use. + Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Enterprise Applications and Global IT Operations \& Service Delivery to align data solutions with application, integration, cloud, infrastructure and service\-management requirements. + Assess data\-engineering technologies, tools and vendor capabilities and provide practical input on technical fit, scalability, risk and lifecycle considerations. + Contribute to knowledge sharing, technical documentation, communities of practice and team capability development through active collaboration and peer support. + Other duties as assigned **What you'd need** * Relevant bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Information Management or a related field, or equivalent demonstrable professional experience. * At least 4 years of progressive experience in data engineering, data platforms, software engineerin itment, and real partnership can help advance care. We put patients at the heart of our work. Their insights, along with those of caregivers, clinicians, scientists, and parters, shape our strategy, guide our decisions, and help turn science into meaningful progress. We keep it simple, act with urgency, and get it done – expanding access to approved therapies, advancing high\-value pipeline programs, and building a leading global rare disease company. Our vision is simple: a world where people living with rare diseases don’t wait for progress or care. Together with the communities who inspire us, we’re opening new possibilities – proving that breakthroughs aren’t just discovered. They’re created together. Ready to make a difference? Join us. **What it’s like to work here** At Pharming, every role helps move rare disease therapies closer to the people who need them. We make it happen together, across teams, disciplines, and borders, because breakthroughs don’t happen in silos. Rare diseases are complex, and meaningful progress takes people who ask better questions, challenge each other, and turn insight into action. Here, you won’t work on the sidelines. Pharming is a place for builders, problem\-solvers, and bold thinkers who move with urgency, take ownership, and stay focused on what matters most: improving the lives of people living with rare diseases. Advancing rare disease care isn’t the work of one team or one leader. It’s all of us, building what’s next together. This is also an important moment of transformation for Pharming’s digital and technology capabilities, as they evolve from a traditional support function into a more integrated, enterprise\-wide enabler of business value. You will have the opportunity to influence how applications, data, technology, processes, and ways of working develop across the organization, helping to build scalable, resilient, and future\-ready capabilities that support Pharming’s continued growth. **Salary range** Pharming takes into consideration a combination of candidate’s work experience, training, and education, as well as the scope of the role, complexity, and external market and internal value when determining a salary level. The base salary range for this job is from $115,000 \- $155,000 per year. **Compensation \& benefits** * Flexible hybrid work schedule to promote a healthy work\-life balance * Competitive compensation package including annual target bonus * Long\-term incentive program * 401(k) plan with company match * Paid Time Off (PTO) * 13 Company Holidays per year * Excellent benefit plans including medical, dental, and vision * Flexible spending accounts * Company\-provided life insurance, short\-term disability, and long\-term disability plans * Optional accident, hospital indemnity, critical illness, and pet insurance plans * Tuition reimbursement program * Health and wellness program * Choice of company provided mobile phone or cell phone stipend **Additional information** Pharming Healthcare, Inc. is a merit\-based equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected classes. An applicant requiring an accommodation in connection with the hiring process and/or to perform the essential functions of the position for which the applicant has applied should make a request via email to HR\-US@pharming.com. Unsolicited resumes from agencies should not be forwarded to Pharming. Pharming will not be responsible for any fees arising from the use of resumes through this source. Pharming will only pay a fee to agencies if a formal agreement between Pharming and the agency has been established. The Human Resources/Talent Acquisition department is responsible for all recruitment activities; please contact us directly to be considered for a formal agreement.

jobs.title: Senior Desiign Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Title** Automation Design Engineer – Automotive Welding **Job Summary** You will design, develop, and test automated welding systems and robotic tooling for automotive manufacturing. Your work includes creating 3D models, selecting automation equipment, and ensuring designs meet safety and customer standards. **Key Responsibilities** * **Design Systems:** Create 3D models and 2D manufacturing drawings for robotic welding cells, end\-of\-arm tooling, and assembly fixtures using CAD software like SolidWorks or AutoCAD. * **Integrate Robotics:** Select and integrate industrial robots, welding guns (MIG, TIG, Resistance/Spot), sensors, and safety hardware. * **Collaborate:** Work with project managers, controls engineers, and the shop floor to ensure designs are practical and buildable. * **Review Safety:** Ensure all mechanical and automation designs follow OSHA, RIA, and customer\-specific safety standards. * **Support Build \& Launch:** Assist with assembly troubleshooting, robot path simulations, and final buy\-off at customer sites if needed. **Qualifications \& Skills** * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). * **Experience:** 3 to 5 years of experience in automation design, specifically within the automotive or tier\-1 welding supplier industry. * **Software Skills:** Proficiency in 3D CAD software (SolidWorks, CATIA, or Inventor) and robotic simulation tools (Robcad or Process Simulate). * **Knowledge Base:** Strong understanding of resistance spot welding, MIG welding, pneumatic components, and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD\&T). **Job Title:** Process Automation Design Engineer – Automotive Welding Systems **Department:** Process Engineering / Automation **Reports To:** Engineering Manager **Position Summary:** The Process Automation Design Engineer is responsible for designing, simulating, and optimizing complete automated welding manufacturing lines. This role focuses on the macro\-level process layout, material flow, cycle\-time (thru\-put) analysis, and the high\-level integration of FANUC robotic arms into coherent production cells. **Key Responsibilities:** * **Process \& Layout Design:** Develop 2D/3D manufacturing line layouts, sequence of operations, and process flow diagrams for robotic MIG, spot, and laser welding cells. * **FANUC Robot Simulation:** Utilize simulation software (such as FANUC ROBOGUIDE or Process Simulate) to perform reach studies, interference checks, and cycle time analysis. * **System Integration:** Define the interaction between FANUC robots, material handling systems, safety gating, and PLC\-controlled equipment. * **Cycle Time Optimization:** Analyze and optimize robot paths and process steps to meet strict automotive customer throughput requirements. * **Specifications \& Standards:** Ensure all process designs comply with automotive OEM specifications (e.g., Ford, GM, Stellantis) and safety standards (RIA/OSHA). * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with Tooling Design Engineers to align fixture placement with robot access paths and process constraints. **Qualifications:** * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, or Automation Engineering. * **Experience:** 3\+ years in automotive process automation design, focusing on robotic welding lines. * **Technical Skills:** High proficiency in FANUC ROBOGUIDE, AutoCAD, and 3D CAD platforms. Deep knowledge of MIG/MAG and resistance spot welding parameters. * **Knowledge:** Strong understanding of automotive assembly line routing, safety circuits, and line balancing. **Job Title:** Tooling Automation Design Engineer – Welding \& FANUC **Department:** Mechanical Design / Tooling **Reports To:** Tooling Engineering Supervisor **Position Summary:** The Tooling Automation Design Engineer is responsible for the mechanical design of welding fixtures, clamping systems, and specialized End\-of\-Arm Tooling (EOAT) for FANUC robots. This role ensures parts are held precisely to meet tight tolerances during high\-stress robotic welding applications. **Key Responsibilities:** * **Fixture \& Tooling Design:** Design 3D geometric welding fixtures, manual/pneumatic clamping systems, and heavy\-duty robotic EOAT using SolidWorks, CATIA, or NX. * **FANUC Payload \& Center of Gravity (CG) Analysis:** Calculate load capacities, moments of inertia, and CG for EOAT to ensure compliance with specific FANUC robot payload profiles. * **Component Selection:** Specify standard automation components including pneumatic cylinders, toggle clamps, proximity sensors, grippers, and slide units. * **GD\&T Application:** Apply strict Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD\&T) to fabrication prints to ensure part repeatability and quality. * **Welding Environment Design:** Material selection and shielding design to withstand weld spatter, high heat, and harsh production environments. * **Build Support:** Support the toolroom build, assembly, shim\-tuning, and try\-out phases of fixtures and EOAT. **Qualifications:** * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Tool \& Die Design, or equivalent trade experience. * **Experience:** 3\+ years designing physical tooling, fixtures, and robotic grippers for automotive body\-in\-white (BIW) welding applications. * **Technical Skills:** Advanced 3D CAD modeling skills (SolidWorks preferred); strong knowledge of pneumatics and fluid power schematics. * **Knowledge:** Deep understanding of FANUC robot mechanical mounting interfaces and payload constraints.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Trust & Safety, Surveillance & Compliance
jobs.description: **About Polymarket** -------------------- Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market. In the US, we operate a CFTC\-regulated exchange and clearinghouse, which comes with real obligations to protect our markets and our users. We recently launched our Trust \& Safety program and are building surveillance and compliance capabilities in\-house. Engineering is the team that makes those commitments work in production. **About the role** ------------------ We're hiring an Engineering Manager to lead the systems that keep Polymarket fair and safe: identity and onboarding, fraud and financial crime controls, market surveillance, and user protections. You'll partner closely with our Trust \& Safety, Surveillance, and Compliance leaders. They define the policy and run the investigations, and your team builds the detection, controls, and tools that make their work possible at scale. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Own identity verification and onboarding systems (KYC), including vendor integrations, decisioning, and the edge cases that come with them. * Build fraud and financial crime controls: payment risk checks, AML transaction monitoring, and sanctions screening. * Build trade and market surveillance that detects manipulation, wash trading, spoofing, and misuse of non\-public information, and produce the alerts our surveillance analysts act on. * Ship user protections such as deposit limits, self\-exclusion, and responsible trading controls, and make them reliable across the product. * Build case management and investigation tooling for the Surveillance, Compliance, and Trust \& Safety teams, with the audit trails and records a regulated exchange needs. * Hire and lead a team of senior engineers, set the technical direction, and balance user friction against risk with good judgment. What we're looking for * 8\+ years in software engineering and 2\+ years managing engineers. * Experience building trust and safety, integrity, fraud, risk, or surveillance systems at a company operating at meaningful scale. * Comfort working in a regulated environment and translating compliance requirements into concrete system design. * Strong data\-intensive systems skills: event streams, rules engines, detection pipelines, and the tradeoffs between real\-time and batch. * Collaboration with non\-engineering partners. You'll work with policy, investigations, and compliance teams every day. * (Plus) Experience at an exchange, broker, or crypto platform with trade surveillance or AML obligations. * (Plus) Familiarity with surveillance and compliance vendors (for example trade surveillance platforms, KYC providers, or blockchain analytics). * (Plus) Applied ML or anomaly detection experience for fraud or abuse. * (Plus) Experience across both centralized and on\-chain products. **Benefits** ------------ * Competitive salary and equity * Unlimited PTO * Health, vision, and dental coverage * 401(k) match * Full hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, large display, and accessories **Pay Transparency** -------------------- Base salary range: $250,000 to $400,000 annually, plus equity and benefits. This range reflects a good\-faith estimate for this position. Experience levels vary widely within a title here, so please reach out even if your expectations fall outside it. We're always happy to chat. Compensation Range: $350K \- $500K

jobs.title: Advanced Manufacturing Engineer

opportunities. * Lead and support continuous improvement initiatives utilizing Lean manufacturing and structured problem\-solving methodologies. * Facilitate root cause investigations using A3, PDCA, 5 Why Analysis, Fishbone Diagrams, and other analytical tools. * Support automation, controls, digitalization, and manufacturing technology projects from concept through implementation. * Assist in implement sustainable process improvements. * Support deployment and utilization of manufacturing systems including SCADA, MES, CMMS, Power BI, and industrial data platforms. * Use process mapping and value stream analysis to improve material flow, labor utilization, equipment performance, and operational efficiency. * Participate in FAT, SAT, commissioning, startup, validation, and operational handoff activities when supporting capital projects. * Support TPM and reliability initiatives aimed at reducing equipment failures and improving asset performance. * Develop reports, dashboards, and performance metrics that support data\-driven decision making. * Maintain process documentation, standard work, and project records. * Coach and support frontline teams in the application of Lean principles and continuous improvement practices. * Support advanced manufacturing initiatives involving automation, robotics, machine vision, artificial intelligence, and smart manufacturing technologies as applicable. * Establish project baselines, performance targets, and benefit\-verification methods to ensure implemented improvements deliver measurable results. * Lead assigned manufacturing improvement projects from opportunity identification through implementation and sustainment. **Qualifications** **EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE:** **Required** * Bachelor’s degree in Industrial, Manufacturing, Mechanical, Electrical, Computer, Mechatronics, Automation, or a related engineering discipline from an accredited four\-year college or university. * Two or more years of relevant experience in manufacturing engineering, advanced manufacturing, industrial automation, reliability, process improvement, operations excellence, or a related industrial environment. * Demonstrated experience analyzing manufacturing losses and implementing process, equipment, automation, reliability, or standard\-work improvements. * Experience working cross\-functionally with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Quality, EHS, or IT/OT teams. * Experience leading or supporting projects from problem definition through implementation, performance verification, and operational handoff. **Preferred** * Experience in food, beverage, consumer packaged goods, or another high\-speed manufacturing environment. * Experience analyzing manufacturing data including OEE, downtime, throughput, reliability, quality, waste, or labor performance metrics. * Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or comparable structured problem\-solving experience. * Experience with Power BI, SCADA, MES, CMMS, SAP, AVEVA, or similar manufacturing systems. * Relevant co\-op or internship experience may be conside s videos * **Career Advancement Opportunities:** Unlock your potential with clear paths for career progression and internal mobility across our diverse family of brands and business units. * **Focused Learning and Development:** Grow as a leader with our dedicated Learning and Organizational Development department, offering extensive resources like People Manager and leadership training, webinars, and eLearning courses. * **Empowering Mentorship Program:** Connect with colleagues through our company\-wide mentorship program to share goals, overcome challenges, and drive your career forward. * **Continuous Improvement Training:** Participate in training that empowers all employees to learn and implement concepts that drive significant, positive change in the workplace. * **Building a Healthy Society:** To date, our co\-Founders Lynda and Stewart Resnick, through their foundations and The Wonderful Company, have invested more than $2\.5 billion in education, health and wellness, community development, and sustainability initiatives across California’s Central Valley, Fiji, and the world. In 2025, Wonderful ranked as \#1 in PEOPLE’s “100 Companies That Care” list and was named one of Fortune magazine’s 100 Best Companies to Work For. jobs.title: Applied Research - Chip Design
jobs.description: **Own Your Intelligence** ------------------------- Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team. Our platform, Lab, unifies compute, environments, evaluations, secure sandboxes, high\-performance training, and deployment into one full\-stack system for post\-training at frontier scale \- from SFT and RL to tool use, agent workflows, and continuously improving production models. We are building open frontier AI: open\-source models trained end to end for long\-horizon tasks like autonomous research, and the full\-stack platform our own research team uses to build them. The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. They need the ability to turn their own workflows, tools, data, and feedback loops into superintelligence they own. Prime Intellect has raised $150M in total funding from Founders Fund, Radical Ventures, NVIDIA, and exceptional AI, infrastructure, and enterprise operators — including Andrej Karpathy, Dwarkesh Patel, and leaders and founders from Ramp, Perplexity, Harvey, Mercor, Zapier, Datadog, Cognition, OpenAI, Thinking Machines, Together AI, SemiAnalysis, LangChain, Browserbase, Cloudflare, Sierra, Databricks, Airbnb, OpenRouter, Standard Intelligence, Fleet, Core Auto, and more. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of frontier research, real infrastructure, and go\-to\-market for a category that does not fully exist yet. **Role Impact** --------------- Chip design is a natural fit for agentic reinforcement learning: long\-horizon work, specialized tools, expensive mistakes, hard constraints, and objective feedback from simulation, verification, timing, power, and area. You will build agents, environments, evaluations, and post\-training systems for real semiconductor design and verification workflows. The work is grounded in an external design workflow, with access to relevant domain experts and toolchains. It may span RTL generation and debugging, formal verification, simulation, physical design, optimization, and orchestration across EDA tools. **Responsibilities** -------------------- **Applied Research at Prime** We turn a workflow into tasks, environments, evaluations, and reward signals, run post\-training experiments against real baselines, and deploy what works. When a result looks good, we find out whether the gain came from the model or from the data, harness, inference, or infrastructure. The reusable parts become shared research, open\-source systems, and product capabilities. Every Applied Research role is externally facing. Most researchers work directly with customers, users, or research partners while maintaining a substantive research agenda. **Representative early problems** * Build an interactive verification environment where an agent reads a specification, writes or repairs RTL, invokes simulation or formal tools, interprets failures, and iterates toward a verified result. * Design rewards and evaluations that combine functional correctness with tool efficiency, robustness, and performance/power/area constraints without opening easy shortcuts. * Train long\-horizon agents to recover from design and tool failures, preserve useful state, and generalize across blocks, designs, and constraint sets. **What you will own** * Interactive environments where agents use EDA tools to modify designs, debug failures, and plan multi\-step work. * Verifiers and rewards grounded in tests, simulation, formal methods, design rules, and engineering outcomes. * Experiments on credit assignment when feedback arrives late and several tools contribute. * Evaluations for correctness, recovery, and generalization, with reusable methods for other simulator\-grounded engineering domains. **Requirements** ---------------- * We are looking first for depth in RL, agents, or post\-training systems and the ability to become fluent in semiconductor workflows. * Prior work in design automation, compilers, formal methods, or ML for systems is useful but not required. * Hands\-on experience building and debugging model\-training, post\-training, agent, evaluation, or closely adjacent experimental loops. * Strong experimental judgment: meaningful baselines, careful trace inspection, clear failure attribution, and a willingness to change direction when the evidence changes. * Strong Python and the ability to build artifacts that other researchers and engineers can run, inspect, and extend. * Comfort owning ambiguous problems and keeping partners and teammates current as you resolve them. **Evidence of exceptional work** We value publications, open\-source systems, benchmarks, and shipped products as evidence of exceptional work. Show us something difficult you built, what failed, and how the evidence changed your approach. **Benefits and Perks** ---------------------- * Cash Compensation Range of $150\-300k \+ equity incentives * Flexible Work (San Francisco, New York, London, or remote) * Visa Sponsorship \& relocation support * Professional Development budget * Team Off\-sites \& conference attendance If you're excited about the opportunity to build the foundation for the future of decentralized AI and create a platform that empowers developers and researchers to push the boundaries of what's possible, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Knowledge Graph Engineer
jobs.description: While technology is the heart of our business, a global and diverse culture is the heart of our success. We love our people and we take pride in catering them to a culture built on transparency, diversity, integrity, learning and growth. If working in an environment that encourages you to innovate and excel, not just in professional but personal life, interests you\- you would enjoy your career with Quantiphi! **About Quantiphi** Quantiphi is an award\-winning, AI\-First digital engineering and consulting company focused on delivering high\-impact Services and Solutions that help organizations solve what truly matters. We partner with enterprises to reimagine their businesses through intelligent, scalable, and transformative AI—driving measurable outcomes at the very core of their operations. Since our founding in 2013, Quantiphi has tackled some of the world’s most complex business challenges by combining deep industry expertise, disciplined cloud and data engineering practices, and cutting\-edge applied AI research. Our work is rooted in delivering accelerated, quantifiable business value—not just technology for technology’s sake. Headquartered in Boston, Quantiphi is a global organization with 4,000\+ professionals serving clients across key industry verticals, including BFSI, Healthcare \& Life Sciences, CPG, MFG, TME etc. As an Elite and Premier partner to leading cloud and AI platforms such as NVIDIA, Google Cloud, AWS, and Snowflake, we build and deliver enterprise\-grade AI services and solutions that create real\-world impact. For more details, visit: Website or LinkedIn Page. **Role:** Senior Knowledge Graph Engineer **Experience:** 5\+ years of software/data engineering experience **Employment Type:** Full\-Time (US Remote) **Work Location:** US Remote (Up to 25% travel to client sites across the US) **Role Overview** We are looking for a Senior Knowledge Graph Engineer to design, build, and productionize knowledge graph solutions for healthcare and clinical data. Our architecture uses a hybrid graph approach, combining a Labeled Property Graph (LPG) for patient/clinical data with an RDF\-based graph for clinical ontology and semantic knowledge. The role will focus on translating ontology and mapping specifications into scalable graph solutions, including data transformation, graph ingestion, concept/entity linking, provenance, validation, and querying. You will work closely with ontology, terminology, FHIR, clinical/domain, and data engineering teams to translate agreed semantic and mapping decisions into robust technical implementations. **Key Responsibilities:** * Develop, implement, build, and maintain production knowledge graph solutions across **LPG and RDF graph technologies**. * Build scalable pipelines to transform healthcare/FHIR data into appropriate graph representations. * Implement mappings between patient/clinical data and concepts represented in the clinical ontology. * Develop reusable mapping and transformation patterns rather than one\-off implementations. * Implement consistent approaches for **entity identity, canonical identifiers/URI/IRI, relationships, and concept linking**. * Maintain **provenance and traceability** between source data, mapping rules, and resulting graph entities and relationships. * Develop and optimize graph queries using **Cypher and/or SPARQL**. * Implement automated validation and testing to identify unresolved mappings, inconsistent relationships, and other graph\-quality issues. * Work with ontology, FHIR, terminology, and clinical SMEs to clarify ambiguous or missing mapping requirements. * Participate in technical design, architecture reviews, code reviews, and engineering best practices. **Required Qualifications:** * **5\+ years of software/data engineering experience**, including hands\-on experience with knowledge graphs or graph technologies. * Strong understanding of **knowledge graph and graph data modeling concepts**. * Hands\-on experience with either:**Labeled Property Graphs**, such as Neo4j/Cypher or equivalent, or**RDF/semantic technologies**, such as RDF/RDFS, OWL, and SPARQL. * Working knowledge of, or ability to work across, both **LPG and RDF graph models**. * Strong programming skills in **Python, Java, or similar languages**. * Experience building production data ingestion, transformation, or integration pipelines. * Experience with graph databases and/or RDF triple stores. * Understanding of entity identity, graph relationships, mappings, provenance, and data quality. * Ability to translate conceptual models and mapping specifications into production implementations. * Ability to work effectively with evolving requirements and cross\-functional technical/domain teams. **Other Qualifications (OQs)** * Hands\-on experience with **both LPG and RDF/semantic knowledge graphs**. * Healthcare or life sciences data experience. * Familiarity with **HL7 FHIR**, including concepts such as Coding, CodeableConcept, Reference, and Identifier. * Experience with ontology\-driven data integration or semantic mapping. * Experience with SHACL or other graph/semantic validation approaches. * Experience with terminology/concept normalization and canonical concept mapping. * Familiarity with clinical terminologies such as **SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, ICD, or UMLS**. * Cloud and CI/CD experience. **What Sets You Apart?** * Hands\-on experience with both LPG and RDF/semantic knowledge graphs. * Healthcare or life sciences data experience with familiarity with HL7 FHIR and clinical terminologies (SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, ICD, or UMLS). * Experience with ontology\-driven data integration, semantic mapping, and SHACL/semantic validation approaches. * Cloud and CI/CD engineering experience in production environment. **What’s In It For YOU At Quantiphi?** * Make an impact at one of the world’s fastest\-growing AI\-first digital engineering companies. * Upskill and discover your potential as you solve complex challenges in cutting\-edge areas of technology alongside passionate, talented colleagues. * Work where innovation happens \- work with disruptive innovators in a research\-focused organization with 60\+ patents filed across various disciplines. * Stay ahead of the curve, immerse yourself in breakthrough AI, ML, data, and cloud technologies and gain exposure working with Fortune 1000 companies. * If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over\-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us! *If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over\-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us**!*

jobs.title: Managing Director USA (f/m/d)
jobs.description: #### **Description** QuantumDiamonds is looking for an exceptional **Managing Director USA** to lead the next stage of our growth in the US semiconductor market. Our quantum sensing\-based inspection systems are already being deployed with leading semiconductor players across the US, Asia, and Europe. With a growing installed base and wafer\-level evaluations progressing with major semiconductor manufacturers, we are entering an exciting new phase: scaling commercial adoption of our QDm.1 systems while bringing our technology from the failure analysis lab closer to the semiconductor production line. As Managing Director USA, you will drive both ambitions. *On one side, you will turn existing customer deployments and technical evaluations into repeatable equipment sales, strategic accounts, and long\-term partnerships. On the other side, you will help advance our lab\-to\-fab development agreements*, working with Tier 1 semiconductor manufacturers to enable wafer\-level inspection. This is not a traditional country management role. You will be our senior commercial and strategic representative in the US, combining direct customer engagement, business development, and organizational leadership. You will work closely with our founders and engineering teams in Munich, with substantial ownership of how QuantumDiamonds grows in one of our most important markets. Based in the San Francisco Bay Area, where we already have customer deployments, you will build on existing relationships, open new opportunities, and develop the local organization needed to support our expanding business. We are looking for *someone with deep semiconductor industry expertise, strong commercial instincts, and a genuine builder mentality*. Someone who can navigate complex equipment sales, engage credibly with senior engineering leaders, and turn breakthrough technology into a scalable business. #### **Who we are** Founded in 2022 as a spin\-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three\-dimensional current maps within multi\-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top\-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long\-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale \- and shaping the next chapter in chip testing. #### **Why join us?** **Picture this:** * Quantum sensors that see *inside* the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide. * Nobel\-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday. * Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on. * An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you. **Still unsure about why joining us?** * You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before. * From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds. * Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years. * You’ll be part of a high\-growth company backed by top\-tier investors. **Let’s make the invisible visible!**#### **What will you do** ### **Own commercial growth of our lab systems** * Own the US commercial strategy for our lab systems, called QDm.1, turning existing installations, customer evaluations, and market interest into repeatable equipment sales. * Develop and expand strategic accounts across semiconductor manufacturers, advanced packaging companies, failure analysis labs, and other relevant customers. * Lead complex equipment sales cycles, from initial engagement and technical qualification through commercial negotiations, purchase orders, and follow\-on business. * Build strong relationships with technical decision\-makers, budget owners, and procurement teams, understanding what drives investment decisions and how to move opportunities forward. * Develop a reliable sales pipeline, clear account plans, and realistic forecasts, with accountability for commercial performance and revenue growth. * Identify opportunities to expand our installed base through additional systems, new customer sites, and broader adoption within existing accounts. * Work closely hand\-in\-hand with existing local distributors for cross\- and upselling opportunities ### **Own existing JDAs with Tier 1 US chipmakers moving from lab to fab** * Strengthen relationships with leading US semiconductor manufacturers to advance technical evaluations and identify commercially relevant use cases. * Work closely with Applications, Engineering, and Product Development to align customer requirements, evaluation milestones uctor industry**, ideally within semiconductor capital equipment, metrology, inspection, test, or failure analysis. * **Proven success selling complex semiconductor equipment**, including managing long sales cycles, strategic customer evaluations, technical qualifications, and multimillion\-dollar commercial opportunities. * Strong understanding of semiconductor manufacturing and advanced packaging technologies, including HBM, chiplets, 2\.5D/3D integration, or related electrical failure analysis and debug workflows. * Familiarity with semiconductor fabs, wafer\-level processes, or inline inspection and metrology, with the ability to understand how new technologies move from technical evaluation towards manufacturing adoption. * An established network within the US semiconductor ecosystem, with relationships among relevant technical leaders, engineering decision\-makers, and strategic accounts. * Demonstrated ability to grow strategic accounts, build commercial pipelines, and convert early customer interest into sustained business. * Experience building or scaling a business, commercial organization, or customer\-facing team, ideally within an international technology or semiconductor equipment company. * Sufficient technical depth to engage credibly with semiconductor engineers, applications specialists, and R\&D teams, while translating complex technology into compelling commercial value. * Entrepreneurial mindset and a hands\-on leadership style, with the ability to operate effectively in a fast\-growing company where structures and processes are still evolving. * Strong commercial judgment, negotiation skills, and the ability to navigate complex customer organizations and stakeholder environments. * Excellent communication and relationship\-building skills, with the confidence to represent QuantumDiamonds at senior executive level and collaborate closely with our Munich headquarters. * **Based in or willing to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area**, with flexibility to travel frequently across the US and regularly to our headquarters in Munich. #### **Our benefits** * **Mission:** At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products \- we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual. * **Impact \& growth:** This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast. * **Team \& culture:** We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off\-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment. * **Well\-being \& balance:** Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation annually, in addition to US company\-observed public holidays. We also offer a flexible paid sick leave policy, because taking care of your health should never come at the expense of your vacation days. * **Learning \& development:** Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills. * **Ownership \& participation:** As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together. #### **About us** QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen\-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2\.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing\-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

jobs.description: Why RTI RTI International is an independent, scientific research institute dedicated to improving the human condition. Our vision is to address the world's most critical problems with technical and science\-based solutions in pursuit of a better future. Clients rely on us to answer questions that demand an objective and multidisciplinary approach—one that integrates expertise across social, statistical, data, and laboratory sciences, engineering, and other technical disciplines to solve the world’s most challenging problems. We believe in the promise of science and technical solutions, and we push ourselves every day to deliver on that promise for the good of people, communities, and businesses in the US and around the world. If you are looking for the opportunity to make a real difference, RTI is the place for you. About the Hiring Group A Data Scientist with deep expertise across one or more areas of advanced analytics, spanning artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML), generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs), and natural language processing (NLP) who applies these capabilities to solve problems across the diverse domains where RTI operates, particularly across the full spectrum of health research, from epidemiology, survey research, and public health surveillance to toxicology and molecular\-level drug discovery, along with social science, environmental research, economics, and defense. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About Re:Build** At Re:Build, our mission is to ensure the next generation of important products are made, at scale, in America. We are laying the foundation for a better future for our customers, employees, and communities by revitalizing America's manufacturing base and creating meaningful jobs across the country, including in historically deindustrialized regions. We operate an advanced, end\-to\-end manufacturing platform that partners with industrial companies and innovators to take products from first concept to full\-scale production in critical verticals including aerospace and defense, electrification, medical, energy and environment, and robotics and automation. It's guided by The Re:Build Way, 16 principles that shape how we collaborate with each other, partner with our customers and vendors, and contribute to the communities where we operate. *(link to* The Re:Build Way principles*)* **Who we are looking for** -------------------------- The Forward Deployed Engineer will be embedded with one of our harness manufacturing plants, and support the day\-to\-day running of Cadonix's harness manufacturing software at that facility. Working directly with the plant's production, engineering, and quality teams, they resolve local issues quickly. They keep collaborators informed and build relationships that make the plant a true partner in improving the system. Drawing on hands\-on AWS cloud development experience, they build and maintain the scripts, integrations and tools that support site operations, and act as a liaison to the Cadonix development team for feature enhancements and change requests. **What you get to do** * On\-Site Production Support – Act as the first point of contact for smartBuild at the plant. Triage, diagnose and resolve issues with the software, its configuration, data, integrations and connected shop\-floor hardware (e.g. workstations, terminals, scanners, label printers), prioritizing anything that affects production output. * Customer Engagement – Works effectively with remote Product, Development and QA teams across time zones, and alongside a senior Forward Deployed Engineer on site, taking on guidance and sharing workload. * Customer Liaison \& Change Requests – Work with plant collaborators to understand their manufacturing processes and difficulties. Capture feature improvements and modification requests as clear, prioritized requirements. Review these with the Cadonix Product and Development teams. Support user acceptance testing on site before new features roll out. * Cloud Development \& Tooling – Develop and maintain scripts, integrations, reports and small tools on AWS that facilitate site operations, following the development team's standards for code review, testing and deployment. * Blocking Issue \& Root Cause Analysis – Bring up defects to the development team with reproducible steps, logs and business impact. Track issues through to resolution, verify fixes on site, and lead root\-cause analysis for recurring or high\-impact problems. * Training \& Documentation – Train and support operators, supervisors and engineers on the system. Maintain site\-specific procedures, runbooks and a knowledge base so common issues are resolved quickly and consistently. **What you bring to the Team** * A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical or Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience combined with education. * 3–5 years' experience in software development, support or implementation * Understanding of production environments and shop\-floor workflows. * Experience engaging directly with customers * Hands\-on experience building and deploying applications on AWS (e.g. Lambda, EC2, S3, RDS, API Gateway, CloudWatch, IAM). * Proficient in Python, TypeScript/JavaScript or C\# * Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases, Windows and Linux environments, and web\-based applications and APIs. * Familiar with Git, CI/CD and infrastructure as code. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for annual incentive compensation and/or long\-term incentives, subject to Company plans. jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer I, Stage Forming
jobs.description: At Relativity Space, we're building rockets to serve today's needs and tomorrow's breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that's just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known. Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven't been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you're in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you'll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we're writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it's early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us. **About the Team:** The Stage Manufacturing team turns design into reality, owning the build of Terran R's primary structures. This isn't about turning the same bolt every day; it's about building the systems to build the rocket. Engineers and technicians work side by side, with deep collaboration and real\-time feedback, to shape how we build better and faster. With a manifest and a launch date, it's up to the team to deliver on Terran R: solving challenges in real time, optimizing for scale, and constantly improving processes. As the vehicle evolves, so will the factory, with opportunities to apply automation, machine learning, and advanced technologies. What we build here sets the blueprint for the future of scaled launch. **About the Role:** * Own Forming operations within the work center, being responsible for delivery of all formed products and improving both roll forming and press brake process * Bring online a press brake work center and lead the development effort for the company to be capable of forming up to 20' sheets of material for our rocket primary structure * Create work instructions, specifications, and best practices across multiple high\-fidelity processes * Help standardize processes across the manufacturing team * Support the shop floor through live issue resolution and provide upstream feedback as we innovate the next generation of manufacturing technology * Provide Design for Manufacturing feedback to structures teams during the development phase and through the first prototype and flight builds **About You:** * Bachelor's degree in manufacturing, mechanical engineering, or other engineering discipline * 1\+ years progressive and related experience required, including internship experience * A history of improving manufacturing processes and the ability to independently identify and lead development projects needed to meet processing requirements * Strong engineering fundamentals in process improvement, forming, metallic processing, mechanics of materials * Deep knowledge of common metallic manufacturing processes, tools, inspection methods and GD\&T * Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to interface with engineering and manufacturing groups to understand process constraints and provide design inputs for improved manufacturability * Strong 3D \& 2D design/drafting skills per ASME Y14\.5M (NX preferred) **Nice to have, but not required:** * Direct experience with roll forming and press brake forming aluminum alloys * New product introduction of an aerospace hardware system into a manufacturing, test, and production system with proven success * Experience in managing projects in a fast\-paced environment **We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.** ***If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact us at*** ***accommodations@relativityspace.com******.*** ***Please note: Relativity Space does not accept unsolicited resumes, candidate profiles, or referrals from recruitment agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited submission \- via email, our website, social media, or directly to an employee \- will be deemed the property of Relativity Space, and no fee will be owed absent a current, fully executed agreement with Talent Acquisition that specifically authorizes submissions for the applicable role.***

jobs.title: Staff Application Security Engineer
jobs.description: At Reltio®, an SAP Company, we believe data should fuel your success in the enterprise AI era. Our Context Intelligence Platform turns fragmented data into a trusted, connected context so AI agents and systems can act with expert\-level judgement at enterprise scale. Reltio's cloud\-native SaaS platform harmonizes, unifies, and governs data across sources and formats—including unstructured data—in real time, turning them into data assets that can be mobilized in milliseconds to any application, user, or AI agent. Trusted by more than 200 of the world's largest brands across industries such as life sciences, financial services, healthcare, and technology, we fuel frictionless operations and help enterprises accelerate innovation and reduce risk. At Reltio, our values guide everything we do. With an unyielding commitment to prioritizing our "Customer First", we strive to ensure their success. We embrace our differences and are "Better Together" as One Reltio. We are always looking to "Simplify and Share" our knowledge when we collaborate to remove obstacles for each other. We hold ourselves accountable for our actions and outcomes and strive for excellence. We "Own It". Every day, we innovate and evolve, so that today is "Always Better Than Yesterday". If you share and embody these values, we invite you to join our team at Reltio and contribute to our mission of excellence. Reltio has earned numerous awards and industry and analyst recognition for our technology, our culture and our people. Reltio was founded on a distributed workforce and offers flexible work arrangements to help our people manage their personal and professional lives. If you're ready to work on unrivaled technology where your desire to be part of a collaborative team is met with a laser\-focused mission to enable digital transformation with connected data, let's talk! **Job Summary:** As a senior individual contributor on the Application Security team, the Staff Application Security Engineer will help to define and drive Reltio's application and product security architecture across a distributed, cloud\-native SaaS platform. This role helps in the technical direction for securing how Reltio designs, builds, and ships software—helps to define the strategy and roadmap for secure SDLC, shift\-left automation, and the secure adoption of API\-driven and AI/agentic technologies. The Staff Application Security Engineer will partner with the Engineering, DevOps, Product, and Release Management teams to embed security as a foundational part of software design and delivery. The successful candidate will set standards, mentor and uplevel other security and engineering staff, lead complex threat modeling and architecture reviews, and develop novel techniques to identify and stop application\- and AI\-layer attacks—protecting Reltio's intellectual property and customer data globally. **Job Duties and Responsibilities:** **Security Architecture \& Technical Leadership** * Serve as the senior application security subject matter expert, providing guidance on industry best practices, secure design patterns, and defense\-in\-depth strategies for the product security architecture. * Helps to define and drive the overall application/product security architecture, vision, strategy, and roadmap across Reltio's platform and services. * Influence engineering architecture and roadmap decisions without direct authority, driving risk\-based consensus across teams. * Mentor and uplevel application security engineers and development teams, raising the secure\-coding maturity of the broader organization. **Secure Development Lifecycle \& Shift\-Left** * Embed security throughout the SDLC, from design through deployment, and define secure coding standards and best practices adopted across teams. * Drive shift\-left initiatives by providing guidance, tooling, paved\-road patterns, and remediation support that enable engineers to build securely from the outset. **CI/CD Pipeline Security** * Design and implement security controls within CI/CD pipelines, enabling automated security testing and vulnerability detection at scale. * Operationalize SAST, SCA, DAST, and secrets scanning as policy\-driven, low\-friction gates; partner with release management on secure deployment checks and policy compliance. **Threat Modeling \& Risk Assessment** * Lead threat modeling sessions for complex, high\-impact systems to identify and mitigate security risks early in design and architecture phases. * Perform technical risk assessments of new technology and ensure solutions meet secure architecture designs; assess, measure, and clearly communicate risk impact to stakeholders. **Vulnerability Management** * Analyze and validate remediation of application security findings from SAST, SCA, DAST, API testing, penetration tests, and manual assessments. * Drive risk\-based prioritization of fixes, reduce false positives, and provide clear, actionable remediation guidance with proper pre\-release  /agent penetration testing; build and curate test payloads (including prompt\-injection and guardrail bypass suites) and validate control effectiveness. **Training, Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement** * Deliver secure\-coding, API, and AI\-security guidance and hands\-on support during code and design reviews. * Partner with DevOps, QA, Engineering, Product, and Release Management to integrate security requirements throughout development and release. * Stay current on emerging application, API, and AI/agentic security threats and continuously improve security processes, tooling, and overall posture. * Investigate security events and incidents leveraging security tooling, and support customer\-facing security communications as needed. **Skills You Must Have:** * 8\+ years of experience in application security or software development, including significant time in a cloud\-native or SaaS environment. * Demonstrated technical leadership as a senior individual contributor: setting standards, driving cross\-team initiatives, and influencing architecture without direct authority. * Hands\-on experience with secure coding practices and modern application development; proficiency leading secure code reviews. * Strong understanding of cloud well\-architected frameworks, application development, and deployment workflows. * Strong understanding of application security vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10\) and prevention strategies. * Strong understanding of API security principles and the OWASP API Top 10\. * Experience integrating security into CI/CD and release management processes (e.g., Jenkins, ArgoCD, or similar). * Experience with application security testing methodologies—SAST, SCA, and DAST—integrated into CI/CD pipelines. * Experience with AI security concepts, including guardrails, prompt and output validation, data protection, and MCP security. * Hands\-on experience with web technologies such as Java, Java Spring Boot, JavaScript, Node.js, C\#, modern UI frameworks, microservices, and cloud\-native/serverless architectures. * Experience with AWS, GCP, and/or Azure, and securing containerized environments and Kubernetes. * Hands\-on experience with Burp Suite Pro for web and API testing. * Experience with modern application security platforms, with Wiz preferred (other AppSec tools acceptable). * Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to educate, collaborate, and drive risk\-based consensus. * Self\-starter with a history of driving technical initiatives; adaptable, agile, and effective in global, distributed teams. **Skills That Are Nice to Have:** * Hands\-on experience securing LLM applications and multi\-agent systems, including agentic guardrail frameworks (e.g., NeMo Guardrails, AWS Bedrock Guardrails) and MCP gateway/tool security. * Experience building or operationalizing AppSec automation/orchestration (SAST/SCA/secrets \+ AI analysis) and defect\-management integration (e.g., DefectDojo). * Experience with commercial AppSec/SCA platforms such as Wiz Code, Veracode, Checkmarx, Cycode, or SonarQube. * Experience developing and operationalizing a vulnerability management or product security program at scale. * Experience with industry frameworks such as SOC 2, HITRUST, or ISO 27001, and supporting audit/customer\-assurance processes. * Applying ML/AI techniques to enhance security detection, anomaly identification, and automated risk prioritization. * Relevant security and cloud certifications. *Reltio is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. activities. **Additional Information** What We Offer * Opportunity to shape the system architecture of next\-generation industrial and/or defense drone solutions. * High technical ownership and jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer ll
jobs.description: **Build reliability into the products people depend on.** At Resmed, we’re looking for a **Site Reliability Engineer** to improve the reliability, performance, and operability of our customer\-facing digital health products. This is a hands\-on role where you’ll move between software engineering, cloud infrastructure, observability, incident response, performance engineering, and release readiness to make meaningful improvements to production systems. You’ll work closely with Product Development, SRE, DevX, Security, and platform teams, helping engineers identify reliability risks earlier and address them directly in application and service code. The goal goes beyond monitoring. You’ll help create services that perform better under load, recover more effectively, and are easier for teams to operate and support in production. **What You'll Do** * Partner with product development teams to improve the reliability, scalability, and performance of applications and services directly through code. * Identify and help resolve production issues involving latency, resiliency, service dependencies, failure handling, capacity, and system behaviour under load. * Build and improve observability using Datadog, logs, metrics, traces, APM, cloud telemetry, dashboards, and alerts to create greater visibility into production behaviour. * Support production readiness for new features, releases, migrations, and other customer\-impacting changes, helping teams identify risks before they reach production. * Use production data to help define practical SLIs, SLOs, alerting thresholds, and reliability priorities that reflect real service behaviour. * Drive performance engineering activities including profiling, load testing, bottleneck analysis, capacity planning, performance monitoring, and regression detection. * Improve incident response practices, runbooks, alert quality, post\-incident actions, and the resolution of recurring production problems. * Help engineering teams design and evolve services that are easier to operate, troubleshoot, scale, recover, and support in production. Surface reliability and performance risks earlier, helping teams make durable improvements at both the code and architecture level rather than relying only on dashboards and alerts. * **What You Bring** * Three or more years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Production Engineering, Platform Engineering, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, or a related field. * Hands\-on experience operating Kubernetes or another container orchestration platform in production. * Experience supporting distributed, customer\-facing applications in AWS or a comparable public cloud environment. * Experience with production monitoring, alerting, logging, and dashboarding. * Experience troubleshooting application, container, network, and infrastructure issues. * Experience building internal operational tools or developer self\-service workflows. * Familiarity with SLIs, SLOs, availability, latency, throughput, error rates, and resource saturation. * Experience participating in production incident response or an on\-call rotation. * Ability to automate operational work using Python, Go, Bash, or another relevant language. Strong written and verbal communication skills. * ***Nice to have*** * Experience with distributed tracing and modern observability practices. * Familiarity with cloud cost optimization and container resource efficiency. Experience with performance engineering, including load testing, capacity analysis, performance monitoring, or bottleneck identification. * **What Sets You Apart** * Reliability mindset: You look beyond a single incident or alert to understand underlying service behaviour and help prevent recurring production problems. * Hands\-on ownership: You’re comfortable moving between code, infrastructure, observability data, incidents, and release readiness to get to the root of a problem. * Performance focus: You think about how systems behave under real\-world load and look for opportunities to improve resiliency, capacity, and performance. * Collaborative approach: You work across engineering disciplines to surface risks early and help teams make practical, durable reliability improvements. Operational thinking: You consider how services will be monitored, troubleshot, scaled, recovered, and supported as part of how they should be designed. * **Why Join Resmed** This is an opportunity to shape reliability where it matters most: within the customer\-facing digital health products people depend on. At Resmed, your work will help product teams find risks earlier, reduce recurring production issues, strengthen performance, and build services that are easier to operate and support. Rather than treating reliability as something that happens after software reaches production, you’ll help make it part of how services are designed, developed, released, and continuously improved. It’s hands\-on engineering work with a clear purpose: contributing to digital health products while supporting Resmed’s mission of helping people breathe better and live healthier, longer lives . **Benefits and Compensation** At Resmed, we're shaping the future by investing in our people through competitive pay, flexible work arrangements, and programs that support personal and professional growth. **Benefits include:** * Medical, dental, vision, life, AD\&D, and disability insurance * HSA, FSA, commuter benefits, and sleep care management * 401(k), ESPP, EAP, and tuition assistance * Flex time off for salaried employees * 11 paid holidays plus 3 floating holidays Up to 14 weeks primary caregiver leave or 2 weeks secondary caregiver leave * **Compensation:** Compensation is based on factors including geographic location, qualifications, experience, skills, and internal equity. **Pay Range:** $124,000 \- $186,000 USD Annual ***Resmed generally does not hire at or near the top of the pay range.*** For remote positions outside the U.S., compensation is determined based on geographic location, qualifications, experience, and skills. Joining us is more than saying “yes” to making the world a healthier place. It’s discovering a career that’s challenging, supportive and inspiring. Where a culture driven by excellence helps you not only meet your goals, but also create new ones. We focus on creating a diverse and inclusive culture, encouraging individual expression in the workplace and thrive on the innovative ideas this generates. If this sounds like the workplace for you, apply now! We commit to respond to every applicant.

jobs.title: Solution Engineer
jobs.description: At Rhoda AI, we’re building the next generation of generalist intelligent robots. We own the full robotics stack from high\-performance hardware and robot systems to the infrastructure and state\-of\-the\-art foundation world models that control our robots. Our robots are designed to be generalists capable of operating in complex, real\-world environments and handling long\-tail edge cases, made possible by our cutting edge research and end\-to\-end system design. We've raised over $450M and are investing aggressively in model research, infrastructure, hardware development, and manufacturing scale\-up to make generalist robotics a reality. **About the Application Engineering Team** ------------------------------------------ Application Engineering is where Rhoda's AI meets the real world. We work directly with customers to understand their operational problems, determine where our platform can deliver value, and lead the application of Rhoda's AI model end to end — from model post\-training and data collection, to robot tooling and work\-cell design, to production deployments on the customer's floor. The team sits at the intersection of engineering, product, deployment operations, and business, with members in the US and Germany. Application Engineering is organized into three complementary roles — Application Engineers, Solution Engineers, and Technical Program Managers — who share ownership of every production deployment. **The Role** ------------ As a Solution Engineer, you own the systems\-engineering work that turns a successful POC into a production deployment. Taking the lead once a customer issues a purchase order, you'll translate customer requirements into a production solution, design the workflow and work cell, and integrate Rhoda's robots and AI model with the customer's environment — sensors, conveyors, PLCs, and MES. You'll carry the solution through Factory Acceptance Testing, commissioning, and Site Acceptance Testing. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Gather, define, and negotiate customer requirements for production, including throughput, uptime, safety, and acceptance criteria. * Conduct feasibility analysis (including simulation) and provide proposal review and feedback during the PO stage. * Design production workflows and work cells, including layout, safety, material flow, and operator interaction. * Lead system integration planning with the customer environment — sensors, conveyors, PLCs, MES, and other plant systems. * Integrate Rhoda's AI model with task\-related tooling and partner with Application Engineers on task engineering and strategy. * Own the overall solution strategy and author workflow SOPs for production operations. * Define solution requirements, shaping both product and site readiness ahead of the deployment. * Measure and report system performance through FAT and SAT, and support on\-site commissioning. * Feed production learnings back to product and engineering to shape the roadmap. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * BS or MS in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, Industrial, or Robotics Engineering, or a related field. * 5\+ years of experience designing and deploying automation or robotic systems in manufacturing or logistics environments. * Hands\-on experience with industrial controls and integration: PLCs, industrial networking and protocols (e.g., OPC UA, Profinet, EtherNet/IP), sensors, and conveyors. * Experience integrating with MES or other plant\-level systems. * Strong understanding of work\-cell design, machine safety standards, and risk assessment. * Track record of taking systems through FAT, commissioning, and SAT. * Ability to translate ambiguous customer needs into clear technical requirements and designs. * Willingness to travel to customer sites (domestic and international). **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience at a systems integrator or robotics OEM. * Experience with simulation tools for work cell design and throughput analysis. * Exposure to AI\- or vision\-based robotic systems. * Familiarity with both US and European safety and compliance requirements. Compensation Range: $175K \- $250K
