jobs.description: **About Rippling** ------------------ Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds. Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses. **About the IT Product Team** ----------------------------- The IT Product Engineering team is critical to unifying Rippling's workforce management system, bridging the gap between HR and traditional IT administration. Our mission is to build software that enables businesses to manage employee devices, applications, and access security automatically, leveraging Rippling's single source of employee truth (the HRIS). We automate the complexity of IT management from the moment a new employee is hired to the moment they offboard. ### **What We Build** We build the mission\-critical software that simplifies IT for organizations, turning complex, manual processes into simple, one\-click solutions. Our core product domains include: * **Device Management (MDM):** Developing systems to securely enroll, configure, manage, and inventory corporate devices (macOS, Windows, iOS, etc.), including policy enforcement and remote wipe capabilities. * **App Management \& Identity:** Creating the centralized platform for provisioning and de\-provisioning employee access to hundreds of third\-party SaaS applications, ensuring instant security and compliance through integrated identity and access management (IAM). * **Inventory \& Asset Management:** Building the core financial and logistical systems to track physical assets, manage software licenses, and automate IT procurement from device ordering to deployment. * **Security \& Compliance:** Developing the mechanisms for setting, managing, and enforcing security policies across all devices and applications, ensuring employee and corporate data remain protected. **What you will do** -------------------- * Design and implement features with an emphasis on backend logic, API development, and data integrity, while also contributing to the frontend implementation. * Work across the stack, focusing on API design, event modeling, and robust data management while ensuring a seamless connection to the user interface. * Own the full development lifecycle for features, ensuring that the backend architecture supports both reliable functionality and excellent frontend performance. * Work closely with cross\-functional partners to understand requirements, refine technical scope, and drive successful, reliable feature delivery. **What you will need** ---------------------- * 2\+ years of professional experience with a focus on full\-stack development, demonstrating the ability to deliver reliable, end\-to\-end products using a backend language (e.g., Python/Go) and frontend technologies like React/TypeScript. * Prioritize projects based on business impact, ensuring high\-quality implementation without unnecessary complexity. * Ability to thrive in dynamic environments, quickly switching context between frontend and backend work as needed to accelerate delivery. * Excellent skills in communicating technical trade\-offs across the stack with clarity and precision to both frontend and backend partners. **Additional Information** -------------------------- Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role. Bicep, or Azure Resource Manager templates. * Promote cloud security best practices and compliance requirements for gaming infrastructure. * Design and develop CI/CD pipelines for builds and deployments. * Respond to live support issues for a live\-service game. * Empower multiple teams through development environment automation. **Requirements** * Four (4\) years of professional experience with Microsoft Azure. * Experience scripting with languages like Python, PowerShell, or Groovy. * Experience with containerization and orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes). * applications (DataDog, CloudWatch, Prometheus) * Ability to debug unexpected issues that arise during development. * Willingness to selflessly put player experiences first before even your own code Jenkins, TeamCity, or Azure DevOps, specifically for game development projects. * Experience working with additional cloud providers (e.g., AWS, GCP). * Knowledge of game development workflows and jobs.title: Senior full-stack engineer
jobs.description: **About the role** We're hiring a senior full\-stack engineer to lead day\-to\-day development of Opportunity Tracker, our construction opportunity\-management platform. The application helps teams manage leads, evaluate which opportunities to pursue, coordinate work, and track pricing and decisions. You'll lead development of Opportunity Tracker, building new features and improving the application as customer needs evolve. You'll help shape technical decisions and support other engineers through code reviews and shared problem\-solving. You'll work alongside our engineering and implementation team and help guide technical decisions as we grow. **What you'll do** * Build and maintain features across the React frontend, TypeScript backend, and PostgreSQL database. * Take work from understanding the problem through implementation, testing, review, and release follow\-up. * Turn customer needs and team feedback into practical product improvements. * Learn the product's business workflows so your technical decisions support how customers actually work. * Identify bugs, technical risks, and maintainability problems, then propose practical ways to address them. * Help shape the application's architecture and keep it running reliably. * Protect customer data through careful authorization, tenant isolation, validation, and database changes. * Review code, explain decisions, and help other engineers improve. **What we're looking for** You have experience building and maintaining production web applications across the full stack. You're comfortable working in an existing codebase, understanding its design, and improving it without rewriting it unnecessarily. You should bring: * Strong TypeScript and React experience, including forms, data fetching, and complex application workflows. * Experience building backend services and APIs with Node.js or a comparable backend platform. * Solid relational database skills, including SQL, data modeling, migrations, and transactions. * An understanding of authentication, authorization, and protecting data in applications used by multiple customer organizations. * Experience testing features, diagnosing problems, and supporting software after release. * Clear communication about technical decisions, uncertainty, and delivery risks. We value initiative and sound judgment. You ask questions when requirements are unclear, understand the problem before implementing a solution, and follow through without needing every step prescribed. When you spot an issue outside your immediate task, you raise it and help decide what should happen next. You stay organized, take feedback well, and keep developing your engineering skills. You're curious about changes in software development and can distinguish a useful tool or technique from something that adds complexity without solving a real problem. **Our stack** We use TypeScript across a React frontend and Node.js backend, with PostgreSQL and AWS. Our tools include Fastify, tRPC, Drizzle ORM, Docker, Terraform, and GitHub Actions. You don't need experience with every tool we use. Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn matter more than an exact stack match. Experience with multi\-tenant business applications is especially relevant. **Location and benefits** This is a full\-time, in\-person role based in Canonsburg, PA. You'll work on\-site with our team. This role is not remote or hybrid. Benefits include: * 401(k). * Health, dental, and vision benefits, with reimbursement toward coverage you choose. * Paid time off and holidays. The anticipated base salary range is $100,000–$150,000 annually, depending on relevant experience and qualifications. Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid holidays * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

At a minimum, engineers are required to have the following: * Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science Engineering, or related field. SMT Corp would prefer that candidates have the following: * Master’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science Engineering, or related field. * Experience with designing and laying out PCB test fixtures for electronic components. * Experience with National Instruments LabView software to control and automate electronic component testing. * Experience with complex digital device such as FPGAs, Microprocessors, and Microcontrollers. * Experience with Advantest test equipment and software. Company Overview: About SMT Corp. Based in Sandy Hook, CT and founded in 1998, SMT Corp. is the industry leader for sourcing and authentication of DMSMS, obsolete and hard\-to\-find electronics components for Aerospace, Defense and critical infrastructure. SMT Corp. is an accredited and recognized expert with full on\-site authentication and electrical testing services to mitigate the risk of counterfeit, cloned, altered or substandard products from entering the critical systems supply chain. With more than a half\-billion components in stock representing over 1,200 major component manufacturers, SMT Corp. maintains one of the largest “ready to ship” electronic component inventories in the world. Come join a growing company with a commitment to provide our customers the highest quality products and services, competitive pricing, and fastest response time in the industry. jobs.description: **Who we are** Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video\-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. **About the role:** Want to build the data foundation powering AI and self\-serve analytics at scale? You will architect core Databricks pipelines, Gold Layer tables, and semantic models, turning ambitious, ambiguous business challenges into high\-value data products, autonomous agents, and cross\-functional automation. This role is open to candidates residing in the US. **You should apply if:** * **You want to impact the industries that run our world:** Your efforts will result in real\-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. * **You are the architect of your own career:** If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment. * **You're energized by our opportunity:** The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers. * **You want to be with the best:** At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. Youwill be surrounded by a high\-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best. **In this role, you will:** * Partner on defining the strategy and multi\-quarter roadmap for MDA's data and AI foundation. * Architect and own Samsara's marketing data infrastructure: ETL/ELT pipelines, Databricks Gold Layer tables, and the core data models that power segmentation, targeting, automation, and analytics. * Design the semantic layers, data dictionaries, and structured documentation that enable self\-serve BI and conversational analytics, partnering with the BI team to ensure core sales and marketing KPIs are built on trusted, well\-modeled data. * Translate ambiguous business questions from Marketing, Sales, and R\&D into clear requirements and scalable solutions, working autonomously without dedicated PM support and influencing decisions with data and sound reasoning. * Lead complex, cross\-team initiatives end to end: stand up new data pipelines and integrations quickly, manage risk across interdependent teams, and own the reliability and data quality of what ships. * Serve as the senior technical lead for the team's hardest problems: raise the bar for engineering quality and code review, remove bottlenecks that slow multiple teams, and mentor engineers and analysts. * Drive the strategic use of AI to solve ambiguous, high\-impact problems: build AI\-enabled data products and agents, with the integrations, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation practices that keep them reliable and trustworthy. * Identify and automate manual workflows with AI across Marketing and GTM teams, taking ideas from concept to prototype to production and influencing org roadmaps. * Ship high\-quality Python and SQL, increasingly by directing agentic coding tools, while holding a high bar for reviewing and verifying AI\-generated work before it reaches production. * Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices. **Minimum requirements for the role:** * 8\+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or AI engineering, including deep hands\-on data engineering experience. * Expert\-level Python and SQL, with strong hands\-on data modeling and DBT experience. * Deep experience with data warehouse and lakehouse architectures, ETL/ELT, and the modern data stack, including hands\-on Databricks (or similar, such as Snowflake or BigQuery).  re engineering background beyond data or AI engineering, with a track record of turning ambiguous, unfamiliar problems into well\-architected, delivered solutions. * Expertise in data visualization and building dashboards for sales and marketing KPIs. * Familiarity with go\-to\-market data and systems: CRM (e.g., Salesforce), marketing automation, web analytics, and MarTech tools. * Experience building interactive applications with Streamlit, Claude workflows, or web frameworks. * Data science, machine learning, or predictive analytics experience. * Comfort working in an exploratory environment, testing and iterating on new data sources and methodologies. **Total Rewards** At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high\-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above\-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance\-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high\-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above\-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long\-term success: a flexible, employee\-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **SUMMARY:** The AI Engineer makes Saturn's data decision\-ready. The role builds one reliable data foundation across SAP S/4HANA, Ignition, Excel, and external market data, automates the reporting produced from it, and applies AI so that management receives analysis and recommendations directly, without the manual collecting, reconciling, and formatting steps in between. The role reports to the CFO and works with the Executive and Plant Leadership Teams. It is a hands\-on position: the incumbent builds the data models, reports, and AI solutions personally and is accountable for their accuracy. The role also makes the wider organization AI\-ready by raising data quality at the source, building skills across the functions, and setting the rules for responsible use of data and AI. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** include the following. Other duties may be assigned.**Data Quality and the Data Foundation*** Make high\-quality base data an organizational standard: define entry rules, master data discipline, and data quality measurement together with the functions, which remain accountable for the accuracy of the data they create. * Build and operate one data foundation that connects SAP S/4HANA, Ignition and production systems, Excel\-based sources, and external market data such as Nielsen, as a Single Source of Truth. * Establish consistent KPI and master data definitions and documented calculation logic, so that every report and every AI answer uses the same numbers. * Work with the functions to eliminate the causes of poor data rather than correcting data downstream. **Automated Reporting for Decision\-Making*** Automate the recurring executive and plant reporting so that management information is produced without manual collecting, reconciling, or formatting. * Inventory existing reporting, consolidate duplicates, and retire the manual spreadsheets that automated reporting replaces. * Deliver executive\-level output: few, clear views showing performance, drivers, and recommended action, so that leadership receives decisions to make rather than data to process. * Use AI to generate commentary, variance explanations, and meeting\-ready summaries from the underlying data, with human review before release. **Forward\-Looking Analytics*** Move reporting from describing the past to anticipating the future: forecasting, scenario and sensitivity analysis, and early\-warning indicators. * Apply AI and statistical methods across all available data \- financial, operational, machine, quality, and market \- to identify trends, anomalies, and predictive maintenance opportunities. * Quantify the financial impact of operational trends so that leadership sees the P\&L consequence, not only the metric. **AI Solutions and Automation*** Identify, prioritize, and implement AI and automation use cases across all functions, each with a business case and a measured benefit. * Build and maintain AI agents and automated workflows that connect to Saturn's systems and perform real work, rather than standalone chat usage. * Test and monitor the quality of AI output, and keep a human accountable for every decision. **Making the Organization AI\-Ready*** Build data and AI capability across the organization: train and coach employees at all levels in the practical, day\-to\-day use of AI, reporting, and automation tools. * Identify where AI changes how work is done, and lead the change so that new ways of working are adopted and the replaced routines are retired. * Make company knowledge and process documentation structured, current, and retrievable, so that both employees and AI systems can use it. * Set and maintain the rules for responsible use of data and AI, aligned with heristo group policy and recognized frameworks such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001, and the EU AI Act, including protection of customer\- and partner\-confidential data from external AI services. **ERP and Process Optimization*** Support the optimization of SAP S/4HANA and related business processes, ensuring that data, reporting, AI, and automation requirements are built into the system landscape. * Partner with KAM serv.it, PMO IT saturn petcare, functional teams, and external providers as the business\-to\-IT translator, and support process mapping and process mining. **Supervisory Responsibilities:** None**Qualifications:** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.**Education and/or Experience:*** Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field; master's degree preferred. Equivalent demonstrated capability may be considered. * 5\+ years of hands\-on expe ge\-management skills, including the ability to present to executives. Candidates should be prepared to present examples of their own work. **Computer and Technology Skills \- Required:*** SQL at a working level: able to query, model, and transform data independently. * Advanced Excel and advanced proficiency in a modern business intelligence platform (Power BI preferred; SAP Analytics Cloud an advantage), including data modeling. * Practical experience extracting and modeling data from an ERP system, preferably SAP S/4HANA. * Hands\-on application of generative AI in a business setting: AI agents, workflow automation, retrieval over company documents, and the judgment to know where AI should and should not be used. **Computer and Technology Skills \- Preferred:*** Python, or an equivalent language, for data processing and automation. * Industrial and machine data: Ignition, historians, MES, OPC\-UA or MQTT. * A modern data platform such as Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, SAP Datasphere, or SAP Business Data Cloud. * Statistical forecasting or machine learning; process mining tools such as Signavio or Celonis; familiarity with AI governance frameworks. **Language Skills:** Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions and procedural manuals. jobs.title: ERP Developer
jobs.description: **Job Summary:** ---------------- The ERP Developer is responsible for developing, customizing, maintaining, and optimizing Servotronics' Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system. This role combines technical development with ERP reporting and data analysis to improve business processes, automate workflows, and support data\-driven decision making. jobs.title: Jr Web Application Developer
jobs.description: ### **The Opportunity** Settlor is a fast\-growing software company focused on building innovative solutions for the title, escrow, and real estate industries. We are looking for a Junior Web Application Developer who loves solving puzzles, cares about the craft of writing good code, and is hungry to learn what enterprise software engineering really takes. You do not have to have all the answers yet, but you do need at least a year of building web applications and a genuine drive to get better every week. As a Junior Web Application Developer, your impact is immediate. Working alongside a highly collaborative team, you will ideate, build, design, and maintain the real estate applications our customers use every day. You won't be handed busywork on the edge of the product; you will ship real features, get real code review, and learn directly from the engineers who built the framework, the design patterns, and the back end of our software. Our team demonstrates and values technical thought leadership, and we expect you to grow into it. This role is your launch pad. It is the starting line to take on harder problems, own bigger pieces of the system, and grow into a senior engineer here \- assuming you are the star we are looking for . . . ! We are a small but mighty team, so there is no shortage of opportunity for someone who runs at it. Show us what you can do, and the sky is the limit. This is a hybrid position based in Denver, Colorado. Typical office hours are 8:00 AM until 5:00 PM; Monday and Thursday at home, Tuesday and Friday in the office, with Wednesday as scheduled weekly/monthly. ### **Why Join Settlor?** * **Impact**: Your work directly influences our customers' experience with our platform and our company and is foundational to our long\-term growth and evolution. * **Culture**: A collaborative, "no\-ego" environment where we celebrate wins and learn from losses. We purposefully operate in a hybrid\-office environment because we believe in the power of teams and relationships, and we have learned that both are best built and nurtured in\-person. * **Growth**: Often hard to find in the age of A.I. and constant turnover with software engineers, we invest in professional and personal growth as demonstrated by our high\-retention of engineers who started their careers with us and have found little reason to look elsewhere. * **Customer\-Centric**: We build for the long haul by prioritizing solutions to real\-world challenges for our customers. Your work ensures we evolve in lockstep with our users' needs, creating a product they truly love and trust. * **Technical Thought Leadership**: You will work with the people who built this platform, in a codebase where architecture and design patterns are discussed openly and taken seriously. * **Self\-funded and privately\-held**: Not looking for hyper\-growth on an aggressive timeline. We want to build an organization thoughtfully and strategically, with solid processes and culture. ### **What You’ll Do** * **Feature Development**: Build, design, and maintain web applications that impact the full spectrum of the real estate industry, using modern JavaScript (Vue 3\) and Python on the back end. * **Technical Troubleshooting**: Investigate and resolve defects using sound debugging approaches, tools, and techniques, and grow your ability to anticipate problems before they ship. * **Agentic Development**: Use AI coding agents as a daily part of your workflow, with the review discipline to catch what they get wrong before it reaches a customer. * **Craft \& Code Quality**: Participate in code review as both author and reviewer, and apply the design patterns and practices the team has established. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration**: Work with product, support, and senior engineers to turn business requirements into working software. * **Domain Fluency**: Learn real estate, title, and escrow terminology well enough to reason about the problems you are solving, not just the tickets you are handed. * **Documentation**: Leave behind clear notes, comments, and documentation so the next person \- including future you \- can move quickly. ### **What You Bring** * **The "Startup Mindset"**: You are comfortable with autonomy, thrive in a fast\-paced environment, and are willing to wear multiple hats. * **Foundational Craft**: You have 1\+ years ideating, building, designing, and maintaining web applications, and you take pride in producing high\-quality deliverables. * **Technical Aptitude**: You know Vue or an equivalent JavaScript framework, and Python with FastAPI, Django, Flask, or an equivalent framework \- and you have a proven ability to pick up new tools quickly. * **Accountable Velocity**: You use agentic coding tools to move faster, and you can explain every line you ship. You know the difference between code that works and code you understand, and you don't confuse the two. * **Passion for the Craft**: You are genuinely curious about what is possible with the g the symptom in front of you. * **Collaborative Execution**: You work effectively across functions, communicate openly, take feedback constructively, and contribute to a positive, accountable team culture, even under pressure. * **Detail Discipline**: You have a sharp eye for details, catch issues before they become problems, and maintain high standards of accuracy without losing sight of broader goals. * **Ownership**: You assume responsibility for your work end to end and follow through without needing to be chased. * **Love of Data**: Our software platform is built around critical, 'system of record' data, so you need to be comfortable working with data sets and able to identify trends or gaps in them. * **Industry Context**: Experience in Real Estate Tech (PropTech) or Mortgage and Real Estate Brokerage is a plus; experience in the Title Insurance \& Escrow/Closing industry would be amazing. ### **Your Education \& Experience** We believe there are specific educational backgrounds and professional experiences necessary or strongly preferred in order to be successful in this position. Necessary: * A related bachelor's degree or commensurate experience * 1\+ years of professional experience building and maintaining production web applications * Strong working knowledge of a modern JavaScript framework and a Python web framework * Proficient in clear, professional written and verbal communication Preferred: * Production experience with Vue 3 and with FastAPI or Flask * Experience designing and maintaining RESTful APIs across internal and external integrations * Experience owning implementation decisions and technology selection on a team * Experience in real estate, mortgage, and/or banking industries Bonus Points: * Experience in the Title and Escrow industry * Experience with enterprise SaaS at multi\-tenant scale * Open\-source contributions, talks, or writing that show how you think ### **Why You’ll Love It Here** We believe you do your best work when you have the freedom to be flexible, backed by a team that's always in your corner. * **Competitive Pay**: $65,000 to $75,000 base salary * **Growth**: Rapid career progression as we scale our customer base and our company. * **Health and Wellness**: We offer full health benefits (medical, dental, and vision) and matching 401(k) retirement plans * **Work\-Life Balance**: Flexible time\-off program that empowers work\-life balance * **Dress Code**: Come as you are. Shorts, hoodies, and t\-shirts are great \- just no smelly sandals. * **Office Culture**: Background music, afternoon board games, puzzle tables, and a fully stocked snack kitchen (plus occasional breakfast burritos for good behavior!). * **Prime Location**: A quick scooter ride to RiNo, and steps away from local coffee, breweries, golf simulators, a dog park, Beat the Bomb, and Topo Designs HQ. **At this time, we are only considering applicants who are already eligible to work for any U.S. employer without company sponsorship.** We anticipate candidates with the necessary skills, background, and passion for this position to receive the base salary and benefits package as outlined above; we also appreciate that candidates with the preferred or ideal background and experience referenced above may demand more. *Settlor is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, citizenship status, color, creed, disability, ethnicity, genetic information, gender (including gender identity and gender expression), marital status, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other status or condition protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.* Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: Siteimprove is the leader in agentic content intelligence. Our platform brings accessibility, analytics, SEO/AEO, and content strategy together in one system, where AI agents work alongside marketing and digital teams to produce content that is accessible and easy to find. Every customer, user, and increasingly every AI agent that touches the Siteimprove platform goes through systems owned by the Access team: sign\-in, single sign\-on, federation with customer identity providers, and the authorization layer that decides who can see and do what. We're looking for a Software Engineer with real depth in authentication, authorization, and identity provider (IdP) systems. You'll design and build the services that secure the Siteimprove platform, work with enterprise and public\-sector customers' SSO setups, help us meet FedRAMP requirements, and shape how AI agents and machine clients authenticate against our APIs and MCP servers. This is a hands\-on role with a lot of technical ownership. You'll be one of the people others on the team, and across engineering, come to with identity questions. ### **What we will be doing** * **SSO and federation:** Build and run our login, session, MFA, and token services. Own SAML and OIDC integrations with customer IdPs (Okta, Entra ID, Ping, ADFS), from metadata and certificate rotation to enterprise edge cases. * **Provisioning:** Own the user lifecycle across SCIM, JIT provisioning, and deprovisioning. * **Authorization platform:** Evolve our centralized permissions and authorization services, including the models (RBAC, ABAC, ReBAC), APIs, and caching, so product teams get fast, consistent access decisions. * **Agent identity:** Define how AI agents, MCP servers, and integrations authenticate and get delegated, least\-privilege access through OAuth 2\.x (token exchange, scoped short\-lived tokens), with consent and auditability built in. * **Security and compliance:** Design against account takeover and token abuse. Implement FedRAMP identity controls (FAL2, signed and encrypted assertions, FIPS\-validated cryptography), and work with Security and GRC on audit evidence and addressing vulnerabilities. * **Reliability:** Raise the bar for reliability and observability on services where an outage means nobody can log in. * **Technical leadership:** Lead design reviews and build\-vs\-buy decisions, mentor engineers, and be the go\-to identity expert across engineering. * Travel may be required; a valid passport is required * Perform other duties as assigned ### **What we will require of you** * **Engineering depth:** 6\+ years of professional software engineering, with at least 3 years building or running authentication, authorization, or identity systems in production. * **Backend stack:** Strong backend skills in C\#/.NET or Java, and a willingness to work in whichever one a given service uses. * **Protocol expertise:** Deep, practical knowledge of OAuth 2\.0/2\.1, OpenID Connect, and SAML 2\.0: grant types, token formats JWT, PKCE, token lifetimes and revocation, and assertion signing and encryption. * **IdP experience:** Hands\-on experience with at least one IdP, whether in\-house, open source (such as Keycloak), or commercial (such as FusionAuth, Auth0, Okta, Entra ID, or Cognito), including integrating customer IdPs for enterprise SSO. * **Authorization design:** Experience designing authorization models and permission services that stay correct and fast at scale. * **Security mindset:** A solid grasp of identity threats (token theft and replay, session fixation, CSRF, open redirects, IdP\-initiated SSO risks) and how to design against them. * **Cloud\-native systems:** Experience building distributed services on AWS or Azure, including containers, CI/CD, and production observability. * **AI\-native delivery:** You use AI tools every day to understand code, generate tests, and ship faster. * **Clear communication:** You can explain a tricky identity trade\-off to engineers, product managers, and auditors. ### **What we will love about you** * Experience with FedRAMP, or other government compliance programs, and with NIST SP 800\-63 identity and federation assurance levels. * Experience with FIPS 140\-validated crypto modules, HSM or KMS\-backed key management, and certificate lifecycle automation. * Experience with policy engines or fine\-grained authorization systems such as OPA, Cedar, OpenFGA, or other Zanzibar\-style systems. * Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) authorization spec, OAuth token exchange, or workload identity (CIMD, IAM roles for service accounts). * Experience with SCIM 2\.0\. * Experience leading a migration between identity platforms without disrupting customers. ### **What you'll love about us** We’re building the next generation of AI\-powered content intelligence, helping organizations unify accessibility, SEO/AEO, analytics, and content performance into one platform. If you’re energized by solving complex problems, working cross\-functionally, and contributing to a product with real\-world impact, we’d love to connect.### **In addition, we hope you will appreciate:** At Siteimprove, we're committed to supporting your wellbeing both at work and beyond. Our Denmark benefits are designed to help you thrive personally and professionally. **Rest and relaxation:** Generous time off including Danish holiday entitlements, five additional FF Days, child sick leave, and bereavement leave. **Comprehensive benefits**: Health insurance, company\-paid mobile phone support, and internet allowance to support your day\-to\-day needs. **Prepare for the future**: Danica pension with employer contributions to help support your retirement goals. The base salary for this role will fall within the posted range and is determined by experience, qualifications, and location.**Siteimprove is an equal opportunity employer** All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information, or other legally protected status. Siteimprove is a global corporation that has developed data practices to ensure your personally identifiable information is appropriately protected. Please note that personal information may be transferred, accessed, and stored globally as necessary for the uses and disclosures stated in accordance with our Privacy Policy at https://siteimprove.com/en/privacy/. **FedRAMP Authorization Notice for Job Postings** This position may involve access to systems, information, or customer environments that are subject to the Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP). Where applicable, FedRAMP\-related responsibilities will be outlined in the job description. If the role includes FedRAMP\-related duties, candidates may be required to meet the following requirements: **Identity Verification:** Candidates must successfully complete federal I\-9 employment eligibility verification. **Citizenship/Residency Requirement:** Certain roles may be limited to U.S. citizens or lawful permanent residents if job duties include access to controlled systems, environments, or data. **Access Authorization:** Employment offers for applicable roles are contingent upon confirmation that the candidate meets the minimum access requirements associated with the FedRAMP authorization level required for the position. jobs.description: Company Overview Spectrix Analytical Services is seeking an Agentic Platform Engineer. This role focuses on building and operating the AWS platform that hosts AI agents, MCP servers, and agent tooling for discovery research groups. This is a full\-time (40 hours/week) remote position open to candidates in the United States. Working hours within one to two hours of US Eastern time are preferred; West Coast candidates who can overlap with Eastern business hours will also be considered. The contractor will own the runtime, access control, and deployment path that agents run on. Agents and MCP servers built by the team call internal APIs, Snowflake, and scientific applications on behalf of individual scientists, so the platform has to authenticate users through Entra ID, scope what each agent can reach, keep credentials out of agent code, and record what each agent did. In addition to the platform, the contractor will build MCP servers, agent skills, and other integrations as needed, and we expect the work to move between platform and integration as priorities shift. Areas of work: * **Agent runtime.** Stand up and operate the runtime that hosts agents and MCP servers, using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore or a comparable agent runtime, together with serverless (Lambda) and container (ECS or EKS) workloads. Define how a new agent or MCP server is packaged, deployed, versioned, and retired. * **Infrastructure as code.** Write and maintain the Terraform modules for the runtime, networking, gateways, and supporting services, so that a new environment, AWS account, or region is created from configuration. * **Gateway and access control.** Run the API gateway layer in front of agents and tools. Integrate Entra ID for user authentication, map Entra groups to the agents and tools each user can call, and implement token exchange so an agent calls downstream services with the requesting user’s permissions. * **Identity and secrets.** Design IAM roles and workload identity for agents and MCP servers, manage credentials for Snowflake and internal APIs through AWS Secrets Manager or equivalent, and automate rotation. * **CI/CD and observability.** Build the pipelines that test and deploy agents, MCP servers, and platform components. Instrument agent and tool calls with tracing, logs, and metrics so that latency, error rate, model usage, and cost can be reported per agent and per user group. * **MCP servers and integrations.** Build MCP servers and agent skills that connect agents to Snowflake, internal APIs, and scientific applications. Provide templates, a local development path, and documentation so that other teams can ship their own MCP servers and skills onto the platform without platform changes for each one. Key Responsibilities: * Develop and maintain production Python services, MCP servers, platform tooling, and CLI utilities. * Write and review Terraform for all platform infrastructure as part of daily workflow. * Deploy and operate agent, serverless, and container workloads across AWS accounts and environments. * Maintain the access\-control model for agents and tools and review new integrations for how they handle identity, secrets, and data scope. * Work directly with scientists, application developers, and IT security to decide what to build, and support adoption through documentation and hands\-on help. Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree with 7–10 years of relevant experience, or a Master’s degree with 5 or more years of relevant experience. * Experience having built and run a shared internal platform used by other engineering teams, including its deployment path, support, and upgrades. * Strong AWS experience with both serverless (Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions or similar) and container (ECS or EKS) workloads. * Experience with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore or a comparable agent runtime is strongly preferred. * Strong Terraform experience, including module design and multi\-account deployments. * Experience with API gateways and access control using Entra ID (Azure AD), including OAuth 2\.0 and OIDC flows. * Experience with cloud identity and secrets management: IAM, workload identity, Secrets Manager or Vault, and credential rotation. * Experience building CI/CD pipelines and observability for production services (tracing, structured logging, metrics, alerting). * Strong Python development skills with experience building production\-grade services or tooling. * Experience building LLM agents in production, including tool use, prompt and context design, and evaluation of agent behavior. * Experience building Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers or comparable tool integrations that let LLM agents call internal APIs and data sources. * Experience on a small team (roughly 3–10 engineers) where individuals own systems end to end, set their own priorities within a goal, and ship without a dedicated QA, SRE, or release function. * Routine use of agentic coding harnesses (Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, or equivalent) as part of day\-to\-day development, with a view on where they help and where they do not. * Experience with Amazon Bedrock is a plus. * Experience with Snowflake or SQL\-based data access from services is a plus. * Experience in a life sciences, chemistry, or drug discovery environment is a plus. * Effective communicator who can work independently in a remote environment and collaborate with engineers, scientists, and IT security. Primary Location: United States (Remote — working hours within one to two hours of US Eastern preferred; West Coast considered) collaborate with both engineers and scientists. *Spectrix offers flexible schedules, competitive salaries, and a committed work environment to its employees; the company provides automatic benefits of life insurance and short and long term disability insurance. Optional benefits for full time employees include health, dental, and vision insurance, college loan assistance, and an employer matched retirement savings plan. Spectrix is not a placement agency.* *Spectrix is participating in the E\-Verify program of the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (phone number: 888\-897\-7781, and website: www.dhs.gov/E\-Verify).* Pay: $48\.00 \- $58\.00 per hour Experience: * Python: 7 years (Preferred) Work Location: Remote

Powered by AI and three decades of industry data, Storable empowers over 33,000 self\-storage facilities with the industry's only fully integrated technology platform. Our end\-to\-end solutions—from management software and demand generation to CRM tools and delinquency solutions—help storage operators streamline workflows, attract tenants, and grow revenue. Dedicated to empowering self\-storage owners and operators, Storable helps you Win More every day. Explore our platform solutions at storable.com. **Overview** ------------ As an Enterprise Systems Engineer in Storable's global IT Operations team, you will help keep our people, systems, and devices running seamlessly so the business can scale with confidence. This hybrid role is based in our Seattle, WA office and reports to the Vice President of IT Operations. You will help evolve IT Operations further into a cloud\-native, automation\-first, AI\-enabled function spanning Identity, End User Computing, Service Desk, SaaS Infrastructure, and M\&A activities. You will design and execute systems improvements that eliminate friction for employees, strengthen security and compliance, and deliver consistently excellent service across a globally distributed workforce. Extend endpoint management across laptops and mobile devices for employees and contractors, using GitOps practices and MDM platforms such as Iru, Intune, and Fleet to manage endpoints as code. * Maintain and evolve a cloud\-native, zero\-touch hardware provisioning and retrieval program across global jurisdictions, supported by international logistics partners and standardized enrollment processes. * Simplify the SaaS ecosystem and reduce fragmented spend across Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Atlassian, AWS, ADP, Workday, and other enterprise platforms. * Partner with leadership, jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Agentic Applications
jobs.description: Seattle Hybrid • San Francisco Hybrid Software Engineering Hybrid Full\-time **About Us** ============ Supio is a trusted AI platform purpose\-built for law firms, reshaping how data drives impactful outcomes. Our innovative approach blends technology with deep legal expertise, making us a leader in our field. We go beyond surface\-level AI to deeply understand our customers’ daily needs, empowering law firms with unparalleled data insights. Supio delivers human\-level, accurate analysis of complex data and legal records, quickly and efficiently bringing critical insights when they matter most. Trusted by top litigation lawyers, our platform has supported over $1 billion in settlements. Headquartered in Seattle with an office in San Francisco, we raised $60M Series B in April 2025 led by Sapphire Ventures with Mayfield and Thomson Reuters Ventures, bringing total funding to $91M. We're scaling rapidly and looking for exceptional talent to join us in this next phase of growth. We're looking for passionate team members who are motivated by our mission and ready to help us achieve it. ### **Who we're looking for** We're looking for **Senior and Staff Software Engineers** to join the Agentic Applications team at Supio. You'll build the software behind AI\-powered products that legal professionals rely on for high\-stakes work, so the code you ship has to be right. We hire full\-stack engineers who've gone deep. You're the person others turn to when a problem gets hard, with a strong backend foundation and the range to work across the rest of the stack. You work autonomously, partner well with product, design, and customers, and take a problem from fuzzy idea to shipped, operating software without waiting to be told what to build. You make good product calls and you leave the code, the system, and the team better than you found them. We're a small team and the impact is direct. You'll work next to engineers who've built this platform from the ground up, and you'll help shape what we build next. ### **What you'll build** You'll build and improve the software behind our AI\-powered products, wherever your skills are most needed. You'll: * **Own problems end to end.** Take ambiguous problems from idea to production: design, build, ship, and operate. You'll drive technical direction in your area and contribute to product decisions. * **Build systems that scale and hold up.** Design services, interfaces, and data pipelines that stay reliable at high volume and with large, complex datasets. * **Work across the stack where it matters.** Own work across frontend and backend, with the heaviest lift on the backend. * **Build with AI, and build AI\-powered features**. Use coding agents and AI tools to move faster, and help build, evaluate, and productionize LLM\- and agent\-driven capabilities with a focus on accuracy and reliability. * **Partner closely with product, design, and customer\-facing teams.** Understand what our users actually need and turn it into the right technical solution. * **Raise the bar.** Review code thoughtfully, mentor teammates, and build the shared tools and practices that help others move faster. At the Staff level, you'll do this across teams and set technical direction for a broader area. ### **Qualifications** * **8\+ years of professional software engineering experience** shipping and operating production systems. Staff candidates should show a track record of leading complex, cross\-team technical work. * **Full\-stack, with depth.** Strong software fundamentals and a track record across the stack, with your strongest experience on the backend (services, APIs, data, infrastructure, or systems). You're comfortable owning the frontend too. We don't screen on a specific language. * **Production AI experience.** You've built with LLMs or agentic systems (RAG, tool use, multi\-agent orchestration), you know how to evaluate whether they work, and you use AI coding tools every day. * **Ownership and product judgment.** You drive work end to end without hand\-holding, make good tradeoffs, and partner well with product, design, and customers. * **Clear communication,** written and in person. ### **Nice\-to\-haves** * Experience at both startups and larger companies * Experience mentoring engineers or leading teams * Experience with cloud platforms ### **Compensation** As an early\-stage startup, we offer a competitive compensation package that includes **base salary, meaningful equity, and benefits**. Equity grants are designed to ensure employees share in the long\-term success and upside of the company. **Base Salary by Level and Location** **Senior Software Engineer** * San Francisco: $190,000 – $240,000 annually * Seattle: $180,000 – $230,000 annually **Staff Software Engineer** * San Francisco: $230,000 – $270,000 annually * Seattle: $220,000 – $250,000 annually This role is open at both the Senior and Staff levels. Final level, and therefore final compensation, is determined during the interview process based on the scope, depth, and impact demonstrated by the candidate. Within each range, placement depends on factors such as qualifications, skills, and experience. **Compensation \& Benefits** * Competitive Salary \+ Meaningful Equity * 401(k) * + Health, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance * Flexible Time Off \+ Holidays ‍ * High\-autonomy work environment, every Tuesday is a Remote Work Day * DoorDash subsidies for breakfast and dinner; Daily lunch options * Boba Wednesdays * Monthly commuter subsidies and pre\-tax parking contribution * Team gatherings and offsites ### **E\-Verify Participation Notice** *Supio participates in E\-Verify, an employment authorization program through the U.S. Department of Homeland Security and the Social Security Administration.* ### **Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement** *Supio is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Partner API (.NET)
jobs.description: Swyfft writes homeowners and commercial package insurance, sold mostly through independent agents. Our platform takes a property address, pulls in data about the building and its risks, and returns a bindable quote in seconds. Behind that is the full policy lifecycle: rating, underwriting rules, policy issuance, endorsements and renewals, and claims. The stack is C\#/.NET, TypeScript, and SQL Server, running largely on Azure. It’s a real production system with real history: some of it is modern, some of it is the kind of code you inherit when a company has been shipping for years, and part of the job is making it better without breaking things people depend on every day. The technology team is about 30 people across development, support, IT, and QA. That’s small enough that your work is visible and you won’t spend months waiting on approvals, and large enough that you’re not the only person who knows how anything works. If you like hard domain problems, working close to the people who use what you build, and seeing your changes in production quickly, we’d like to talk. **About the Position:** Swyfft’s Partner API lets our partners create and manage Swyfft insurance quotes directly from their own software. We’re hiring a senior engineer to own it full time and make it a best\-in\-class developer experience: intuitive, consistent, well documented, and dependable as it evolves. You’ll design clean, stable resources on top of a rich insurance domain and work closely with our partners’ engineering teams. jobs.title: DevOps Machine Learning Infrastructure
jobs.description: Syntiant Corp., a leader in the high\-growth AI software and semiconductor solutions space, is looking for an experienced and talented DevOps Machine Learning Infrastructure Engineer to take on a critical role with expansive responsibilities to enhance the Software Engineering function in a growing organization. This individual will play a crucial role in building, maintaining, and enhancing our machine learning applications, specifically those deployed on AWS Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) and on\-premises machine learning cluster. The ideal candidate will have experience with application development, cloud infrastructure, containerization, and DevOps practices, as well as the ability to work on both on\-premises and cloud environments. Specific Duties and Responsibilities: * Develop, maintain, and optimize RESTful APIs using Python and FastAPI. * Deploy \& manage applications on AWS EKS, ensuring high availability, scalability, and performance. * Integrate with various data sources \& services (e.g., MongoDB, Postgres) for efficient data storage and retrieval. * Implement CI/CD pipelines to automate testing and deployment processes. * Collaborate across teams to ensure seamless integration of cloud\-native tools and practices. * Maintain on\-premises servers running Ceph, PostgreSQL, and NFS services. * Troubleshoot \& in Computer Science or equivalent work experience. * Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience. * Proficiency in Python, with experience using FastAPI for API development. * Hands\-on experience with RDS, and VPCs. * Familiarity with CI/CD tools like GitLab CI/CD or Jenkins. * Strong understanding of database systems, including MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and NFS. * Experience with on\-premises storage solutions like Ceph. * Expertise in Linux system administration. * Ability to write clean, maintainable code and perform thorough testing. * Excellent problem\-solving skills and a strong attention to deta. * Experience with cloud\-native observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana) is a plus. * Familiarity with Kubernetes operators and Helm charts is a plus. * Knowledge of container orchestration on\-premises using K8s or similar technologies is a plus. * Experience with DevOps best practices and infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible) is a plus. **Benefits** * Medical: Several plan options including PPO and HSA\-compatible plans from Anthem Blue Cross, most of which are 100% paid by Syntiant Corp. for you and your family. * Dental: Company\-paid dental PPO coverage from MetLife, including coverage for Orthodontia. * Vision: Company\-paid vision PPO coverage from MetLife / VSP. * Life Insurance / AD\&D: Company\-paid basic Life / AD\&D coverage in the amount of 3x your salary (up to $1,000,000\). Additional supplemental life insurance with low group rates is available for yourself and your family. * Disability Coverage: Company\-paid Short Term and Long\-Term Disability coverage provides up to 60% income replacement protection. * Spending and Savings Accounts: Flexible Spending Account (FSA) benefits for Health Care and Dependent Care. Health Savings Accounts (HSA) for those enrolled in a qualified Medical plan. * 401K Retirement Plan: Administered by Empower, the 401(k) plan allows you to plan for your future by investing a portion of each paycheck. * Other Benefits: A company\-provided Employee Assistance Program (EAP), as well as access to additional voluntary benefits including Accident, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, Legal Support, and Identity Fraud Protection. **About Syntiant:** Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Irvine, Calif., Syntiant Corp. is a leader in delivering hardware and software solutions for edge AI deployment. The company’s purpose\-built silicon and hardware\-agnostic models are being deployed globally to power edge AI speech, audio, sensor and vision applications across a wide range of consumer and industrial use cases, from earbuds to automobiles. Syntiant’s advanced chip solutions merge deep learning with semiconductor design to produce ultra\-low\-power, high performance, deep neural network processors. Syntiant also provides compute\-efficient software solutions with proprietary model architectures that enable world\-leading inference speed and minimized memory footprint across a broad range of processors. The company is backed by several of the world’s leading strategic and financial investors including Intel Capital, Microsoft’s M12, Applied Ventures, Bosch Ventures, the Amazon Alexa Fund, and Atlantic Bridge Capital. More information on the company can be found by visiting www.syntiant.com. Elements of our total compensation package include base pay, annual incentive plan, participation in our equity plan, and robust benefits program. The base salary range for this role is between $185,000 \- $215,000\. Individual compensation decisions are based on a number of factors, including but not limited to previous experience and skills acquired prior to joining Syntiant, cost of living in the assigned work location, assigned schedule, and salaries of similarly situated peers at the company. jobs.title: Quality Assurance Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **POSITION OVERVIEW:** The Quality Assurance Systems Engineer supports the maintenance, implementation, and continual improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS). This role partners with process owners and cross\-functional teams to strengthen audit readiness, corrective action, risk management, document and change control, quality data analysis, and process improvement. The position helps ensure that quality processes are documented, implemented, monitored, and improved in accordance with applicable standards, customer requirements, regulatory requirements, and TAS procedures. **KEY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Support the maintenance, implementation, and continual improvement of the TAS Quality Management System. * Coordinate and support internal, customer, certification, regulatory, and supplier audits, including preparation, evidence collection, response development, and follow\-up. * Track audit findings, NCRs, CARs, and SCARs through containment, root cause, corrective action, effectiveness verification, and closure. * Facilitate structured root cause analysis using appropriate methods such as 5 Why, Fishbone/Ishikawa, 8D, Pareto analysis, change analysis, or DMAIC. * Develop, revise, review, and maintain controlled procedures, work instructions, forms, templates, and records. * Administer document and change control activities to ensure approved revisions are communicated, implemented, and available at points of use. * Partner with process owners to evaluate process changes for impacts to quality requirements, risk, documentation, training, resources, and compliance. * Support the development and maintenance of FMEAs, PFMEAs, risk assessments, control plans, and quality planning tools. * Analyze quality data, audit results, nonconformance trends, and recurring issues to identify systemic risks and improvement opportunities. * Prepare clear, accurate, and audit\-ready reports, presentations, dashboards, and management review inputs. * Develop and deliver training for new or revised quality processes, procedures, systems, and tools. * Promote quality awareness, risk\-based thinking, accountability, and consistent application of the QMS across TAS locations. * Stay current on standards, codes, customer requirements, and regulations relevant to TAS operations. * Support achievement of Quality department objectives and perform other duties assigned by TAS. * Any other responsibilities as assigned by TAS. **JOB SKILLS:** * Strong working knowledge of ISO 9001 quality management system requirements and audit principles. * Knowledge of corrective action, root cause analysis, risk management, FMEA/PFMEA, document control, change control, and continual improvement methods. * Ability to interpret procedures, specifications, engineering drawings, standards, and customer requirements. * Strong technical writing skills with the ability to create clear, controlled, and audit\-ready documentation. * Ability to organize and facilitate cross\-functional meetings, follow up on action items, and drive timely closure. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, including the ability to identify trends and evaluate corrective action effectiveness. * Ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, and deadlines with limited supervision. * Effective written, verbal, presentation, training, and interpersonal communication skills. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and quality management or workflow software. Experience with Intellect, Power BI, GoCanvas, or similar systems is preferred. * Working knowledge of manufacturing, fabrication, welding, coating, assembly, inspection, and modular construction processes is preferred. * Ability to collaborate effectively with Quality, Engineering, Production, Supply Chain, Project Management, and other process owners. * Commitment to TAS core values: Safety, Integrity, Teamwork, Customer Passion, Growth Oriented, Innovation, and Value Driven. **EDUCATION \& TRAINING:** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Industrial Technology, or a related technical discipline from an accredited program, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. * Internal Auditor or Lead Auditor training for ISO 9001 is preferred. * ASQ Other duties may be required and assigned.** * Inspect standard and highly complex utility pipeline and building mechanical systems construction and materials. Instruct contractors in construction practices and in correcting construction errors. Enforce inspection decisions. Carry out liaison between District engineers and contractors. Lead construction inspection teams in the largest projects or on\-going construction programs, as assigned. Demonstrate construction inspection practices and guides less experienced inspectors. * Compile outstanding deficiencies for substantially completed construction projects and resolves issues with contractors. Ensure the accuracy and completeness of associated documentation at the completion of a construction project. * Ensure that work zones comply with MDC and OSHA safety standards. * Respond to state Call Before You Dig Mark\-out Program requests. Interprets existing records using various equipment to accurately identify and mark utilities. Maintain accurate mark\-outs and document mark\-outs through video/photo and GPS data collection of infrastructure marked out. * Assist in collection of monies for delinquent water accounts and miscellaneous bills. Confer with customers, attorneys or District personnel regarding collection action. Appear as a court witness representing the District. Establish payment schedules. Determine abatement of penalties and occupancy/hardship status. * Respond to inquiries and complaints and assist in the follow\-up of claims. Assist in processing and scheduling termination and restoration of service for non\-payment. Assist Operations Function with service shut on/off during off\-hours. Demonstrate service termination procedures. * Monitor customer compliance with wastewater discharge limits against Federal/State/Local/District regulations * Calculate discharge fees related to specific customer discharges. * Inspect standard cross\-connections in all types of structures for backflow conditions. Conducts surveys of industries for possible hazardous waste discharge, determines corrective actions and assures their implementation. Perform surveys at residential and small/medium Industrial and Commercial facilities * Determine backflow prevention measures for standard problems and assures the implementation of those measures by the owner. Investigate standard water contamination problems, including meter readings, excessive water use, water leaks, and water quality, and determine corrective actions to be taken and assures their implementation. * + Perform and document private property surveys with regards to the District's sewer backup prevention program and the water and sewer service line inspection and replacement program, including monitoring and tracking of assessments, permitting, execution and completion. Coordinate required improvement with contractors + Conduct research and makes recommendations for inclusion of customers' property in the District's inflow, backwater device installation, rain water disconnect, and similar programs. Meet with property owners and others to explain program implications. Assists in development of strategy for effective program presentation, implementation and expansion. Educates customers through home vi flow conditions. Conducts surveys of industries for possible hazardous waste discharge, determines corrective actions and assures their implementation. Tests backflow prevention devices. * Determines backflow prevention measures for standard problems and assures the implementation of those measures by the owner. * Responds to emergency calls on off hours * Performs related work as required. **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS** An Associate's degree plus four (4\) years construction, drafting, Utility, or related experience. Must be certified, or be able to be certified within one year, as a CT Backflow Prevention Tester and a Cross\-Connection Survey Inspector and a Connecticut Water Distribution System Operator Class I. Must have a valid driver's license **As part of the screening process, applicants will be required to take a written and practical exam. A passing score of 70 on the written exam is required in order to be referred to a practical exam. Candidates must pass both exams to be considered for an interview with supervision and further point evaluation.** . **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES** * Knowledge of surveying and construction inspection principles and practices as applied to basic engineering technician projects. * Knowledge of computer technology, as applied to construction inspection. * Good ability to ability to read and interpret plans and blueprints and to inspect utility pipeline construction safely, effectively and efficiently and with firmness and tact. * Good knowledge, skill and ability in utility construction methods and plan review. * Knowledge of cartography, geodesy and photogrammetry principles and practices as applied to topographic, planimetric and thematic mapping. * Knowledge of automated mapping applications with respect to a geographic information system environment. * Knowledge of Arc Info, GIS Mapping, and other related software. * Knowledge of water and sewer system and pipe design. * Knowledge of claims administration principles and practices * Knowledge of Public Administration Principles and practices as applied to claims resolution. * Knowledge of account clerical procedures and techniques in support of claims management * Knowledge of basic plumbing and electrical work in residential and small commercial buildings * Knowledge of procurement, contracting and work management * Knowledge of various ESRI tools, databases and services. * Knowledge of SAP Sales and Distribution reporting as it relates to department functions * Knowledge of SAP Project Systems reporting for Developer Permit Agreement Projects and Capital Projects * Ability in mathematics as applied to surveying and related operations. * Knowledge of standardized pipe assessment procedures. * Some knowledge of computerized mapping digitizing practices. Good ability in oral and written communications. * Ability in oral and written communications. * Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with coworkers, town officials, vendors, contractors, consultants, and the general public. **Physical Ability**: Tasks require the ability to exert moderate physical effort that involves lifting, carrying, pushing and/or pulling of objects and materials of moderate weight (under 50 pounds). **Sensory Requirements**: Some tasks require the ability to perceive and discriminate visual and/or auditory cues or signals. Some tasks require the ability to communicate orally. **Environmental Factors**: Essential functions are performed primarily outdoors, frequently exposed to any or all of the following: various weather conditions, high or deep dangerous places, working near moving mechanical parts, risk of electric shock, vibration, fumes, airborne particles, chemicals, etc. *The Metropolitan District seeks to ensure the diversity of its workforce through non\-discriminatory employment practices. People of all backgrounds, including people of color, women, veterans, and persons with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.*

query languages such as PowerShell, Python, Bash, KQL, SPL, SQL, SOAR playbooks, or API\-based workflows preferred. * Security, network, or cyber defense certification(s) preferred, such as Security\+, Network\+, CySA\+, SSCP, GSEC, CCNA, or equivalent experience. * A track record of taking initiative, being resourceful, and consistently improving alert quality, documentation, troubleshooting processes, and operational outcomes. * Effective organizational skills and ability to manage competing priorities in a high\-volume ticket and alert environment. * Ability to establish and maintain productive relationships with internal customers, engineers, vendors, leadership, and cross\-functional technology teams. * Career ladder readiness \- demonstrated interest and capability improvements. * Domain Expertise \- Experience demonstrating domain expertise including the ability to understand immediate systems, recognize relationships with adjacent systems, stay aware of
