The ideal candidate will have experience developing AI agents using **Claude Agent SDK**, deploying them on **Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime**, automating deployments through **GitHub Actions**, and implementing **Langfuse for observability and continuous evaluation of agent traffic**. The role requires a strong combination of AI engineering, cloud deployment, data pipeline development, and LLM performance monitoring. **Key Responsibilities** **1\. Agentic AI Development** * Design, develop, and deploy AI agents using Claude Agent SDK and Python. * Build intelligent, autonomous agents capable of executing complex workflows and interacting with external tools, APIs, and knowledge bases. * Develop agent orchestration workflows with appropriate error handling, retry mechanisms, and guardrails. * Integrate AI agents with enterprise applications and data sources. **2\. AWS Bedrock \& AgentCore** * Deploy and manage AI agents using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime. * Develop scalable, secure, and production\-ready agent architectures on AWS. * Integrate agents with Amazon Bedrock foundation models and enterprise knowledge bases. * Implement agent authentication, access controls, logging, and runtime monitoring. **3\. Langfuse Deployment \& AI Observability** * Deploy, configure, and maintain Langfuse for comprehensive LLM and agent observability. * Integrate Langfuse with AI agents to capture traces, prompts, responses, tool calls, and execution metrics. * Monitor agent performance, response latency, token consumption, and operational costs. * Identify and troubleshoot production issues through distributed tracing and monitoring dashboards. **4\. Continuous Agent Evaluation** * Design and implement continuous evaluation frameworks for production AI agent traffic. * Evaluate agent responses for accuracy, relevance, hallucinations, task completion, and tool execution quality. * Develop automated evaluation pipelines using Langfuse, LLM\-as\-a\-Judge, and custom evaluation metrics. * Implement continuous feedback mechanisms to improve agent reliability and effectiveness. * Establish quality benchmarks and detect agent performance regressions. **5\. Data Pipelines \& Knowledge Base Integration** * Develop AWS Step Functions workflows integrating Amazon Textract and Amazon Comprehend for intelligent document processing. * Build document ingestion, preprocessing, and data transformation pipelines. * Implement vector database solutions, including document chunking, embedding generation, and vector indexing. * Integrate AI agents with Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and enterprise knowledge bases. * Optimize retrieval performance and contextual accuracy. **6\. CI/CD \& Deployment Automation** * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions. * Automate agent code builds, testing, deployment, and configuration management. * Implement deployment workflows for Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime. * Integrate automated agent evaluations into CI/CD processes. * Apply DevOps best practices for version control, release management, and production monitoring. **Required Technical Skills** * **Programming:** Strong Python development experience. * **Agentic AI:** Claude Agent SDK, AI agent development, agent orchestration, tool calling. * **AWS AI Services:** Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore Runtime, Step Functions, Textract, Comprehend. * **Observability:** Langfuse deployment, LLM tracing, monitoring, performance analysis. * **Evaluation:** Continuous agent evaluation, LLM\-as\-a\-Judge, evaluation metrics and automated testing. * **DevOps:** GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines, Git, deployment automation. * **RAG:** Vector databases, embeddings, chunking strategies, indexing, knowledge base integrations. * **Cloud:** AWS architecture, IAM, CloudWatch, security, and deployment practices. **Good\-to\-Have Skills** * Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or other agent orchestration frameworks. * Experience with RAGAS, DeepEval, or similar LLM evaluation frameworks. * Familiarity with Amazon OpenSearch, Pinecone, FAISS, or pgvector. * Experience with Docker, Terraform, or infrastructure as code. * Knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP). * Experience with prompt engineering, guardrails, and AI governance. * Experience deploying enterprise Generative AI solutions in production environments. **Qualifications** * 6–8\+ years of software engineering, cloud engineering, or AI/ML development experience. * Strong hands\-on experience building Generative AI or Agentic AI applications. * Demonstrated experience deploying and supporting AI agents in production. * Strong understanding of AWS cloud services, LLM architectures, and automated deployment processes. * Ability to independently design, implement, troubleshoot, and optimize AI agent solutions. **Ideal Candidate Profile** A hands\-on AI Engineer who can take an agent from development through production deployment and ongoing evaluation. The candidate should be proficient in **Claude Agent SDK, AWS Bedrock AgentCore, Langfuse, GitHub Actions, and continuous AI agent evaluation**, with the ability to build reliable, scalable, and observable enterprise AI solutions. **Additional Information** All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.description: ### **Description** We are looking for a **Data Engineer** with strong **Microsoft SQL Server and Snowflake** experience to join our Data \& Analytics engineering team. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys working with **large\-scale data, complex SQL, data pipelines, and production systems** and wants to play a key role in modernizing a large SQL Server\-based data platform to Snowflake and AWS. You will work across both our existing SQL Server environment and our modern cloud data platform, developing new capabilities while helping migrate and optimize existing data processing. **Tech Stack*** **Languages**: SQL, Python, C\#; scripting experience * **Databases**: Microsoft SQL Server, Snowflake * **Data Engineering**: ETL/ELT, Apache Airflow, data pipelines * **Cloud**: AWS, including S3 and other AWS data services * **Development**: Git, CI/CD, Liquibase, automated testing and deployment * **Data**: Market data, trade data, transaction cost analysis, and financial data ### **Key Responsibilities** * Develop, maintain, and optimize complex SQL Server queries, stored procedures, functions, views, and data processing workflows. * Design and develop scalable Snowflake data solutions, including data models, SQL transformations, loading processes, and analytical workloads. * Participate in the migration of large volumes of data and processing from SQL Server to Snowflake. * Analyze existing SQL Server logic and translate or redesign it for Snowflake where appropriate. * Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL, Python, and workflow orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow. * Develop data ingestion and processing workflows using AWS, including S3\. * Perform SQL Server and Snowflake performance tuning, including query optimization, execution plans, indexing, statistics, warehouse sizing, and workload optimization. * Build data validation and reconciliation processes to ensure migrated and transformed data is accurate and complete. * Troubleshoot production data issues, identify root causes, and implement reliable long\-term solutions. * Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational controls for critical data pipelines. * Collaborate with software engineers, service managers and implementation team, product teams, and DevOps. * Support and enhance existing Transaction Cost Analysis (TCA) products and develop new functionality. * Work with large\-scale trade, market, benchmark, and financial data. ### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise** **Essential Skills \& Experience** Educational Background:* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field. Technical Skills:* Hands\-on experience with **Snowflake** and **AWS** **Cloud services** (particularly S3 and data services). * Strong hands\-on **SQL** development experience. * Python \& C\# scripting experience * Strong experience with **Microsoft SQL Server**, including complex queries, stored procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting. * Experience working with **large datasets and production data systems**. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. **Desirable Skills \& Experience*** Experience migrating SQL Server workloads to Snowflake or another cloud data platform. * Experience with Apache Airflow or similar orchestration technologies. * Experience with Git, CI/CD, Liquibase and automated deployment processes. * Experience with data quality, reconciliation, and data governance. * Knowledge of capital markets, trading, market data, or financial systems. * Experience with Transaction Cost Analysis (TCA) or other financial analytics. * Snowflake or AWS certification. AI\-Assisted Development:* We encourage engineers to use modern AI\-assisted development tools, such as Claude Code to accelerate development, debugging, testing, refactoring, and migration work. * Candidates should understand how to use AI effectively while independently validating generated code for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability. ### **Benefits** ***Competitive Benefits \& Perks*** *We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well\-being, growth, and work\-life balance.* * **Health \& Financial Security:** + Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance + Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) \& Health Savings Accounts (HSA) + 401(k) retirement plan + Pre\-tax transit and parking benefits * **Time Off \& Flexibility:** + Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in\-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in\-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in\-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands\-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture. + 22 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, with the option to roll o w uninterrupted professional development. + An additional PTO day added during milestone anniversary years. + Robust paid holiday schedule with early dismissal. + Generous parental leave for all parents (including adoptive parents). * **Work\-Life Support \& Resources:** + Budget for tech accessories, including monitors, headphones, keyboards, and other office equipment. + Backup child and pet care, as well as tutoring services. + Milestone anniversary bonuses. * **Wellness \& Lifestyle Perks:** + Stipend and subsidy contributions toward personally\-owned cell phones + Contributions for gym memberships and health/wellness initiatives. + Discounted healthcare premiums. + Healthy meal delivery program subsidies. Trading Technologies (www.tradingtechnologies.com) is a global capital markets platform services company providing market\-leading technology for the end\-to\-end trading operations of Tier 1 banks, brokerages, money managers, hedge funds, proprietary traders, Commodity Trading Advisors (CTAs), commercial hedgers, and risk managers. With its roots in listed derivatives, the Software\-as\-a\-Service (SaaS) company delivers “multi\-X” solutions, with “X” representing asset classes, functions, workflows, and geographies. This multi\-X approach features trade execution services across futures and options, fixed income, foreign exchange (FX), and cryptocurrencies, augmented by solutions for data and analytics, including transaction cost analysis (TCA); quantitative trading; compliance and trade surveillance; clearing and post\-trade allocation; and infrastructure services. jobs.title: Lead Systems Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **We Put the World on Vacation** Travel \+ Leisure Co. is the world’s leading vacation ownership and travel membership company, with a dynamic and growing portfolio of resort, travel club, and lifestyle travel brands. Our dedicated associates help the company achieve its mission to put the world on vacation. Innovation and growth keep our work interesting and fun. Every day is a chance to learn something new and turn vacation inspiration into exceptional experiences for millions of travelers worldwide. The **Systems Infrastructure Engineer, Consulting Engineer** (Active Directory, DDI \& PKI) is the subject matter expert (SME) for enterprise Active Directory, DDI (DNS, DHCP, and IP Address Management), and Certificate Services (PKI) infrastructure. The incumbent carries deep, expert\-level expertise across these domains, from multi\-forest and multi\-domain Active Directory design to DNS, DHCP, and IPAM administration to certificate authority and certificate lifecycle management, and is the hands\-on technical authority the Technical Architect and Sr. Manager rely on for that expertise. This position partners with the Technical Architect, Infrastructure, Security, Network, Application, and Project Management teams to engineer and operate an Active Directory, DDI, and Certificate Services environment that is secure, highly available, and aligned with enterprise architecture and standards. This role also drives automation of Active Directory, DDI, and PKI operations to reduce manual effort and improve consistency across the environment. The role may also be assigned other WINTEL infrastructure work, such as Windows Server, virtualization, storage, or endpoint platform support, on an as\-needed basis outside of its core Active Directory, DDI, and PKI focus. This role does not carry direct people management responsibility but is expected to set technical direction, define standards, mentor engineers, and serve as the final internal escalation point for complex Active Directory, DDI, and Certificate Services issues. **How You'll Shine:** * **AD Engineering:** Own day\-to\-day engineering, administration, and support of the enterprise Active Directory environment, including multi\-forest and multi\-domain topology, trust relationships, Group Policy, and directory security. Drive innovation and automation of routine Active Directory administration, such as account and group lifecycle management, Group Policy deployment, and health checks, to reduce manual effort and improve consistency. Serve as the hands\-on technical advisor the Technical Architect and Sr. Manager rely on for Active Directory, providing expert input on domain controller placement, replication, authentication, and access control. Lead the planning and technical execution of Active Directory projects, including domain upgrades, migrations, and consolidations. * **DDI Engineering:** Own day\-to\-day engineering, administration, and support of the enterprise DNS, DHCP, and IP address management (IPAM) environment. Drive innovation and automation for DNS record management, DHCP scope provisioning, and IPAM workflows using scripting, APIs, or orchestration tools to reduce manual effort, improve accuracy, and speed up delivery of DDI changes. Serve as the hands\-on technical advisor the Technical Architect and Sr. Manager rely on for DDI, providing expert input on zone design, scope management, and address allocation. Lead the planning and technical execution of DDI projects, including DNS/DHCP/IPAM modernization initiatives. * **PKI Engineering:** Own day\-to\-day engineering, administration, and support of the enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), including certificate authority (CA) hierarchy, certificate templates, and certificate lifecycle management. Drive innovation and automation of certificate issuance, renewal, and expiration monitoring to reduce manual effort and prevent outages caused by expired certificates. Serve as the hands\-on technical advisor the Technical Architect and Sr. Manager rely on for Certificate Services, providing expert input on certificate issuance, renewal, and revocation standards. Lead the planning and technical execution of PKI projects, including certificate authority upgrades and cipher/algorithm modernization initiatives. * **Technical Escalation and Mentoring:** Serve as the senior\-most technical escalation point for complex Active Directory, DDI, and Certificate Services incidents. Lead root cause analysis for critical or recurring issues, drive remediation to closure, and build automated diagnostics and health checks that speed up detection and resolution. Participate in the on\-call rotation for business\-critical incidents. Mentor engineers through design discussions, troubleshooting, peer reviews, and knowledge\-sharing sessions, and support security posture, access governance, and compliance and audit activities such as SOX, PCI, and PII. * **Other Duties as Assigned:** Provide support across the bro \-enrollment * **Automation and Scripting Tools** + PowerShell + Python + Ansible + REST APIs / DDI platform automation interfaces + GitHub * **Additional WINTEL Platforms (Supported as Assigned)** + Windows Server infrastructure + VMware ESXi / vSphere + Dell EMC storage platforms + SCCM + Citrix + Azure fundamentals * **Targeted Supporting Tools** + ServiceNow + Monitoring and alerting platforms * Minimum of 15 years of experience in enterprise IT infrastructure engineering or administration in a mid\-size to large environment. * Minimum of 11 years of hands\-on experience designing, administering, and securing Active Directory environments, including multi\-forest and multi\-domain architectures. * Minimum of 8 years of hands\-on experience designing and administering enterprise DNS, DHCP, and IP address management (DDI) services. * Minimum of 8 years of hands\-on experience designing and administering enterprise PKI / Certificate Services, including certificate authority hierarchy and certificate lifecycle management. * Experience automating Active Directory, DDI, and PKI administration, such as account/group lifecycle management, DNS record management, DHCP scope provisioning, IPAM workflows, or certificate lifecycle management, using scripting, APIs, or orchestration tools. * Working knowledge of broader WINTEL infrastructure, such as Windows Server, virtualization, storage, or endpoint platforms, sufficient to support assigned work outside of core Active Directory, DDI, and PKI responsibilities. * Experience leading enterprise Active Directory, DDI, or Certificate Services projects such as domain upgrades, migrations, consolidations, DNS/DHCP/IPAM modernization, or certificate authority modernization. * Experience mentoring engineers and setting technical standards across an infrastructure engineering team. * Experience supporting compliance and audit requirements such as SOX, PCI, and PII. * Experience working in a multiple\-site, multiple\-vendor team environment. *Experience equivalent to the education requirement may be accepted in lieu of the education requirement.* **How You'll Be Rewarded:** We offer a diverse range of comprehensive health and welfare benefits to associates who work 30 or more hours per week to meet your needs and support you throughout your career with us. Certain benefits may be available to associates working fewer hours where required by applicable law. Travel \+ Leisure Co. benefits include: ***Note: Temporary and/or seasonal associates are ineligible for Paid Time Off.*** * Medical * Dental * Vision * Flexible spending accounts * Life and accident coverage * Disability * Depending on position, paid time off, parental leave and holidays (speak to your recruiter for additional information) * Wish day paid time to volunteer at an approved organization of your choice * 401k with employer match (subject to eligibility requirements, including tenure \- speak to your recruiter for additional information) * Legal and identify theft plan * Voluntary income protection benefits * Wellness program (subject to provider availability) * Employee Assistance Program **Where Memories Start with You** Hospitality is at the heart of all we do at Travel \+ Leisure Co. Here, you’ll find an inclusive environment where we deliver excellence and take time to have fun, celebrate together, and support one another. We're always looking ahead to what’s next and how we can strengthen our business, its neighboring communities, and the customer experience. Join our global team and build a career where memories start with you. We are an equal opportunity employer, and all applications will be considered for employment without attention to their membership in any protected class. If you require any reasonable accommodation to complete your application or any part of the recruiting process, please email your request to MyCareer@travelandleisure.com, including the title and location of the position for which you are applying.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Atlanta, Georgia)
jobs.description: **Shape the Future with TribalScale** ===================================== TribalScale is a digital innovation firm that helps organizations adapt and thrive in a rapidly changing world. We partner with clients to build transformative digital products, modernize technology platforms, and apply emerging technologies—including artificial intelligence—to meaningful business challenges. Our teams work closely with clients from strategy through execution. We value curiosity, ownership, practical innovation, and people who are comfortable turning ambiguity into action. **Our Digital Expertise** * **Transformation Experts:** We transform traditional business models into agile, AI\-powered ecosystems. * **Strategic Visionaries:** We navigate the uncharted waters of technological evolution. * **Product Virtuosos:** We orchestrate the creation of world\-class digital solutions. * **Code Optimizers:** We leverage AI to refine and perfect digital systems. **Our Technological Toolkit** * **Mobile \& Web Development:** (iOS, Android, React Native, React, Node.js) * **Voice\-Activated Platforms:** (Amazon Alexa, Google Home) * **Connected Ecosystems:** (Cars and Homes) * **Streaming Platforms:** (Roku, Fire TV, Android TV, tvOS) **The TribalScale Professional** You thrive in challenging environments where innovation is key. Your passion for technology is matched only by your drive to redefine its limits. You seek more than a job; you seek a calling—a chance to make a lasting impact on the digital landscape. **The Opportunity** ------------------- TribalScale is looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to work at the intersection of software engineering, artificial intelligence, product development, and client delivery. In this role, you will embed with client and internal teams to understand complex business problems, rapidly design solutions, and deploy production\-quality software in real\-world environments. You will operate as both a hands\-on engineer and a trusted technical partner—translating business needs into working products while helping clients make sound technology decisions. You will be expected to understand more than models and prompts. You will help design the systems around AI models: the harnesses, agent loops, state graphs, tools, context, evaluations, observability, permissions, and human controls required to make AI applications useful and reliable in production. This role is ideal for an adaptable engineer who enjoys direct customer interaction, can move comfortably between discovery and delivery, and wants to see their work create immediate, measurable impact. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Partner directly with clients to understand their objectives, workflows, technical environments, data, and operational constraints. * Translate ambiguous business challenges into clear technical requirements, solution architectures, prototypes, and delivery plans. * Design and build AI\-enabled applications, agentic workflows, developer tools, APIs, data pipelines, and full\-stack products. * Engineer the harnesses around AI models, including prompts, tools, context, memory, permissions, runtime controls, observability, and feedback mechanisms. * Build and refine agent loops that support planning, tool selection, execution, observation, reflection, recovery, and termination. * Model complex workflows as graphs, state machines, or other orchestration patterns that coordinate models, tools, data, systems, and human approvals. * Create evaluation frameworks that measure task completion, accuracy, reliability, safety, latency, cost, and user value. * Develop rapid prototypes and proofs of concept, validate them with real users and representative evaluations, and evolve successful ideas into secure, scalable products. * Integrate solutions with client systems, enterprise data sources, cloud platforms, and third\-party services. * Work across the technology stack, contributing wherever needed—from user interfaces and backend services to AI infrastructure, data workflows, and deployment pipelines. * Implement appropriate safeguards, permission boundaries, approval steps, and fallbacks for autonomous and semi\-autonomous systems. * Instrument AI applications so teams can inspect traces, understand intermediate states, diagnose failures, and improve system performance. * Identify and address failure modes such as hallucinations, looping, brittle tool calls, context loss, prompt injection, non\-deterministic behavior, and unsafe actions. * Troubleshoot complex technical and operational issues in client environments. * Communicate technical decisions, risks, trade\-offs, and progress clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Collaborate with product managers, designers, engineers, data specialists, security teams, and client stakeholders throughout the delivery lifecycle. * Establish strong engineering practices, including automated testing, documentation, observability, security, and continuous d nt frameworks, or related open\-source projects. * Experience working in regulated or complex enterprise environments. * Experience in consulting, professional services, solutions engineering, sales engineering, or another customer\-facing technical role. * A history of taking products from initial discovery through production launch and ongoing adoption. * Claude Certified Architect \- Foundations or Professional certification (or equivalent), with practical experience designing and implementing Claude\-based AI solutions, agentic workflows, and enterprise integrations. * Experience with agentic AI and harness\-driven development, including designing, building, and optimizing autonomous AI agents, multi\-agent workflows, tool integrations, and agent harnesses that support reliable, scalable, and production\-ready AI applications. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- In your first few months, you will have built trusted relationships with client and TribalScale teams, developed a strong understanding of the client's operating environment, and contributed working software to a meaningful business challenge. As you grow in the role, you will: * Turn loosely defined client needs into clear, executable technical plans. * Deliver AI\-enabled products that perform reliably outside of controlled demonstrations. * Establish evaluation and observability practices that make quality measurable and regressions visible. * Improve agent behavior by refining harnesses, loops, tools, graphs, context, and safeguards—not only by changing prompts or models. * Help client teams understand what their AI systems can do, where they can fail, and how they should be operated responsibly. * Create reusable technical patterns that accelerate future TribalScale engagements. * Become a trusted partner who can navigate uncertainty, solve difficult technical problems, and help promising ideas reach production. **Why TribalScale** ------------------- * Work on high\-impact challenges across industries and technology domains. * Build real products and production systems—not just recommendations or presentations. * Work directly with clients and see the impact of your decisions. * Explore emerging approaches to AI, agentic systems, product development, and software delivery. * Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams that value experimentation and continuous learning. * Influence both client outcomes and TribalScale's evolving technical practices. * Join an environment where ownership, diverse perspectives, and thoughtful innovation are encouraged. **Why Choose TribalScale** At TribalScale, collaboration is at the heart of our innovative approach. We don't simply work for clients; we form partnerships, building transformative solutions that redefine what's possible. Our team, once at the forefront of the mobile revolution, now leads the charge in AI\-driven innovation. We empower each team member to be a catalyst for change, adhering to our principles of meritocracy, empowerment, and transparency. Diversity isn't just celebrated—it's fundamental to our strength. Our mission to "Right the Future" is a call to action to make a significant impact in the world of innovation. **Diversity: Our Collective Strength** TribalScale proudly stands as a beacon of equal opportunity in employment and workplace culture. We are steadfastly committed to equal employment opportunity, transcending the boundaries of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, able\-bodiedness, or gender identity. We not only welcome but actively encourage applications from individuals of all abilities, ages, citizenships, marital statuses, and gender identities. Your unique perspective is the key to our collective innovation. Should you require any accommodations, we implore you to inform us. Our commitment to inclusivity knows no bounds, and we stand ready to adapt our processes to ensure your comfort and success.

This role requires someone who can independently design, develop, optimize, deploy, and support scalable enterprise applications in AWS environments. **Key Responsibilities** * Design and develop scalable backend applications using Java 21, Spring Boot, and microservices. * Build, integrate, and maintain APIs using **REST and GraphQL**. * Develop, deploy, and support cloud\-native applications on AWS. * Own end\-to\-end application development, from architecture and design through production deployment. **Required Technical Skills** * Java 21 (or strong modern Java experience) * Spring Boot and Microservices * **REST APIs and GraphQL** * AWS Cloud Services * End\-to\-End Application Development and Production Deployment **Preferred Skills** * Multithreading, concurrency, and performance optimization * Kafka and event\-driven architecture * Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD * AI\-assisted development tools ### **Ideal Candidate Profile** We are particularly interested in engineers who combine: * **Deep Java expertise:** Strong command of Java, spring boot, graphql and performance optimization. * **AWS proficiency:** Proven ability to deploy and manage production applications in AWS. * **End\-to\-end ownership:** Ability to take an application from initial concept through successful production launch. * **Hands\-on engineering:** Comfortable writing code, solving complex problems, and making technical decisions. * **Modern development mindset:** Familiarity with AI\-powered development tools and emerging engineering practices. **The ideal candidate is a strong individual contributor who can independently architect, build, deploy, and maintain production\-grade applications—not simply someone who has worked on individual components of larger projects.**

After you click Apply Now and complete your application, you'll be invited to create a profile, which will let you see your application status and any communications. If you already have a profile with us, you can log in to check status.** Need Help? *If you have a disability and need assistance with the application, you can request a reasonable accommodation. Send an email to* *Accessibility* *(accommodation requests only; other inquiries won't receive a response).* **Regular or Temporary:** Regular**Language Fluency:** English (Required) **Work Shift:** 1st shift (United States of America)### **Please review the following job description:** Seeking an experienced engineer with a strong software development background and a passion for observability, automation, and platform engineering. This role is responsible for designing, developing, and enabling enterprise observability capabilities through code, leveraging OpenTelemetry, APIs, automation frameworks, and modern monitoring platforms. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on developer who understands distributed systems, cloud\-native architectures, and application performance monitoring. They will partner with application teams to implement telemetry standards, automate observability onboarding, develop integrations, and create scalable solutions that improve visibility, reliability, and operational resilience across the enterprise. Key Responsibilities * Develop and maintain observability solutions using modern programming languages and automation frameworks. * Design and implement OpenTelemetry instrumentation, collectors, and telemetry pipelines. * Build APIs, integrations, and self\-service capabilities that simplify monitoring adoption. * Create automation to manage monitoring configurations, maintenance windows, alerting, and platform onboarding. * Partner with application teams to embed observability into the software development lifecycle. * Develop dashboards, analytics, and monitoring\-as\-code solutions that improve operational visibility. * Contribute to platform engineering initiatives focused on reliability, scalability, and operational excellence. * Drive adoption of observability standards, telemetry contracts, and engineering best practices **For this opportunity, Truist will not sponsor an applicant for work visa status or employment authorization, nor will we offer any immigration\-related support for this position (including, but not limited to H\-1B, F\-1 OPT, F\-1 STEM OPT, F\-1 CPT, J\-1, TN\-1 or TN\-2, E\-3, O\-1, or future sponsorship for U.S. lawful permanent residence status.)** **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** Following is a summary of the essential functions for this job. Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below. Specific activities may change from time to time. 1\. Designs, builds, and implements enterprise infrastructure technology platforms and systems across cloud, network, database, storage, platform, computing, or middleware domains. 2\. Applies automation, monitoring, and optimization techniques to ensure high availability and performance of infrastructure. 3\. Manages infrastructure engineering projects and processes aligned with organizational policies and regulatory requirements. 4\. Collaborates with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders to integrate new technologies and continuously improve infrastructure standards and processes. 5\. Troubleshoots and resolves complex technical issues impacting infrastructure performance and reliability. 6\. Supports compliance with technology strategies, standards, and governance to mitigate risks and ensure regulatory adherence. 7\. Reviews and guides infrastructure designs, configurations, and procedures to support operational consistency and knowledge sharing. 8\. Provides technical guidance and direction to lower\-level technical professionals. 9\. Develops technical solutions with deep analysis of infrastructure systems and leads infrastructure processes. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications** The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 1\. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, a related field, or equivalent education, training, and work\-related experience. 2\. Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in infrastructure engineering. 3\. Strong knowledge of enterprise infrastructure technologies including cloud, network, database, storage, platform, computing, and middleware. **Preferred Qualifications** * Strong software engineering experience in Python, Java, Go, .NET, or similar languages. * Experience with OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, metrics, and logging. * Knowledge of modern observability platforms such as Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana, Datadog, or similar tools. * Experience with APIs, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, and automation frameworks. * Understanding of cloud platforms, microservices, Kubernetes, and event\-driven architectures. * Passion for building reusable solutions that enable engineering teams at scale. **General Description of Available Benefits for Eligible Employees of Truist Financial Corporation:** All regular teammates (not temporary or contingent workers) working 20 hours or more per week are eligible for benefits, though eligibility for specific benefits may be determined by the division of Truist offering the position. Truist offers medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability, accidental death and dismemberment, tax\-preferred savings accounts, and a 401k plan to teammates. Teammates also receive no less than 10 days of vacation (prorated based on date of hire and by full\-time or part\-time status) during their first year of employment, along with 10 sick days (also prorated), and paid holidays. For more details on Truist’s generous benefit plans, please visit our Benefits site. Depending on the position and division, this job may also be eligible for Truist’s defined benefit pension plan, restricted stock units, and/or a deferred compensation plan. As you advance through the hiring process, you will also learn more about the specific benefits available for any non\-temporary position for which you apply, based on full\-time or part\-time status, position, and division of work. ***Truist is an Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, color, religion, citizenship or national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or other classification protected by law. jobs.title: Systems Analyst - Microsoft 365
jobs.description: **Position Overview** --------------------- **Pay range:** $63,875 \- $103,800 / year **Benefits and perks available for eligible positions include:** robust educational assistance programs, generous paid time off, employee assistance and wellness programs, paid parental leave, qualifying employer for the Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) Program, plus more. **Job Highlights** ------------------ UAB Medicine Health System Information Services (HSIS) plays a critical role in supporting the entire organization. This team of more than 400 dedicated individuals keeps UAB Medicine’s IT systems and infrastructure running smoothly to deliver quality care to our patients and business support to our organization. You’ll join a large team with a passion for healthcare information technology and being part of a mission\-driven organization. **Job Description** ------------------- To conduct business requirements reviews, technical systems specifications and systems process analysis. To develop detailed selection evaluation criteria. To analyze and re\-engineer business processes using industry standard tools and methods with understanding of the technical and business environments. jobs.title: Director, AI Product Management - Global Marketing Services
jobs.description: **About Us** Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. **Job Description** **About the Job** Visa is a world leader in payments and technology, with over 259 billion payments transactions flowing safely between consumers, merchants, financial institutions, and government entities in more than 200 countries and territories each year. Our mission is to connect the world through the most innovative, convenient, reliable, and secure payments network, enabling individuals, businesses, and economies to thrive while driven by a common purpose – to uplift everyone, everywhere, by being the best way to pay and be paid. Make an impact with a purpose\-driven industry leader. Join us today and experience Life at Visa. Visa is searching for a Director, AI Product Management \- Global Marketing Services to own the internal AI solutions and AI agent product portfolio for the Marketing Services organization. This role will identify, prioritize, and design AI\-enabled opportunities that improve productivity, quality, speed, and scalability across Marketing Services. The ideal candidate is a seasoned product manager who understands how AI solutions are built, what data they require, and how to manage the iterative, experiment\-driven nature of AI development. This role will be part of the AI Transformation team within the Global Marketing Services organization. The Director will work closely with business stakeholders to translate business needs into product requirements, manage the internal use\-case prioritization backlog, and serve as the business product owner within Technology sprint and build cycles. The role requires a leader who can bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating complex AI possibilities into actionable product roadmaps that deliver measurable value. This leader will own the end\-to\-end internal AI product lifecycle, from opportunity identification and use\-case prioritization through agent specification, MVP definition, build collaboration, and adoption measurement. The role demands comfort with ambiguity, strong stakeholder management skills, and the ability to drive alignment across business and technical teams on what to build, why, and in what order. Reporting to the Senior Director, AI Transformation, Global Marketing Services, this leader will work closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Technology partners, and business stakeholders across Marketing Services to ensure AI solutions and agents are designed around validated business needs, built on reliable data foundations, deployed through the organization's agent platform, and delivered through disciplined product management practices. The Director will partner with peers on the Global Marketing Services AI Transformation team and across Marketing Services' regional teams, Finance, Technology, Legal, Privacy, Risk, and Compliance teams, and external vendors to ensure successful product design, development, deployment, measurement, governance, and adoption. **Key Responsibilities** * **Own the internal AI product roadmap and use\-case backlog:** Prioritize AI\-enabled opportunities across Marketing Services using a clear framework based on business impact, feasibility, and data readiness. Keep the roadmap current as priorities, technology, and capacity evolve. * **Co\-lead workflow reimagination and future\-state process design:** Create or leverage industry frameworks to guide business stakeholders with redesigning future\-state AI\-enabled workflows. Partner with business subject matter experts to identify where AI solutions and agents improve quality, or accelerate delivery, and translate those into scoped product opportunities with clear success criteria. * **Define agent specifications and MVP scope:** Author detailed agent and AI solution specifications covering scope, target users, data needs, integration requirements, guardrails, and MVP definitions. Partner with Data Scientists and Data Engineers to validate data availability, quality, and pipeline requirements. * **Translate business needs into product requirements and user stories:** Develop product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for Technology teams. Manage backlog refinement and grooming. Bridge communication between business and technical teams to resolve ambiguity and maintain alignment. * **Serve as business product owner in Technology sprint and build cycles:** Participate in sprint planning, backlog r Experience managing pilots and proof\-of\-concept programs, including soliciting user feedback, iterating on solutions, and scaling successful pilots into enterprise\-wide solutions. * Demonstrated success leading complex, cross\-functional programs with measurable business impact in a global, matrixed organization. * Strong ability to translate complex AI, data, and technology concepts into clear product requirements, executive\-level recommendations, and stakeholder communications. **Preferred Qualifications** * 15 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor's Degree, or at least 12 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree, such as a Master's, MBA, or a PhD. * Familiarity with data architecture, data pipelines, feature stores, and the data foundations required to support AI and machine learning solutions. * Experience with workflow analysis, process redesign, and translating operational inefficiencies into product\-led solutions. * Familiarity with payments, banking, fintechs, or card products is a plus. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to operate in ambiguity, build structure in white space, and drive action across stakeholders and business units. **Additional Information** This role requires a leader who combines strategic product thinking with hands\-on execution. The ideal candidate will have strong relationship\-building skills, excellent written and verbal communication, personal presence, and the ability to clearly communicate compelling product vision and priorities to both technical and business audiences. Experience with AI product development dynamics, including iterative development, shifting requirements, data dependencies, and the need to balance speed with responsible deployment, is essential. The candidate should be extremely organized, demonstrate quick follow\-through, and bring a strong bias toward action. The role requires comfort working in fast\-paced, matrixed environments and the ability to collaborate across regions and business units to execute strategy and drive measurable business outcomes. **Acceptable Position Location** Seeking a candidate who will be based in the Visa San Francisco Office in Mission Rock. This is a hybrid position. Employees in hybrid roles are expected to work from the office 2\-3 set days a week (determined by leadership/site), with a general guidepost of being in the office 50% or more of the time based on business needs. Visa is not offering relocation assistance for this role. **Information for US Applicants** For roles located in the US, the estimated salary range for this position is $179,000\.00 to $ 287,000\.00 USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). Salary may vary depending on job\-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity.Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program.**Work Hours** Varies upon the needs of the department. **Travel Requirements** This position requires travel 5\-10% of the time. **Mental/Physical Requirements** This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers. **Visa is an EEO Employer** Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protect veteran status. jobs.title: Precision Phenotyping Postdoctoral Scientist
jobs.description: **Join Vylor—Powering the Future of Agriculture** At Vylor, we’re advancing agriculture through breakthrough science—combining elite germplasm, cutting\-edge biotech, and next\-generation expertise in gene editing and molecular breeding. Our portfolio includes trusted industry brands like Pioneer®, Brevant®, and Hoegemeyer®, delivering performance farmers rely on. Join us to help scale innovation globally and shape what’s next in crop science. The Precision Phenotyping Team within the Seed Product Development Group is seeking a highly motivated post\-doctoral scientist to help shape the future of AI\-enabled plant breeding through multimodal phenomics and predictive modeling. This position will focus on developing next\-generation approaches for predicting corn yield, agronomic performance, and breeding outcomes using large\-scale precision phenotyping datasets collected from drones, ground\-based robotics, LiDAR, RGB imaging, hyperspectral sensing, thermal imagery, environmental measurements, and genomic information. The successful candidate will work at the intersection of plant breeding, artificial intelligence, computer vision, and data science to develop novel phenomic features, foundation models, and multimodal machine learning approaches that transform raw sensor data into actionable breeding insights. This role offers the opportunity to advance cutting\-edge research while delivering practical solutions that directly impact breeding decisions and product advancement. Our team develops and deploys precision phenotyping technologies across global breeding programs and is actively advancing the next generation of AI\-driven phenomics. The incumbent will help design and execute scientific research programs, develop scalable analytical pipelines, collaborate across breeding and technology teams, and translate emerging AI capabilities into production\-ready breeding solutions. An ability to work independently, think creatively, and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams is critical. Experience in machine learning, computer vision, deep learning, statistics, phenomics, or related computational disciplines is highly desirable. **What You’ll Do:** * Collaborate on a scientific research program focused on multimodal AI\-driven prediction of corn yield, agronomic performance, and breeding outcomes using large\-scale phenotyping datasets. * Develop and evaluate novel phenomic features from multimodal sensor data including RGB, LiDAR, hyperspectral, multispectral, thermal, environmental, and genomic datasets. * Design, train, and validate machine learning and deep learning models including multimodal architectures, transformer\-based models, representation learning approaches, and foundation models for agricultural prediction tasks. * Discover and characterize latent\-space phenotypes derived from multimodal sensing platforms and evaluate their utility for breeding selection, environmental characterization, and genotype\-by\-environment analyses. * Build scalable data processing, feature engineering, and model training pipelines capable of supporting large\-volume phenotyping datasets collected across years, locations, and environments. * Collaborate closely with breeders, quantitative geneticists, data scientists, software engineers, and sensor technology teams to translate research advances into breeding applications. * Quantify model performance, biological interpretability, uncertainty, and failure modes while communicating results to both technical and business stakeholders. * Publish scientific findings, contribute to intellectual property, and help maintain Vylor's leadership position in AI\-enabled phenomics and predictive breeding. **What Skills You Need:** * Experience developing machine learning, deep learning, or AI models for prediction, classification, or representation learning applications. * Experience with state\-of\-the\-art deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, Lightning, or Hugging Face ecosystems. * Experience developing yield prediction, genomic prediction, phenotype prediction, crop modeling, or genotype × environment prediction frameworks. * Experience extracting quantitative plant traits from RGB, LiDAR, hyperspectral, multispectral, thermal, and robotic sensing platforms. * Experience with statistical genetics, plant breeding, quantitative genetics, crop science, phenomics, or agricultural AI applications. **What Makes You Stand Out:** * Experience with multimodal data integration involving imagery, sensor, environmental, genomic, or time\-series datasets. * Experience with computer vision, self\-supervised learning, contrastive learning, transformer architectures, graph neural networks, or foundation models. * Experience with LiDAR point cloud processing, 3D reconstruction, sensor fusion, or digital twin frameworks. * Experience managing large\-scale cloud computing or MLOps environments including AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, Docker, MLFlow, or related technologies. * Publications in high\-impact journals, conference proceedings, patents, open\-source software contributions, or demonstrated technical innovation. When applying for this position, please provide a current *curriculum vitae*. Please be prepared also to submit bibliography and poof of doctoral degree (e.g. copy of diploma, final transcripts, or letter from your university's registrar office indicating you will be eligible to graduate) and three letters of recommendation to the hiring team prior to an interview. Please note: there is no relocation or visa sponsorship provided for this role. **Join us in building the next generation of AI\-powered phenomics, where multimodal sensing, foundation models, and predictive breeding converge to transform how crop performance is measured, predicted, and improved. Start by applying to this opportunity today!** Are you a good match? Apply today! We seek applicants from all backgrounds to ensure we get the best, most creative talent on our team. ### **Vylor is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to embracing our differences to enrich lives, advance innovation, and boost company performance. You will be accountable for how those pieces fit together, not only for any single model. You will set technical direction alongside other staff engineers, product managers, and platform partners. You will raise the bar on how the organization builds, evaluates, and operates models, and mentor the engineers around you through design reviews, code reviews, and direct feedback. We expect you to challenge technical decisions across teams when the engineering case is clear, and to bring evidence when you do. Our team practices end to end project ownership, and our work focuses heavily on personalized recommendation, retrieval, and classification from catalog content and clickstream. Deep neural networks, learned embeddings and approximate nearest neighbor retrieval, transfer learning from pre\-trained large scale models, calibration, classic regressions, fine tuning, and large language models all have a place in our daily lexicon. **The Impact You Will Make** * Own the architecture of our ranking and recommendation stack end to end: candidate retrieval, multi\-objective ranking, calibration, and the ensemble that trades conversion against profitability. Make the cross\-system design calls that no individual model owner can make alone. * Lead the evolution of our optimization objective from short\-term conversion toward long\-term diner value, including the offline evaluation and online experimentation work required to trust the result before it ships. * Bring state of the art research in information retrieval and recommender systems into our runtime environment: LLM\-driven query and intent understanding, embedding\-based retrieval, sequential user representations for cold start, and real\-time inference. Assess rigorously what actually transfers to our traffic, and say no to what does not. * Raise engineering and operational standards across multiple teams: model evaluation and scorecards, reproducible training pipelines, safe deployment, SLOs and observability for tier\-1 models, and proactive management of technical debt before it becomes urgent. * Partner with Product, Search Engineering, Ads, and Data Platform to shape roadmaps, surface risk early, and make sure the data and infrastructure exist before the model needs them. * Mentor senior and mid\-level engineers, participate in hiring, and grow the technical depth of the team so that no critical system depends on a single person. * Translate technical trade\-offs into business terms for product and executive stakeholders, and document the rationale clearly enough that decisions outlive the people who made them. * Question existing assumptions, look for the innovation we are not yet pursuing, and relentlessly analyze and improve the performance of our business. **What You Bring to the Table** * MS/PhD in a quantitative discipline (Computer Science, Math, Physics, Engineering, Statistics or other technical field) or equivalent experience * 6\+ years building and shipping machine learning systems, including 3\+ years operating at senior\-level scope: setting technical direction across multiple teams, model families, or systems * Deep experience in recommendation systems, ranking, or information retrieval at scale, in production and under real latency and cost constraints * Proven track record with production deep learning in TensorFlow or PyTorch, including training, serving, and tuning runtime models on GPUs * Experience with Large Language Models and transformer\-based architectures, including fine\-tuning, embedding generation, and deploying them in latency\-sensitive applications. Experience with language understanding over imperfect grammar (real\-world search queries, menu and catalog text) is a strong plus * Strong data engineering fundamentals: PySpark, Hive/SQL, the Python data stack, and feature pipelines you can debug as well as build * Fluency with experimentation: designing A/B tests, choosing the right guardrails, and recognizing when an offline metric is misleading you * Experience with cloud ML infrastructure (AWS/SageMaker or equivalent), model deployment, and production monitoring and observability * Demonstrated technical leadership: mentoring engineers, driving design and architecture reviews beyond your own team, and influencing decisions without direct authority * Comfort communicating performance metrics, model behavior, and technical trade\-offs to both deeply technical and non\-technical audiences, up to and including executive stakeholders * Ability to keep up with the latest research publications and synthesize them into working production systems * Deep interest in self\-motivated continuous learning Our hybrid model requires 3 days a week in the office. That said, many team members choose to come in more often to take advantage of in\-person collaboration and connection. You're welcome—and encouraged—to be in the office up to 5 days a week if it works for you. New York Base Salary: $208,500 \- $216,500\. Wonder uses geographic\-specific salary structures, which means the salary offered may vary depending on where the job is located. The final salary offer will take into account various factors, such as the candidate's skills, education, training, credentials, and experience. **Benefits** The benefits applicable to this role include a competitive compensation package with equity and a 401(k). We also offer a choice of medical, dental, and vision plans, company paid short and long term disability coverage, paid time off including flexible time off for exempt employees, paid vacation for non\-exempt employees, and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable law in addition to paid parental leave, discounted meals and exclusive perks across the Wonder family of brands. Eligibility, effective dates, and available plan options vary by employment classification and location. To learn more about benefits for this role, visit our Careers page here. **A Final Note** At Wonder, we build the best teams by hiring with an objective lens — evaluating people for their potential while championing diversity, equity, and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, marital status, disability, or any other protected class. As part of our commitment to fair and compliant hiring practices, Wonder participates in the federal government's E\-Verify program to confirm employment eligibility. If you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know. **We look forward to hearing from you! We'll contact you via email or text to schedule interviews and share information about your candidacy**.

jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer
jobs.description: We're looking for a Senior QA Engineer to own quality for a significant area of our platform — the web application, admin tooling, and the integrations our customers depend on. This is a senior individual contributor role: you'll set the testing approach for your area rather than execute someone else's, and you'll be the person the squad turns to when the question is "what could this break?" The craft here is still hands\-on testing — exploratory work, risk\-based coverage decisions, and the kind of deep product knowledge that catches the defect nobody wrote a test case for. What makes it senior is scope and influence: you'll define test strategy, push quality earlier into the development cycle, and make the judgment calls on release risk that others rely on. What You'll Do * Own the test strategy — deciding what gets deep coverage, what gets a smoke check, and what we consciously accept risk on, then defending those calls with reasoning rather than instinct. * Lead exploratory and risk\-based testing across multi\-tenant data separation, role\-based permissions, complex customer workflows, and the seams between systems where defects actually live. * Design and implement test plans and cases and raise the standard of the team's existing cases through review and refactoring. * Shift quality left — reviewing requirements and designs early, challenging ambiguous acceptance criteria before a line of code is written, and making the case for testability in design discussions. * Own release risk assessment on go/no\-go calls: what was tested, what wasn't, what the residual risk is, and whether it's acceptable. Senior means your assessment carries weight. * Write exemplary bug reports with clear reproduction steps, environment details, evidence, and a considered severity and priority — and triage incoming defects for the team. * Own and curate the regression suite so it stays fast, meaningful, and trusted; retire cases that no longer earn their place and identify the highest\-value candidates for automation. * Test APIs and integrations using Postman or similar — validating payloads, status codes, error handling, and contract behavior between services. * Query the database to validate data directly, investigate discrepancies, and build the test data the team needs. * Improve QA practice — identify recurring failure patterns, propose process changes, and drive them to adoption. You'll be expected to improve how we work, not just work within it. * Partner with Support and Product on escalated customer issues, reproducing hard\-to\-pin\-down problems and feeding what you learn back into test coverage. **Requirements** * 5\+ years of hands\-on software QA experience, with meaningful time testing a complex web application. * A track record of owning quality for a product area independently — setting the approach, not just executing a plan handed to you. * Strong risk\-based testing judgment: you can articulate why you tested what you tested, and what you deliberately left uncovered. * Deep command of QA fundamentals: test planning and design techniques, boundary and negative testing, equivalence partitioning, severity vs. priority, and the defect lifecycle. * Excellent written and verbal communication, including the credibility and comfort to tell a room that a release isn't ready — and to explain why. * Hands\-on experience with automation tools ( Github Actions, Playwright)) — enough to read, run, and evaluate a suite even if you don't build it. * Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and where testing fits within them. * Proficiency with a bug tracking and test management toolchain (Jira, confluence, github) * Solid API testing skills with Postman or similar, and working with SQL for data validation. * Fluency with browser developer tools and application logs — you can usually tell the team whether an issue is front\-end, back\-end, or data before they open it. * Experience in an Agile/Scrum environment with frequent releases. Nice to Have * Senior QA experience in B2B SaaS, particularly with multi\-tenant architecture, role\-based permissions, or subscription and billing flows. * Experience identifying automation candidates and collaborating with engineers on coverage strategy. * Experience testing third\-party integrations, webhooks, or SSO/SAML. * Performance or security testing exposure. * Accessibility testing against WCAG guidelines. * ISTQB Advanced Level (Test Analyst) or comparable depth of training. **Benefits*** Health/dental/vision insurance * 401(k) * Equity/stock options * Flexible PTO * Hybrid work

jobs.description: **Job Overview:** APTIM is seeking a Senior Air Quality Engineer to provide technical leadership in air permitting, dispersion modeling, regulatory strategy, and compliance. This client\-facing role will support complex projects for data centers, power generation, manufacturing, industrial operations, and major infrastructure while helping grow APTIM's Air Quality Services practice. **Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities:** * Lead major source, PSD/NSR, Title V, synthetic minor, and minor source permitting for new facilities, expansions, and modifications. * Develop regulatory strategies, emissions calculations, potential\-to\-emit analyses, BACT evaluations, and air permit applications. * Evaluate applicability of the Clean Air Act, NESHAP/MACT, NSPS, and state and local air regulations. * Perform or oversee air dispersion modeling using AERMOD and related tools, including criteria pollutant and toxic/HAP impact assessments. * Support compliance through audits, emissions inventories, monitoring, recordkeeping, reporting, and corrective actions. * Lead air quality support for data centers and power infrastructure, including emergency, standby, and prime\-power generation. * Coordinate permitting with project design, construction schedules, commissioning, and operations. * Serve as a primary client and regulatory agency contact; manage project scopes, budgets, schedules, teams, and technical quality. * Build client relationships and identify opportunities to expand APTIM's services. **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in engineering, environmental science, atmospheric science, or a related technical discipline. * Must have 10\+ years of relevant air quality consulting, permitting, modeling, or compliance experience. * Demonstrated experience with major source permitting, regulatory strategy, dispersion modeling—preferably AERMOD—and federal, state, and local air regulations. * Experience preparing and reviewing emissions calculations, potential\-to\-emit analyses, BACT evaluations, and permit applications. * Strong technical writing, communication, client relationship, and project management skills. * Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities. **Preferred Qualifications:** * PE, CCM, or another relevant professional credential. * Experience with PSD/NSR, Title V, NESHAP/MACT, and NSPS requirements. * Experience permitting data centers, power generation, large combustion sources, industrial facilities, or utility infrastructure. * Experience with complex multi\-source modeling, emergency and non\-emergency generators, and direct coordination with regulatory agencies. **Why APTIM** APTIM brings together environmental consulting, permitting, engineering, construction, EHS, infrastructure, and operational capabilities to help clients address complex projects across their entire lifecycle. For data center and power projects in particular, APTIM can help clients address environmental and regulatory requirements before they become critical\-path issues, while connecting those requirements to site development, engineering, construction, commissioning, and operations. **About APTIM** APTIM enhances the quality of the environment, wellbeing of people, resilience of communities, and opportunity for employees to make a difference, not just a living. A leading professional solutions firm, we specialize in environmental, sustainability, resilience, and infrastructure solutions. Our team of experts provide these integrated solutions for forward\-thinking government agencies, commercial and industrial clients, and energy customers. Together, we create sustainable and resilient communities for all. What you can expect from APTIM: * Work that is worthy of your time and talent * Respect and flexibility to live a full life at work and at home * Dogged determination to deliver for our clients and communities * A voice in making our company better * Investment into your personal and professional development As of the date of this posting, a good faith estimate of the current pay range for this position is $135K to $166K per year. Compensation depends on several factors including: experience, education, key skills, geographic location of the position, client requirements, external market competitiveness, and internal equity among other employees within APTIM. **Employee Benefits** APTIM Environmental \& Infrastructure, llc is committed to providing an extensive range of benefits that protect and promote the health and financial well\-being of our employees and their families through the APTIM Benefits Marketplace https://aptim.makeityoursource.com/. * Medical, vision, and dental insurance: Through the marketplace, our employees can choose benefits from five metallic levels and several carriers to find the right benefits that work for them in their location. * Company paid and optional Life insurance * Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance * Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity coverage * Paid holidays, vacation, and sick leave (eligibility based on company policy and applicable law) * 401(k) APTIM offers three 401k plans through the Aon Pooled Employer Plan (PEP). The specific plan you are eligible for depends on the business unit you are in. The details of the largest plan are found here: * + APTIM 401(k) Guide + APTIM \- Helpful Documents **Watch our video:** **About APTIM \- In Pursuit of Better**
